jobs.description:
Solving the most complex technology and business challenges is what Appficiency is about. As the top partner for creating the new industry benchmarks in the ERP Services, Appficiency is an Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner with over 7 different industry and partner awards. We are a leader in both construction and manufacturing and as a top 5 Alliance Partner, we go to work each day solving the hardest industry problems and sharing these news-worthy achievements to set a higher bar for the professional services and software industry.

The Value

Appficiency understands that people are our greatest strength. We always put our talented people first and invest heavily in their learning and career opportunities. We consistently provide amazing opportunities to learn, innovate and lead. We combine advice with action to develop experts that are knowledgeable and passionate about what they do. Appficiency is committed to developing a culture built on integrity, collaboration and growth, and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. In addition, as part of our growing global network, there are opportunities to work with international teams and clients, or even help lead our global expansion.

The Grind

We have been recognized for being the best at what we do, but we are working smart to do even better and that all starts with you. We are a rapidly growing company at the interchange of business and technology which requires entrepreneurial tenacity, motivation to learn, and enterprise building initiative.

No matter your role, you will be an integral member of the team, focusing on engagements of varying sizes and across diverse industries. In our progressive environment, the projects you work on will drive your learning and accelerate your business acumen and technical expertise.

Our delivery team is a key part of our business engaging with clients with a focus on key stakeholders at the C-Suite level. Working hand in hand with the internal project management and oversight teams to ensure projects are on time, on budget, and in scope.

The Talent

We realize that to maximize value for our clients we need to deliver the best advice and technological solutions unique to their business needs. As part of our team you'll be at the forefront of new initiatives and best practices as we continue to help businesses grow and thrive on the cloud.

We are looking for business and technology smarts; driven and hard-working individuals; and savvy communicators. You are creative, each project comes with unique challenges which requires adapting quickly. You will partner closely with various teams/individuals across countries and cultures. You are an effective communicator.

The Commitment

  • Simultaneously work on 2-4 or more client projects/engagements and oversee 3-5 projects
  • Find new accounts, manage new and existing accounts, assess needs of new customers, build, test and implement NetSuite. .
  • Leading all phases of NetSuite implementation, including requirements gathering, documentation, buildout, validation/demos, testing, and user training.
  • Conduct training sessions/mentoring session with junior consultants
  • Develop expertise in Appficiency's project delivery methodology and ensure its effective application.
  • Gain proficiency in the NetSuite application, its capabilities, and industry-standard business practices.
  • Identify non-standard business processes and recommend effective solutions.
  • Assist clients in designing and implementing their enterprise architecture.
  • Participate in the design, build,testing and support of integrations between clients' business systems.
  • Resolve and provide innovative solutions to any NetSuite issues that clients may encounter.

The Essentials

  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). MBA is an asset.
  • Japan-based, Professional level Japanese language
  • 6+ years of experience as a Functional Consultant or Business Analyst in NetSuite implementation projects.
  • Experience with SaaS solutions, IT systems, software, or specific business models (e.g., distribution, manufacturing, construction, retail, media, and advertising).
  • At least 1-2 years of experience managing direct reports, with proven leadership and team management skills.
  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite modules.
  • Experience designing complex solution in NetSuite
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain profitable, referenceable customer relationships.
  • Strategic thinking skills, with the ability to align client business pain points with solutions and implementation strategies.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills (Japanese and English)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Adaptability to fast-paced environments and shifting priorities.
  • Willingness to travel to client locations as required.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant, Digital Experience Optimization
jobs.excerpt: Ready to Make Your Mark?  As a Senior Consultant at BlastX, you help clients solve the challenges that stand between customer insight and a better digital experience.
jobs.description:
Ready to Make Your Mark?

As a Senior Consultant at BlastX, you help clients solve the challenges that stand between customer insight and a better digital experience. You combine the strategic judgment to uncover friction, prioritize opportunities, and design an experimentation roadmap with the hands-on development skills to build, launch, troubleshoot, and measure sophisticated A/B tests and personalization campaigns.

In this client-facing role, you own optimization from discovery through activation: interpreting quantitative and qualitative insights, shaping test hypotheses, developing experiences with modern web technologies, ensuring technical quality, and translating results into actionable recommendations. You activate audiences, behavioral signals, and MarTech investments to deliver relevant customer experiences and measurable business outcomes. You have an opportunity to Make Your Mark every day on our clients, teammates, company, industry, and community.

Primary Responsibilities
  • Partner directly with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, diagnose digital experience challenges, and advise on optimization and personalization strategy.
  • Analyze web analytics, conversion funnels, customer feedback, heatmaps, session recordings, and user research to identify friction and prioritize high-impact opportunities.
  • Develop test hypotheses, experimentation roadmaps, audience strategies, success metrics, and measurement plans grounded in client goals.
  • Personally design, code, configure, and launch A/B/n, multivariate, multi-page, and personalization experiences using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and leading optimization platforms.
  • Own technical implementation and troubleshooting of client-side experiments, including targeting, audience activation, integrations, and cross-browser/device quality assurance.
  • Work with client developers and cross-functional consultants to implement complex experiences across responsive websites, single-page applications, and mobile environments.
  • Interpret experiment results using sound statistical principles; communicate findings, limitations, and next-step recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Translate research and test ideas into clear requirements, wireframes or mockups as needed, and practical execution plans.
  • Apply audience and behavioral data, including CDP-enabled segments where available, to deliver relevant personalized experiences and measure their impact.
  • Lead client working sessions, present recommendations, train client teams, and strengthen ongoing partnerships through reliable delivery and consultative guidance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve experimentation processes, technical quality, program maturity, and the return on clients’ MarTech investments.
  • Stay current with emerging optimization platforms, privacy requirements, AI/ML capabilities, and modern development practices; contribute to team learning and client growth.

Desired Knowledge, Skills, & Qualifications
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in digital experience optimization, experimentation, front-end development, or consulting, with demonstrated ownership of both strategy and execution.
  • Deep hands-on experience building and troubleshooting A/B tests and personalization campaigns in Adobe Target (strongly preferred); Optimizely or comparable platforms also valuable.
  • Advanced proficiency in vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, DOM manipulation, and jQuery; ability to write production-quality code independently.
  • Amplitude experience is highly desirable.
  • Experience with React or other single-page application frameworks strongly preferred; familiarity with server-side testing is a plus.
  • Proven ability to turn customer and behavioral insights into test hypotheses, prioritization, experimentation plans, and measurable optimization outcomes.
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization, audience segmentation, personalization, and A/B/n or multivariate experimentation methodologies.
  • Comfort interpreting web analytics, qualitative research, and statistical test results to make sound recommendations.
  • Experience with cross-device and cross-browser QA, debugging, privacy constraints, and performance considerations.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts and business implications clearly to client stakeholders and collaborate with designers, analysts, and developers.
  • Experience using customer data platforms for audience activation, mobile experimentation, and Adobe Target/Optimizely certifications are advantageous.
  • Ability to manage multiple client engagements, work independently, and deliver high-quality solutions in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline preferred; equivalent practical experience welcomed.

To Be Successful
Success in this role requires curiosity about customer behavior, rigorous technical craftsmanship, and the confidence to guide clients from problem definition to measurable results.
  • Balances big-picture strategic thinking with close attention to implementation details.
  • Owns outcomes end to end rather than handing off strategy or development to someone else.
  • Approaches ambiguous client challenges with analytical rigor, creativity, and practical problem-solving.
  • Builds trusted relationships through clear communication, collaboration, accountability, and responsiveness.
  • Explains complex technical and statistical concepts in accessible, business-relevant terms.
  • Learns continuously, welcomes feedback, and helps teammates grow.
  • Demonstrates a Make Your Mark mindset through thoughtful, customized solutions and consistently high-quality delivery.

This is a full-time remote opportunity. Travel up to 5% for business purposes, determined by client requests or industry events.

Who We Are
BlastX Consulting provides strategic, digital experience advice and implementation services to help brands drive deeper customer relationships using data-driven insights to optimize the digital experience. Over the past 25 years we have assembled a seasoned team of consultants with deep expertise and experience across a wide array of strategic, technical, and operational disciplines who share a passion for helping brands be customer-centric, creating strategies to enable the ultimate experience across touchpoints.

BlastX Consulting embraces and holds to a set of Core Values and encourages each member of the team to continually find ways to “Make Your Mark” for clients, teammates, the community, the industry, and the company. We are an Inc. magazine top 5000 fastest-growing private company and is also a Great Place to Work-Certified company.

Why Work at BlastX Consulting
We believe in meaningful work. Regardless of role, you'll have the opportunity to Make Your Mark every day, solving challenges and seeing the positive impact of your contributions, as we support leaders to EVOLVE their organizations. Join us to Make Your Mark — on each other, our clients, our company, our industry, and the community. Ask any employee why they come to work here, and they'll say, "to make my mark!" We BELIEVE BlastX Consulting is a Great Place to Work! We are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work since 2019.

Who You Will Work With
Client Service Leads, Cross-functional Consultants, Project Delivery Managers, and other subject matter experts.

Compensation & Benefits
Salary Range: $111,538.00 - $165,000.00 USD annually DOE

We offer a competitive salary based on experience and a supportive, challenging, and fun work environment to ensure teamwork, productivity, and teammate happiness. We offer a flexible PTO policy, 60% employer paid medical insurance coverage options, 100% employer paid dental and vision insurance, 401k 4% company matching, profit sharing, education assistance, paid parental leave, performance-based salary increases, and year-end incentive bonuses.

We are not interested in placement agencies or companies at this time. BlastX Consulting is an “at-will” employer. Compensation, benefits, and job descriptions are subject to change based on individual performance and business conditions. BlastX Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO).

jobs.description:
Account Executive

Remote | Canada or US

Overview

Labbit is a modern Laboratory Information Management (LIMS), informatics, and workflow execution platform built for regulated laboratories with complex, evolving processes across molecular diagnostics, biologics, cell and gene therapy, pharma, and more. We’re looking for an Account Executive to join our growing sales team to help organizations move beyond the limitations of legacy LIMS and adopt a more flexible approach to laboratory operations. This is a full-cycle enterprise sales role for a consultative seller who can navigate complex buying environments and engage stakeholders across the lab, IT, quality, manufacturing, and executive teams.

What you'll do

As an Account Executive, you’ll own the full enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation, close, and handoff. You’ll build and manage a pipeline of approximately 10–15 active opportunities, develop strategies for complex multi-month sales cycles, and lead consultative conversations with laboratory, scientific, quality control, IT, QA/RA, business, engineering, manufacturing, and executive stakeholders. You’ll conduct discovery, lead presentations and demonstrations, develop proposals, negotiate commercial terms, and build trusted relationships with decision-makers and champions throughout the buying process.

You’ll work closely with Marketing, Solutions, Product, and Customer Success to execute outbound prospecting campaigns, generate opportunities, deliver a coordinated customer experience, and expand Labbit’s presence within target accounts and markets. You’ll maintain accurate CRM and forecasting data, stay current on trends and the competitive landscape across laboratory informatics and life sciences, and represent Labbit at industry events and customer meetings.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas in a B2B environment.
  • Demonstrated success selling complex, technical solutions with typical deal sizes of 100K–1M+ and sales cycles anywhere from 3-18 months.
  • Experience driving net-new customer acquisition and revenue, managing approximately 10–15 active opportunities through the full sales cycle.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales, engaging effectively with technical, scientific, business, and executive decision-makers.
  • Experience and demonstrated effectiveness with business development and lead generation activities, and a willingness to execute these activities directly
  • Experience selling into life sciences, particularly pharma, biologics, biotech, clinical diagnostics, quality control, manufacturing, cell and gene therapy, or related laboratory environments.
  • Domain expertise in QC LIMS and/or Lab Software Solutions in the above industries
  • Strong consultative selling skills, including the ability to conduct discovery, understand complex laboratory workflows and business challenges, and translate customer needs into compelling business outcomes.
  • Experience developing pricing proposals, negotiating commercial and contract terms, and successfully driving opportunities through to close.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS and subscription-based revenue models, including ARR, MRR, renewals, and pipeline forecasting, with experience using CRM tools such as HubSpot.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, organization, prioritization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to adapt and operate effectively in a rapidly changing environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, combined with a highly motivated, competitive, collaborative mindset and a genuine desire to learn, be coached, and continuously develop as an enterprise software sales professional.

You’ll stand out if you have:

  • Deep experience with LIMS, laboratory informatics, or adjacent laboratory software.
  • Knowledge of laboratory compliance and regulatory requirements such as CLIA, CAP, GMP, 21 CFR Part 11 & 820, ISO/IEC 17025, etc.
  • Experience engaging with lab directors, quality stakeholders, executive IT leaders, other laboratory representatives, manufacturing leaders, or operations executives.
  • Familiarity with the informatics needs of genomic, proteomic, molecular diagnostics, cell and gene therapy, biologics, and pharma organizations.
  • Experience translating complex scientific and data-management challenges into clear business outcomes.
  • Knowledge of the competitive landscape across LIMS, laboratory informatics, and related life sciences software.
  • Experience selling to CROs, biotech, pharma, QC manufacturing, or other highly regulated laboratory environments.
  • Experience developing relationships with industry partners to identify target segments and create new pipeline opportunities.

To further support our team, we offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive vacation
  • Flexible health spending account / Health Insurance
  • RRSP / 401 K matching
  • Annual professional development budget
  • The expected salary range for this role is: $125,000 - $162,00 base salary with a competitive variable compensation plan.
    Actual compensation may vary based on experience, domain expertise, and geographic location.

Senior Software Engineer (Node.js)

Important: This role is open only to candidates currently living in Mexico or Latin America. Applications from other regions will not be considered.

Join MagmaLabs, a leading provider of expert software engineers dedicated to helping companies achieve their goals across diverse and impactful industries. We are actively seeking a seasoned Senior Software Engineer (Node.js) to join our fully remote team.

In this pivotal role, you will apply your passion for building scalable, high-performance backend systems to solve complex challenges for our clients in healthtech, e-commerce, fintech, and other fast-growing sectors. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining modern backend architectures powered by Node.js and cloud-native technologies, directly contributing to our clients’ success while driving technical excellence across projects.

About the Role

Are you a seasoned Backend Engineer passionate about building reliable, secure, and scalable systems with Node.js?

As a Senior Software Engineer (Node.js), you will take ownership of architectural decisions, lead backend initiatives, and ensure best practices across high-traffic APIs, SaaS platforms, and distributed systems. You’ll balance delivery speed with long-term maintainability, performance optimization, security, and observability.

Your contributions will directly impact system reliability, developer productivity, and business scalability.

If you thrive on solving complex backend challenges using modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architectural design, development, and continuous evolution of scalable backend applications using Node.js (preferably with TypeScript).
  • Design and implement RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs with clear versioning, validation, documentation, and error-handling standards.
  • Optimize database performance (primarily PostgreSQL), including schema design, indexing strategies, query tuning, and transaction management.
  • Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs, and event-driven workflows using modern queue or messaging systems.
  • Design resilient integrations with third-party APIs and services (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, monitoring).
  • Ensure code quality and reliability through automated testing (unit, integration, and contract tests).

jobs.description:
Department: Operations

Reports to: Head of Technical

Salary:Circa £75K (depending on experience and voltage level accreditations) i.e LV, HV & EHV

Location: Remote (ideal candidate would be based near to Manchester)

The Opportunity

Join Leep and play a critical role in keeping our electricity networks safe, compliant and connected. As a Control Engineer, you'll be responsible for the safe operation of our HV and LV networks, ensuring that authorised staff, Independent Connection Providers (ICPs), repair contractors and streetlighting teams work in line with Leep's Distribution Safety Rules and Approved Codes of Practice.

You'll maintain network configuration control, oversee networks under construction, support supply restoration activities, and lead a small team of Duty Control Engineers to ensure a Safe System of Work is always maintained. Operating within a 24/7/365 control environment, you'll be part of a 1-in-3 rota, helping to ensure the resilience, regulatory compliance and safe management of Leep's licensed networks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with developers, ICPs, streetlighting partners, contractors and wider stakeholders, promoting Leep Control's processes and maintaining Leep Utilities' reputation as a reliable and compliant IDNO.

  • Onboard, technically assess and manage ICPs, Developers and Streetlighting Partners for LV self-authorisation status, including ongoing technical compliance reviews and audits.

  • Support the auditing and compliance management of designated Repairing Contractors (MERs), including onboarding, periodic reviews and site audits.

  • Own, develop and maintain relevant Approved Codes of Practice (ACOPs), Group Standard Operating Procedures (GSoPs) and other operational documentation required to ensure a Safe System of Work (SSoW) across Leep's networks.

  • Ensure all activities undertaken under Transfer of Control (ToC) arrangements comply with Leep's Codes of Practice, GSoPs, SHEQ policies, UK legislation, ENA Engineering Recommendations, Ofgem licence obligations and wider regulatory requirements.

  • Undertake and coordinate supply restoration activities, ensuring incidents are managed safely, escalated appropriately and delivered within Ofgem standards of performance (SLC15A).

  • Utilise network monitoring systems, live network drawings (VizNet) and other operational tools to support safe, informed real-time network decision-making and restoration activities.

  • Support the ongoing development, implementation and monitoring of Control systems, including SCADA and network modelling applications.

  • Deliver Control training to Duty Control Engineers and provide role-specific training and guidance to operational and project teams.

  • Maintain accurate and auditable records of network control activities, including authorisations, energisation requests, supply restoration activities, site mimics, control logs and operational handovers.

  • Coordinate daily and weekly operational governance activities, including Control handovers, Control meetings, action tracking and the management of Control-related requests for information.

  • Monitor and manage the Control mailbox, ensuring enquiries and requests are distributed and actioned appropriately.

  • Support operational risk reviews, budget planning, forecasting and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance the efficiency, resilience and compliance of Leep's network operations.

  • Participate in the 24/7/365 Control rota, undertaking the Duty Control and Supply Restoration Manager role on a 1-in-3 basis.

Measures of Success

  • Safe and compliant operation of Leep's HV and LV networks, with no preventable breaches of Distribution Safety Rules, Approved Codes of Practice or regulatory requirements.

  • Supply restoration activities delivered safely, efficiently and within applicable Ofgem Standards of Performance.

  • Safe Systems of Work maintained across all sites operating under Transfer of Control arrangements, supported by robust compliance auditing and contractor oversight.

  • Accurate, auditable and up-to-date network records, control logs and operational documentation maintained at all times.

  • A resilient and effective 24/7/365 Control function, providing high-quality support to customers, contractors, partners and internal stakeholders

About You

Essential

  • Proven experience managing LV network operations and supply restoration activities.

  • Experience working under the direction of Control within a network operations environment.

  • Strong working knowledge and application of safety documentation, including LOAs, Permits, TOCs, IOEs and SFTs.

  • Hold industry LV and 11kV network authorisations, with a minimum qualification of SAP (11kV).

  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise changing workloads and respond to urgent operational requirements.

  • High levels of accuracy and attention to detail, particularly in maintaining Control logs and network records.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work professionally and effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Competent in Microsoft Office applications.

  • A safe, pragmatic approach to network management, policy development and regulatory compliance.

Desirable

  • Experience managing limited HV supply restoration activities.

  • Experience working within a Control environment.

  • Experience leading and coordinating remote restoration teams across both civils and electrical disciplines.

  • Knowledge and experience of street works and civils activities.

  • Experience developing Codes of Practice, operational procedures and other technical documentation.

Your Development and Benefits

At Leep, we believe in stable growth and putting our people first. Our 5-year strategic growth plan gives us stability today and prepares us for the future, while nurturing a strong collaborative and supportive culture.

Our benefits include:

  • Salary which aligns to your experience and skillset

  • 25 days paid holiday + bank holidays

  • An additional day off to celebrate your birthday

  • Annual discretionary bonus

  • Car allowance

  • Company pension plan

  • Health Cash plan through Westfield Health

  • Option to purchase additional holiday days through our Holiday Buying Scheme

  • Engagement committee with events throughout the year, including Christmas Party, Summer Party and individual team socials

  • Paid professional memberships relevant to your role and access to professional development opportunities

Our Values

At the forefront of everything we do:

Safety, Customer Promise, Accountability, Reliability, Respect, Flexibility

Equal Opportunities

Leep Utilities is committed to promoting equality of opportunity for all staff and job applicants. We aim to create a working environment in which all individuals are able to make best use of their skills, free from discrimination or harassment. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you require any appropriate accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know.

jobs.description:
VERSIONE ITALIANA

CDP Venture Capital – insieme a Mutti, Sipcam Oxon, Crédit Agricole Italia e GELLIFY – lancia Novagria Ventures, il nuovo venture builder dedicato alla filiera agroalimentare italiana.

🎯 Obiettivo:creare fino a 6 nuove startup in 3 anni, mobilitando oltre 45 milioni di euro di investimenti complessivi per colmare i gap di digitalizzazione e sostenibilità della filiera.

🚀Il ruolo: Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) —Future CTO

Cerchiamo builder tecnologici pronti a diventare CTO & co-founder di una delle prossime startup che nasceranno dentro Novagria Ventures.

Come EIR sarai il motore tech della futura venture.
Partirai da una value proposition già pre-validata dal team GELLIFY e avrai la responsabilità di:

Product & Tech Ownership

  • Disegnare l’architettura della soluzione (anche no-code/low-code nelle fasi iniziali)
  • Coordinare lo sviluppo dell’MVP con designer e developer
  • Validare use case, feature, prototipi e metriche
  • Guidare la tech roadmap verso product-market fit

Market Validation & Growth

  • Testare MVP e iterare rapidamente sul prodotto
  • Supportare go-to-market, acquisire early users e sviluppare primi PoC
  • Identificare le metriche chiave per PMF

Fundraising & Leadership

  • Contribuire alla preparazione del round seed
  • Presentare la soluzione a investitori e partner
  • Costruire il futuro team tech (engineering, data, AI)

Obiettivo finale: diventare CTO & co-founder della startup dopo lo spin-off.

💡Chi cerchiamo

Un/una imprenditore·trice con anima da builder e forte competenza tecnologica.

Must have

  • 5–10 anni in: Product, Engineering, Tech Leadership, Startup, Venture Building
  • Provata esperienza con:
    • Architetture Full stack: sviluppo end-to-end di applicazioni web (frontend + backend + DB + deploy) su stack tecnologico React/Node.js con almeno un prodotto portato in produzione.
    • Architetture cloud: progettazione e sviluppo di sistemi scalabili, affidabili e sicuri da ambienti Cloud (microservizi / API-first).
    • Data & integrazione: progettazione di basi dati (SQL + NoSQL), data pipeline di base, integrazione via API.
    • Security & privacy: principi di sicurezza applicativa, gestione identità e accessi.
    • DevOps / Delivery: CI/CD, containerizzazione (es. Docker), monitoring, logging.
  • Esperienza pratica con MVP digitali, prototipazione e validazione rapida
  • Ottima capacità di tradurre problemi complessi in soluzioni scalabili
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, velocità, execution

Nice to have

  • Esperienza da founder o first-hire in startup early stage
  • Background in: AI/ML, SaaS, IoT, piattaforme B2B, cloud architecture
  • Interesse per agritech, foodtech, supply chain, sustainability

💰 Cosa offriamo

  • Retribuzione durante il periodo di lavoro all’interno di Novagria
  • Equity nella startup che sarà scorporata
  • Lavoro full-remote
  • Opportunità concreta di diventare CTO e co-founder di una startup backed da corporate top-tier

🌍Perché unirti a Novagria Ventures

  • Costruisci startup con un impatto reale sulla filiera agroalimentare italiana grazie al supporto dei partner CDP Venture Capital, GELLIFY, Mutti, Sipcam Oxon e Crédit Agricole Italia
  • Lavori in Le Village by CA Parma, cuore dell’innovazione agri-food
  • Impari un metodo di venture building replicabile e scalabile
  • Cresci come imprenditore, con supporto finanziario, operativo e strategico

🎬Come candidarti

Crediamo che i futuri founder si riconoscano dal modo in cui pensano.

Oltre al CV / LinkedIn, inviaci un breve video Loom (max 1 minuto) in cui racconti:

  • Quali problemi tech ti appassionano oggi e perché
  • Un prodotto o MVP che hai costruito o validato
  • Perché vuoi diventare CTO/co-founder con Novagria adesso

Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91 e D.Lgs 198/2006

ENGLISH VERSION

CDP Venture Capital, Mutti, Sipcam Oxon, Crédit Agricole Italia and GELLIFY have just launched Novagria Ventures, the new venture builder dedicated to the Italian agrifood value chain.

🎯 Goal: build up to 6 new startups in 3 years, mobilizing over €45M in total investments to bridge the digitalization and sustainability gaps across the supply chain.

🚀 The Role: Entrepreneur in Residence (EIR) — Future CTO

We are looking for technology builders ready to become CTO & co-founder of one of the next startups created within Novagria Ventures.

As an EIR, you will be the tech engine of a future venture.
You will start from a value proposition already pre-validated by the GELLIFY team, and you will be responsible for:

Product & Tech Ownership

  • Design the solution architecture (including no-code/low-code approaches in early stages)
  • Coordinate MVP development with designers and developers
  • Validate use cases, features, prototypes, and metrics
  • Drive the tech roadmap toward product–market fit

Market Validation & Growth

  • Test the MVP and iterate rapidly on the product
  • Support go-to-market activities, onboard early users, and develop initial PoCs
  • Identify the key metrics required for PMF

Fundraising & Leadership

  • Contribute to the preparation of the seed round
  • Present the solution to investors and strategic partners
  • Build the future tech team (engineering, data, AI)

🎯 Ultimate goal: become CTO & co-founder of the startup after the spin-off.

💡 Who We’re Looking For

An entrepreneurial builder with strong technological expertise.

Must Have

5–10 years of experience in Product, Engineering, Tech Leadership, Startup or Venture Building roles.

Proven experience with:

  • Full-Stack Architectures: end-to-end development of web applications (frontend + backend + DB + deployment) using React/Node.js, with at least one product shipped to production.
  • Cloud Architectures: designing and developing scalable, reliable, and secure cloud-based systems (microservices / API-first).
  • Data & Integration: SQL + NoSQL database design, basic data pipelines, API integrations.
  • Security & Privacy: application security principles, identity and access management.
  • DevOps / Delivery: CI/CD, containerization (e.g., Docker), monitoring, logging.
  • Hands-on experience with MVPs, prototyping, and rapid validation
  • Excellent ability to translate complex problems into scalable solutions
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, speed, execution

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience as a founder or first-hire in an early-stage startup
  • Background in AI/ML, SaaS, IoT, B2B platforms, cloud architecture
  • Interest in agritech, foodtech, supply chain, sustainability

💰 What We Offer

  • Compensation during your residency within Novagria
  • Equity in the spin-off startup
  • Full-remote work option
  • A concrete opportunity to become CTO & co-founder of a startup backed by top-tier corporate players

🌍 Why Join Novagria Ventures

  • Build startups with real impact on the Italian agrifood supply chain, supported by CDP Venture Capital, GELLIFY, Mutti, Sipcam Oxon, and Crédit Agricole Italia
  • Work from Le Village by CA Parma, a leading hub for agrifood innovation
  • Learn a replicable, scalable venture-building method
  • Grow as an entrepreneur with strategic, operational, and financial support

🎬 How to Apply

We believe future founders reveal themselves through how they think.

Along with your CV / LinkedIn profile, send us a short Loom video (max 1 minute) explaining:

  • Which tech problems excite you today—and why
  • A product or MVP you built or validated
  • Why you want to become a CTO/co-founder with Novagria right now

This job advertisement is open to candidates of all genders, in accordance with Laws 903/77 and 125/91 and Legislative Decree 198/2006

jobs.excerpt: About Homeaglow Homeaglow’s mission is to create happy homes.
jobs.description:
About Homeaglow

Homeaglow’s mission is to create happy homes. We delight customers and empower cleaning professionals by building the leading platform for home services. Today, we are the world’s largest marketplace for home cleanings. Tomorrow, we’ll be the world’s leading platform for all home services.

We are transforming the home services industry by making high-quality home cleanings more accessible, affordable, and transparent for everyone. We connect customers with independent, background-checked cleaning professionals through a modern technology platform that simplifies booking, pricing, and communication.

Why Join Homeaglow?

A True Startup Environment

Join a high-growth, entrepreneurial company where speed, ownership, and impact define the culture.

Sustained, Profitable Growth

Double-digit year-over-year growth at a nine-figure revenue scale, while serving less than 0.5% of U.S. households — with significant runway ahead.

Strong Unit Economics

Disciplined focus on LTV/CAC and long-term value creation drives sustainable expansion.

Bootstrapped & Focused

No liquidation preferences. No distracting investor pressure. Just stable priorities and long-term thinking.

Real Economic Impact

Over 100,000 cleaning professionals have earned $250M+ through our platform. Average earnings are ~50% higher than traditional hotel housekeeping roles.

Vertical Expansion Strategy

Significant opportunity to expand into adjacent services and deepen customer relationships.

Building a World-Class Team

Be part of a professional, high-caliber team scaling a category-defining platform.

About the Role

Homeaglow is looking for a Director of Finance who thinks like an operator and acts like a strategist. This is not a role for someone who lives in variance reports. We want someone who uses financial data as a lens to understand our business, identify leverage points, and help leadership make better decisions faster.

You will be a key voice in the room when we are deciding where to invest, what to cut, how to price, and how to grow. You will own the financial narrative of the company — not just the numbers behind it.

What You’ll Do

Strategic Financial Leadership

  • Partner directly with the leadership team to translate financial data into strategic recommendations — pricing, unit economics, capital allocation, and growth bets.
  • Build and maintain financial models that drive decision-making, not just report history. Your models should answer “what should we do” as much as “what happened.”
  • Identify inflection points in the business before they show up in the income statement — through cohort analysis, leading indicators, and operational metrics.
  • Evaluate new initiatives, partnerships, and investments with rigorous but fast financial analysis. Be the person who pressure-tests ideas without killing momentum.
  • Develop a deep understanding of our unit economics (CAC, LTV, RNR, contribution margin) and communicate them clearly to inform resource allocation and prioritization.

Finance & Accounting Oversight

  • Lead and develop the Finance and Accounting teams, setting high standards for accuracy, timeliness, and analytical rigor.
  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process — but orient your team toward forward-looking insight, not just backward-looking reconciliation.
  • Ensure financial reporting is clean, consistent, and audit-ready. Establish controls and processes that scale with the business.
  • Manage cash flow, runway, and treasury with a clear-eyed view of the company’s financial position at all times.
  • Oversee tax strategy and compliance, working with external advisors as needed.

Planning & Forecasting

  • Drive the annual planning process — not as an exercise in spreadsheet management, but as a tool for aligning the company on priorities and trade-offs.
  • Maintain a rolling forecast that reflects real business dynamics, not just last year plus a growth rate.
  • Build scenario models that help leadership understand the financial implications of different strategic paths.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of progressive finance experience, with meaningful time in FP&A, investment banking, management consulting, or a high-growth startup.
  • Demonstrated experience influencing business strategy with financial analysis — not just building models, but changing decisions.
  • Strong command of unit economics, cohort modeling, and the financial drivers of marketplace or subscription businesses.
  • Exceptional communicator who can translate complex financial concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders.
  • Prior experience managing a finance or accounting team.
  • High comfort with ambiguity. You don’t need perfect data to form a useful point of view.
  • Low ego, high standards. You’d rather be right than look smart.

Who Thrives Here

This role is ideal for a finance leader who is energized by the question “what does this mean for the business?” — not “how do we explain the variance?” You should be as comfortable in a strategic planning meeting as you are reviewing a reconciliation. You move fast, communicate crisply, and treat financial analysis as a means to an end: building a better business.

This role is not for someone looking to run a tightly scoped accounting function or whose primary output is monthly close packages. We have operational finance needs and you will own them — but that is the floor, not the ceiling.

Perks and Benefits

  • Health insurance fully covered by the company.
  • Parental leave.
  • Flexible / unlimited PTO policy.
  • Cleaning membership perk – Free Homeaglow membership with complimentary cleanings. Enjoy up to 2x cleanings a month, capped at $200 USD per cleaning.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Homeaglow is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

Accommodations

We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout our hiring process. Please let us know if you require any adjustments.

Pay Transparency

Compensation ranges are available upon request. Final offers are based on experience, skills, and location in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws.

Who We Are

Scratch Financial (“Scratch”) is a late stage venture-backed financial technology business based in Pasadena, California. At Scratch, everything starts and ends with our mission: being the payment partner of choice for veterinary practices and helping pet parents access the care their animals need without financial barriers. Driven by our award-winning technology, Scratch has become the fastest growing financing provider in veterinary care, with a partner network of 17,000+ practices across the U.S. and Canada.

Scratch has 2 main products:

  1. Scratch Pay: Point-of-sale lending, including a BNPL offering and longer-term payment plans
  2. Scratch Checkout: Payment processing that is integrated with the veterinary practice management software

We are a company built on the foundation of transforming the way pet healthcare payments are done, and we are looking for innovators who share our commitment to shaping the future of veterinary care financing. If putting compassion first, helping tell the story of groundbreaking products and continuously learning & refining to achieve exceptional outcomes sounds like you, then we encourage you to apply.

Position Overview

Senior Staff Accountant to assist primarily in daily, weekly and monthly accounting and reconciliation for our payments processing side of the business and is a core partner to the Director of Accounting/Controller in the monthly close. The position will also support all monthly close tasks and reconciliations across the entire business, including relating to our loan portfolio and other revenue streams.

What You'll Do

  • Pull and analyze transactions from our BigQuery database, transforming it in Google Sheets/Excel, and importing detailed and summarized entries into QuickBooks Online for the payments processing business.
  • Calculate, run, and analyze monthly billing for the payments processing business including ensuring and tracking AR related to billing, ensuring payments from our customers are drafted timely and entering payments for AR into QuickBooks Online timely for proper review and analysis.
  • Reconcile payments processing activity by clinic and clinic consolidators on a monthly basis to ensure data integrity, analyzing discrepancies and working with the Product and Revenue Teams to resolve differences in a timely manner.
  • Own a defined set of month end close tasks against the month end close calendar including journal entries, accruals, and other required schedules.
  • Support month end close tasks for the lending business, including journal entries and account reconciliations as needed and serving as a backup for daily and monthly lending reporting as needed.
  • Assist in preparing schedules for the annual audit and other various financial audits including searching for and providing support requested by the auditors for testing.
  • Other special projects as assigned by the Director of Accounting/Controller.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP and accrual accounting.
  • Hands-on experience with month-end close and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and working with large transaction files.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, especially Google Sheets, Docs and Drive.
  • High attention to detail

Nice to Have

  • Experience with QuickBooks Online (Advanced preferred), including bulk journal entry and transaction imports through native or third-party import tools.
  • Ability to write and run queries in Google BigQuery (or similar SQL tools) to pull, join, and analyze transaction data.
  • Experience in payments, merchant services, fintech, or lending.
  • Exposure to multi-currency accounting or Canadian operations.
  • Experience with a loan servicing platform such as LoanPro.
  • Experience in Stripe or related platforms.
  • CPA (or progress toward it)

What You Can Expect From Our Process

While these steps may vary slightly from role to role, we aim for a well-rounded interview approach for all involved.

  1. A quick chat with People Ops (HR): To ensure logistics and team fit make sense from both sides.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview: To dive deeper into your experience, fit for the role, and answer any questions you have about the team.
  3. Panel Style Interview/Presentation or Live Coding (Tech roles): A practical exercise to showcase your skills and approach with a cross-functional panel.
  4. Executive-Level Interviews & Reference Checks: A chance for you to meet our leaders, discuss big-picture alignment, and introduce us to your professional references.
  5. In-Person Connection: We include an in-person visit at our Pasadena HQ, either as a final interview step or during your first week of onboarding, so we can connect face-to-face right from the start!

Why You'll Love Working Here

Competitive base salary ranging from $120,000 - $130,000 + equity

While Scratch supports remote work for most roles, we believe the secret sauce to our team culture is meaningful connection and close collaboration. For those nearby or visiting, our Pasadena office is fully open and stocked with snacks and drinks for hybrid work. We also bring the whole company together each year for Hub Day, our annual onsite where everyone gathers in person to bond, align, and celebrate our wins together!

Alongside our collaborative team environment, we offer unlimited PTO, covered healthcare, flex benefits, 401(k) matching, cell plan reimbursement, monthly recognition opportunities, continuous learning resources, an equity retention program, and generous parental leave!

How to Apply

Ready to join our team? To apply, please visit our Scratch Careers Page. Be sure to:

  1. Submit your resume.
  2. Answer the custom questions provided.
  3. Feel free to add any additional information or documents you believe are relevant to your application.

We look forward to reviewing your application!

*Our team will ONLY contact you from the domain @scratchpay.com or @ats.rippling.com

Our Commitment

We’re innovators who care deeply about the lives of pets, their owners, and veterinary professionals. We believe diversity strengthens our team and drives better solutions.

Scratch is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Scratch considers qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT onXWe’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors.
jobs.description:
ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Product Launch Manager to help bring an exciting new connected product experience to market, designed to work seamlessly with the onX Hunt app and create new possibilities for our customers.

This role will play a key part in bringing that experience to life, independently driving launch execution from beta through broader availability. You'll coordinate across engineering, operations, marketing, and customer experience, keeping timelines, dependencies, and teams aligned as we navigate the complexities of a new product launch.

Working closely with leadership, you'll translate launch plans into coordinated action, proactively identifying risks, navigating day-to-day challenges, and helping teams stay focused on shared milestones. As onX expands into new product experiences, you'll have the opportunity to apply lessons learned, improve launch processes, and help establish a strong foundation for future launches.

This role reports to the Director of Connected Devices.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

  • Own and manage the end-to-end launch timeline, milestones, and deliverables across hardware, software, marketing, operations, and customer experience.
  • Coordinate launch activities from beta through broader availability, ensuring key milestones and dependencies are aligned across teams.
  • Partner with manufacturing partners to coordinate production timelines and ensure internal teams are prepared for critical launch milestones.
  • Proactively identify, track, and manage cross-functional dependencies, risks, and potential roadblocks to keep launch activities on track.
  • Drive day-to-day launch execution, ensuring teams have clear ownership, priorities, and accountability for their deliverables.
  • Monitor launch readiness and progress, identifying gaps and working with cross-functional partners to address issues before they impact timelines.
  • Facilitate clear, consistent communication across stakeholders, providing visibility into launch status, key decisions, risks, and upcoming milestones.
  • Navigate day-to-day execution challenges independently, escalating complex trade-offs or competing priorities that require broader leadership alignment.
  • Demonstrate onX's Company Values by fostering accountability, building trust across cross-functional teams, and proactively addressing challenges to keep launch activities moving forward.
  • Look for opportunities to embed AI as a repeatable co-pilot in daily workflows, integrating experimentation into real work and refining its use with sound judgment and validation.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in program management, project management, product launches, or related work involving complex, cross-functional initiatives.
    • Experience with physical or hardware products is required.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently coordinate multiple workstreams, manage competing deadlines, and drive projects toward successful completion.
  • Strong project management skills, including timeline development, milestone tracking, dependency management, and risk mitigation.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, building alignment, and driving accountability without direct authority.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate challenges, work through day-to-day obstacles, and recognize when issues require escalation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate progress, risks, and priorities to diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to evolving priorities, and maintain momentum in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to thoughtfully explore and apply AI tools to streamline launch planning, track dependencies, improve stakeholder communication, and enhance day-to-day execution, while exercising sound judgment and validating outputs.
  • A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.
  • Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.
  • Ability to travel up to quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

  • Experience supporting the launch of a new physical product or product category, particularly from beta through commercial availability.
  • Experience with devices or products that integrate hardware, software, and subscription or membership services.
  • Experience coordinating production schedules, launch milestones, and dependencies with overseas manufacturing partners.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $120,000 and $150,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

  • Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
  • Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents

The Salesforce Developer owns Fullbay’s Salesforce platform end to end, from day-to-day administration and configuration through custom Apex and Lightning Web Component development. This role determines when a requirement calls for declarative configuration and when it calls for code, then builds the solution directly. Working closely with Sales, Finance, and Operations stakeholders across Sales Cloud, Einstein AI, and the Nue CPQ platform and its integrations with QuickBooks and Stripe, the Salesforce Developer is accountable for both the daily health of the platform and its long-term technical architecture.

Right Wrench for the Job:

The right wrench for this job enjoys the full spectrum of Salesforce work, from resolving a user’s support request in the morning to delivering a custom Apex integration in the afternoon. This individual takes ownership of both the daily health of the platform and its long-term architecture, builds solutions that scale, and partners with Sales, Finance, and Operations to understand the business need before building.

  • Platform Ownership & Administration

    • Debug and resolve production issues in a timely manner across both configuration and code
    • Manage sandbox environments and CI/CD / change-set deployment processes
  • Development & Engineering
    • Design and develop custom Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, and scheduled jobs

    • Adheres to all confidentiality, compliance, and company standards

    • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
    • Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant
    • Salesforce Certified Integration Architecture Designer

    • Experience with CPQ tools (Nue, Salesforce CPQ, or similar) and order-to-cash / quote-to-cash workflows

jobs.excerpt: Interim Managing DirectorCalifornia Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP) Housed at Koreatown Immigrant Workers Alliance (KIWA) About CCWPThe California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP) is a statewide table of worker centers, labor policy advocates, and unions advancing strategies that build durable worker power across California.
jobs.description:
Interim Managing Director

California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP)
Housed at Koreatown Immigrant Workers Alliance (KIWA)

About CCWP

The California Coalition for Worker Power (CCWP) is a statewide table of worker centers, labor policy advocates, and unions advancing strategies that build durable worker power across California. Our coalition focuses on structural reforms that strengthen worker organizations, expand collective voice, and protect workers, including immigrant and Black workers, from retaliation and exploitation.California Coalition for Worker Power seeks an Interim Managing Director who understands coalition dynamics, coalition tables, operational systems and finances and can work collaboratively with CCWP leadership team, staff, and partners.

Overview

  • Position Type: At-will, temporary, exempt
  • Location: Remote, must be California-based
  • Duration: 6-18 months
  • Reports To: KIWA’s Executive Director, Coalition Co-Presidents and Co-Managing Directors

Position Summary

California Coalition for Worker Power seeks an experienced and hands-on Interim Managing Director to provide financial leadership and operational support during a short-term transition period. The Interim Managing Director will set up systems and oversee the organization’s financial operations, strengthen organizational digital security protocols, partner with the leadership team to fundraise strategy, and provide oversight of organizational activities, priorities, projects and decisions.

The ideal candidate is a proven operations and executive leader who can quickly create unified finance systems, oversee priorities, and work effectively with directors, staff, finance, and coalition partners to execute plans.

Job Description

We are seeking a proven and experienced Interim Managing Director who will provide strategic and operational leadership to set up systems to the coalition’s continued growth, effectiveness, and alignment during a period of transition. Working closely with coalition leadership, staff, and member organizations, the Interim Managing Director will create and strengthen internal systems, facilitate cross-coalition coordination, and ensure that organizational priorities are translated into clear plans and effective execution.

The Interim Managing Director will partner with CCWP leadership and workgroups to lead the following areas:

Finance & Administration

  • Working with coalition leadership, drive a process to consolidate the coalition’s organizational structure, including transition to a single fiscal entity.
  • Oversee the completion of the coalition’s financial systems, including identifying gaps and implementing practical systems to improve financial visibility, accountability, compliance and decision-making.
  • Lead and oversee the 2027 budget process and subgrants process including the development of overall strategy, support decision-making regarding overall budget and subgrant amounts, coordinate with staff, manage disbursements, and ensure appropriate financial documentation and accountability
  • Work with all relevant parties to ensure compliance with coalition’s financial policies and procedures, as well as applicable grant requirements, accounting standards, and other financial obligations
  • Monitor budget-to-actual performance, identify trends, variances and potential areas of over- or underspending and proactively collaborate with staff and leadership team.
  • Support the development and implementation of organizational security protocols.

Organizational Operations

  • Lead the day-to-day operations of the coalition; ensure that decision-making structures, roles, responsibilities, and processes are clear, effective, and aligned with the coalition's long term agenda and goals.
  • Ensure continuity between coalition meetings and decision-making spaces, communicate decisions, next steps, ownership, and timelines so that collective work moves forward between convenings, and retreats.
  • Serve as strategic thought partner to coalition leadership, help navigate competing priorities, resolve organizational and governance challenges, and maintain focus on shared goals.
  • Maintain clear governance documentation, include decisions, policies, roles, meeting records, workplans, and other materials necessary to support institutional memory and accountability.
  • Evaluate and strengthen coalition governance practices over time, use feedback and experience to improve how the coalition makes decisions, shares power, manages conflict, and advances collective work.

Leadership Support

  • Coordinate and facilitate staff and Leadership team meetings including develop agendas, sequence and prioritize topics, manage scheduling, and ensure clear decisions and next stepsPlan and coordinate Leadership Team and Coordinating Committee retreats, ensuring clear objects, effective agendas, strong facilitation, and alignment with organizational priorities
  • Provide strategic oversight of organizational priorities, ensuring that key initiatives, projects, and meetings remain focused on the coalition’s measurable outcomes, and long term vision..
  • Track organizational commitments, priorities and deliverables, proactively identifying potential delays, competing demands or capacity challenges and sounding the alarm when commitments or timelines are at risk

Job Qualifications

The ideal candidate is a strategic, systems-oriented leader who brings strong attention to detail while maintaining a clear understanding of the organization’s broader goals and mission. They are comfortable operating in complex, fast-moving environments and have the ability to translate strategy into effective systems, processes, and action.

The successful candidate will have:

  • Strong systems thinking and attention to detail, with the ability to see the big picture, connect across functions, and build practical systems that support organizational effectiveness.
  • Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to develop plans, establish timelines, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure projects move from strategy to completion.
  • The ability to thrive in complexity, manage competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment in a dynamic, mission-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with financial systems and tools, including QuickBooks, Bill.com, and related nonprofit financial management systems.
  • Understanding of nonprofit organizational structures and organizational development and security, with an appreciation for the systems, processes, and culture needed to support a healthy and effective organization.
  • Experience with coalition-based work, including the ability to build relationships, coordinate across diverse stakeholders, follow through on commitments, and help groups move from discussion to action.
  • Familiarity with the California labor movement, including an understanding of its organizations, stakeholders, priorities, and organizing and coalition-building approaches.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust, create accountability, and move work forward across teams and organizations.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach, with the ability to identify what needs to happen, bring the right people together, and follow through to get it done.
  • Being bilingual in Spanish is a plus.

Compensation and Benefits

Salary: $135,000 to $150,000 annual, to be negotiated based on experience and scope.

Benefits: Employee healthcare, dental and vision plan; PTO and paid holidays; 403b retirement plan

Supervision & Collaboration Structure

The Interim Managing Director will:

  • Report to the Executive Director of Koreatown Immigrant Workers Alliance (KIWA), who also serves as CCWP Co-President.
  • Coordinate closely with CCWP’s Co-Managing Directors and staff to ensure effective organizational coordination and alignment.
  • Work in close partnership with CCWP’s steering committee, policy, organizing, and communications workgroups to align legislative strategy, coalition organizing, and public engagement.

Equity Commitment

KIWA is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, religion, color, sex, disability, sexual orientation or national origin. Candidates whose backgrounds, identities, and/or lived experience have been historically marginalized in roles like this are strongly encouraged to apply.

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  1. Resume
  2. A brief cover letter highlighting a proven track record of successfully establishing and leading scalable operations or equivalent in a growing nonprofit, coalition, or community-based organization.
  3. Three professional references

If you are interested, apply above.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Salary: $135,000 to $150,000

Senior Product Manager - Platform

Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts.

As Senior Product Manager, Platform at Bitwarden, you will own the foundational capabilities that every user and admin depends on: how people create accounts and sign in, how developers and other systems reach Bitwarden programmatically, and how customer data stays protected. Your scope covers account creation, authentication (SSO, role-based access), the Bitwarden CLI, our public APIs and MCP server, integrations with the business platforms our customers already use, and the security foundations underneath them, such as key management, vulnerability response, and post-quantum readiness. You will partner with Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Design to turn these into clear, shippable outcomes, and you will work with Sales and Solutions Engineering to understand how identity and integration capabilities help win and keep enterprise customers. You will use customer feedback, usage data, and competitive benchmarking to inform roadmap decisions, thinking about the end user, the IT admin, and the developer.

This is an all-remote team and we're looking for someone located in the U.S. with no preference for time zone. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the roadmap for account creation and authentication, including SSO, role-based access control, and how users and admins first set up and sign in to Bitwarden
  • Own the Bitwarden CLI, public APIs, and MCP server as products, making it easy for developers, admins, and AI agents to work with Bitwarden data securely
  • Define and prioritize integrations with identity providers and other business platforms our customers rely on
  • Partner with Security and Architecture on platform-wide data protection, including key management, vulnerability response, and post-quantum cryptography readiness, and translate that work into clear requirements and customer-facing value
  • Write clear specs and user stories, and work closely with engineering to scope, sequence, and ship features
  • Analyze how competitive password and identity vendors approach authentication, developer tooling, and integrations, and identify where Bitwarden can stand out
  • Define and monitor adoption metrics, such as, SSO adoption, API and CLI usage, and integration usage
  • Support Sales and Solutions Engineering with product knowledge on authentication, integrations, and security architecture, including RFP and security questionnaire input
  • Share progress, roadmap updates, and wins with leadership and cross-functional partners
  • Use AI tools to accelerate spec writing, competitive analysis, data analysis, and rapid prototyping

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • 4+ years experience in product management
  • Experience with platform, developer-facing, or identity features of B2B SaaS products
  • Strong technical aptitude, with familiarity with authentication standards (SAML, OIDC, SCIM) and APIs
  • Comfort working with developer tools such as CLIs, REST APIs, and SDKs
  • Ability to translate complex security concepts into intuitive user and admin experiences
  • Ability to have technical discussions with engineering about architecture and technology tradeoffs
  • Extremely organized and able to make well-informed prioritization and trade-off decisions with engineering
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A growth mindset and a desire to learn from others
  • Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:

  • Interview with Director, Product Management
  • Interview with Chief Product Officer
  • Interview with Chief Technology Officer
  • Reference calls

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world's largest organizations. Become an expert. You'll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.

In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $150,000 - $160,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market.
