jobs.description:
We are a healthcare technology company that provides platforms and solutions to improve the management and access of cost-effective pharmacy benefits. Our technology helps enterprise and partnership clients simplify their businesses and helps consumers save on prescriptions.

As a leader in SaaS technology for healthcare, we offer innovative solutions with integrated intelligence on a single enterprise platform that connects the pharmacy ecosystem. With our expertise and modern, modular platform, our partners use real-time data to transform their business performance and optimize their innovative models in the marketplace.

Position Summary

The Senior Data Engineer owns the data platform end to end — designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure, pipelines, and governed data layers that power analytics and downstream consumers across the organization. This is a hands-on engineering role centered on cloud data platform development, pipeline orchestration, and data modeling at scale.

The guiding principle is to build once, consume everywhere — define transformations and metrics a single time, governed and version-controlled in the warehouse, then serve them consistently to every downstream consumer: BI tools, client-facing reporting, and AI systems.

The ideal candidate is comfortable building data platforms and systems from scratch, thrive in a platform development and maintenance environment, and brings strong hands-on experience with Snowflake and workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow and dbt (or equivalent platforms). This role does not own BI visualization — your work spans raw ingestion through the governed gold layer.

Key Responsibilities

Data Platform Development & Maintenance

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and platform infrastructure on Snowflake.
  • Architect and implement end-to-end data flows from source ingestion through the silver and gold layers.
  • Own platform reliability, performance tuning, and ongoing maintenance — treating the data platform as a product.
  • Build systems from the ground up where needed; evaluate existing systems and refactor for scale, cost efficiency, and maintainability.
  • Establish engineering standards: version control, CI/CD, testing frameworks, and documentation for all platform components.

Pipeline Orchestration & Workflow Management

  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows using Apache Airflow (or equivalent) to schedule, monitor, and manage data pipelines.
  • Ensure pipeline reliability, observability, and failure recovery through alerting, logging, and automated retries.
  • Coordinate dependencies across upstream sources and downstream consumers with well-defined SLAs.

Gold-Layer Modeling & Metrics

  • Design, build, and maintain gold-layer data models and a governed metrics layer in Snowflake using dbt — clean, tested, documented, and version-controlled.
  • Establish metric definitions as the single source of truth: calculated once, reused everywhere, with clear ownership and change management.
  • Push transformation and calculation logic upstream into the warehouse so the consumption layer stays simple, consistent, and high-trust.
  • Partner with analytics and BI stakeholders on the boundary between pipelines (data engineering) and consumption (analytics/reporting).
  • Structure and document data models so they meet the governance and consistency requirements of AI agents and autonomous analytical systems.

AI-Native Development

  • Build with coding agents and AI-assisted tooling as a primary part of the workflow — accelerating pipeline development, data modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Independently set up and manage development environments, repositories, and the tooling needed to work effectively with agentic systems.
  • Help establish team practices and standards for building data infrastructure in the AI era.

Quality, Governance & Platform Judgment

  • Champion data quality, consistency, and trust across all platform layers — ensuring data holds up under scrutiny from any downstream consumer.
  • Contribute to platform architecture decisions; identify opportunities for automation, templating, and process improvement.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment to evaluate build vs. buy decisions and tooling trade-offs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering — building pipelines, data models, and platform infrastructure in a data-driven organization.
  • Snowflake:Proven, hands-on production experience building data models and transformations in Snowflake. Deep familiarity with Snowflake architecture, performance optimization, and cost management.
  • Workflow Orchestration (must have):Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow or an equivalent DAG-based orchestration platform (e.g., Prefect, Dagster, Mage). Ability to design, deploy, and operate complex pipeline workflows.
  • dbt:Demonstrated experience using dbt for transformation modeling, testing, and documentation in a production warehouse environment. Equivalent semantic layer tooling experience considered.
  • Strong SQL proficiency — able to write, optimize, and review complex queries across large datasets.
  • Experience building data platforms or systems from scratch — not just extending existing infrastructure but designing and standing up new ones.
  • Comfort with platform development and maintenance as a long-term ownership model — not just project delivery.
  • Fluency working in the AI era: building with coding agents, setting up development environments, and using AI tooling as a core productivity multiplier.
  • Familiarity with software engineering practices: version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code review.
  • Strong communication skills — able to translate business requirements into technical data platform decisions.

Preferred

  • Experience in pharmacy benefits management, healthcare technology, or a related regulated industry.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and data platform tooling (AWS, Azure, or GCP) alongside the data stack.
  • Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data contracts, or data mesh principles.
  • Experience with streaming or near-real-time data pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Spark Streaming).
  • Exposure to semantic/metrics layer tooling (e.g., MetricFlow, Cube, LookML).
  • Experience building demo environments or client-facing data products.

The Benefits Realization Manager is responsible for ensuring Digital, AI, business transformation, and process improvement investments deliver the value they were expected to achieve.

This role leads the firm's benefits realization capability, working with business leaders, product teams, portfolio teams, and transformation leaders to define value before work begins, establish success measures and benefit ownership, and validate that expected outcomes are achieved after implementation.

Rather than focusing solely on project delivery, the Benefits Realization Manager focuses on business outcomes. The role creates the frameworks, governance, reporting, and accountability needed to connect investments to measurable operational, financial, workforce, client, and strategic benefits.

The Manager serves as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders on value realization, adoption, transformation outcomes, and investment effectiveness while leading a team responsible for value measurement and benefits governance across the portfolio. This role is aligned and collaborates with the finance, digital effectiveness, digital portfolio and business strategy teams to ensure their goals and capabilities align with the benefits realization frameworks.

Benefits Strategy, Value Definition & Measurement (30%)

  • Establish enterprise standards, methodologies, and governance for benefits realization and value management.
  • Partner with business stakeholders during intake, discovery, and business case development to define expected outcomes and value targets.
  • Develop measurable benefit metrics, baselines, benefit dependency maps, and realization plans.
  • Ensure business ownership and accountability are established for all significant benefits.
  • Define how value will be measured before investments are approved.

Business Case & Value Assessment (15%)

  • Partner with sponsors and portfolio leaders to evaluate business cases and value assumptions.
  • Validate forecasted benefits, financial impacts, productivity opportunities, and strategic outcomes.
  • Support governance and investment review processes with value-driven analyses and recommendations.
  • Improve organizational rigor around value assessment, prioritization, and investment decisions.

Benefits Realization & Outcome Tracking (20%)

  • Maintain portfolio-level benefit tracking and realization reporting.
  • Monitor actual performance against approved business cases and expected outcomes.
  • Identify value realization risks, adoption challenges, and areas of value leakage.
  • Recommend corrective actions that improve realization performance.

Adoption & Transformation Outcomes (15%)

  • Partner with Change Management and Process Transformation teams to ensure adoption efforts translate into measurable business outcomes.
  • Evaluate adoption, utilization, behavioral change, process improvement, and stakeholder experience metrics.
  • Help business leaders understand the difference between successful deployment and successful realization of value.
  • Promote outcome-focused accountability across transformation initiatives.

Executive Reporting & Governance (10%)

  • Deliver executive dashboards, scorecards, portfolio reporting, and value realization insights.
  • Present findings and recommendations to leadership, governance committees, and investment review forums.
  • Communicate realized value, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve portfolio outcomes.

Team Leadership & Capability Development (10%)

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of value realization professionals.
  • Establish repeatable tools, templates, and operating practices.
  • Drive maturity of the firm's benefits realization discipline and promote a culture of value accountability.

Success Measures

  • Benefits and value metrics defined before investment approval.
  • Clear accountability for benefit ownership across business initiatives.
  • Increased realization of forecasted business benefits.
  • Reduction of value leakage across Digital and AI investments.
  • Improved transparency into portfolio outcomes and investment effectiveness.
  • Increased adoption of value-based decision making across business and technology leadership.

  • Experience developing business cases, investment analyses, and value realization plans, including ROI, TCO, NPV, payback period, productivity, and operational performance measures.
  • Demonstrated ability to define KPIs/OKR’s, establish baselines, measure outcomes, and validate realization of expected business benefits.
  • Strong analytical, financial, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and executive recommendations.
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders, drive accountability, and lead cross-functional initiatives in complex organizations.
  • Strong communication and executive presentation skills with experience presenting findings and recommendations to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Digital, AI, Business Transformation, Process Improvement, Enterprise PMO, Technology Financial Management (TBM), or Management Consulting functions.
  • Experience establishing benefits realization frameworks, governance processes, dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting.
  • Experience measuring adoption, utilization, behavioral change, and business outcomes associated with transformation initiatives.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Excel, Python, or similar analytics and reporting platforms.
  • ACMP, PMP, TBM, Lean Six Sigma, Prosci, or related professional certification.

Key Success Profile

  • Able to challenge assumptions, identify value leakage, and validate whether investments are delivering expected outcomes.
  • Focuses on accountability, outcomes, and realization of business value rather than project delivery alone.

jobs.description:
About Cloudtrace

Founded in 2018, Cloudtrace specialises in providing offensive and defensive cyber security services for public cloud environments. Our service offerings include penetration testing, red/purple teaming, 24/7 managed security services, PCI DSS QSA assessments and incident response.

Cloudtrace is a PCI Security Standards Council (SSC) Qualified Security Assessor Company (QSAC), a CREST accredited penetration testing provider and ISO 27001 certified by the British Standards Institution (BSI). Amazon Web Services (AWS) has designated Cloudtrace as an Advanced Tier Services partner with the Level 1 Managed Security Services Provider Competency and recognised us as the 2024 AWS Rising Star Consulting Partner of the Year for Australia and New Zealand.

Our Values

Customers are our compass:Our customers drive our decision-making processes. We are dedicated to our mission of protecting them and work backwards from that.

We get things done:When we work on something we own it. We love solving difficult challenges and we never make excuses. We know time is valuable and we don’t waste it.

We are constantly learning:Our team is passionate about what we do and are hungry for knowledge. It excites us that the work we do lets us learn more every day.

We are creators:There is always a better way and we are obsessed with continually improving how we do things. Invention is in our DNA and we are all about rewriting the rules.

We take pride in our work:If a job’s worth doing its worth doing well. We pay attention to detail, deliver quality and encourage each other to be the best at what we do.

Why Join Us

Here's why passionate cyber professionals choose to work with us:

We make a real difference:The work we do directly protects the global community from cybercriminals, making the digital world a safer place.

We are at the forefront of innovation: Our customers are some of the brightest stars in technology and we work closely with them to secure their cloud-native platforms.

We are shaping the future of threat detection:We are crafting a cloud-native threat detection service that changes the way modern application environments are protected.

We unlock potential with continuous learning: We invest in career growth with training programs, attendance at security conferences, and mentorship from cloud security experts.

We are a collaborative fast-paced team:Our team is made up of experts in the industry who share a passion for cyber security and building innovative technology.

The Role

We are looking for a technical lead to join our fast-growing Threat Detection and Response (TDR) team and help us forge a next-generation cloud native managed security service. This role would suit someone currently in a senior security operations or DevOps role that is looking to take the next step in their career and become an expert in cloud security.

Our philosophy is that solid defense requires intimate knowledge of offensive tactics. Our managed security service leverages our penetration testing and red team expertise to ensure our TDR team is across current cyber-attack techniques. This, combined with our cloud-native tooling and deep understanding of AWS services, allows us to deliver best-in-class protection for AWS customer environments.

The successful candidate will work closely with our experienced offensive security and incident response teams to understand the latest TTPs used in real world breaches. That knowledge will be used to continually improve our next generation threat detection service and protect our customers from cyber-attacks. Cloudtrace customers include start-ups, scale-ups, enterprises and state/federal government agencies, giving this role exposure to a range of technologies and industry sectors.

Your Responsibilities

Our in-house SIEM platform, built on Amazon Security Lake, ingests telemetry from AWS services, endpoint security products and third-party SaaS vendors. You be working with our team to continuously improve the detection and investigation capabilities of the platform. You will use findings from our offensive team engagements and MITRE ATT&CK® Matrices to detect the latest threat IOCs and TTPs used by highly skilled adversaries.

You will be responding to alerts generated by our SIEM platform and investigating complex attack chains to ensure breaches are rapidly discovered and contained. Using penetration testing techniques, you will also validate any security exposures detected by our Attack Surface Management (ASM) platform and review the security of new customer assets identified by the platform discovery engine.

Your Typical Day

This is not a typical SOC role where you wait for SIEM alerts to come through, you will be constantly applying your current skillset across different areas and learning new skills every day. A typical day will include enhancing the capabilities of our TDR service, using exploit POCs to validate real cyber threats, and giving security advice to customers in shared slack channels.

Your daily activities will include the following:

Investigating and responding to potential cyber threats

  • Ownership through to resolution of alerts generated by our SIEM and ASM platforms
  • Liaising with customers to provide updates on alert investigation status
  • Escalating to our offensive security team for validation of complex exposures
  • Closing alerts with investigation outcomes once appropriate action has been taken
  • Review of new assets discovered by our ASM platform and assessing exposure risk

Developing high signal threat detection rules

  • Tuning existing rules to reduce false positive rates
  • Developing new rules to search and alert on threat activity
  • Engaging our offensive security team for rule testing

Managing a best-in-class cloud TDR solution

  • Updating event ingestion pipelines to enrich data for threat detection rules
  • Monitoring CloudWatch metrics and modifying AWS service configurations as required
  • Reviewing OpenSearch metrics and modifying index configurations as required
  • Developing and maintaining runbooks that improve our threat detection processes
  • Automation of routine tasks such as filtering low-priority alerts and sending notifications

You will also be using your client facing and engineering skills to work collaboratively with the broader team on projects and periodic reporting. These activities will include:

  • Assistance with onboarding of new clients to our TDR and ASM platforms
  • Integration of new log sources for existing TDR clients
  • Generation of reports for our managed service clients
  • Presentation of report content to our managed service clients

Your Experience

You will need 5+ years’ experience in the following areas:

  • Cyber security operations covering endpoints and cloud services
  • Tuning SIEM rules for accurate threat detection

Your Skills

The following base technical skills are required for this role:

Endpoint Security

Understanding of endpoint cyber threats and attack vectors including:

  • Malware (e.g. Ransomware)
  • Adversary in the Middle Attacks

Network Protocols

Understanding of common internet protocols, including:

  • TCP/IP
  • HTTP
  • DNS
  • TLS

AWS

Configuration of basic AWS services via console and CLI, including:

  • EC2 Instances
  • Security Groups
  • IAM Permissions

Data Analysis

  • Ability to write data queries using syntax such as SQL, DSL, KQL or ES|QL
  • Ability to extract relevant data in spreadsheets using formulas and functions

Linux

  • Command line navigation and file operations
  • Scripting for automation using Bash and Python

The following non-technical skills are required for this role:

  • Clear communication of technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Problem solving and critical thinking to approach problems from different angles and identify potential solutions
  • Ability to independently find information from internet resources and use that to solve complex problems
  • Strong organisational skills with the proven ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to make quick decisions under pressure, weighing risks and benefits to choose the best course of action
  • Ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and draw conclusions from complex information

jobs.description:
Remote (Pakistan preferred) · Full-time

🧭 About the role

iClosed.io is a SaaS platform for sales and marketing teams, scaling to millions of users. This role sits in our Performance Team and owns the performance and scalability of our Node.js/TypeScript backend services and data layer.

We believe the biggest gains come from design, not just tuning: matching each store to its access pattern, moving work off the critical path, and drawing service boundaries that scale cleanly. You'll solve the problem in front of you, then shape the architecture so whole classes of problems never come up.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, high autonomy and significant technical influence.

🔀 How the work splits

You'll own performance across three connected areas, with genuine depth expected in both system design and data-layer internals:

  • Design: how a request flows, what runs synchronously, where state lives, and what happens when a dependency is slow.
  • Diagnosis: reading traces, execution plans and metrics to find the real cause rather than the obvious one.
  • Prevention: instrumentation, review standards and regression gates, so issues are caught long before they reach customers.

🎯 What you'll do

  • Lead the design of high-traffic flows end to end, keeping them fast under load and resilient when dependencies fail.
  • Diagnose latency across the full request path using traces, execution plans and metrics.
  • Match each workload to the right data store, and document the reasoning.
  • Scale reads and writes through caching, replicas, partitioning, sharding and queue-buffered writes.
  • Build reliable background processing on SQS and EventBridge with idempotency, retries, dead letters and backpressure.
  • Eliminate N+1 queries and chatty data access, including inefficient queries generated by ORMs such as Prisma and Mongoose.
  • Own data-layer capacity planning and cost per request alongside latency.
  • Set engineering standards: design and query review for hot paths, migration standards, CI regression gates, and load testing at production-realistic volumes.
  • Review architecture proposals from feature teams, and write the design docs others build from.

🧑‍💻 Who we're looking for

Required

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with 3+ where performance and scale were a named part of your job.
  • Performance ownership of a multi-tenant SaaS product under real load.
  • Systems you designed yourself, including the alternatives you rejected and the tradeoffs you accepted.
  • A concrete track record: a problem you diagnosed, its root cause, your fix, and the before-and-after numbers.
  • Strong system design judgement across caching, sharding, CQRS, queues, real-time delivery (WebSockets/SSE), autoscaling, high availability and resilience patterns. Knowing when not to use one matters more to us than listing its benefits.
  • Real depth in at least two of PostgreSQL/MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB and Redis, with working competence in the rest.
  • Production ownership of Node.js/TypeScript services, and a solid understanding of how ORMs and ODMs such as Prisma and Mongoose generate queries.
  • Hands-on Datadog APM and tracing experience (or equivalent), plus production experience on AWS (ECS/EKS), including the cost behaviour of managed data services.
  • Clear writing: design docs a team can build from and an executive can follow.

🗄️ Data layer depth

Nobody is deep in all four engines, and we'd rather you tell us where you are. Across your areas of depth, we expect you to reason about:

  • Relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL): execution plans as routine, composite and partial indexes and their write cost, locking, isolation levels, connection pooling and replica lag.
  • Document (MongoDB): embedding vs referencing, shard key selection, aggregation performance and working set sizing.
  • Key-value: access-pattern-first modelling, partition keys, hot partition avoidance, secondary indexes and capacity cost.
  • In-memory cache (Redis/Memcached): caching patterns, key design, eviction and TTL, and system behaviour when the cache is cold or unavailable.
  • Across engines: consistency boundaries, dual-write problems, and recognising when a query problem is really an application design problem.

🌟 What success looks like

  • Diagnosis: latency is attributed to real causes with evidence, and per-tenant investigations end with clear answers.
  • Design: critical paths have documented designs others can reason about, store selection is deliberate and written down, and queues behave predictably under load.
  • Measurable improvement: meaningful latency reduction on the highest-cost paths, with before-and-after numbers, and cost per request trending down.
  • Prevention: design and query review is standard practice for hot paths, regressions are caught before merge, and migration standards are followed across teams.
  • Partnership: feature teams bring you proposals early because you make them better, not slower.

➕ Nice to have

APM, error tracking and database performance tooling using tools like Datadog and Sentry · event streaming or messaging at scale · real-time delivery and fan-out at scale (Socket.IO) · third-party integrations where latency is outside your control · noisy-neighbour and tenant isolation · load testing tools and building that capability · SLOs and error budgets · infrastructure as code

🚫 What this role is not

  • Not a DBA role. Backups, patching and routine operations sit with DevOps. You set the performance requirements.
  • Not feature work. Your output is latency removed and regressions prevented.
  • Not a management role today. Leading the function as it grows is an open conversation.

💎 Why join

  • Shape the performance function and its priorities from day one.
  • Have direct influence on architecture across every engineering team.
  • Work on a polyglot stack at real scale.

📋 Practicalities

  • Location: Remote (Pakistan preferred)
  • Type: Full-time, permanent
  • Level: Senior individual contributor, no direct reports
  • Compensation: Market competitive
  • On-call: Part of the escalation rota
Salary: Market Competitive

Peru (Remote)

Remote LATAM role. Compensation listed in USD with local currency equivalent. This particular role is a Peru-based independent contractor engagement.

Freedom Health Systems, Inc. is a mission-driven healthcare advisory and management consulting firm that partners with behavioral health and human services organizations to improve access, equity, and operational excellence. We specialize in guiding providers through program development, accreditation, compliance, and clinical best practices.

While Freedom Health Systems does not provide direct clinical services, the organization delivers critical operational support through revenue cycle management, prior authorization, medical billing and coding, compliance consulting, and administrative services to outpatient behavioral health providers.

DISCLOSURES:

This document defines the scope of work and service expectations for an independent contractor engagement and does not create an employment relationship. Scope, deliverables, tools, priorities, and assignments may be modified through written amendment based on client needs, regulatory requirements, or contractual obligations.

COMPANY INFORMATION

COMPANY WEBSITE:

COMPANY PHONE NUMBER: 667-239-9572

HUMAN RESOURCES PHONE: 667-239-9572 EXT 10

HUMAN RESOURCES EMAIL:

SERVICE TITLE:

Medical Biller & Coder 3 (Team B)

ALTERNATE SERVICE TITLES:

Medical Billing Specialist (Contractor)

Medical Coding Specialist (Contractor)

Freedom Health Systems, Inc.

(In support of outpatient mental health center clients under contract)

DEPARTMENT: Accounts Receivables

UNIT: Medical Billing & Coding (Revenue Cycle Management Services)

BENEFITS PACKAGE: Not applicable (Independent Contractor)

Monday – Friday, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time business hours
(8:00 AM EST – 5:00 PM EST or as otherwise contractually agreed)

The contractor will coordinate daily service delivery with the Medical Billing & Coding Analyst 2 (Team Lead – Team B). Escalations, risks, or unresolved issues will be routed through the Team Lead to the Accounts Receivables Department Manager as required.

CONTRACT CLASSIFICATION: W8BEN – Independent Contractor

COMPENSATION RANGE

USD $5.00–$6.50 (≈ PEN 18.5–24/hr)

ANTICIPATED TRAVEL: None

SCOPE OF ASSIGNMENT

This scope of work applies to Team, supporting one or more outpatient mental health center clients. The Medical Biller & Coder is responsible for executing accurate, compliant, and timely billing and coding services to support end-to-end revenue cycle operations.

SUMMARY OF CONTRACT SCOPE

The Medical Biller & Coder provides medical billing and coding services for outpatient mental health center clients. This includes translating clinical documentation into accurate diagnosis and procedure codes, entering charges, submitting claims, correcting errors, and supporting accounts receivable workflows.

All services are performed under the functional oversight and quality review of the Medical Billing & Coding Analyst 2 (Team Lead – Team B) and are a critical component of the Revenue Cycle Management process.

CORE SCOPE OF WORK & DELIVERABLES

  • Review clinical documentation to confirm required elements are present prior to billing (signed notes, treatment plans, service dates, units, provider credentials)
  • Assign accurate CPT, ICD-10-CM, and applicable HCPCS codes based on documentation
  • Enter charges accurately into the EHR or billing system
  • Submit claims timely and in compliance with payer-specific requirements
  • Verify patient demographics, insurance information, and payer details prior to claim submission
  • Identify and correct claim rejections, coding errors, and data entry issues
  • Support denial resolution activities by correcting coding or documentation issues as directed
  • Ensure all services rendered are captured and billed; escalate suspected missed charges
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready billing records and supporting documentation
  • Adhere to workflows, quality standards, and productivity expectations established by the Team Lead
  • Communicate documentation gaps, authorization issues, or system barriers promptly to the Team Lead

UNSCHEDULED / SUPPORT DUTIES

  • Assist with billing backlogs or high-volume periods
  • Support internal quality assurance reviews and audits
  • Participate in training, coaching, and cross-training activities
  • Provide coverage for essential billing tasks during team member absences
  • Support process improvement initiatives related to billing accuracy and turnaround time

TECHNOLOGY, DATA SECURITY & MONITORING REQUIREMENTS

  • All work must be performed exclusively on the assigned Amazon Workstation (AWS virtual workstation) authorized by Freedom Health Systems.
  • Use of personal devices, local storage, screenshots, external email forwarding, or unauthorized systems is strictly prohibited.
  • The Amazon Workstation environment is monitored by the Company for security, compliance, productivity, and quality assurance purposes.
  • System access logs, activity monitoring, and usage metrics may be reviewed to ensure compliance with HIPAA, client contracts, and Company policies.
  • Failure to comply with technology, security, or monitoring requirements may result in immediate termination of the contract.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Service quality and contract effectiveness will be evaluated using, but not limited to, the following KPIs:

  • Coding accuracy rate
  • Charge entry accuracy and completeness
  • Clean claim submission rate
  • Claim rejection rate
  • Timeliness of claim submission
  • Error correction and resubmission turnaround time
  • Audit findings and error trends
  • Adherence to established workflows and instructions
  • Responsiveness to Team Lead requests and escalations

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Continuous use of EHR and billing platforms
  • Frequent virtual communication via chat, phone, or video

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Fully remote (Peru-based) via assigned Amazon Workstation
  • Production-driven, deadline-oriented revenue cycle environment
  • Collaboration across time zones with U.S.-based leadership and client operations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERTISE

  • Minimum 2–4 years of U.S. medical billing and coding experience
  • Outpatient mental health or behavioral health billing experience preferred
  • Working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10-CM, and basic HCPCS coding
  • Familiarity with U.S. insurance, Medicaid, and managed care billing processes
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to follow defined workflows and quality standards
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Experience working in secure virtual workstation environments preferred
  • Professional coding certifications (CPC or equivalent) preferred

About MATSYS

MATSYS, based in Sterling, Virginia, develops advanced technology for government and commercial customers across R&D, prototyping, and manufacturing. Our technology and technical data are core to what we do, and this role makes sure we protect them.

About the Role

You will own how MATSYS manages its agreements and protects its intellectual property and data rights. You will take government and commercial agreements from intake through closeout, keep the IP register and data rights records audit-ready, and help program, engineering, and business development teams understand what they can sign, share, and mark. You will run the process and escalate decisions that carry legal, financial, or strategic risk. Signature authority stays with designated company officers.

You will report to the Director of Business Agreements, Improvements & Plans.

What You'll Do

  • Triage, review, and route prime contracts, subcontracts, OT agreements, SBIR/STTR awards, CRADAs, NDAs, teaming agreements, licenses, and supplier and consulting agreements.
  • Summarize risks in scope, flowdowns, payment, liability, termination, and IP and data rights terms, and recommend positions to decision-makers.
  • Maintain templates, a clause library, and the central agreements tracker, including key dates, obligations, and closeout requirements.
  • Keep the company IP register current, run the invention disclosure process, and track government-funded subject invention deadlines.
  • Track the funding source of technical data and software, maintain data rights assertion lists, and make sure deliverables carry correct restrictive markings.
  • Respond to government questions and challenges about markings and assertions.
  • Coordinate with Trade Compliance on export-controlled items and technology.
  • Train program, engineering, and business development staff on agreement routing, NDAs, and protecting IP.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in business, contracts management, law, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years in contracts administration, agreements management, or IP and data rights administration, including agreement drafting, with at least 5 years with the government or a defense contractor.
  • Strong knowledge of the FAR and DFARS, particularly the IP and data rights clauses.
  • Experience reviewing NDAs, teaming agreements, subcontracts, and licensing agreements.
  • Strong organizational and record-keeping skills, with the ability to manage many agreements and deadlines at once.
  • Clear writing that turns legal and regulatory requirements into practical guidance for technical teams.
  • U.S. person status as defined by the ITAR, and eligibility for a security clearance if required.
  • Experience with SBIR/STTR awards, OT agreements, or CRADAs.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Bayh-Dole reporting and patent prosecution workflows.
  • Knowledge of ITAR/EAR/OFAC, CUI handling, and NIST SP 800-171/CMMC.
  • Experience in advanced materials, manufacturing, or R&D settings.

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this full-time, exempt position is $135,000–$150,000 per year, based on experience. MATSYS offers medical coverage with an employer contribution and education sponsorship. Occasional travel may be required.

Equal Opportunity Employer

About us

Founded in 2015 in Athens, Greece, Welcome redefines the way people travel by going above and beyond the commoditized transfer service and being the first company to deliver a complete, personalised, in-destination travel experience. From the moment a traveler arrives at a new destination, until their return journey home, Welcome accommodates all their travel needs, including transfers, sightseeing trips, and local information, in the easiest, friendliest, and most personalised way possible. Welcome's drivers are experts in the area and share their local know-how to make travellers feel at home wherever they are. The company has also introduced contactless rides, thorough cleaning protocols, and protective equipment to make every journey safe.

Being a travel tech startup, Welcome continues to grow and scale its operations and is quickly becoming a global category leader for in-destination travel services.

  • One of the highest-rated global transportation companies with a rating of 4.9/5 stars.
  • Expanded from 200 destinations last year to 350, achieving our ambitious 2024 growth target.
  • Over 4,000 travel partners including 2,500 hotels, numerous vacation rentals, and travel agents, adding 50+ new ones every month.
  • Over 2.5 million happy travellers every year.

⭐️ If you want to dive deeper into the awesomeness of Welcome's culture, click on this link to check our TikTok account.⭐️


The Team

We are a group of vibrant, diverse people who love travelling and never settle on quality. Each one of us didn’t join Welcome by chance and believes deeply in what Welcome is trying to achieve, so we work relentlessly to make that happen. We challenge common logic, focus on design, put simplicity and usability first, and create memorable experiences. We keep learning and exploring better ways to serve our community and grow personally and professionally in our respective fields. We stay humble along the way, with a “pay it forward” mentality, but with big and bold goals.

As a Senior Platform Engineer at Welcome Pickups, you will keep the platform behind our product reliable, fast, scalable and secure, so travellers, drivers and partners can count on our services every day. Much of what we do runs in the background: matching rides to drivers, pricing, notifications, partner syncs and payouts. If the platform slows down or stops, rides don't get assigned and travellers end up waiting at arrivals. This is a hands-on role that works across all our product teams. You will make key architecture and infrastructure decisions, set the standards everyone builds to, and own the technical roadmap together with the Product Manager of the Core team. The role is about helping product teams move fast without breaking things, not slowing them down.

What you'll work with

  • A large Ruby on Rails application, with Sidekiq and RabbitMQ
  • A large, fast-growing PostgreSQL/PostGIS database, plus Elasticsearch and Redis
  • Azure as our main cloud, with AWS S3 and Google Cloud
  • Cloud66, Cloudflare, CircleCI and Docker
  • New Relic and Rollbar for monitoring, and Mixpanel for product analytics
  • 30+ external services, including Checkout.com, Twilio, Braze and hotel booking systems

Responsibilities

Reliability & Uptime

  • Define and track reliability targets (SLAs/SLOs) for our core flows: bookings, ride matching and payments.
  • Set up and run the incident process and on-call, and reduce recovery times.
  • Improve monitoring and alerting across the platform (New Relic, Rollbar).

Performance, Scalability & Data

  • Lead architecture decisions for scaling our backend systems and services.
  • Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the application, background jobs and database.
  • Improve the performance of our large, fast-growing PostgreSQL database:
    • tune slow queries and indexes
    • plan data growth and archiving
    • manage replication, backups and restore drills
    • change large tables without downtime
  • Make sure the platform handles peak season and partner growth smoothly.

Infrastructure, Security & Compliance

  • Define and evolve our infrastructure strategy on Azure, and balance performance, reliability and cost.
  • Define and enforce security best practices: access control, secrets management, and the security of our build and release pipeline.
  • Prepare the platform for compliance: payment-data rules (PCI), GDPR, and over time SOC 2 / ISO 27001.

Developer Experience

  • Improve internal tooling, CI/CD and deployment workflows so engineers can ship faster and safer.

Technical Roadmap & Collaboration

  • Keep the backlog of technical work (upgrades, technical debt, performance, security) organised and ranked in Jira, and prioritise it together with the Product Manager.
  • Write technical docs, runbooks and development plans, and break them into Jira tickets with clear requirements.
  • Participate in team ceremonies (grooming, planning, kick-off meetings, retrospectives & demos).

Requirements

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with strong backend and systems experience.
  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science or a related subject.
  • Proven experience operating and scaling production systems.

Technical Skills

Culture & Growth

Saphetor’s mission is to enable anyone to find, share and use the most comprehensive human genome data – and to collaborate to improve health and lives around the world. Our customers work around the globe across academic, clinical, and industry laboratories analysing NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) data for research and diagnostic purposes. Saphetor is a global precision medicine company with offices and distributed teams across Greece, Spain, the UK, Switzerland, France, the MENA region, South America, and other countries, employing a diverse global workforce.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an Application Scientist in Clinical Genomics to join our commercial organization.Standing at the intersection of clinical genomics and bioinformatics, you will support our customers through their journey with VarSome, from pre-sales discussions and platform onboarding to post-sales support and account management finding new opportunities for further growth. You will play a key role in shaping and delivering solutions to our direct and indirect customers.

  • Workflow Optimization & Support: Fine-tune filtering strategies and automation to maximize platform “stickiness” while acting as a high-level bridge between customer support and stakeholders to ensure seamless routine operations.
  • Scientific Advocacy: Systematically gather power-user feedback to influence the product roadmap and cultivate strategic relationships for conference presentations (ESHG, MedTech) and the development of technical white papers.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Marketing, and Operations to ensure product-market fit and growth. Work with growth marketers to translate features into benefits for prospects, while influencing the product roadmap through prioritization.

The Ideal Candidate (Profile)

The ideal candidate combines strong clinical genomics expertise and a passion for data analysis with a commercial mindset. You should be able to translate complex technical/IT specifications into clear benefits, while possessing the communication skills necessary to engage both laboratory professionals and clinicians.

What you will bring:

  • Education: A Master’s or PhD in Human Genetics, Laboratory Medicine, Molecular Biology/Pathology, Life Sciences, or related field.
  • Expertise: Hands-on experience in clinical genomics workflows, including NGS library preparation, sequencing, and secondary and/or tertiary analysis in a clinical setting.
  • Technical Knowledge: A solid grasp of variant classification frameworks and a deep understanding of NGS workflows.
  • Communication: The ability to simplify complex clinical genomics and bioinformatics concepts for clinicians, laboratory technicians, researchers, and IT professionals.
  • Languages: Native in Polish. Proficiency in English is a must.

Strongly Valued

  • Clinical Experience: Previous background in a hospital or private laboratory setting interpreting NGS patient cases.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with working in regulated environments, such as IVDR, CLIA/CAP, or similar standards.
  • Global Mindset: Proven experience in multicultural environments and/or supporting international customers in a scale-up setting.

  • Scientific Rigor: A curious, detail-oriented professional who maintains high scientific standards while managing complex data analysis.
  • Commercial Mindset: The ability to balance scientific accuracy with pragmatic sales decisions and translate features into customer benefits.
  • Self-Organization: A structured thinker with strong prioritization and project management skills, comfortable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Global Mobility: Available and willing to undertake international business travel in Europe to support our global customer base.

While our foundation is in Athens, our talent pool is spread across Europe, with a strong culture of remote collaboration. Our team is highly experienced in distributed Agile workflows and communicates exclusively in fluent English.

Your career journey with us includes, among others:

  • A position in a fascinating healthcare growth domain, at the cutting edge of technology and research
  • A competitive compensation package tailored to your unique expertise and professional background.
  • A remote work environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance
  • Endless learning opportunities, while transferring new technologies from academics to clinical practice all over the world.

jobs.excerpt: About FlexspringEverything connects.  That's not just our tagline - it's the whole job.
jobs.description:
About Flexspring

Everything connects. That's not just our tagline - it's the whole job.

Flexspring is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) built for one of the thornier problems in enterprise software: getting HR systems to actually talk to each other. We link payroll, recruiting, benefits, and HRIS platforms API-to-API so data moves between them cleanly and in near real-time, with no manual re-entry anywhere. The results back it up - 3,000+ integrations delivered, 800+ clients including Fortune 500 companies, ADP Marketplace Platinum Partner, and named HR Data Integration Experts of the Year 2025. And we do it all as a remote-first team spread across Canada and beyond.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a QA Developer Co-op to join our R&D team - and we'll be upfront about what that means.

This is real experience, in the fullest sense. No throwaway side project, no busywork to fill the term - from your first weeks you'll be testing our actual product, as a real part of the team, protecting data that real customers depend on. Many of our co-ops go on to join us full-time after graduation.

You'll work mainly in Java, writing automated tests around the ways real integrations break - API timeouts, mismatched data, systems drifting out of sync. Good QA here is half code, half detective work - every test exists because a real company is counting on its HR data to arrive intact. If you like asking "what could go wrong here?", and you get a little satisfaction from catching the bug everyone else missed, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Writing and maintaining automated test suites in Java - and understanding the customer problem behind what you're testing
  • Designing tests around the ways real integrations break - API timeouts, corrupted or mismatched data, systems falling out of sync
  • Tracking failures back to their root cause, not just the symptom
  • Using modern tooling, AI included, to work efficiently - and reviewing what it produces with a careful eye before you trust it
  • Working closely with developers through code reviews and team discussions to keep quality high

What We're Looking For

  • Strong analytical thinking. This is the heart of good QA - you can look at a feature and reason about where it might break and why that would matter, connecting each test back to the real customer on the other end.
  • A thoughtful approach to new tools. You enjoy picking up unfamiliar technology, including AI tools, and using it to work faster and smarter. You also know that generating output is only the start - the real value is in reviewing it, catching what's off, and being able to stand behind the result.
  • You've already completed a co-op term or have some professional work experience - this won't be your first time in a real work environment
  • You're currently studying Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • A solid foundation in Java
  • You've written automated tests before, even for a class project (JUnit or something similar)
  • You've worked with or learned about APIs
  • You're curious, motivated, and get real satisfaction from finding what others miss

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with testing frameworks or tools (JUnit, Selenium, Postman, REST-assured, or similar)
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and how data moves between systems
  • Interest in integration platforms (iPaaS) and how systems connect
  • Curiosity about how large systems talk to each other - and what happens when they don't

What You'll Walk Away With

  • Real, hands-on experience protecting the quality of a production platform real customers rely on
  • Mentorship from senior developers who'll invest in how you think, not just the tests you write
  • A working understanding of how HR data moves between enterprise systems - and where it tends to break
  • Real practice using AI and modern tooling the way strong engineers do - fast, but with judgment
  • Competitive co-op pay
  • Flexible hours in a remote-first environment
  • A strong chance to grow into a full-time role after graduation

jobs.description:
L'Instructeur en droit du sol (h/f) assure l'instruction des demandes d'autorisation d'urbanisme pour le compte de collectivités territoriales, en garantissant leur conformité aux règles d'urbanisme en vigueur. Il analyse les dossiers de permis de construire, déclarations préalables et certificats d'urbanisme, tout en conseillant les pétitionnaires et les services instructeurs.

Cette mission s'inscrit dans l'accompagnement des collectivités pour la gestion de leur développement territorial.

L'Instructeur en droit du sol (h/f) intervient en support des communes et intercommunalités pour l'instruction de leurs demandes d'autorisation d'urbanisme :

1. Instruction des demandes d'autorisation d'urbanisme

  • Analyser et instruire les demandes de permis de construire (PC), déclarations préalables (DP), permis d'aménager (PA) et certificats d'urbanisme (CU)
  • Vérifier la complétude des dossiers déposés et demander les pièces complémentaires si nécessaire
  • Examiner la conformité des projets aux règles d'urbanisme applicables (PLU/PLUi, carte communale, RNU)
  • Rédiger les projets d'arrêtés (accords, refus, sursis à statuer) et les notifications aux pétitionnaires
  • Respecter les délais d'instruction réglementaires et assurer le suivi administratif des dossiers

2. Vérification de la conformité réglementaire

  • Appliquer les dispositions du Code de l'urbanisme et analyser les règlements de PLU/PLUi (zonage, règles de constructibilité, servitudes)
  • Consulter les services instructeurs concernés (ABF, SDIS, gestionnaires de voirie, services d'assainissement, etc.)
  • Intégrer les contraintes spécifiques : zones protégées (monuments historiques, sites classés), risques naturels et technologiques (PPR), règles environnementales
  • Vérifier la conformité architecturale, paysagère et d'implantation des projets

3. Reporting et collaboration interne

  • Établir des rapports d'activité réguliers pour les collectivités clientes (statistiques d'instruction, délais, typologies de dossiers)

Conditions d’éligibilité à l'inscription et la prise de missions sur la plateforme

        • Maîtrise approfondie du Code de l'urbanisme et des procédures d'autorisation

Compétences :

  • Excellente connaissance du Code de l'urbanisme (L. 421-1 et suivants, R. 431-1 et suivants)
  • Maîtrise de l'analyse réglementaire des PLU/PLUi, cartes communales et règlement national d'urbanisme (RNU)
  • Capacité à instruire tous types de dossiers : PC, PA, DP, CU (opérationnel et informatif)
  • Connaissance des servitudes d'utilité publique, des périmètres de protection (ABF, sites classés) et des règles de constructibilité
  • Compétence en lecture de plans, coupes et documents graphiques de projets d'architecture
  • Connaissance des outils SIG (systèmes d'information géographique) : QGIS, ArcGIS
  • Connaissance des procédures de recours contentieux et de la jurisprudence administrative en urbanisme

Savoir-être :

  • Rigueur et sens de l'organisation
  • Capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse pour la rédaction d'arrêtés et de notes juridiques

  • Esprit d'analyse et capacité de discernement face à des situations complexes ou ambiguës

Background

당사의 고객사는 국내 대기업, 국책 연구기관과 컨소시엄을 구성해 정부 주관 대규모 R&D 국책과제에 선정된 몰입형 미디어 테크 기업입니다. 아시아 최초 수준의 8K급 초대형 LED 몰입형 콘텐츠 공간과, 기존 영화·영상을 이 공간 규격으로 확장 변환하는 자체 AI 영상 엔진을 함께 개발하고 있습니다. 이 엔진이 목표로 하는 것은 기존 CG/VFX 방식 대비 제작비 60% 이상 절감, 제작 기간 대폭 단축입니다. 몰입형 체험 시장이 연평균 20%대로 성장하는 가운데, 국내 첫 공간 구축을 시작으로 향후 10년 내 아시아 주요 도시와 글로벌 시장으로 확장하는 로드맵을 가지고 있습니다.

이 회사의 AI개발팀은 최신 논문과 모델을 빠르게 적용하는 것보다, 실제로 문제를 해결하는지 끝까지 검증하는 연구를 중시합니다. 왜 필요한지, 기존 방식보다 실제로 나은지, 어떻게 측정할지, 보유한 GPU 환경에서 실행 가능한지, 실제 서비스에 적용할 수 있는지까지 묻는 팀입니다.

이번에 모시는 Video / Vision AI Research Engineer는 이 AI 영상 처리 플랫폼의 핵심 연구를 이끄는 포지션입니다.   • 장시간 영상에서의 Temporal Consistency 및 Scene Consistency 개선

  • 고해상도 영상 Processing 및 12K/16K급 처리 Pipeline 연구와 최적화
  • AI 모델의 논문 및 Open Source 구현 재현
  • Dataset 수집, 전처리, 정제 및 Training Data Pipeline 구축
  • Training / Fine-tuning / Inference Pipeline 구축

Key Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: About the roleA senior individual contributor owning the data science work end to end: deciding what to measure, getting the data, building the models, defending the conclusions.
jobs.description:
About the role

A senior individual contributor owning the data science work end to end: deciding what to measure, getting the data, building the models, defending the conclusions. You work directly with traders, deal economists, finance and treasury, and the founders — no account manager in between.

We are hiring for a sector, not for one narrow problem. Assignments come from business stakeholders and they vary; what stays constant is the industry and the independence expected. The team can grow with one or two junior data scientists reporting to you.

There is a data engineer and an established data lake, but not every source is organised that way — a meaningful part of the work still starts in raw tables and unprocessed exports.

What the work looks like

The system we are building exists so that anyone involved in a deal can reconstruct the P&L between any two points of the chain, at any moment, on an agreed and versioned allocation basis. That is where the role sits: P&L, cost and financial transactions. Operational data is an input to margin, not a subject of its own.

This is operational deal P&L, reconciled to but not identical with the statutory accounts; the general ledger and month-close stay in the accounting system.

Scope

  • P&L reconstruction and margin attribution across the deal lifecycle — netback at entry, provisional P&L, final P&L after final pricing, actual costs, demurrage and claims — with a defensible account of every delta, and the ability to reproduce the P&L as of a past date
  • Forecasting where it pays on the financial side: provisional cost lines invoiced later, cost and margin per tonne, demurrage and claim exposure, FX and open pricing-period exposure, working capital and cashflow
  • Anomaly and fraud detection on financial data: invoice lines inconsistent with contract terms, cost booked to the wrong deal or period, duplicate invoices, off-market pricing between related parties, cost reallocation that improves one deal at another's expense
  • The reporting layer for finance and risk — margin, cost per tonne, exposure, receivables, cash position — with single agreed definitions where trading, economics and finance disagree
  • Turning vague business problems into a research plan, and results into a recommendation someone can act on
  • Incomplete and contradictory financial data as the normal case: provisional costs never trued up, invoices arriving months late, deals kept open for years by claims

Requirements

  • 7+ years in data science, with senior ownership of your own workstreams
  • Oil & gas industry experience — at least two years of delivered projects in trading, refining, logistics, storage or distribution. You can read a pricing clause, an invoice with its cost lines and a demurrage claim without a translator, and you know why provisional and final invoices for the same cargo legitimately differ. Which segment matters less. What matters is physical hydrocarbon volumes and index-linked pricing — power or utilities experience alone does not cover that
  • Working with coding agents, seriously. Agents write most of the code here. Bad agent output in analysis fails silently: a join fans out rows, a `dropna` removes half a population, a future-dated column leaks into features. We hire for verification habits, not speed — row-count and population checks, reconciliation against a number someone already trusts, held-out evaluation, a traceable path from raw data to any figure a decision-maker sees
  • Strong Python and SQL, and readiness to work in raw data yourself: unfamiliar schemas, undocumented tables, exports never meant for analysis
  • Forecasting and time-series modelling on real business data
  • Experience taking models into production and operating them; close to essential for us
  • Numbers that carry weight. Your output feeds invoices, hedges and shareholder reporting: reconciliation to the accounting system, a versioned and documented method, and an explanation the person signing the invoice can follow. Accuracy that cannot be explained loses to accuracy that can
  • English sufficient to present findings and defend methodology
  • Professional proficiency in Russian

What we offer

  • Ownership of the data science work, and room to shape how it is done
  • Direct access to founders and decision-makers; short feedback loops
  • Generous AI tooling budget — frontier models are a working expense, not a perk
  • Competitive compensation, discussed individually

How to apply

Share your CV an answer to any of the questions below, at your choice. Applications without answers are not reviewed.

1. A term contract drawn down over several lots was booked at a netback of about $14/t. The final P&L closes at $6/t and nobody can say where the rest went — pricing period, FX, provisional costs replaced by actuals, late demurrage and cost reallocation all have their advocates. How would you approach it, what would you need, and what would you deliver?

2. Give a real case where two systems or two departments reported different numbers for the same P&L, margin or quantity. What were the figures, why did they differ, which one did the business treat as truth, and what did you change?

3. Show a real prompt or task brief you gave an agent for an analysis or a model, and what it produced. Then one case where agent output looked right and was numerically wrong: what was wrong, how you caught it, what check you added.

4. Which systems have you personally pulled data from — CTRM/ETRM, ERP or accounting, invoice and settlement data, bank statements, terminal systems, price feeds? Pick one and tell us something about its data that only someone who has used it would know.

jobs.description:
At OneLocal, we know that marketing is no longer just about buying ads. It's about mastering a technology landscape that keeps changing. We provide SaaS solutions to small and medium businesses (SMBs) worldwide through a suite of seven digital marketing products. We aim to be the best partner our clients can have by combining innovative technology with local marketing expertise.

As we keep growing globally, we are looking for a high-energy Talent Acquisition Specialist (Recruiter) to join our People team full-time. You'll own full-cycle recruiting for your roles from start to finish. You'll also help shape our employer brand, culture, and People operations. This is an early-career role with real ownership from day one. If you are a "people person" who loves the thrill of the hunt and wants to help build a great company, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own Your Requisitions: Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for sales, tech, and operations roles, from the intake meeting to the signed offer.
  • Partner with Hiring Managers: Run intake meetings to define role requirements, write job descriptions, and agree on the interview process and hiring criteria.
  • Source & Engage: Build pipelines by finding and reaching out to strong passive candidates on LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and other creative channels.
  • Screen & Assess: Review resumes and run phone screens to assess skills, motivation, and alignment with our values.
  • Manage the Process: Guide candidates through each interview stage, gather feedback from interviewers, and lead debriefs that end in a hiring decision.
  • Close Candidates: Extend offers, handle negotiations with guidance from senior team members, and close top talent.
  • Deliver a Great Candidate Experience: Communicate promptly and professionally with every candidate, whatever the outcome.
  • Track & Report: Keep our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) accurate and report on your pipeline health, time-to-fill, and other hiring metrics.

Employer Branding

  • Brand Storytelling: Create content for LinkedIn, our careers page, and other channels, such as employee spotlights, "day in the life" posts, and team wins, that shows what it's really like to work at OneLocal.
  • Careers Presence: Keep job postings, our careers page, and employer review profiles (e.g., Glassdoor) accurate, engaging, and on-brand.
  • Talent Community: Build long-term pipelines through university partnerships, virtual career fairs, and networking events.

Culture & Engagement

  • Team Events: Plan and run virtual and in-person events, celebrations, and team-building activities that keep our remote-first team connected.
  • Recognition & Milestones: Help manage recognition programs and celebrate work anniversaries, birthdays, and company wins.
  • Employee Feedback: Help run engagement surveys and pulse checks, summarize the results, and support follow-up initiatives.
  • Internal Communications: Draft announcements, newsletters, and updates that keep everyone informed and engaged.

People Operations

  • Onboarding & Offboarding: Hand off each hire into a welcoming onboarding experience, including paperwork, equipment, system access, and first-week schedules, and support smooth offboarding.
  • HR Administration: Keep employee records accurate in our HRIS and prepare offer letters, contracts, and employment verifications.
  • Process Improvement: Document and improve recruiting and People processes, templates, and policies so they scale as we grow.

What You Bring

  • Experience: Some experience in recruiting (agency or in-house), talent acquisition, or a closely related field. Strong internship experience in recruiting will also be considered.
  • Full-Cycle Mindset: You're comfortable owning a process from start to finish and holding yourself accountable for results.
  • The "Hustle" Factor: A proactive, results-driven approach. You aren't afraid to pick up the phone, push back with a hiring manager, or try new ways to find talent.
  • Exceptional Communication: Strong written and verbal skills, plus the confidence to build relationships with candidates and hiring managers alike.
  • Organization: You can manage multiple requisitions, pipelines, and projects at once without dropping details.
  • Creativity: An eye for engaging content and a genuine interest in employer branding and company culture.
  • Discretion: Sound judgment and the ability to handle confidential information professionally.
  • Tech Savviness: Experience with an ATS and LinkedIn Recruiter is strongly preferred. Familiarity with an HRIS, Canva, or Google Workspace is a plus.
  • Educational Background: A degree in HR, Communications, Business, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Real Ownership: Run your own requisitions and see your hires make an impact across the company.
  • Mentorship & Growth: Learn from experienced recruiters and HRBPs who care about your development, with a clear path to Recruiter and Senior Recruiter roles.
  • Broad Exposure: Get hands-on experience across recruiting, employer branding, culture, and People operations.
  • Remote-First: Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote work environment.
  • Fast-Paced Culture: We promote successful team members and celebrate wins together.

Diversity & Inclusion

At OneLocal, we are committed to building an environment where every employee feels included, valued, and heard. We encourage applications from all candidates regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, age, citizenship, disability, or national origin.

Adjunct Faculty - Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administration

Department of Cybersecurity | University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC)

This position is specifically to teach remotely, for stateside applicants. Local applicants only; UMGC does not sponsor logistical support for this role.


Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administration (CMIT 380):

A lab-based exploration preparing students to become proficient in Microsoft Endpoint Administration. The focus is on deploying, configuring, securing, and maintaining modern endpoint devices using Microsoft solutions, including Intune, Entra ID, and Windows client management. Topics include endpoint deployment, application management, identity and access management, security policies, and troubleshooting techniques. Through hands-on exercises and industry-aligned assessments, skills will be developed to implement modern endpoints that meet the business needs of an organization.

At UMGC, we don’t just teach; we empower. Founded in 1947, UMGC is an open-access, minority-serving institution serving over 90,000 nontraditional learners worldwide, including a proud, large military-affiliated population. Our students are mature, highly dedicated, and balancing careers, families, and service. As an Adjunct Faculty member, you are the essential partner helping them bridge the gap between classroom theory and real-world career success.

Why Teach with UMGC?

  • Focus on Students, Not Course Design: All courses follow a standardized, pre-designed, unified course model. Standardized rubrics, OER materials, library resources, and digital textbooks are fully provided at no cost to you. You get to focus 100% of your energy on mentoring, facilitating, and providing high-quality feedback—no unpaid course-building required.
  • True Asynchronous Flexibility: Teach with flexibility, on your own schedule. As long as you meet weekly grading, responsiveness, and engagement milestones, your daily hours are entirely up to you.
  • Ongoing Growth: We invest in you. All newly hired faculty receive comprehensive online orientation, alongside ongoing, cost-free professional development opportunities.

The Rhythm of Your Week (Key Responsibilities)

Adjunct faculty bring our pre-built curriculum to life through real-world expertise and active mentorship.

Classroom Engagement & Presence

jobs.excerpt: A Little Bit About Us:Saphetor’s mission is to enable anyone to find, share and use the most comprehensive human genome data – and to collaborate to improve health and lives around the world.
jobs.description:
A Little Bit About Us:

Saphetor’s mission is to enable anyone to find, share and use the most comprehensive human genome data – and to collaborate to improve health and lives around the world.To do this we have built the VarSome suite of bioinformatic tools, the world’s leading resource for analysis and interpretation of human genome variant data, with more than 6 000 citations in scientific papers, and over 60 000 registered professional users. Our customers work around the globe across academic, clinical, and industry laboratories analysing NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) data for research and diagnostic purposes. Saphetor is a global precision medicine company with offices and distributed teams across Greece, Spain, the UK, Switzerland, France, USA, the MENA region, South America, and other countries, employing a diverse global workforce.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an Application Scientist in Bioinformatics to join our commercial organization.Standing at the intersection of bioinformatics and system operations, you will support our customers through their journey with VarSome, from pre-sales discussions and platform onboarding to post-sales support with cloud and on-premises deployments and finding new opportunities for further growth. You will play a key role in shaping and delivering solutions to our direct and indirect customers.

We thrive in a high-pressure, high-performance environment where clinical precision and rapid growth meet. While our pace is fast, it is always directed by rigorous organization and clear processes, ensuring that our commitment to quality is never compromised by our drive for speed.

Role Responsibilities

  • Pre-sales Support: Act as the technical “closer” by delivering expert demonstrations that bridge clinical needs with VarSome Premium, Clinical, API; you will own the customer evaluation process, solve “pain points” around variant analysis, and advise on lab equipment/system integrations.
  • Post-sales Support: Lead onboarding sessions for geneticists and bioinformaticians to ensure rapid “time to value”; you will act as the primary lead for on-premises and private cloud deployments, coordinating infrastructure specifications (storage, network) between clients and our DevOps team.
  • Workflow Optimization & Support: Fine-tune filtering strategies and automation to maximize platform “stickiness” while acting as a high-level bridge between customer support and stakeholders to ensure seamless routine operations.
  • Scientific Advocacy: Systematically gather power-user feedback to influence the product roadmap and cultivate strategic relationships for conference presentations (e.g. APCHG) and the development of technical white papers.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Marketing, and Operations colleagues to ensure product-market fit and growth. Work with growth marketers to translate features into benefits for prospects, while influencing the product roadmap through prioritization.

The Ideal Candidate (Profile)

The ideal candidate combines strong bioinformatics expertise and a passion for data analysis with a commercial mindset. You should be able to translate complex technical/IT specifications into clear benefits, while possessing the communication skills necessary to engage both laboratory professionals and DevOps/IT departments.

What you will bring:

  • Education: A Master’s or PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related field.
  • Expertise: Hands-on experience in bioinformatics, including NGS secondary and/or tertiary analysis workflows.
  • Technical Knowledge: A solid grasp of variant classification frameworks and a deep understanding of bioinformatics and IT workflows.
  • Communication: The ability to simplify complex bioinformatics and technical infrastructure concepts for researchers, clinicians, and IT professionals.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English is a must. Fluency in other languages (e.g. Mandarin, Japanese or Korean) will be considered as a plus.

Strongly Valued

  • Industry Experience: Previous background in a bioinformatics software company or experience in DevOps/SysAdmin roles.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with working in regulated environments, such as IVDR, CLIA/CAP, or similar standards.
  • Global Mindset: Proven experience in multicultural environments and/or supporting international customers in a scale-up setting.

Mindset & Key Skills

  • Scientific Rigor: A curious, detail-oriented professional who maintains high scientific standards while managing complex data analysis.
  • Commercial Mindset: The ability to balance scientific accuracy with pragmatic sales decisions and translate features into customer benefits.
  • Self-Organization: A structured thinker with strong prioritization and project management skills, comfortable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Global Mobility: Αvailable and willing to undertake international business travel to support our global customer base in the APAC region.

While our foundation is in Athens, our talent pool is spread across Europe, with a strong culture of remote collaboration. Our team is highly experienced in distributed Agile workflows and communicates exclusively in fluent English.

Your career journey with us includes, among others:

  • A position in a fascinating healthcare growth domain, at the cutting edge of technology and research
  • A competitive compensation package tailored to your unique expertise and professional background.
  • A remote work environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance
  • Endless learning opportunities, while transferring new technologies from academics to clinical practice all over the world.

Saphetor is proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and our employees, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, medical condition or disability, sexual orientation, gender expression, or marital status.
