jobs.title: Organic Search Lead
jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewHallam is a B2B-specialist digital marketing agency.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

Hallam is a B2B-specialist digital marketing agency. Our proposition is being chosen before the search begins, and discoverable when it does.

As an Organic Search Lead, you’ll own the Organic & AI Search strategy for some of our highest-billing, multi-channel accounts. You’ll be confident and experienced across both traditional and AI search - you know how to report on it, how to communicate it with clarity to clients and peers, and how to position it within the wider search landscape.

Around 60% of Google searches now end without a click as AI Overviews reshape the SERP. That means we need to build brands that are trustworthy and authoritative enough to be cited in AI answers - the new frontier of modern search success. At the same time, human search behaviour has fundamentally shifted: 40% of Gen Z use TikTok as a search engine, and 45% use Instagram. Search is no longer limited to Google - we must capture our audiences’ attention wherever they search organically online.

We call this Total Search. This requires deep audience understanding - the core of Hallam’s effective marketing. Using tools such as SparkToro to understand where our clients’ audiences actually spend their time, we build highly efficient, platform-agnostic campaigns that drive commercial outcomes.

Our Organic Search proposition is three-fold:

  • Traditional Search: Nailing the fundamentals to capture as much available market share as possible in Google & Bing.
  • Unified Search: Combining paid media and organic efforts to identify cannibalisation, wasted spend and missed opportunities, improving blended ROI for our clients.
  • Total Search: Our core proposition: a platform-agnostic Organic Search strategy that grows high-intent visibility across the full funnel, regardless of platform.

You’ll maintain a coaching and mentoring relationship with the SEO consultants in the team, speaking with authority both internally and externally.

We live by a team philosophy of KELI - Knowledgeable Experts that Love Innovation - using our knowledge to deliver the best outcomes and pushing ourselves to innovate further.

Purpose

  • Lead the Organic & AI Search strategy for a portfolio of Hallam’s highest-billing, multi-channel accounts.
  • Grow high-intent organic visibility across the full funnel
  • Build client brands that are trustworthy and authoritative enough to be chosen before the search begins.
  • Coach and mentor the SEO consultants in the team, raising the bar on craft and innovation.
  • Contribute to Hallam’s growth as a market-leading B2B marketing agency.

Responsibilities

  • Own the Organic & AI Search strategy end-to-end for your portfolio, from audience research through to measurement and reporting.
  • Lead AI Search strategy - including AI citation research, query fan-out analysis, and building brand authority to earn citations in AI Overviews and LLM answers.
  • Deliver against all three Organic Search propositions: Traditional Search, Unified Search (in collaboration with Paid Media) and Total Search.
  • Conduct deep audience research using SparkToro and other behavioural tools to identify where client audiences spend their time online - and shape platform-agnostic strategies accordingly.
  • Lead technical SEO work across your accounts, including internal linking audits, page speed audits, and site migration support.
  • Own content strategy for existing and new content - both re-optimisation to recover lost ground and new content to drive market growth in emerging categories.
  • Contribute to authority-building work, collaborating with the Digital PR team.
  • Lead keyword research and meta optimisation across client accounts, using Ahrefs, SE Ranking, Keywordtool.io and SparkToro.
  • Develop Organic Social content strategies (especially across visual discovery platforms - Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube) to support wider Organic Search presence.
  • Collaborate with Paid Media on Unified Search strategies - identifying cannibalisation, wasted spend and opportunities to replace PPC with Organic.
  • Report on performance confidently across GA4, GSC, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, SE Ranking and Google Data Studio.
  • Coach and mentor the SEO consultants in the team, providing technical and strategic guidance.
  • Present to clients and prospects with confidence, building engaging, persuasive presentations.
  • Build and refine AI workflows for SEO using LLMs, contributing to the team’s internal toolkit.
  • Contribute to Hallam’s growth as a B2B marketing leader - through thought leadership, cross-team collaboration and Marketing team support.

KPIs

All KPIs are measured monthly and targeted quarterly.

Client Performance

  • Growth in organic visibility across your portfolio.
  • Growth in AI citations and Share of LLM.
  • Commercial outcomes - organic-driven revenue, leads and pipeline contribution.

Client Satisfaction & Retention

  • High client NPS and retention across the portfolio.
  • Quality of reporting and strategic communication.

Commercial Contribution

  • Organic account growth through upsell and expanded scope.
  • Contribution to Unified Search opportunities alongside Paid Media.

Team Development

  • Quality of coaching and mentoring provided to SEO consultants.
  • Contribution to team knowledge sharing, innovation and process improvement.

Requirements

  • Demonstrable senior experience in Organic Search, with the confidence and authority to lead strategy internally and externally.
  • Strong knowledge of both Traditional Search and AI Search - including how to report on, communicate and measure both.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise: internal linking audits, meta optimisation, page speed audits, site migrations.
  • Confident with keyword research, AI citation research and query fan-out analysis.
  • Strong content strategy skills - both re-optimisation of existing content and new content to drive growth in new categories.
  • Experience with authority building / Digital PR as part of a holistic SEO approach.
  • Familiarity with our core toolkit: GA4, GSC, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, SparkToro, Keywordtool.io, SE Ranking, Google Tag Manager and Google Data Studio.
  • Experience working with LLMs to create AI workflows for SEO is highly desirable.
  • Confident client-facing presenter - able to build engaging presentations and present to clients and prospects.
  • Comfortable coaching and mentoring more junior team members.
  • Data-led mindset - we’re data nerds at Hallam, not led by vibes. You should be led by evidence and commercial impact.
  • Based in the GMT time zone; this is a remote role with quarterly in-person away days.
  • A nice and friendly person - we value enjoying our jobs more than anything.
  • Desirable: experience in Organic Social content strategy, particularly across visual discovery platforms (Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube).

Marketing

In this role, you will be expected to contribute both independently and collaboratively at the department level to drive the overall success of our marketing efforts. You will play an active role in thought leadership initiatives that support lead generation and help maximise the department’s impact. This includes contributing to a range of activities such as blogging, content creation, event support, and other marketing tasks. Your proactive involvement in these areas will be key to ensuring we consistently deliver high-quality marketing outputs and fully leverage the capabilities of the department.

Workplace Culture

At Hallam, we believe that a positive and inclusive workplace culture is the foundation of our success. Every employee plays a crucial role in fostering this environment by embodying and promoting our company values in their daily work and interactions. Whether collaborating with colleagues, engaging with clients, or driving innovation, we expect our team members to champion integrity, respect, and creativity. Together, we are committed to building a workplace that encourages growth, inclusivity, and excellence, ensuring that our values are reflected in everything we do.

BCorp

You will play a pivotal role in promoting the overall success of the Company. As a key member of the agency, you are expected to act in good faith to advance the Company’s mission of benefiting its members, while also having a material positive impact on society and the environment. Your decisions will be made with careful consideration of long-term consequences, the well-being of employees, and the nurturing of strong relationships with clients, suppliers, and other stakeholders. Additionally, you will ensure that the Company maintains a reputation for high standards of business conduct and operates in a manner that positively impacts the community and the environment. You will also ensure fairness among all members of the Company while driving its strategic objectives forward.

Salary: £37,000 - £55,000 DOE

jobs.description:
Global ChangeFacilitator - Supply Resilience

Help strengthen the global biopharmaceutical supply chain and make a lasting impact on the delivery of medicines to patients.

Make a difference to the future of medicine

What if your ability to bring people together could help solve some of the biggest challenges facing the global pharmaceutical supply chain?

At BioPhorum, we bring together experts from across the global biopharmaceutical industry to collaborate on shared challenges, exchange knowledge and turn collective expertise into meaningful change. Established in 2004, we are a business-to-business membership organisation working with more than 150 organisations, including 18 of the 20 largest global biopharmaceutical companies. Through our collaborative network, more than 7,000 subject matter experts contribute to over 90 initiatives designed to improve the industry.

We are looking for a Global Change Facilitator to join our Supply Resilience Phorum, helping biopharmaceutical manufacturers, suppliers and logistics providers work together to build a more resilient, agile and sustainable global supply chain.

This is an opportunity to combine your scientific understanding, project management expertise and stakeholder engagement skills to address complex industry challenges and support the reliable delivery of high-quality medicines to patients worldwide.

Be at the heart of global supply resilience

About BioPhorum Supply Resilience

BioPhorum Supply Resilience brings together 34 member organisations, including many of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies, to strengthen the inbound biopharmaceutical supply chain. By sharing knowledge, experience and best practice, our members work collectively to anticipate risks, improve supply chain performance and drive innovation across the industry.

Global events, geopolitical uncertainty, increasing demand for raw materials and consumables, and evolving regulatory requirements continue to place pressure on pharmaceutical supply networks. Our members collaborate to develop practical solutions that improve supply chain visibility, strengthen risk management, enhance demand forecasting and support business continuity.

Through dedicated workstreams, members explore opportunities to advance digital transformation, improve traceability, promote regional manufacturing capabilities, address emerging materials of concern and encourage regulatory alignment. The Phorum also develops industry guidance, practical tools and strategic frameworks that help organisations assess their capabilities and identify opportunities for improvement.

By bringing together expertise from across the supply chain, BioPhorum Supply Resilience helps turn shared challenges into coordinated industry action, supporting a safer, more adaptable and sustainable supply network that ultimately benefits patients.

As Global Change Facilitator, you will play a central role in this collaboration. You will guide industry experts through complex discussions, help translate challenges into structured projects and ensure that collective knowledge delivers meaningful, measurable outcomes.

What will you be doing?

  • Lead and facilitate workstreams: Guide a portfolio of collaborative initiatives, helping members define priorities, agree objectives and deliver outcomes aligned with BioPhorum's strategy and governance.
  • Bring industry experts together: Create engaging, inclusive meetings that encourage open discussion, draw out specialist knowledge and build strong working relationships across manufacturers, suppliers and logistics providers.
  • Drive projects forward: Apply your project management skills to establish clear deliverables, manage timelines, monitor progress and keep workstreams focused on achieving their objectives.
  • Turn complexity into clarity: Bring together complex scientific, technical, operational and regulatory information and translate it into clear, accessible outputs that support industry-wide understanding and change.
  • Deliver meaningful industry outputs: Work with members to develop publications, practical guidance, proof of concepts, business cases, benchmarking tools and conference presentations that address supply chain challenges and demonstrate tangible value.
  • Support resilience and innovation: Facilitate discussions on areas such as supply chain risk, demand planning, traceability, digital transformation, materials of concern and business continuity, helping members identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Create impactful events: Collaborate with Phorum colleagues and the events team to plan and facilitate engaging virtual and in-person meetings, workshops and industry events.
  • Build member engagement: Monitor participation, identify emerging challenges and work with colleagues to maintain momentum, strengthen relationships and support member satisfaction.
  • Champion collaboration and continuous improvement: Share member insights, identify opportunities to demonstrate the value of BioPhorum's work and contribute to the ongoing development of our collaborative approach.

Bring your scientific knowledge and people skills together

We are looking for someone who understands the life sciences environment and enjoys bringing people together to solve complex problems. You will be comfortable working with highly knowledgeable industry experts, navigating technical discussions and turning different perspectives into practical action.

A scientific education or background is essential for this role. You will need a solid understanding of scientific and technical concepts to engage credibly with subject matter experts and understand the challenges affecting pharmaceutical manufacturing and supply chains.

Experience working within the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry would be highly advantageous, particularly in supply chain resilience, raw materials, procurement, manufacturing, quality, logistics, regulatory affairs or related areas. Experience in a CDMO or within pharmaceutical supply chain consulting would also be valuable.

You do not need to be the technical expert in every discussion. However, you should have the scientific grounding, curiosity and confidence to understand complex topics, ask insightful questions and help experts move towards a shared outcome.

You will bring:

  • A degree in a relevant scientific discipline, or an equivalent scientific education and background that enables you to engage confidently with complex life sciences topics.
  • Experience working within life sciences, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, CDMOs or a related technical environment.
  • Experience managing projects, programmes or change initiatives, ideally within pharmaceutical manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, logistics or operational excellence.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, build trust, adapt your communication style and bring diverse groups of people on a journey.
  • A collaborative mindset and a genuine enjoyment of facilitating constructive discussions, drawing out information and helping groups reach decisions.
  • The ability to synthesise complex information and communicate it clearly to different audiences, using plain language to make technical topics accessible.
  • Excellent organisation and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, competing priorities and agreed deadlines.
  • Sound judgement, initiative and a bias towards action, combined with the flexibility to adapt as priorities and discussions evolve.
  • An interest in supply chain resilience, risk management, digital transformation, sustainability and the wider challenges affecting the global pharmaceutical industry.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and the ability to work effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a remote, fast-paced and growing organisation.

Help shape a more resilient pharmaceutical industry

If you are scientifically minded, thrive on collaboration and enjoy turning complex challenges into practical solutions, this is an opportunity to use your expertise in a role with a wider industry impact.

At BioPhorum, you will work alongside leading experts and organisations across the global biopharmaceutical sector, helping to develop collaborative solutions that strengthen supply chains, improve operational performance and support the consistent delivery of medicines to patients.

Location: Home-based, with occasional travel required. You must be able to commit to at least two UK trips and two international trips each year to support our annual events programme.

Ready to help strengthen the future of pharmaceutical supply chains?

Apply today and bring your scientific knowledge, collaborative approach and project leadership skills to BioPhorum.

Who We Are

Vial is a hyper-scalable biotech company advancing programs into the clinic by leveraging dramatically cheaper trials and computationally designed therapeutics.

Our mission is to reimagine drug development in order to cure all human diseases. We have assembled a talented team of clinical operators, scientists, and innovative thinkers to achieve this vision.

Vial is fully remote and was founded by Simon Burns in October 2020. Since our founding, we have grown rapidly to a team of 50+ employees with over $100 million in funding from leading investors including General Catalyst, Box Group, and Byers Capital.

Vial is rebuilding the infrastructure to advance research. By deploying technology at every step, we are creating a more efficient future for drug discovery.

What You'll do

As a PBPK Modeler at Vial, you will play a critical role in predicting human pharmacokinetics (PK) and optimizing dosing strategies for our novel drug candidates across multiple modalities, including antibodies, small molecules, and oligonucleotides. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate in vitro, preclinical, and clinical data into physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) models to support decision-making in drug development.

We are looking for individuals who are deeply experienced in PBPK modeling, thrive in fast-paced environments, and can independently develop and validate models to guide clinical translation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and refine PBPK models to predict human PK for novel drug candidates using available in vitro and preclinical data.

  • Compare and validate PBPK models using published clinical PK data from reference compounds to establish model credibility.

  • Propose clinical dosing regimens based on PBPK model outputs, leveraging reference drug data for benchmarking.

  • Analyze and interpret model predictions, identifying key parameters influencing drug exposure and clearance.

  • Collaborate with internal scientists and external partners to integrate experimental data into PBPK modeling workflows.

  • Address discrepancies between preclinical and human PK predictions, providing insights into factors driving variation.

  • Incorporate variability (e.g., age, weight, genetics) into PBPK models, ensuring robustness of clinical predictions.

  • Adapt modeling approaches for different drug modalities (antibodies, small molecules, oligonucleotides), considering key differences in ADME properties.

  • Stay up to date on advancements in PBPK modeling, applying best practices and emerging methodologies.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of experience in PBPK modeling, preferably within a biotech or pharmaceutical setting.

  • Expertise in modeling across multiple modalities, with a strong understanding of PK principles for antibodies, small molecules, and oligonucleotides.

  • Proficiency in PBPK modeling software (e.g., Simcyp, GastroPlus, PK-Sim, Phoenix WinNonLin) and familiarity with programming languages such as R, Python, or MATLAB.

  • Strong understanding of ADME properties and their impact on drug disposition.

  • Experience with parameter estimation and model validation using clinical reference data.

  • Ability to propose and justify clinical dosing regimens based on model outcomes.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex modeling results into actionable insights.

  • Experience in multi-specific antibodies or extended half-life biologics.

  • Understanding of small molecule PBPK modeling, including key input requirements and differences from mAb models.

  • Prior experience supporting clinical trial design or regulatory submissions using PBPK models.

Why You’ll Love Working At Vial

Innate curiosity. At our core, we embody an insatiable curiosity. Our journey into the realm of clinical trials was ignited by a firsthand understanding of the challenges involved. This innate curiosity drives us to constantly innovate, seek fresh ideas, and bring our vision of reimagining clinical trials to life.

Fostering autonomy. Autonomy is our guiding principle. We firmly believe that when team members are entrusted with autonomy, they unleash their true potential. Our culture fosters an environment where each individual takes ownership of their domain, empowering them to make a profound impact.

The pursuit of mastery. We are dedicated to cultivating mastery. We understand the value of honing expertise in a craft. The pursuit of mastery, coupled with a deep sense of pride in one's workmanship, fuels our unwavering commitment to tackle intricate challenges. At Vial, we foster a culture of highly autonomous professionals, each an expert in their field, collaborating on an immensely demanding endeavor together.

Move fast, stay humble. Our strength lies in agility and humility. We firmly believe that intellectual honesty and a nimble mindset are the pillars of success. By staying adaptable and open-minded to all solutions, we tackle obstacles head-on, remaining humble in the face of adversity. This enables us to surmount the hurdles that confront us at every twist and turn.

Job Title

Manager Continuous Improvement and Quality

Job Summary

The Manager Continuous Improvement and Quality leads the implementation of Noridian Healthcare Solutions’ enterprise quality strategy, Quality Management System, business process improvement portfolio, and operational excellence priorities. This role transforms quality from a reporting-focused function into an enterprise capability that identifies risks, analyzes performance trends, prioritizes opportunities, redesigns processes, and delivers measurable improvements across the organization. The Manager leads the Quality Management, Improvement and Innovation team and partners with operational, compliance, technology, data, and senior leaders to improve enterprise performance. The team interprets performance trends, identifies leading and lagging indicators for key quality outcomes, and applies analytics and structured process improvement methodologies to drive results. The role also administers Noridian’s innovation framework for developing and submitting innovation concepts to CMS. Additionally, the Manager promotes a culture of operational excellence by embedding quality, continuous improvement, innovation intake, and process discipline into daily management, corrective action planning, and enterprise initiatives.

Essential Functions

Key Duties/Responsibilities/Accountabilities

  • Leads and executes Noridian’s enterprise quality strategy, including governance, operating model, quality framework, priorities, performance measures, and continuous improvement capabilities aligned with organizational objectives, compliance requirements, customer outcomes, risk management, and contract success.
  • Manages and continuously enhances Noridian’s Quality Management System (QMS) by establishing enterprise standards, quality methodologies, corrective and preventive action processes, root cause analysis practices, operational controls, and sustainable quality improvement across all business areas.
  • Direct the enterprise business process improvement and operational excellence portfolio, prioritizing initiatives based on risk, customer impact, operational performance, strategic value, and business outcomes, while ensuring effective governance, implementation, adoption, measurement, and sustainment of improvements.
  • Develop and leverage enterprise quality intelligence and performance analytics to identify trends, risks, root causes, leading and lagging indicators, and improvement opportunities; partner with business and technical leaders to create actionable dashboards, monitoring capabilities, and data-driven performance insights.
  • Lead process redesign and transformation efforts using Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, change management, and other improvement methodologies to simplify, standardize, automate, digitize, and optimize workflows, processes, and controls.
  • Manage Noridian’s CMS innovation submission framework, including innovation intake, evaluation, prioritization, governance, development, submission, tracking, and organizational learning for innovation concepts aligned with business and CMS priorities.
  • Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and address quality issues, operational risks, performance gaps, corrective actions, and strategic improvement opportunities.
  • Champion a culture of quality, innovation, and operational excellence by embedding continuous improvement principles into leadership practices, daily management routines, enterprise planning, employee development, and decision-making processes.
  • Build organizational capability in quality and continuous improvement through training, communities of practice, coaching, communication, and tools that strengthen process thinking, root cause analysis, data-driven decision-making, change leadership, and automation readiness.
  • Lead, develop, and manage the Quality Management, Improvement and Innovation team, establishing priorities, accountability, performance expectations, and professional development plans.
  • Influence and communicate effectively with leaders and stakeholders by leading governance activities, facilitating decision-making, preparing executive communications, reporting enterprise performance outcomes, and representing the function with internal and external stakeholders, including CMS.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Engineering, Quality Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Organizational Leadership, or related field
  • 7 years of progressive experience in quality management, operational excellence, continuous improvement, business process redesign, performance improvement, healthcare operations, or related disciplines
  • 3 years of leadership experience managing staff, cross-functional initiatives, or improvement programs
  • Demonstrated success implementing quality, process improvement, operational excellence, or transformation strategies
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional business process improvement initiatives from problem definition through implementation and sustainment
  • Strong understanding of quality management systems, performance management, data-driven decision-making, root cause analysis, corrective action, and continuous improvement methods
  • Experience operating in highly regulated environments with significant compliance, customer, contract, financial, or reputational impact
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including preparation of leadership materials focused on insight, risk, decisions, and outcomes
  • Ability to travel independently to all company sites

Preferred Qualifications

Above requirements and the following:

  • Master's in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Engineering, Organizational Leadership, Quality Management, or related field
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, PMP, Prosci, Theory of Constraints or comparable certification
  • Experience supporting Medicare, Medicaid, healthcare payer operations, government contracting, or similarly regulated environments

Every employee is responsible to perform their duties and responsibilities in accordance with Noridian values, policies and procedures, including but not limited to: Segregation of Duties Principles, HIPAA, Security and Privacy, CMS requirements, the Noridian Compliance Program and any other applicable laws, rules and regulations.

jobs.description:
Please note that we do not accept unsolicited candidate introductions, referrals, or resumes from external recruiters or staffing agencies.

Location: Remote (U.S. based). This role supports Frontline customers in every market we serve and requires availability for rotating shifts, including overnights, weekends, and holidays. Candidates located in PST or MST time zones are preferred.

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

As Customer Success Manager, you will build and lead the team that stands behind every Frontline customer, from the day their system is installed through every fire season after. You will own Frontline’s customer support function and lead our Wildfire Response Specialists, the team that helps homeowners and commercial customers make sure their systems are ready, running, and doing their job when a wildfire is approaching.

Every Frontline system is designed to protect a property even after its owners have evacuated. Our fire-tracking software alerts customers when a wildfire comes within ten miles and starts an automatic activation countdown. Each system has a connected controller with Wi-Fi, cellular, and satellite connectivity and a backup battery. When it activates, eave sprayers and roof rotors wet the home and up to 30 feet around it with water and Class A foam. When fire is close, customers need fast, calm, accurate help, and you will be responsible for making sure they get it at any hour.

This is a founding, hands-on leadership role. You will hire and coach the team, design the coverage model and on-call rotation, build the playbooks and escalation paths the team runs on, and lead the team through active fire events. You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Installation Operations, Field Service, and Product so that customer issues get resolved quickly and turn into lasting product and process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Hire, onboard, and lead Frontline’s Wildfire Response Specialists, and grow the team as our customer base and coverage hours expand.
  • Coach the team on system troubleshooting, crisis communication, de-escalation, and documentation, and run regular 1:1s, call reviews, and performance management.
  • Build a culture of calm, ownership, and genuine care for customers, and protect the team from burnout through fair scheduling, post-event debriefs, and access to support resources.
  • Serve as a hands-on leader: take escalated calls, step into coverage gaps, and share the after-hours on-call rotation with the team

24/7 Response Operations

  • Design and run the team’s coverage model, including shift schedules, an after-hours on-call rotation, and surge staffing plans for Red Flag Warnings and active fires.
  • Lead the team during active fire events: decide outreach priorities, assign customers to specialists, track system status across affected properties, and keep leadership informed in real time.
  • Own the escalation matrix that connects the team to on-call engineering, field service, and leadership, and make sure it works at 2am as well as it does at 2pm.
  • Train and maintain a bench of cross-trained employees who can support the team during large or multiple simultaneous fire events.
  • Manage schedules, timekeeping, overtime, and labor costs for an hourly team in compliance with federal and state wage and hour rules, including meal and rest breaks.

Customer Support & Customer Experience

  • Own the end-to-end customer support experience across phone, text, email, and app messages for homeowners and commercial customers.
  • Define and track SLAs and key metrics, including response time, resolution time, first-contact resolution, escalation rate, and customer satisfaction, and report them to leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Serve as the final escalation point for complex, sensitive, or unresolved customer issues.

jobs.description:
Position Title

Relationship Manager - Fiduciary Banking/Specialty Deposits

Location

Nationwide, MI 48098

Job Summary

The Relationship Manager-Fiduciary Banking manages commercial depository relationships. Generates new business and relationships that will produce revenue from title companies, residential and commercial property managers, developers and businesses. Generates deposits and payments deal flow directly from these clients/prospects and orchestrating a team approach to the relationship.

The position is supported by treasury management specialists, product specialists, portfolio managers (credit, underwriting, transaction approvals/processing) and operational support specialists but remains accountable for all aspects of the relationship. Responsible for the origination, negotiation, structuring, pricing, underwriting, and closing of deposits and treasury management solutions. Manages a complex commercial depository portfolio ensuring the highest quality for the organization with minimal risk. Manages the on-going monitoring of portfolio quality and ensures compliance with applicable laws, regulations and guidelines.

Job Responsibilities:

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

New Business Origination:

  • Develop and maintain relationships to generate direct deal flow. Position will be focused on generating new business that focuses on the entire banking relationship; Coordinates the team approach to approving and closing new deals to grow deposits and revenues while optimizing profitability (ROE).

Relationship Management:

  • Works with assigned treasury management personnel and portfolio managers, engage with clients on idea generation and relevant opportunities to expand our relationship.

Industry Outreach:

  • Stays abreast of industry trends and market conditions in specialty deposits that could impact the assigned portfolio of relationships. Attend conferences and participate in speaking opportunities as a subject matter expect related to the intersection of specific specialty industry and banking.

Credit Quality and Onboarding:

  • When client/prospect lending needs arise, work with assigned portfolio managers to ensure pro-active monitoring of the credit quality of the portfolio through timely financial statement gathering, monitoring client’s compliance with ongoing required reporting, properly analyzing financial information and taking or recommending appropriate corrective actions based on acceptable levels. Ultimately responsible for managing the banks risk exposure to acceptable levels. Collaborating with Credit team and outside counsel as needed to prepare credit approval documents and managing onboarding process to ensure transactions are booked appropriately.

Maintaining Knowledge:

  • Stays abreast of industry trends and market conditions that could impact the assigned portfolio of relationships and borrowers.
  • Uses independent judgement and discretion to make decisions.
  • Analyzes and resolves problems.

ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Performs special projects, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
  • Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Required Qualifications:

  • Education level preferred: High School / High School Equivalency (GED, HiSET, TASC) / Foreign Equivalent .
  • Minimum experience required: 6+ Years as a Commercial Relationship Manager and/or commercial depository and treasury management sales. Some experience in commercial treasury management support may substitute for production experience.
  • Experience specific to specialty deposits industries; including treasury management, Investment Banking, or Capital Markets experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Education level preferred: Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) or equivalent experience. In business, finance or related field.

Job Competencies:

  • Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) designation.
  • Knowledge of commercial deposits, treasury management services, account analysis, and depository pricing skills.
  • Industry knowledge: Some understanding of specialty deposits industries including title companies, residential and commercial property managers, etc.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills to understand financial and cash flow analyses.
  • Experience utilizing a calling strategy to actively call on prospects/clients and establish a personally-developed network of clients and potential clients to source deals through various centers of influence.
  • Computer proficiency in Microsoft Office applications including; Word, Excel, and Teams.
  • Demonstrates a strong ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders by communicating clearly, engaging in proactive collaboration, and leveraging cross functional insights. Aligns relationship building efforts with enterprise goals to accelerate performance and drive strategic results.
  • Builds trusted client relationships, whether internal or external, by identifying needs and delivering tailored solutions to enhance the overall client experience.
  • Travel will be required as necessary.
  • Physical demands (ADA): The job requires a moderate degree of physical exertion and stamina such as standing, sitting, walking, driving or infrequent lifting.

jobs.excerpt: If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you!
jobs.description:
If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This is a developmental territory management & production underwriting role focused on Middle Market accounts across the Manufacturing, Wholesale/Distribution, Real Estate, Retail, and Food Service industry segments. You will own a defined renewal book and new business goal, with personal underwriting authority and accountability for profitable results, and a targeted promotional path into the Territory Manager level.


This is a Work-From-Home (WFH) position involving both virtual and occasional in-person travel to key agency partners.


Territory: Northern & Southern California Metros, including the Bay Area, Los Angeles, and Orange County.


Preferably, this Associate Territory Manager will be based in California or a bordering state, though other locations within the Pacific time zone can be considered.


Minimum qualifications:

  • Multi-line commercial insurance underwriting experience, including underwriting authority
  • A passion for driving profitable growth through agency engagement

Preferred qualifications:

  • Underwriting experience with accounts larger than 100k in DWP
  • Industry segment experience in Manufacturing, Wholesale/Distribution, Real Estate, Retail, and/or Food Service & Accommodation
  • Insurance designations or coursework, such as CPCU, CIC, or AU

The internal title for this role is "Associate Territory Manager, Middle Market Business Development - Commercial Lines"


This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.


Job Description Summary

On our team, we look for that rare professional who is both analytical and a relationship-builder. Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As an Associate Territory Manager, you'll be the primary relationship manager for middle market new and renewal business, through direct contact with a territory of select agencies or brokers. We'll count on you to drive profit and premium to meet financial goals and objectives through development, negotiation and execution of business plans. Your leadership and influencing skills will be key as you help agencies create and implement sales strategies, processes and practices that drive new sales, increase shelf space, profit and member retention. Your collaboration with internal partners will be important to support and increase the overall Nationwide presence.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Underwrites new business, renewals and endorsements based on authority level and appetite. Decisions at this level may require review of additional variables, leveraging agency, sales and underwriting relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions.

  • Reviews individual risks for acceptability and handles those within authority based on company underwriting guidelines and standards. Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports accordingly. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans. May perform portfolio analysis or additional underwriting analysis in support of unit objectives.

  • Monitors market conditions, competitive landscape, and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and factors necessary to win the account.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis.

  • Manages workflow and intricacies of underwriting assigned work by utilizing company tools and systems. Ensures file handling quality and workflow efficiency. Manages large, complex work and coordinates work with and through others to meet service level agreements. Effectively influences activities of Middle Market Business Development Team to facilitate the successful delivery and execution of select agency business plans.

  • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance, enhance agency relationship and to develop business solutions. Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options to improve retention and profitability. Develops and maintains strong business relationships with agencies, producers and key groups. Effectively communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines. Communicates product, technology changes and company objectives. Communicates and collaborates actively with team members and leadership to share industry trends, and field underwriting experience.

  • Drives robust agency business planning to deliver detailed performance plans with actions, account abilities and scheduled performance checkpoints. Ensures strong territorial objectives to maximize profit and pipeline management. Proactively identifies opportunities for all lines of business and refers to appropriate business leaders. Plans and coordinates the efforts of the Middle Market Business Development Team regarding new business, renewals, service plans, etc. Identifies prospects and recommends new agency appointments.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all enterprise products that may enhance offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and to develop new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of escalated customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities. Participates in program and product orientation meetings in conjunction with Sales/Marketing partners as the underwriting subject matter expert.

  • Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of any action plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to MM Business Development Director. Individual contributor.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree in business administration or management preferred. Technical insurance coursework toward designations of CPCU, CLU, FLMI, etc. is desirable.

Experience: Three years Commercial Lines underwriting experience required, additional sales experience preferred. Successful completion of the first phase (training) of the Associate Territory Manager role required.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Ability to manage heavy workload effectively and backup other team members as needed. Thorough working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for commercial business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and practices company commercial products and programs. Knowledge of state statutes and regulations. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment with underwriting authority and company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and best practices compliance. Strong drive for results.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Heavy travel with extended stays may be required. Most incumbents work from a remote location. A valid drivers license and safe driving record are required.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. jobs.excerpt: Technical Project ManagerABOUT THE ROLEAs a Technical Project Manager at 321, you will serve as the strategic leader responsible for planning, executing, and delivering complex technical projects including custom website development, enterprise system integrations, CRM implementations, and proprietary platform builds.
jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Technical Project Manager at 321, you will serve as the strategic leader responsible for planning, executing, and delivering complex technical projects including custom website development, enterprise system integrations, CRM implementations, and proprietary platform builds. You'll bridge the gap between technical teams and business stakeholders, translating strategic objectives into detailed technical requirements while managing timelines, budgets, and cross-functional resources to ensure successful delivery.

This role sits at the intersection of technical expertise, project leadership, documentation excellence, and AI-powered development methodologies. You'll bring deep understanding of software development lifecycles alongside proven ability to manage complex technical implementations. Your proficiency in AI-assisted development combined with strong technical writing skills will enable you to create comprehensive requirements documentation, guide development teams through AI-enhanced workflows, and deliver sophisticated solutions that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As part of an AI-first organization, you'll champion AI development practices, ensuring projects utilize intelligent tools to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and maintain competitive advantage.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Technical Project Planning & Execution

  • Own end-to-end project management for complex technical initiatives including custom website development, CRM integrations, API development, and proprietary platform builds like 321 AIM.
  • Develop comprehensive project plans including scope definition, technical architecture, resource allocation, timeline milestones, risk management, and budget tracking.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business requirements, technical constraints, and success criteria.
  • Translate business objectives into detailed technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that guide development teams.
  • Manage project budgets and timelines, tracking actuals against estimates and proactively addressing variances to protect profitability.
  • Coordinate resources across development, design, Client Success, and external vendors to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Facilitate agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

Technical & Functional Requirements Documentation

  • Create comprehensive technical requirements documents (TRDs) that define system architecture, data models, API specifications, integration patterns, and technical constraints.
  • Write detailed functional requirements documents (FRDs) that describe user workflows, business logic, interface requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Document system integrations including API endpoints, authentication methods, data mapping, error handling, and testing procedures.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate documentation creation, ensure completeness, and maintain consistency across technical specifications.
  • Develop user stories, use cases, and process flows that communicate requirements clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Create data flow diagrams, system architecture diagrams, wireframes, and technical specifications using industry-standard tools and notation.
  • Maintain living documentation that evolves throughout the project lifecycle, capturing decisions, changes, and lessons learned.
  • Ensure documentation meets compliance requirements for regulated industries including HIPAA, SOC 2, and data privacy standards.

AI-Powered Development Leadership

  • Champion AI-assisted development methodologies using platforms like Replit, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI-powered coding tools.
  • Guide development teams in leveraging AI for code generation, debugging, testing, documentation, and optimization to accelerate delivery cycles.
  • Architect solutions that integrate AI capabilities including natural language processing, machine learning models, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation.
  • Evaluate and implement AI development tools and platforms that improve team productivity, code quality, and project outcomes.
  • Define AI-specific requirements including model selection, training data needs, accuracy thresholds, and performance benchmarks.
  • Stay current on AI development trends, frameworks, and best practices, sharing knowledge with technical teams and stakeholders.
  • Assess technical feasibility of AI features, balancing innovation with practical constraints including cost, complexity, and time-to-market.

Website Development & CMS Projects

  • Manage custom website development projects from discovery through launch including design, development, content migration, and deployment.
  • Oversee CMS implementations and customizations across platforms including WordPress, HubSpot CMS, Webflow, and headless CMS solutions.
  • Define website requirements including information architecture, user experience flows, responsive design specifications, and performance targets.
  • Coordinate with Creative teams on design specifications, ensuring technical feasibility and maintaining design integrity through development.
  • Manage website integrations including CRM connections, marketing automation, analytics, payment processing, and third-party services.
  • Ensure websites meet accessibility standards (WCAG), SEO best practices, performance benchmarks, and security requirements.
  • Plan and execute website launches including DNS management, SSL certificates, quality assurance, and post-launch monitoring.

System Integrations & API Development

  • Lead complex integration projects connecting CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, High Level), marketing automation tools, and business systems.
  • Define integration requirements including data synchronization, real-time vs batch processing, error handling, and data validation rules.
  • Work with development teams to design and implement RESTful APIs, webhooks, and middleware solutions that enable seamless data flow.
  • Document API specifications including endpoints, authentication methods, request/response formats, rate limits, and error codes.
  • Manage third-party integrations and vendor relationships, ensuring SLAs are met and integration points remain stable.
  • Develop integration testing plans, coordinate QA activities, and validate data accuracy across connected systems.
  • Monitor integration performance and reliability, addressing issues proactively and implementing improvements.

Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Develop comprehensive testing strategies including unit testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing, and performance testing.
  • Create detailed test plans and test cases that validate functionality against requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Utilize AI-powered testing tools for automated test generation, bug detection, and quality assurance at scale.
  • Coordinate UAT sessions with clients and stakeholders, managing feedback and ensuring issues are resolved before launch.
  • Identify and manage project risks including technical constraints, resource availability, third-party dependencies, and scope creep.
  • Implement change management processes that assess impact, maintain scope control, and protect project timelines and budgets.
  • Ensure projects meet security standards, compliance requirements, and data protection regulations relevant to regulated industries.

Stakeholder Communication & Leadership

  • Serve as primary point of contact for technical project communication with clients, internal teams, and external vendors.
  • Lead client meetings including kickoffs, status updates, demo sessions, and strategic planning discussions.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into business language that non-technical stakeholders can understand and act upon.
  • Provide regular project status reporting including progress updates, milestone tracking, risk assessments, and budget reporting.
  • Facilitate decision-making when technical trade-offs arise, presenting options with clear pros, cons, and recommendations.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with clients through consistent delivery, proactive communication, and strategic guidance.
  • Mentor junior team members on project management methodologies, technical documentation, and AI development practices.

jobs.excerpt: Who is Credible? Credible is a leading U. S.  consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products.
jobs.description:
Who is Credible?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

About the Role:

Credible is looking for an AI-native Principal Product Manager to take ownership of our personal loans lending marketplace, our largest marketplace. You will own and deliver features from ideation to launch alongside design, engineering, and data. Primarily you'll focus on the front-end experience that helps consumers discover and compare options across multiple lenders.

This role requires AI fluency in both how you work and what you build. In your workflow, you bring working concepts rather than documents describing them, using AI tools like Claude to prototype ideas, run your own analysis, and validate concepts before committing engineering resources.You bring the experience and rigor to know which few ideas are worth building, and the drive to see them through.

In the product itself, you will shape how Credible reaches users as loan discovery moves beyond the comparison page and into AI assistants and embedded experiences, and you will determine where AI belongs within our own funnel to make comparing and choosing a loan simpler. Where AI touches the product, you own the quality bar: defining what good output looks like, measuring it, and ensuring it stays accurate and compliant.

Teams will look to you and your product leadership to guide the vision and direction of the product and achieve team OKRs.

The role is full-time and compensation will be based on experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Think Strategically and Creatively: Deliver new features for growing the personal loans marketplace and align them with Credible's long-term vision. Synthesize market trends, regulatory shifts in the personal loan space, user needs, and rapidly advancing AI capabilities to continually reinvent the platform, including how it reaches users beyond our own site.
  • Own AI-Powered Product Surfaces: Shape how Credible helps consumers discover and choose loans through AI assistants, embedded experiences, and AI-assisted flows within our own funnel. Decide where AI meaningfully improves the experience and where it doesn't belong.
  • Own the Roadmap: Manage the roadmap for personal loans by identifying opportunities in the industry and within our own funnel, weighing tradeoffs, and prioritizing team resources. Decide not only what to build, but what to remove.
  • Prototype and Validate: Use AI tools like Claude to build working concepts, test them quickly, and validate ideas with real artifacts. Explore many approaches, and find the ones that resonate with users and lenders.
  • Make Data-Driven Decisions: Utilize data analysis, A/B testing, and user research to validate assumptions, uncover insights, and drive meaningful improvements to the business. Run your own queries and analysis rather than depending on others for every question.
  • Lead and Collaborate Across Functions: Proactively engage cross functional teams to brainstorm innovative solutions and lead their implementation. Collaborate with engineering, design, data, partnerships, and operations teams to deliver product enhancements and achieve team OKRs.
  • Operate Responsibly in a Regulated Space: Personal loans lending is compliance-constrained. Understand where AI-assisted work and AI-generated output need human review, where claims and disclosures matter, and how to move fast without creating regulatory or trust risk.

Education and Experience:

  • At least 7 - 10 years of experience in a Product Management role for web-based consumer Internet products
  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Deep, demonstrated fluency using AI tools in your actual workflow for prototyping, analysis, research synthesis, and writing, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they don't
  • Genuine interest in and ideas about building AI-powered product experiences, not just using AI to work faster
  • Ability to bring working concepts to life, whether through AI tooling, light coding, or strong partnership with engineering
  • Familiarity with how to evaluate AI output quality, or clear aptitude and appetite to own it
  • Ability to use data, your experience, and product instincts to identify the most impactful areas of focus, including running your own analysis
  • Strong analytical abilities across spreadsheets, SQL, and other analytics tools
  • Exceptional problem solving and communication skills
  • Strong project management skills, and willingness/ability to own critical parts of the product, end-to-end
  • Thrive on collaboration with other teams to accomplish shared goals
  • Technical aptitude sufficient to work closely with engineers, evaluate implementation approaches, and weigh cost/benefit tradeoffs
  • A bias toward experimentation and the discipline to walk away from your own ideas when the evidence says so

Why work at Credible?

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we’re the friend you always wish you had in finance.

We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we’ll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world.

AIS is looking for a Program Analyst to support the NOAA Fisheries, Alaska Region Fisheries Disaster Support Services program.

Primary Function:

The Fisheries Disaster Program Analyst supports NOAA Fisheries, Alaska Region in evaluating fishery disaster requests submitted under Section 312(a) of the Magnuson-Stevens Act. Working under the Regional Fishery Disaster Assistance Lead, the analyst reviews requests for completeness, coordinates with requesting states, tribes, and government entities, evaluates complete packages against established policy methodology, and drafts decision memos to support a determination by the Secretary of Commerce. The role also builds and maintains the tracking tools, templates, and file systems used to manage Alaska fishery disasters from declaration through grant close-out.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Provide program management support to the Regional Fishery Disaster Assistance Lead (Lead).
  • Serve as the point of contact for requesting entities from initial receipt of a request through the final decision and funding; answer questions and refer items outside the contractor’s scope to the Lead.
  • Review each disaster request against the required information in MSA Section 312(a); notify the requestor’s staff contact of any missing or incomplete information and inform the Lead by email of the deficiencies.
  • Evaluate complete request packages using the methodology in the Headquarters Policy Guidance, and notify the Lead when commencing review.
  • Draft decision memos on agreed-upon templates for the Lead’s review, incorporate requested edits, and update memos with the Lead’s recommended decision.
  • Serve as the initial point of contact for staff questions during the Headquarters and Region clearance process, working with the Lead as appropriate.
  • Develop an annotated Alaska fishery disaster request template that can be shared with requesters.
  • Build and maintain a database of Alaska fishery disasters to track multi-year disasters and grants, and monitor state, federal, and Pacific States Marine Fisheries Commission websites for related disaster-relief information.
  • Create and maintain a file management system for Alaska disasters spanning declaration through grant close-out.
  • Prepare annual reports on pending and approved Alaska fishery disasters and develop spend plans for leadership.
  • Submit monthly progress reports (accomplishments, issues encountered, and recommendations) and monthly invoices by the 15th of the following month.

About Us:

Zepto is building the beating heart of Australia's real-time, account-to-account payments revolution.

We're a rapidly-scaling business reimagining how money moves for some of Australia's largest merchants, organisations and payment platforms – disrupting a market that's been overdue for change for decades. This ambition has seen us recognised as FinTech Organisation of the Year at the Finnies Awards. Twice.

For passionate, action-oriented people, this ambition means genuine opportunity: to build category-defining infrastructure, own hard problems, and grow a career at the pace of the business around you. This isn't incremental work – it's the kind of experience that changes the trajectory of a career.

We believe in the power of positive human experiences, and that a deep sense of belonging creates cohesion in our culture. Even as a remote-first team, you'll be a contributor and custodian of that culture, solving complex problems alongside talented people who are just as driven to help us deliver on our brand promise and build 'a better way to pay' at Zepto.

About the Role:

Reporting to the Head of Solutions and Customer Success, as a Senior Solutions Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of engineering, product and sales - the technical backbone of our sales cycle and the trusted advisor our merchants and partners turn to for an end-to-end payments experience.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role built around technical pre-sales, solution design and integration consultation. You'll need real expertise in payments technology - how currency and data move through APIs, webhooks, settlement rails and reconciliation flows - and the ability to translate that complexity into a solution that a merchant's CTO, CFO and engineering team can all get behind.

You'll lead technical discovery, design and present tailored solutions, run proofs of concept, and own the technical thread from first conversation through to a live, successful integration. Your work directly shapes whether prospects convert, and whether customers see the value of our technology once they're live.

Working in a scale-up means you get the opportunity to flex your skills in a variety of ways. We are agile and always willing to roll up our sleeves to get things done. You can, however, expect your day to day to be involved in the following:

  • Own technical pre-sales end to end; leading discovery, scope alignment, gap analysis and solution design from first conversation through to signed deal and handover to delivery.
  • Architect payments solutions across Zepto's API and product suite; payment initiation, PayTo/PayID, direct debit, disbursements, reconciliation, webhooks - solving each merchant's specific technical constraints.
  • Run technical workshops and demos for technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, adapting the story to whoever's in the room.
  • Own the technical content of RFPs, RFIs and tenders, partnering with Commercial on positioning and competitive differentiation.
  • Be the technical voice in the sales cycle, fielding deep questions on APIs, integration patterns, compliance and security in real time.
  • Prototype and validate; building sandbox integrations and testing API flows to prove feasibility before a merchant commits engineering resources.
  • Bridge sales and product, feeding real merchant requirements and competitive gaps back into the roadmap.
  • Support technical delivery handover, making sure what's sold is what's built and customers are set up for a smooth go-live.

About You:

You're a technical pre-sales pro who can hold your own in front of an engineering team in the morning and a CFO in the afternoon. Specifically, we'd welcome any candidate who has:

  • 3+ years' experience in pre-sales, solutions engineering or solution architecture, ideally supporting technical sales cycles.
  • Strong, demonstrable payments experience; payment rails, gateways, settlement and reconciliation - ideally with exposure to the Australian landscape (NPP, PayTo, PayID, BECS, card schemes) or equivalent overseas. Time at a payments company, fintech, bank or PSP is highly valued.
  • Genuine comfort in the technical weeds of APIs - reading docs, constructing and debugging REST calls, interpreting JSON, and reasoning through webhook and event-driven patterns without needing an engineer to translate.
  • A track record in technical pre-sales specifically - running discovery, scoping integrations, presenting to technical and executive audiences, and responding to tenders. You sell the "how" as convincingly as the "why".
  • A tertiary qualification in computer science or a related field, or the equivalent built through 3+ years hands-on with code, APIs or technical systems.
  • Strong project management instincts - comfortable juggling multiple live deals and stakeholders without dropping the ball.
  • A self-directed streak and comfort with ambiguity - you're energised by startup pace and go looking for the process improvement rather than waiting for someone else to find it.

Why Zepto?

Headquartered in beautiful Byron Bay, Zepto has an inspiring founder story and is a customer-focused, culture-first organisation. You’ll be joining a team that champions curiosity and a pioneering perspective, and thrives in a fast-moving sector.

Just some of Zepto’s commitments to it’s people include:

  • Flexible Work: A remote-first work culture, with the opportunity to work anywhere in Australia. You’ll also get access to premium co-working spaces and a Byron, Sydney & Melbourne Hub

  • Annual Learning Budget: An individual learning budget, and 4 x paid Growth & Impact Days annually to focus on professional development
  • Remote-Work Support: A $500 Remote Work Budget to set up your home office upon commencement, and $300 annually from your 2nd Zeptoversary

📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Dans ce rôle de Program Manager, vous pilotez plusieurs équipes techniques, coordonnez les parties prenantes et assurez la gestion des projets liés au domaine IT judiciaire. Vous encadrez des équipes aux profils variés, actives à la fois sur le développement d’applications, la modernisation du parc existant et la mise en place ou la maintenance des infrastructures IT. Ces équipes couvrent notamment les applications historiques, les nouvelles solutions logicielles, les systèmes, les réseaux, le stockage de données et les pratiques DevOps.

Vous intervenez dans un environnement lié aux activités de police judiciaire et au traitement de dossiers sensibles, avec des enjeux élevés en matière de continuité, de sécurité et de coordination entre parties prenantes.

Missions principales

  • Prendre connaissance de l’existant et formuler des pistes techniques pour stabiliser certaines parties d’applications legacy.
  • Superviser la migration de fonctionnalités provenant d’autres solutions vers une application legacy de type client Windows lourd, en garantissant la compatibilité avec le socle technologique en place.
  • Veiller à l’intégration correcte des fonctionnalités migrées avec les autres modules applicatifs et les systèmes externes nécessaires à la collecte ou à l’échange de données.
  • Garantir la compatibilité des applications legacy avec les futures versions de Windows et la stabilité de leur exécution.
  • Encadrer l’équipe chargée de l’analyse de la nouvelle solution et contribuer activement à ses choix techniques.
  • Piloter les équipes responsables de l’implémentation d’une nouvelle solution web responsive.
  • Superviser les développements backend et frontend, ainsi que les tests unitaires et d’intégration.
  • S’assurer du versionnement correct du code source, de l’usage de Git et des bonnes pratiques associées, comme les branches, pull requests et code reviews.
  • Structurer et suivre la rédaction de la documentation technique par les équipes.
  • Encadrer les activités DevOps et la mise en place des pipelines de déploiement pour les applications, les services et l’infrastructure as code.
  • Superviser les équipes en charge de l’infrastructure, des réseaux, des systèmes, de l’intégration et du déploiement continu.
  • Accompagner des programmes de transformation numérique, notamment la modernisation d’applications et le passage d’un client lourd vers une application web moderne.

  • Assurer un niveau de monitoring adapté avec des outils tels que Grafana et Prometheus.

📝 Votre profil

Vous êtes titulaire d’un bachelier en informatique et justifiez de plusieurs années d’expérience en développement logiciel, y compris dans des fonctions techniques, ainsi que d’une expérience dans une fonction similaire.

Vous avez une expérience confirmée en gestion de programme complexe, avec coordination de plusieurs projets et de multiples parties prenantes. Vous savez encadrer des équipes techniques hétérogènes et adapter votre style de management selon les personnes, les contextes et les priorités.

Vous êtes à l’aise dans un environnement Agile, en particulier Scrum. L’animation de Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-up, Review et Rétrospective fait partie de votre pratique quotidienne.

Sur le plan technique, vous disposez de bonnes connaissances en .NET (C#), appliquées notamment à des architectures microservices. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les API REST ou gRPC, les approches event driven et le développement d’applications web de type SPA dans une architecture micro-frontend, notamment avec Angular, ainsi qu’avec HTML et CSS.

Vous maîtrisez les mécanismes d’authentification via OpenID Connect et O365, côté backend comme côté frontend.

Vous avez une expérience confirmée en CI/CD et dans la mise en place de pipelines de déploiement avec GitLab. Vous maîtrisez également Kubernetes, Linux et les principes d’Infrastructure as Code. Une expérience en IaC constitue une plus-value importante.

Vous avez une bonne compréhension des enjeux de cybersécurité et de la mise en œuvre de solutions sécurisées. Une connaissance de la cryptographie est un atout.

Vous possédez également de bonnes bases en modélisation UML et BPMN, en monitoring avec Grafana ou Prometheus, ainsi qu’en bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL.

Une expérience en Delphi et en développement d’applications Windows constitue un atout supplémentaire.

Vous maîtrisez l’anglais ainsi qu’une des deux langues nationales. La connaissance active d’une langue nationale et au minimum passive de l’autre représente un avantage. La connaissance de l’environnement policier, et plus particulièrement du contexte de la police judiciaire, constitue un atout important.
