jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryScicom Infrastructure Services is seeking a part-time Strategic Alliances and Partner Manager to manage and strengthen relationships with our technology and ISV partners, including organizations such as Dynatrace, Datadog, Databricks, BigPanda, SpaceX, and other strategic technology providers.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Scicom Infrastructure Services is seeking a part-time Strategic Alliances and Partner Manager to manage and strengthen relationships with our technology and ISV partners, including organizations such as Dynatrace, Datadog, Databricks, BigPanda, SpaceX, and other strategic technology providers.

This individual will serve as the primary point of coordination between Scicom and our partner organizations, ensuring that we understand and meet partner program requirements, maintain appropriate certifications and competencies, and take full advantage of available training, sales, technical, marketing, and business development resources.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working across technical, sales, operations, and executive teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage ongoing relationships with Scicom's technology, ISV, and strategic partners.
  • Serve as the primary internal point of contact for partner programs, requirements, initiatives, and communications.
  • Develop a strong understanding of each partner's program structure, certification requirements, competency levels, benefits, and available resources.
  • Maintain documentation of requirements necessary to achieve or maintain partner status, tiers, competencies, or specializations.
  • Track employee training and certification requirements across partner programs.
  • Coordinate with employees and leadership to ensure required partner courses, training programs, and certifications are completed on schedule.
  • Maintain a centralized certification and partner-requirements tracker, including certification expiration and renewal dates.
  • Identify new training and certification opportunities that support Scicom's technical capabilities and strategic objectives.
  • Schedule and participate in regular meetings with partner/channel representatives.
  • Build relationships with partner account managers, channel managers, technical teams, and alliance representatives.
  • Identify partner incentives, rebates, credits, funding programs, marketing resources, training resources, and other benefits available to Scicom.
  • Ensure Scicom is utilizing the full range of resources available through each partner program.
  • Monitor changes to partner programs and communicate relevant requirements or opportunities to leadership.
  • Coordinate completion of partner applications, documentation, renewals, business plans, and compliance requirements.
  • Identify opportunities for joint business development, co-selling, referrals, lead generation, and partner-supported client opportunities.
  • Work with internal leadership to align certifications and partner investments with Scicom's service offerings and growth strategy.
  • Assist with partner portals, opportunity registration, deal registration, certification records, and other administrative partner activities.
  • Provide periodic updates to leadership regarding partner status, certification progress, upcoming requirements, risks, and opportunities.

Qualifications

  • Experience in channel management, strategic alliances, technology partnerships, vendor management, or a related role.
  • Experience working with technology vendors, ISVs, cloud providers, SaaS companies, or IT consulting organizations strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with partner programs, certification programs, and technology vendor ecosystems.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills with the ability to manage requirements across multiple partners simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with technical employees, sales teams, executives, and external partner representatives.
  • Strong follow-through and attention to deadlines, certification requirements, and partner program milestones.
  • Comfortable working independently in a consulting or part-time capacity.
  • Experience with partner portals, CRM systems, certification tracking, or similar tools is preferred.

Key Measures of Success

Success in this role will include:

  • Maintaining Scicom's good standing with strategic technology partners.
  • Ensuring required employee certifications and partner competencies are completed and maintained.
  • Increasing utilization of partner training, resources, programs, and incentives.
  • Developing stronger relationships with partner representatives and channel teams.
  • Identifying opportunities that generate new business, technical capabilities, or financial value for Scicom.
  • Providing leadership with clear visibility into the status and value of each strategic partnership.

Position Type

Part-Time Consultant

This position is expected to work independently and collaboratively with Scicom leadership, technical resources, and external technology partners. Hours may fluctuate based on partner initiatives, certification deadlines, and business development activities.

jobs.description:
About The Lisinski Law Firm

Since 2020, Lisinski Law Firm has served as a dedicated humanitarian immigration practice committed to providing meaningful support to individuals and families seeking safety, stability, and a path forward. We frequently stand with clients who have been turned away elsewhere, offering both advocacy and care. Joining our Firm means becoming part of a team devoted to keeping families together and “Changing as Many Lives as Possible.”

About the Role

The Sr Staff Attorney independently drafts and reviews standard immigration applications, motions, briefs, and client communications and manages assigned portions of immigration matters. The role supports clients in obtaining their documents and remaining united with their families through accurate legal work, client communication, and routine hearing coverage with supervision. The attorney coordinates with staff attorneys, paralegals, and support teams, provides technical guidance, resolves standard corrections and escalations, and seeks direction on complex or non-standard issues. The role exercises greater independence than an Operations Staff Attorney and delivers routine work requiring limited substantive edits.

Your Key Contributions

  • Participate in hiring staff attorneys by assessing legal knowledge, drafting skills, and suitability for the role; lead technical onboarding and training to establish proficiency in immigration case processes, legal review standards, and Firm procedures.
  • Conduct case shadowing and review attorney work products to identify development needs; provide timely, specific feedback that strengthens legal analysis, accuracy, professional judgment, and independent execution of routine assignments.
  • Serve as a primary resource for staff attorney questions and routine legal issues; address feedback, clarify legal guidance, and escalate complex, novel, or high-risk matters to supervising counsel with supporting analysis and recommended next steps.
  • Lead daily case and workflow huddles to communicate priorities, review progress toward task goals, and identify obstacles; coordinate follow-up to support timely completion while maintaining legal quality and client service standards.
  • Draft, review, and update legal procedures, training materials, and review resources to reflect approved practices and changes in immigration requirements; recommend improvements and obtain appropriate approval before implementation.
  • Take ownership of assigned escalations, corrections, and deadline-sensitive cases; assess underlying issues, coordinate corrective action, and complete required legal work within established timelines, seeking supervisory guidance when matters exceed the role’s scope.
  • Research immigration statutes, regulations, agency guidance, and relevant decisions to resolve case questions and support legal recommendations; translate findings into practical guidance and share relevant developments with staff attorneys and supervising counsel.
  • Serve as attorney of record on assigned immigration matters pursuant to Form G-28 for USCIS matters or Form E-28 for immigration court matters, as applicable; maintain familiarity with case status, material legal issues, and required filings.
  • Develop and recommend legal strategies for assigned USCIS matters and cases pending in immigration court by analyzing facts, evidence, and available legal options; implement approved strategies and obtain supervising counsel’s direction and approval for non-standard, complex, or high-risk decisions.
  • Independently draft and review standard immigration applications, responses to Requests for Evidence, appeals, and court filings using established legal guidance; provide substantive edits and obtain supervisory review for complex or unfamiliar issues.
  • Evaluate filings and supporting evidence for accuracy, completeness, consistency, legal sufficiency, and alignment with approved case strategy; identify deficiencies, assess their potential impact, and ensure necessary revisions are addressed before submission.
  • Coordinate corrections and requests for additional information with attorneys, paralegals, and support staff; provide clear direction on required changes, track outstanding items, and verify that identified issues and required attorney reviews are completed before filing.
  • Communicate with clients, generally through an interpreter, to explain case status, address legal questions within the assigned scope, clarify next steps, and obtain relevant information; document material communications and escalate concerns requiring additional legal review.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Instills Trust – Demonstrates integrity, protects client confidentiality, provides reliable legal work, and communicates limitations, errors, and risks promptly.
  • Resourcefulness – Uses legal research, established precedents, and available resources to resolve routine issues; seeks appropriate assistance when matters exceed the assigned scope.
  • Plans & Aligns – Organizes case workstreams, prioritizes deadline-sensitive tasks, and proactively coordinates dependencies to meet filing and hearing requirements.
  • Collaborates – Works effectively with attorneys, paralegals, support staff, and other partners; shares information and provides constructive technical feedback.
  • Working knowledge of immigration law and standard case processes, with sound legal analysis, research, drafting, and document review skills.
  • Ability to manage routine assignments independently, produce work requiring limited substantive edits, and recognize complex issues requiring supervisory review.
  • Clear, respectful client communication and developing advocacy skills, including communication through interpreters.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently handle routine legal assignments with limited substantive edits, manage competing deadlines, and recognize complex or high-risk issues requiring supervising counsel’s review
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Litify, Neutrinet, and comparable case and document management tools.

Minimum Education and Experience Requirements

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Active membership in good standing with a state bar.
  • 1–3 years of post-J.D. legal experience in immigration law, with demonstrated proficiency in legal drafting, document review, and client communication.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing immigration applications, supporting evidence, responses to Requests for Evidence, and related filings; humanitarian immigration experience preferred.
  • Experience providing technical guidance, training, or constructive feedback to attorneys or legal support staff preferred.

Work Schedule

  • Monday to Friday 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM EST

How You'll Benefit

Lisinski Law Firm provides a comprehensive benefits package that supports the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We recognize the importance of health and well-being and are committed to fostering an environment where every team member can feel and perform at their best.

  • 401K Match
  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
  • Options for Health Savings Account or Flexible Spending Account
  • Dependent Care FSA
  • Basic Life Insurance
  • Voluntary Life & AD&D
  • Disability Insurance
  • Voluntary Accident Insurance
  • Voluntary Hospital Indemnity Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Calm App Subscription

Our Firm

At Lisinski Law Firm, the commitment we show to our clients is matched by how we support and invest in our people. LLF is a place where employees are encouraged by peers, heard by leadership, and strengthened by a genuinely collaborative team culture. Whether you join Marketing, IT, Accounting, Legal, or any other function, your work matters. Every role contributes to meaningful, lasting impact in the lives of those we serve.

Our Values

At Lisinski Law Firm, we are driven by a client obsessed mindset and a commitment to learning, advocacy, efficiency, and nimbleness in everything we do. We work as true team players, delivering creative problem-solving and high-quality service to support families with excellence and care.

Who You Are

As an employee-owner, you embrace accountability, working safely, and collaboration while thinking resourcefully and independently.

Like all Dudekians, you are curious and solution-oriented, with the ability to adapt quickly to changes and approach challenges with a spirit of innovation.

  • Documents procedures and recurring solutions and contributes to knowledge-base and onboarding materials.
  • Progressively develops technical and business-process knowledge across Deltek Vantagepoint and other supported systems.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Highschool diploma

  • Organized and able to manage multiple requests, priorities, and follow-ups effectively.

  • Resourceful and comfortable researching issues and using available documentation before escalating.

  • Ability to work independently while partnering effectively across departments in both remote and office environments.

  • Highly coachable, curious, and proactive in developing new knowledge and skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in an IT help desk, application support, service desk, or similar ticket-based support environment.
  • Experience with Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or a comparable ticketing platform.
  • Exposure to ERP or enterprise business applications; experience with Deltek Vantagepoint is a plus.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional business teams or documenting procedures and knowledge-base content.

Compensation: $32.64.00-$47.00 hourly*

*Final agreed-upon compensation will be based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s related experience, education, certifications, skills, and work location. Successful candidates must pass a pre-employment drug test and background check prior to beginning employment.

Working Conditions

  • This job operates in a remote or office-based environment and this role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, etc.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. This job requires the following:

  • Attending meetings, both in person and virtually, and speaking on the phone with peers, clients, etc.

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Marketing Science sits within Upstart's Growth, Product, and Ops Analytics team and answers two questions for the business: is our marketing working, and where should it go next? The team's analysts and data scientists are embedded with growth marketing across every channel that brings borrowers to Upstart, including direct mail, paid search and social, video, mobile, email, brand campaigns, and lending partnerships. Within a channel, they work out what's performing and how to make it better. Across channels, they look at how spend should be divided and how each channel affects the others.

At Upstart, a marketing dollar only pays off if it reaches someone our AI models approve and who then takes the loan, so the team's questions go well past the click. And since we see the full path from first touch to funded loan, the team can measure marketing against that outcome rather than a stand-in for it.

You'll lead that team and work directly with Upstart's marketing leaders, acting as a thought partner to optimize for what is best for the company. We're looking for an experienced data science and analytics leader who can raise the impact this team has on Upstart's growth.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead a team of analysts and data scientists who are embedded with each marketing channel and responsible end to end for its work
  • Put experimentation at the center of the team's work: decide which tests are worth running across channels, and make sure the results change what marketing does next
  • Guide the team's analysis toward explaining why a channel's performance moved and what marketing should do about it

  • Hire and develop a team that marketing leaders treat as a partner, not a reporting servic

  • Enough SQL and Python to check your team's work yourself
  • A record of hiring well and growing people into more senior roles
  • Good judgment in ambiguous, greenfield areas: you can frame a question nobody has asked yet and decide whether it's worth the team's time
  • Clear written and verbal communication with marketing, finance, product, and technical audiences, and the willingness to tell a senior leader when the evidence doesn't support their plan

Preferred Qualifications

  • An exceptional candidate will also have:

    • A PhD or master's degree in statistics, economics, computer science, or another quantitative field
    • Experience bringing AI tools into a team's analysis and reporting work

jobs.description:
We're Novakid, the next-generation early English learning environment that allows kids around the world to learn English efficiently, through play and fully remote practice with certified professional teachers.

Think cutting edge technology like AI-powered games and training apps that promote English speaking and comprehension based on the use of authentic content in English language. Think certified professionals with years and decades of expertise in children's psychology and learning methods.

“Our Vision is to change the way ESL children learn English by making it more engaging, elective, fun, and accessible. The ability to master the English language from an early age is critical to achieving a path of greater success and fulfillment, socially, emotionally, academically and professionally.” – Max Azarov, Founder

About the Role

Novakid is investing heavily in its brand, and we want films that move people. We’re looking for an AI Film Director to create brand films with a movie-level finish, using the latest generative AI tools.

You’ll take each film from brief to final master: from taking the brief to storyboard, AI generation, edit, colour and finishing. You’ll work with our sound engineer on music and sound. Our video production team covers Novakid’s day-to-day content; your focus is our hero brand films, made for families around the globe (motion graphics and 3D/compositing chops are a real plus). This is a full-time, hands-on role in the Creative team, reporting to our Head of Creative.

Key Responsibilities

  • Direct and deliver cinematic brand films from brief to final master

  • Turn briefs from the Head of Creative and Brand Director into emotional, story-driven concepts that stay true to Novakid’s brand voice and visual identity

  • Create and own Novakid’s AI film style guide (characters, worlds, look and feel) so characters and style stay consistent from film to film

  • Refine AI output by hand (retouching, compositing, redrawing, colour grading) until every frame has a movie-level finish

  • Work with our sound engineer on music, sound design and voice-over, including localized versions for our key markets

  • Plan each film’s schedule and budget (tools, generation credits, freelancers when needed) and deliver on time

  • Keep up with AI film tools and bring in new techniques that raise quality or speed

  • Follow responsible AI practices with our Legal team: clear AI labelling, consent for any real person’s likeness or voice, and commercial rights to everything we publish

  • Strong design background alongside video production and AI prompting skills.

  • Can build automated content-production workflows using AI agents, APIs or workflow tools.

  • Own the voice acting and dubbing pipeline: work with an external casting/dubbing agency, or with per-language actor leads who source and manage further talent for their own language, to cast, record and quality-check localized voice content, attending recordings yourself to protect creative and brand quality

  • Explore where AI voice generation fits for the existing video editors on lower-complexity projects, and build a lightweight workflow so they can use it without pulling in the full unit

  • Integrate the AI Video Production Unit into the wider creative organization, with clean handoffs to the video editors team and the Lead Producer so both tracks reinforce each other instead of duplicating work

Requirements

What you’ll have…

  • A portfolio of complete AI films, not just a showreel, with consistent characters and coherent storytelling

  • Proven experience directing cinematic, emotionally resonant brand or narrative films, combining traditional film craft with current, hands-on AI video experience (image-to-video, AI-assisted VFX)

  • Strong visual fundamentals: composition, colour, lighting and storytelling, with a design background and the eye to judge and fix AI output

  • Editing and finishing skills: Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (including colour grading), plus Photoshop, Illustrator and After Effects for fixes and compositing

  • Motion graphics and 3D/compositing skills (e.g. Cinema 4D, Maya, Nuke, After Effects) are a strong plus

  • Experience leading a small technical-creative team (e.g. prompt engineers, a cinematography lead, or similar hybrid creative/technical roles)

  • Familiarity with voice acting and dubbing production, whether managing an external casting agency or per-language talent leads

  • Able to deliver a film a month on your own: organised, reliable on deadlines, and comfortable setting up a process from scratch, since this is a new discipline at Novakid

  • Collaborative: you’ll work closely with Brand, our sound engineer and the video production team

  • Comfortable defining process as you go, this is a new production discipline at Novakid, not an established playbook

  • English fluency; other languages are a real plus given the multi-market, multi-language scope of this role

What Success Looks Like (first 6 months)

First 3 months

  • Your workflow from brief to final master is set up and documented

  • Version 1 of Novakid’s AI film style guide is in place (characters, look, reference library)

  • 2–3 brand films delivered and approved by the Head of Creative and Brand Director

First 6 months

  • Minimum of one film every month, each with a movie-level finish (5–6 films delivered in total)

  • Characters and look stay consistent from film to film

  • The Head of Creative and Brand Director trusts that every film meets Novakid’s creative and brand standards without needing heavy oversight.

  • Every film on time and within budget, with what we learn from each film’s performance feeding into the next

We Offer

  • Make an impact: Improve the lives of children around the world.

  • Grow with us: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

  • Thrive in a collaborative culture: Join a diverse and supportive team that values creativity and innovation.

  • Flexible work environment: Enjoy the freedom to work remotely.

Reporting directly to and working under the direction of the General Counsel, the Full-Time Executive Legal Assistant to the General Counsel will provide confidential administrative and paralegal support to the General Counsel and be a critical part of the organization’s Legal Team. This position supports the General Counsel and internal legal activities by processing litigation holds, coordinating communications, maintaining files and records, monitoring compliance with labor agreements and statutory and regulatory filings, preparing and processing documents, and scheduling meetings, travel, and related logistics in accordance with Color Of Change policies and procedures. The ideal candidate will possess superb organizational and communication skills; creative problem-solving skills; knowledge of legal procedures, process, concepts, and terminology; the ability to handle a multitude of tasks simultaneously; and the ability to adapt quickly to meet changing deadlines and priorities.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Organize and maintain legal matter files, board governance documents and correspondence, contract and other legal templates, internal policy documents and written protocols, and assist with the maintenance of personnel and labor relations files;
  • Ensure efficient processing of litigation holds, discovery materials, legal correspondence and filings;
  • Format and help prepare correspondence, memos, reports, and presentations;
  • Assist in the preparation of materials and presentations to governing boards and staff, to include PPT presentations, training materials, resolutions, board minutes, charters, and other related materials;
  • Monitor and track filings, registrations, and submissions necessary for nonprofit organizational compliance, governance, and corporate good standing;
  • Identify and analyze relevant multistate and federal administrative, regulatory, and tax agency requirements and regulations;
  • Provide confidential administrative support to the General Counsel and coordinate with the People & Culture Team on labor and employee relations matters, to include monitoring compliance with the collective bargaining agreement, assisting with handling grievances and developing grievance procedures, workplace investigations, and other matters related to the implementation of the organization’s labor-relations and employment policies and strategy;
  • Independently use sound judgment and initiative to develop project timelines, anticipate organizational needs, prioritize assignments, meet deadlines, and perform complex administrative tasks;
  • Coordinate travel arrangements, itineraries, meetings, and events, and prepare and submit related expense reimbursement requests in accordance with Color Of Change policies;
  • Work collaboratively and cooperatively with staff and leadership in a fast-paced environment, sometimes under pressure, remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient; and,
  • Other relevant duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of experience in a legal administrative support role to an attorney, preferably in a nonprofit or internal corporate setting.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of legal terminology, concepts, forms, documents, practices, and procedures.
  • Experience working with corporate governance boards, or the ability to demonstrate a working knowledge of corporate governance and compliance requirements.
  • Experience working in a unionized environment, including familiarity with labor relations processes, union representation, and collective bargaining agreements is preferred.
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint and other applications, and demonstrated ability to configure templates and workflows.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently and effectively.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Demonstrated commitment to racial justice and equity.

MORE INFORMATION

  • Location: Remote
  • FLSA Status: Exempt
  • Employees Report to this Position: No
  • Job Classification: Non-Bargaining Unit

COMPENSATION

Compensation for this role is $70,000 - $85,000 base, commensurate with experience and qualifications with a schedule in coordination with the General Counsel’s core work hours and time zone (Mountain Time).

Color Of Change offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; flexible spending accounts; a 401(k) retirement plan; generous paid time off; paid holidays; and paid family leave.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

Color Of Change (COC) operates under a remote office environment. You will collaborate with colleagues around the United States. This position requires working core hours on a laptop for most of the workday, and may require additional time as necessary to perform job duties and responsibilities. No special physical demands are required to perform the work.

jobs.title: Head of Sales
jobs.excerpt: About By Association Only (BAO)BAO is a globally award-winning Platinum Shopify Plus eCommerce agency based in the UK.
jobs.companyName: By Association Only - Shopify Platinum Partner
jobs.description:
About By Association Only (BAO)

BAO is a globally award-winning Platinum Shopify Plus eCommerce agency based in the UK. We’re a senior team of designers, developers, and marketers committed to exceptional standards in eCommerce. We work exclusively with Shopify Plus merchants, specialising in the fashion, cosmetics, and luxury goods sectors, for brands all over the world in competitive global markets.

We work in a studio where independence, autonomy, and doing the right thing are at the centre of everything we do. As an agency, we’re on a mission to work with the world’s most ambitious eCommerce brands, and we do this in an environment that is smart, open, fast-paced, fun, and rewarding.

Although we're headquartered in Cambridge, we are staffed by around 80% permanently remote employees that are located all over the UK. All of our team members are full-time team members.

Role Overview

We are looking for an articulate, commercially astute and highly organised Head of Sales to join BAO’s Commercial Team.

This is a pivotal role within the agency. BAO is an agency that puts service first, so white-glove treatment of inbound and outbound sales journeys is crucial. We are not a hard-sales agency, our approach is thoughtful, consultative, well-informed and relationship-led.

The Head of Sales will be responsible for owning and managing BAO’s sales pipeline, from the first review of a new opportunity through to proposal, negotiation, winning the work and briefing the client successfully into the wider team.

The role sits within the Commercial Team and reports directly into the Commercial Director. You will work closely with the Commercial Director, Managing Director and Head of Client Services, all of whom are actively involved in BAO’s commercial process and have played a central role in shaping how the agency wins new projects and retainer clients.

Over time, the ambition for this role is that you become the autonomous lead of BAO’s sales process: confidently qualifying opportunities, leading sales conversations, shaping proposals, coordinating scopes with internal specialists and ensuring new clients experience a smooth, considered and professional introduction to the agency.

Alongside managing inbound opportunities, the Head of Sales will help BAO become more structured and intelligent in how we understand, report on and develop our pipeline. This includes capturing pipeline information, maintaining a high-quality sales contact database, supporting carefully targeted outbound activity and working with BAO’s marketing team to connect sales strategy with PR, events, white papers, podcasts and wider agency profile-building activity.

This role would suit someone who combines commercial confidence with maturity, sensitivity and excellent judgement. You will need to be credible with ambitious eCommerce brands, comfortable discussing Shopify Plus projects and retainers, and able to represent BAO clearly and professionally in writing, on calls, in person and, where appropriate, on stage at industry events.

Core Responsibilities

1, Sales pipeline ownership

You will own and manage BAO’s sales pipeline, ensuring that inbound enquiries are reviewed, qualified and progressed with clarity and consideration.

You will be responsible for understanding which opportunities are right for BAO, which require further discovery and which should be prioritised. You will maintain a clear view of pipeline status, opportunity value, likelihood, timing and potential resourcing requirements, giving the Commercial Director and Managing Director confidence in the state of new business.

This role requires someone who can balance enthusiasm for new opportunities with strong commercial judgement. Not every enquiry will be right for BAO to add value, and part of the key to this role is knowing how to identify fit early, guide promising conversations forward and support prospects with swift guidance to proposed service.

2. Consultative sales conversations

You will lead sales conversations with prospective clients, often senior stakeholders within ambitious and enterprise grade brands.

Your role is to understand the client’s business, their objectives, their current eCommerce setup, their challenges and what they are hoping to achieve. You should be able to ask intelligent questions, identify commercial and technical considerations, and communicate BAO’s value in a way that is confident and collaborative.

BAO’s sales process is built on trust, expertise and fit. We want prospective clients to feel that they are speaking with someone who understands their context, can interpret their needs and can help them make a good decision.

3. Proposal development and commercial scoping

You will be responsible for developing high-quality proposals that clearly articulate BAO’s understanding of the client’s needs and how we would approach the work.

This will involve working closely with members of the Development, Design, Strategy, Solutions, Project Management and Account Management teams to shape scopes of work that are commercially appropriate, operationally realistic and aligned with the client’s objectives.

You do not need to be a developer, but you do need to have enough eCommerce and Shopify fluency to understand client requirements, ask the right questions and translate conversations into clear, accurate and compelling proposals.

4. Winning projects and retainers

The Head of Sales will play a central role in converting qualified opportunities into new project and retainer clients.

This requires confidence, patience and strong commercial judgement. BAO’s sales process is not about aggressive closing; it is about building trust, demonstrating expertise, understanding fit and guiding the client towards the right decision.

You will be expected to manage momentum across opportunities, follow up appropriately, identify blockers, support decision-making and help BAO win the right type of work with the right type of clients.

5. Sales reporting and pipeline intelligence

You will be responsible for ensuring that BAO’s sales pipeline is captured and maintained in a way that is simple, accurate and commercially useful.

This means ensuring that the right information is available at the right time: where opportunities are coming from, what stage they are at, what they are worth, how likely they are to close, what type of work they represent, when they may land and what they may require from the wider team.

You will use this information to present clear weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual sales updates, helping the Commercial Director and Managing Director understand pipeline health, forecast potential revenue, spot trends and make better commercial decisions.

Over time, this insight should help inform BAO’s sales strategy, including which sectors, services, project types, retainers, events and marketing activities are generating the strongest commercial opportunities.

6. Contact database and targeted outbound activity

The Head of Sales will also be responsible for building and maintaining a high-quality sales contact database.

This database should support thoughtful, relevant and well-timed outbound activity. BAO is not looking for a volume-led cold sales approach. Instead, we want to build a more considered view of the brands, contacts, partners and opportunities that are genuinely aligned with our positioning, experience and ambitions.

You will be expected to identify and organise relevant prospects, maintain useful contact information, track engagement and support selective outbound activity where there is a clear reason for BAO to start or develop a conversation.

7. Sales and marketing collaboration

You will work cross-functionally with BAO’s marketing team to ensure that sales activity and marketing activity support one another.

This may include identifying potential clients connected to BAO’s PR calendar, events, white papers, podcasts, thought leadership, partner activity and wider agency profile-building work.

You will help ensure that commercial opportunities are captured from marketing activity, relevant prospects are followed up appropriately and insight from the sales pipeline informs future marketing focus.

8. Agency representation and industry events

The Head of Sales may be expected to represent BAO externally at industry events in the UK and internationally.

This could include attending eCommerce events, participating in panels or fireside chats, presenting on stage, contributing to partner-led events and speaking with prospective clients, partners and industry contacts.

You should be comfortable acting as an ambassador for BAO: articulate, well-presented, commercially aware and able to communicate our perspective with confidence. This is not about performing a generic sales pitch. It is about representing the agency credibly, building trust and helping the right brands understand where BAO can add value.

9. Internal briefing and handover

Winning the work is only part of the responsibility. The Head of Sales must also ensure that new projects and retainers are introduced smoothly to the internal team.

You will be expected to brief in the context behind the opportunity, the client’s objectives, known sensitivities, agreed scope, commercial parameters and any important details gathered during the sales process.

This handover is essential to maintaining BAO’s standards and ensuring the client’s experience remains consistent from sales through to delivery.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means BAO has a clear, well-managed and healthy sales pipeline, with suitable opportunities being progressed confidently and unsuitable opportunities being handled professionally.

Over time, we would expect the Head of Sales to:

  • Become the day-to-day owner of BAO’s sales process.
  • Lead the majority of qualified new business conversations.
  • Maintain a clear, accurate and commercially useful sales pipeline.
  • Provide weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual sales reporting that supports decision-making.
  • Improve BAO’s ability to forecast new business revenue and understand pipeline health.
  • Improve the consistency and quality of proposal development.
  • Build and maintain a high-quality sales contact database.
  • Support selective outbound activity towards relevant, high-fit prospects.
  • Work closely with marketing to convert PR, events, podcasts, white papers and thought leadership activity into commercial opportunity.
  • Give the Commercial Director and Managing Director clear visibility of pipeline status, opportunity value, probability and timing.
  • Represent BAO confidently at meetings, pitches and relevant industry events.
  • Increase confidence across the team that new work has been scoped, sold and briefed in properly.
  • Help BAO win high-quality project and retainer clients that align with the agency’s positioning, values and capabilities.

About You

We are looking for someone with a strong blend of commercial ability, communication skills, eCommerce understanding and personal judgement.

You will likely have:

  • Proven experience in a sales, commercial or new business role, ideally within an eCommerce, digital, creative or technical agency environment.
  • Experience managing a sales pipeline and progressing opportunities from enquiry to close.
  • Strong understanding of consultative sales and relationship-led business development.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to lead calls and meetings with confidence, clarity and professionalism.
  • Experience creating or contributing to proposals, scopes of work, commercial documents or pitch materials.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to identify good-fit and poor-fit opportunities.
  • Enough technical understanding to discuss eCommerce requirements credibly with clients and internal specialists.
  • Experience maintaining a sales pipeline, CRM or equivalent system with accuracy and commercial discipline.
  • Ability to analyse sales information and present clear pipeline updates, forecasts and recommendations.
  • Experience building or managing a prospect/contact database.
  • Comfortable working with marketing teams to connect campaigns, content, events and thought leadership with commercial opportunity.
  • Confidence representing a business externally at client meetings, industry events or partner conversations.
  • High standards of personal presentation, whether in writing, on video calls or in person.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • A measured, mature and emotionally intelligent approach to client relationships.
  • The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a senior team.
  • UK-based availability, with flexibility to travel for client meetings, pitches and industry events where required.

Desirable Experience

The following would be advantageous, but not essential:

  • Experience working with Shopify Plus or another major eCommerce platform.
  • Experience selling project-based and/or retainer-based agency services.
  • Experience working with fashion, beauty, luxury, lifestyle or premium consumer brands.
  • Brand-side digital or eCommerce experience.
  • Familiarity with eCommerce technology stacks, integrations, migrations and replatforming projects.
  • Experience working with designers, developers, strategists, project managers and account managers to shape client recommendations.
  • Experience reporting on pipeline performance, lead source, conversion rate, sales cycle, average deal value or revenue forecast.
  • Experience working with agency marketing, PR, content or events teams to support lead generation.
  • Experience participating in webinars, podcasts, panels, fireside chats or industry events.
  • Existing relationships within the Shopify, eCommerce, fashion, beauty, luxury or premium retail ecosystem.

Benefits

  • Highly competitive salary DOE
  • 24 days of annual leave + 8 bank holidays
  • +1 extra day per year served
  • Training budget for courses or online training relevant to your role
  • High-spec Apple equipment
  • Opportunity to travel globally for key eCommerce industry events and client pitches
  • Working with a primarily luxury, innovative and high-profile international client base
  • No micro-management culture
  • Remote working or office-based, or a combination of the two, depending on your location
  • In-person and online social events throughout the year
  • Clear career progression paths and a structured employee review process

Application Process

Join us in our quest to shape the future of eCommerce. Our application process is informal, beginning with an initial chat to get to know you. We avoid technical tests, focusing instead on aligning cultural and professional aspirations.

Become part of our Carbon Positive workforce

All BAO team members contribute to our carbon-positive initiative, planting trees to offset your carbon footprint, including your home, travel, and more.

NO AGENCIES PLEASE - SERIOUSLY!

Salary: Highly competitive salary

jobs.title: Administrador em segurança da informação – Sênior
jobs.excerpt: Responsável pelos serviços de análise e acompanhamento de suporte operacional, seguindo os padrões e processos do cliente.
jobs.description:
Responsável pelos serviços de análise e acompanhamento de suporte operacional, seguindo os padrões e processos do cliente.

Principais atividades e responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e aprimorar políticas, normas, procedimentos e controles de segurança da informação alinhados às melhores práticas e requisitos institucionais;
  • Definir e aplicar políticas de hardening para sistemas operacionais, servidores, aplicações, bancos de dados, dispositivos de rede e demais ativos tecnológicos;
  • Propor melhorias contínuas nos processos operacionais relacionados à segurança da informação, gestão de riscos e proteção dos ativos corporativos;
  • Monitorar o ambiente tecnológico para identificação de ameaças emergentes, vulnerabilidades e comportamentos suspeitos, propondo e implementando medidas mitigadoras;
  • Realizar análises detalhadas de logs, eventos e indicadores de segurança para identificação de incidentes, anomalias e potenciais comprometimentos;
  • Conduzir auditorias internas de segurança da informação, avaliando a efetividade dos controles implantados e propondo melhorias;
  • Realizar avaliações periódicas de maturidade e postura de segurança, identificando lacunas e oportunidades de evolução dos processos e tecnologias adotadas;
  • Apoiar a elaboração, revisão e atualização de normas, procedimentos e políticas de segurança da informação;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e executivos relacionados a incidentes, riscos, vulnerabilidades, conformidade e desempenho dos controles de segurança;
  • Investigar incidentes de segurança da informação, identificando causas, impactos, vulnerabilidades exploradas e medidas corretivas para prevenção de novas ocorrências;
  • Conduzir análises forenses digitais em incidentes críticos, identificando vetores de ataque, evidências técnicas, cadeia de eventos e impactos ao ambiente corporativo;
  • Desenvolver e executar planos de resposta a incidentes de segurança, contemplando ações de contenção, erradicação, recuperação e lições aprendidas;
  • Planejar, coordenar e executar exercícios de simulação de ataques cibernéticos, incluindo cenários avançados como APTs (Ameaças Persistentes Avançadas), ransomware e ataques distribuídos;
  • Avaliar e mitigar riscos relacionados a Shadow IT, identificando ativos, serviços e aplicações não homologadas utilizadas no ambiente corporativo;
  • Avaliar, homologar e recomendar novas tecnologias, soluções e ferramentas de segurança da informação, considerando requisitos técnicos, riscos e benefícios;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de infraestrutura, desenvolvimento e operações para integrar requisitos e controles de segurança nos processos e sistemas corporativos;
  • Apoiar a implementação de práticas de segurança em aplicações, serviços, arquiteturas e processos de desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Realizar avaliações e auditorias com base em frameworks e boas práticas reconhecidas, como ISO 27001/27002, CIS Controls, SANS, OWASP e normativos do CNJ;
  • Definir, acompanhar e analisar indicadores, métricas e KPIs de segurança da informação, avaliando a eficácia dos controles implementados e o nível de resiliência organizacional;
  • Participar da gestão de riscos de tecnologia e segurança da informação, propondo planos de tratamento e mitigação;
  • Elaborar estratégias de recuperação de desastres (Disaster Recovery) e continuidade de negócios para sistemas, aplicações e serviços críticos;
  • Definir, documentar e testar procedimentos de restauração de ambientes tecnológicos após incidentes de segurança, falhas operacionais ou desastres;
  • Identificar e classificar sistemas críticos, definindo tempos objetivos de recuperação (RTO) e pontos objetivos de recuperação (RPO);
  • Planejar, implementar e validar estratégias de continuidade operacional para garantir a manutenção dos serviços essenciais em cenários adversos;
  • Realizar exercícios e testes periódicos de contingência, recuperação de desastres e continuidade de negócios, avaliando a efetividade dos planos estabelecidos;
  • Elaborar planos de ação para cenários de contingência envolvendo falhas de infraestrutura, ataques cibernéticos, indisponibilidade de serviços e desastres naturais;
  • Testar e validar ambientes redundantes, servidores de contingência, backups e mecanismos alternativos de comunicação e operação;
  • Definir papéis, responsabilidades e fluxos de atuação das equipes envolvidas em processos de resposta a incidentes, contingência e continuidade operacional;
  • Estruturar e manter fluxos de comunicação interna e externa para situações de crise, garantindo alinhamento e disseminação adequada das informações;
  • Consolidar informações de chamados, incidentes, vulnerabilidades e demandas relacionadas à segurança da informação;
  • Prestar suporte técnico e orientação especializada às equipes de segurança, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento e governança;
  • Atuar como referência técnica em temas relacionados à segurança da informação, gestão de riscos, continuidade de negócios e recuperação de desastres;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas à segurança da informação, proteção de ativos digitais e gestão da continuidade dos serviços de TIC.

Perfil desejado: experiência sólida em Segurança da Informação, Gestão de Riscos, Resposta a Incidentes, Análise Forense, Governança de Segurança, Continuidade de Negócios (BCP), Recuperação de Desastres (DR), Gestão de Vulnerabilidades e Conformidade. Conhecimentos em ISO 27001/27002, CIS Controls, SANS, OWASP, SIEM, SOC, Cloud Security, análise de logs, indicadores de segurança e normativos do CNJ serão considerados diferenciais.

EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL

The Director, Transmission/Interconnection is a key commercial and strategic role in Avangrid Power Transmission & Interconnection organization. Across all ISOs and RTOs in the United States, the Director will be responsible for developing and implementing interconnection and transmission strategies for energy projects; staying attuned to federal, state, ISO/RTO, and transmission owner rules for renewable generator interconnections; filing and negotiating new interconnection agreements; administering existing interconnection contracts including financial and operational terms and conditions; supporting the Senior Director in executive support activities, including financing, common facilities agreements, and FERC filings; and leading a team of Interconnection Analysts. A key part of the role will be managing relationships with ISO/RTO staff and specific third parties such as generators, utilities, public power entities, and selected large customers relative to transmission interconnections and service.   • Reconcile bank accounts and review general ledger activity.

About the Team

We're guided by one core question: how do we help our colleagues reduce cognitive load and get more done? Whether that's building tools to make operating code in production easier, running foundational shared services, or educating engineers on AWS and Kubernetes, our work has a direct multiplier effect on the rest of the business. We work closely with security and Implementation teams to make sure our infrastructure decisions serve the wider organisation's goals.

The Platform team exists to make the whole engineering organisation more effective. We're responsible for:

You'll champion infrastructure best practices, shape team goals, and influence the wider engineering roadmap. Just as importantly, you'll obsess over friction: the small (and large) things that slow engineers down, and how to remove them through better tooling, clearer paths, and stronger enablement.

This is a senior, high-trust role: you'll be expected to make sound architectural judgement calls, mentor other engineers, and represent the Platform team's priorities in cross-functional conversations, all while keeping empathy for the end-user (your fellow engineers) at the centre of what you build.

  • Reduced the barrier for every engineer to build, ship, and operate their own code in production, measured through faster lead time for changes and fewer hand-offs

  • Wrote and maintained clear, discoverable documentation and runbooks, treating docs as a product with the same quality bar as code
  • Gathered and acted on developer experience signals (e.g. surveys, feedback loops, usage metrics on internal tools) to prioritise the roadmap based on real pain points, not assumptions
  • Partnered with engineering teams to understand their workflows first-hand (shadowing, pairing, dogfooding your own tools) rather than building in isolation
  • Brought innovative ideas to the team and contributed meaningfully to the Platform roadmap, balancing infrastructure evolution with tooling and enablement work
  • Established objective measures of "done" and documented assumptions clearly, so both infrastructure and tooling initiatives had transparent success criteria
  • Contributed to observability as code initiatives, both inside the team and across engineering

Infrastructure & reliability

  • Provided a highly available and performant platform, including our AWS, Kubernetes (EKS) and MongoDB Cloud infrastructure
  • Hardened production systems, improving uptime, graceful degradation, and automated recovery
  • Modernised our CI/CD pipelines leveraging GitOps practices (e.g. ArgoCD), making deployments faster, safer and more transparent
  • Evolved our Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code, improving consistency, reusability, and safety of infrastructure changes
  • Established or improved SLAs/SLOs for core platform infrastructure
  • Worked with Security to raise our compliance and security posture without adding unnecessary burden on other engineering teams
  • Identified and delivered infrastructure cost-saving opportunities

Organization Overview

Tens of millions of people in the U.S. live with chronic financial insecurity, inadequate savings, and no meaningful wealth, with deeply harmful consequences for themselves, their children, families, communities, employers, and the economy.

Black, Latinx, and women-led households disproportionately experience financial insecurity due in large part to longstanding, systemic racism and gender discrimination. Addressing these issues is critical to Commonwealth's work of making wealth possible for all.

For over two decades, Commonwealth's fundamental purpose has remained to create a stronger and more prosperous society where everyone has financial opportunity. Our work has enabled over 2 million people to save nearly $8 billion on a path to greater financial security and wealth. We are now embarking on a new 4-year strategic plan that seeks greater impact and builds on our systems focus to expand workplace benefits, strengthen partnerships with financial institutions and fintech partners, and explore new frontiers like climate and generative AI.

Commonwealth strengthens the financial opportunity and security of financially vulnerable people by discovering ideas, piloting solutions, and driving innovations to scale. We understand broad change requires market players to act. That's why we take a unique approach to collaborate with consumers, the financial services industry, employers, policymakers, and mission-driven organizations. The solutions we build are grounded in real life, based on our deep understanding of people who are financially vulnerable and how businesses can best serve them.

For more than two decades, we have moved employers to prioritize worker financial security, the financial services industry to bring products to market that better serve financially vulnerable people, and policymakers to pass legislation and take action to enable savings and financial security. To learn more about the organization, please visit buildcommonwealth.org.

Diversity of background and perspective are strengths that we value. We are committed to creating a diverse, dedicated, skilled, and collaborative environment, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.description:
About Conference Catalysts:

What started over 20 years ago as a company with a simple goal to become a respected conference management company has grown and evolved to become something with a much greater reach and impact. At Conference Catalysts we have an exceptional team of professionals who are dedicated to making our clients’ lives easier, optimizing the way our organizations operate, and creating life-long relationships through exceptional customer service and innovative software solutions. Come see what it’s like to be a ConfCat!

Reports to: Assigned Team Lead

Location: Remote in the U.S.

Job Type: Full-time, exempt, salary

Summary of Position:

The Associate Conference Manager provides support and assistance to Conference Managers and to the Director – Conference Management Operations, in the successful management of conferences from conception through to completion. This position is designed to lead into the Junior Conference Manager role within the Conference Management Unit.

Performance Evaluation:

Formal evaluations will be conducted in six-month intervals by your assigned Team Lead to assess job performance.

Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Meet weekly with Director, Conference Management Operations to provide status updates, discuss time-sensitive items that require completion, address quality control checks, and discuss improvements that should be made.
  • Attend weekly Unit meetings and actively participate in discussions on items of importance and process/systems improvement.
  • Attend weekly team meetings and actively participate in discussions on items of importance and process/systems improvement.
  • Attend and participate actively in Unit Workshops.
  • Attend and participate actively in All-Company meetings.
  • Maintain accurate time records according to company policy, to track support requirements for each client.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in the use of Company applications: Gmail, ClickUp, Slack, Google Calendar, Zoom, Cvent, MailChimp, Last Pass, Survey Monkey, ShareX, and others.
  • Demonstrate knowledge proficiency of the basic structure of IEEE, keeping current on all policies and keeping an updated contact list.
  • Work with Conference Managers as directed, to assist with the following:
    • Manage ClickUp boards for each conference, keeping tasks dated and up-to-date. Ensure boards and tasks contain complete information, checklists, etc. so anyone is able to seamlessly step in and help with tasks as required.
    • Develop and foster relationships with Conference leadership: General Chairs, Technical Program Chairs, Organizing Committee, becoming an invaluable resource.
    • Liaise with clients to ascertain their precise conference requirements.
    • Configure and manage the online paper submission process.
    • Compile and produce conference proceedings content.
    • Produce detailed RFP for conferences (e.g. timelines, venues, suppliers, legal obligations, staffing, and budgets).
    • Communicate and maintain timelines and priorities on every project.
    • Develop and actively manage conference budgets.
    • Manage all project elements on schedule and on budget.
    • Research markets to identify opportunities for conference attendance growth and increased paper submissions.
    • Coordinate with venue management, caterers, exhibit designers, contractors, and other vendors, as necessary.
    • Plan room layouts for conference sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and social events.
    • Plan menus and order food & beverage for conference functions.
    • Coordinate volunteer staff requirements and volunteer staff briefings.
    • Sell sponsorship/stand/exhibition space to potential exhibitors/partners.
    • Configure online registration sites and manage conference registration processing.
    • Prepare delegate packs, name badges, and collateral.
    • Liaise with marketing and PR colleagues to promote the conference.
    • Liaise with clients and internal design staff to create a brand for the conference and organize the production of tickets, posters, catalogs, and sales brochures, plus social media coverage.
    • Coordinate suppliers, handle client queries, and troubleshoot on the day of the conference to ensure that all runs smoothly.
    • Oversee onsite setup of the registration area, exhibit area, and meeting rooms.
    • Demonstrate a proactive approach to handling issues and troubleshooting any emerging problems throughout the entire conference planning cycle.
    • Carry out the post-conference evaluation (including data entry and analysis and producing reports for conference sponsors).
    • Schedule and facilitate conference calls with Conference committees, taking detailed minutes. Facilitate action item completion.
    • Managing Conference websites, ensuring the website is always current and user-friendly.
    • Develop and maintain Conference social media platforms, drafting and posting content regularly.

Required Experience, Skills, and Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in event management, business administration, management, communications, or related field. Or relevant combination of education and experience.
  • Strong communication, organization, and client-facing skills.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving ability and resourcefulness.
  • Familiarity with professional associations or nonprofit organizations.

Travel Requirements:

  • Travel for this position will be around 7-8 times per year, for a length of 5-8 days each time.
  • Estimated travel between 10 - 18%
  • Domestic and international travel is required. Must have, or have the ability to acquire, a passport.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
  • Must be capable of traveling on long-haul flights.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Compensation is commensurate with skills, education, and experience starting at $47,175/year.
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance (Full employee premiums covered by Conference Catalysts).
  • Health Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for eligible health & wellness expenses.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan following the 90-day onboarding period (Conference Catalysts matches dollar for dollar, up to 5% of employee deferrals).
  • Uncapped flex time off following the 90-day onboarding period.
  • 14 paid company holidays.
  • Voluntary Life and AD&D insurance.
  • Individual professional development budget.
  • Annual office discretionary budget.
  • Annual swag store budget.
  • Monthly gym membership reimbursement.

jobs.excerpt: About Generation:AtGeneration, we believe in the power of employment to change lives.
jobs.description:
About Generation:

AtGeneration, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have an 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

JOB OBJECTIVES:

The Impact Manager will strengthen Generation’s ability to measure, evaluate, and communicate durable impact across the global network. Reporting to the Lead, Impact Evaluation & Data Advocacy, this role will lead durability measurement and evaluation workstreams, deliver instruction and content for the Durability Academy, and serve as global D&I’s day-to-day counterpart on APAC and SAMEA.

This role combines research rigor, structured problem-solving, and the ability to teach and coach. The Impact Manager will independently own defined evaluation, research, and insight workstreams, manage vendor and research partner relationships, coach Durability Academy partner organizations, and produce high-quality materials for Generation leadership, country CEOs, and funders.

This is a remote position, based in the SAMEA region (India preferred).

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Durability & Impact Evaluation

  • Lead defined cross-country durability analyses (employment, earnings, job quality, financial health, and related metrics), from framing through final outputs
  • Shape evaluation framing, research design, and methodological comparability across countries and program models
  • Manage evaluations and research partnerships end to end, including scoping, vendor procurement, contracting support, data-sharing processes, and quality of deliverables
  • Own evaluation briefs, synthesis memos, and funder-ready materials
  • Ensure durability insights are grounded in consistent and reliable underlying data

Durability Academy Instruction & Content

  • Co-facilitate cohort-wide Durability Academy sessions, taking ownership of selected modules over time
  • Serve as a 1:1 coach for a portfolio of cohort partner organizations, guiding them through their theory of change, durability logframe, and measurement plans
  • Maintain and improve Academy content between cohorts, including module materials, milestone documents, logframe templates, and facilitation guides
  • Turn cohort work into reusable examples, case material, and practical guidance for future cohorts and the wider Durability Collective

APAC & India Impact Priorities

  • Act as global D&I's day-to-day counterpart to Generation India and other APAC teams on evaluation, data, and impact priorities
  • Coordinate regional evaluations and research partnerships, ensuring alignment with global methodology and standards
  • Support regional teams on outcomes data, cost-per-learner and ROI inputs, and funder reporting
  • Support onboarding and alignment of regional impact leads with global D&I tools and ways of working
  • Surface regional insights and needs to D&I leadership to inform priorities and planning

Structured Analysis & Insight Communication

  • Translate ambiguous leadership and funder questions into structured analytical approaches, and lead the resulting analyses
  • Develop high-quality slide decks, workshop materials, and written summaries for Generation leadership, country CEOs, and funders
  • Shape coherent impact narratives across decks, reports, and external-facing materials
  • Contribute evidence, data, and methodology inputs to grant proposals and funder engagement

Cross-Functional Delivery & Team Support

  • Manage timelines, deliverables, and dependencies across D&I workstreams, proactively flagging risks and reporting progress
  • Partner with Impact Operations and Analytics colleagues to improve the clarity and consistency of core metrics (e.g., placement, durability indicators, income, living wage, ROI)
  • Provide guidance and quality review for analyst-level work as needed
  • Support D&I team operations such as recruitment and onboarding

ATTRIBUTES (e.g. qualifications, knowledge, skills, and experience):

Required experience and skills:

  • 5+ years of experience in impact evaluation, monitoring & evaluation, research, analytics, consulting, policy, or related fields
  • Track record of independently owning evaluation, research, or analytical workstreams from framing to delivery
  • Experience managing external vendors, research partners, or academic collaborators
  • Experience facilitating workshops, training, or coaching for professional audiences
  • Strong structured thinking and the ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights
  • Strong written communication and slide development skills, including materials for senior leadership or funders
  • Comfort working with data (Excel required; SQL preferred)
  • Ability to operate independently with significant ambiguity and manage multiple workstreams

Preferred experience and skills:

  • Experience in workforce development, economic mobility, education, or related social sector work
  • Experience working with teams in India or the wider SAMEA/APAC region
  • Hands-on experience with survey design, research design, and impact evaluation methodologies, including quasi-experimental approaches
  • Familiarity with adult learning principles or curriculum development
  • Experience working with dashboards (e.g., Power BI) and interpreting metrics
  • Fluency in additional languages beyond English

Mindset:

  • Structured thinker who breaks down ambiguous questions into clear components and approaches, and helps others do the same
  • Intellectually curious and motivated to understand the “why” behind outcomes, not just produce analysis
  • Rigorous and practical, holding a high bar on evidence while keeping measurement useful for partners and programs
  • Takes ownership, proactively flagging risks and proposing solutions
  • Collaborative and low-ego, able to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders, cultures, and time zones
  • Self-reflective and open to giving and receiving frequent feedback

***Please apply with your English CV/resume, thank you***
