DIRECTOR, FHIR TECHNICAL ECOSYSTEM

HL7 International is a global, member-driven non-profit dedicated to advancing healthcare data interoperability. The organization is accredited by the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) as an international Standards Development Organization (SDO). Our widely adopted standards and frameworks are the foundation of health information exchange worldwide, enabling data to be shared, accessed, and applied to improve health outcomes and system performance.

We are entering an exciting new chapter of growth and transformation. Our strategic vision emphasizes brand recognition, revenue diversification and growth, and the ability to innovate in response to emerging healthcare challenges.

Position Summary

FHIR's technical foundations, the build, validation, and publication tooling, the publication infrastructure, the implementation-guide framework, and the body of knowledge and practice that keeps all of it working, need sustained and resilient ownership. The Director, FHIR Technical Ecosystem provides that ownership.

Working under the direction of the FHIR Product Director, the Director keeps the technical machinery of FHIR dependable and keeps the knowledge behind it distributed and documented. A defining purpose of the role is continuity: reducing the ecosystem's dependence on any one person by building documented practices, distributed technical ownership, and succession into every critical technical function.

The Director is a member of the Standards Development division and reports to the CSDO, while coordinating closely with the FHIR Product Director on functional and technical priorities, and the Deputy FHIR Product Director on process and terminology. The Director also works closely with senior leadership on business development initiatives, supports the Standards Implementation division as a technical subject-matter expert, and coordinates with the Contributor Engagement Lead on community.

This is a remote position. Travel to HL7 meetings and selected national and international industry events is required.

Key Responsibilities

Tooling, publication, and build infrastructure

  • Set direction, resourcing, and resilience strategy for FHIR build, validation, and publication tooling and infrastructure, against the requirements defined by the Product Director, so these remain dependable foundations for the community.
  • Ensure the tooling and infrastructure are actively maintained through engineers, contractors, or HL7 technical services, with no critical component dependent on a single person.
  • Ensure the resourcing and resilience of terminology services infrastructure, coordinating with the Deputy FHIR Product Director, who leads FHIR terminology ecosystem architecture.

Standards-development infrastructure and the community's workflow

  • Provide direction for the integrated set of infrastructure the community relies on to develop standards, and keep the connections between its parts coherent: the FHIR publication infrastructure, the GitHub repositories that hold the specifications and their source, the build infrastructure that turns that source into published output, the JIRA infrastructure that Work Groups use for balloting comments and issue resolution, and the documentation platforms such as Confluence that hold process and guidance.
  • Ensure these systems work together as a dependable pipeline from proposal to comment to resolution to build to publication, so that a Work Group's development activity moves through the toolchain without friction or gaps.
  • Treat this toolchain as the connective tissue between the community's standards-development work and the published specification, owning its health, integration, and evolution, and coordinating with the Deputy FHIR Product Director on the process that runs on top of it and with the Contributor Engagement Lead on the contributor experience of using it.
  • Anticipate how a change in one system, for example repository structure, issue-tracker workflow, or build process, affects the others and the Work Groups that depend on them, and manage that change so the community is supported.

Implementation-guide framework and quality

  • Own the implementation-guide authoring framework, quality expectations, and consistency standards across guides, producing specific implementation guides for adoption programs, and supporting the implementers who use them.

Technical continuity and capability

  • Establish documented practices, distributed technical ownership, and succession across critical FHIR technical functions, reducing dependence on any single individual.
  • Capture and maintain the operating knowledge behind FHIR's tooling and publication so it remains accessible to current and future contributors.
  • Contribute FHIR subject-matter expertise to HL7 education and certification.

Support to Standards Implementation

  • Serve as a senior FHIR technical subject-matter expert to the Standards Implementation division's funded work, grants, and consulting.

Business Development

  • Co-lead business development initiatives with other members of HL7’s leadership and management.

People, program, and operational leadership

  • Supervise and develop the technical and program staff responsible for FHIR tooling and publication, setting priorities, managing performance, and building a collaborative, high-trust team.
  • Manage budgets, timelines, risks, and dependencies for FHIR technical operations.

Coordination

  • Coordinate with the FHIR Product Director on requirements and priorities, the Deputy FHIR Product Director on process and terminology, the Contributor Engagement Lead on community, and the Standards Implementation division on adoption.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Substantial experience in health IT, interoperability, and standards, including technical program and people leadership.
  • Strong understanding of FHIR tooling, publication, and the specification lifecycle.
  • A track record of building resilient technical operations and reducing key-person risk through documentation, distributed ownership, and succession.
  • Experience directing software and tooling maintenance, whether through employees, contractors, or shared technical services.
  • Excellent written communication and the ability to make technical operations understandable to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated commitment to open, community-driven development.
  • Track record of successful business development initiatives.

Leadership Attributes

  • Stewardship: motivated by the long-term health and resilience of FHIR's technical foundations.
  • Team and organizational leadership: skilled communicator, motivated to provide team leadership, clear direction and guidance to attain results.
  • Systems thinking and acting: able to see the whole tooling and publication chain and where it is fragile, and intervene accordingly.
  • Collaboration: leads through influence and coordination across roles and divisions.
  • Innovation and process improvement: Encourages and enables the development and adoption of novel technologies, and promotes continuous process improvement.

The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at .

Bitwarden is expanding its sales footprint and is looking for a Enterprise Account Executive based in the U.S. within the Central or Eastern regions.

We are seeking an energetic and motivated sales professional with strong sales skills and channel experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will have 4-8 years of new account or business development experience with a proven track record of engaging the Partner ecosystem to drive success. In your role, you will be responsible for achieving an assigned quota number while also managing lead flow, closing deals, recruiting partners and developing geographical go to market plans.

RESPONSIBILITIES

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • 4-8 years of outside high-tech IT sales experience. IT security product experience is desirable but not mandatory
  • Experience at a startup or pre $100M revenue company is desirable

jobs.description:
Patient Access Liaison

US Commercial, Market Access – Remote

Pharvaris is a Nasdaq listed late-stage biotech company developing bradykinin B2 receptor antagonists for bradykinin-mediated angioedema (including hereditary angioedema), with offices in Switzerland (Zug), the Netherlands (Leiden) and the USA (greater Boston area). We aim at bringing new, more convenient options to people who suffer sudden and prolonged attacks of swelling in multiple areas of the body including the airway, which can be life-threatening.

We have a culture built on the core values of considering others care-fully, leading with trust, ensuring rigor and diversity of thought, and contributing freely. Our company is driven by individuals committed to developing breakthrough therapies which can have a real impact on people’s lives. If you are looking for a place where your work can have meaning, and you can make a difference – Pharvaris is the place for you!

We are excited to be building our commercial business infrastructure to prepare for our first commercial launch. We are actively recruiting for the US Market Access Team, and we are looking for a dynamic and experienced Patient Access Liaison (PAL)to join our team and report to the Exec. Director, Patient Services.

The Patient Access Liaison (PAL) is a field-based, patient access and reimbursement specialist in high-touch role dedicated to helping patients and healthcare provider (HCP) offices understand and navigate the complexities of access to therapy. As a trusted resource and advocate, the PAL provides education, guidance, and support across product, insurance coverage, prior authorization, medical exceptions, appeals, affordability programs, and adherence to ensure patients can begin and continue therapy with confidence.

The Patient Access Liaison (PAL) plays a crucial role in ensuring timely access to Pharvaris treatments for patients after receiving a prescription. This position is responsible for working directly with patients, caregivers, healthcare providers, Pharvaris distribution partners and patient services and other stakeholders to provide education and overcome barriers to access.

Location:

Pharvaris has offices in Switzerland (Zug), the Netherlands (Leiden) and the U.S. (greater Boston area) and, at Pharvaris, we promote and enable a flexible, hybrid work-environment and support our talent to be home based and work virtually. While this is a remote role, you must be located in the U.S. with a preference to be aligned with your assigned Zone.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner with field leadership and patient services to define roles, workflows, and best practices.
  • Support development of reimbursement and access training for field sales teams.
  • Collaborate with patient services and trade and distribution teams to improve access processes and speed to therapy.
  • Coordinate with HCPs and internal teams to support payer-required coverage information.

Patient Support & Journey Management

  • Serve as the primary access resource for assigned patients, providing high-touch support throughout treatment.
  • Deliver empathetic, patient-centered communication and build trusted relationships.
  • Educate patients on treatment, adherence, and access-related challenges.
  • Identify financial, reimbursement, and coverage support resources to reduce therapy delays.
  • Conduct follow-ups to reinforce adherence and continuity of care.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, specialty pharmacies, and case management partners to accelerate therapy access.

HCP & Office Staff Engagement

  • Educate HCP offices on payer requirements, PA submissions, appeals, and coverage processes.
  • Resolve patient-specific access barriers, including denied PAs and formulary restrictions.
  • Support benefits investigations and interpretation of payer policies.
  • Maintain compliant, professional engagement aligned with company and regulatory standards.

Access & Reimbursement Expertise

  • Apply expertise in pharmacy benefit and specialty pharmacy workflows.
  • Manage PA, appeals, and medical exception processes efficiently and accurately.
  • Support appropriate use of copay assistance, bridge programs, and foundation resources.
  • Monitor payer trends and implement strategies to reduce access barriers.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a liaison among Physician Engagement, Care Coordination, Market Access, and Trade teams.
  • Share field insights on payer trends, access challenges, and patient experience gaps

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; clinical background in Healthcare Administration, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related field strongly preferred.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in reimbursement, market access, patient services, or related healthcare roles; rare disease or orphan drug experience strongly preferred.
  • Direct patient-facing experience providing disease, product, reimbursement, and access education in complex healthcare environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to build processes, capabilities, or field functionality in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. payer systems, reimbursement processes, prior authorization, appeals, specialty pharmacy workflows, and payer decision-making across Medicare, Medicaid, DoD, TRICARE, and commercial payers.
  • Proven success identifying and resolving reimbursement barriers to help patients initiate and continue therapy.

Skills & Competencies

  • Patient-first mindset with strong advocacy skills and a sense of urgency around therapy access and continuity of care.
  • Empathetic, trust-building communication with patients, caregivers, HCP offices, and cross-functional partners.
  • Strong listening, adaptability, analytical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills.
  • Collaborative influence and relationship agility, with refined customer focus and people skills.
  • Ability to balance patient advocacy with company policies, compliance requirements, and regulatory standards.
  • Able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Additional Information:

  • Ability to travel for in-person interactions as dictated by business needs.
  • Ability to work outside traditional business hours, particularly for patient meetings.

Pharvaris is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base salary range for this role is $155,000-$195,000 per year. Actual compensation will depend on various factors, including but not limited to depth of experience, skill set, overall performance, and education. Pharvaris believes in providing a competitive compensation and benefits package. Base salary is just one component of our competitive total rewards strategy. In addition to compensation, this role offers the unique opportunity to help build and shape an early-stage commercial organization, meaningful ownership through equity, workplace flexibility, and flexible time off. We encourage candidates who are motivated by the full opportunity and alignment with our mission to apply, even if their current compensation falls outside the stated range.

Salary: $155,000-$195,000

jobs.description:
The Business Intelligence and Business Systems Analyst develops and supports the data, reporting, and business-system capabilities used to manage Medical Device Services (MDS). The role combines business intelligence, data modeling, data-quality management, and day-to-day business administration of CRM and related operational systems.

This position builds Power BI models and reports that integrate CRM and eLIMS data to present financial, project, and operational information. It also supports CRM configuration, testing, user administration, documentation, and data integrity under the governance and priorities established by the Business Operations leadership.

The role is designed to offload technical reporting and systems work from Business Operations leadership while preserving clear separation between business governance and day-to-day administration.

Key Responsibilities

Business Intelligence and Reporting:

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI datasets, semantic models, dashboards, reports, and drill-through views.
  • Translate leadership and operational requirements into clear, actionable reporting solutions.
  • Support pipeline, portfolio, departmental operations, capacity, financial, project, and integrated business reviews.
  • Create repeatable reporting processes that reduce dependence on manually maintained spreadsheets and trackers.
  • Document report definitions, calculations, refresh schedules, dependencies, intended audience, and user guidance.

Data Modeling and Integration

  • Develop and maintain data models connecting financial, project, and other operational data sources, primarily eLIMS and CRM
  • Define and document relationships, transformation logic, calculated measures, inclusion criteria, and reusable analytical structures.
  • Work with IT, database, and system resources to understand source data, access requirements, refresh processes, and integration constraints.
  • Test and validate data pipelines and reporting outputs following system or model changes.

CRM and Business Systems Administration

  • Perform day-to-day CRM administration within established MDS governance, including user setup and permissions, fields, views, workflows, and configuration support.
  • Support account hierarchy, leads, opportunities, ownership, classification, and project-linkage requirements in the CRM.
  • Coordinate testing, release readiness, issue tracking, and user acceptance for approved enhancements.
  • Maintain system documentation, training materials, configuration records, and change logs.
  • Support appropriate alignment among CRM, eLIMS, reporting, SharePoint, and other business tools.

Data Integrity and Governance Support

  • Monitor data completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, duplication, and conformance with MDS standards.
  • Develop recurring data-quality checks, exception reports, reconciliation processes, and remediation tracking.
  • Investigate discrepancies between reports and source systems and document root causes and corrective actions.
  • Support master-data and reporting-definition governance established by the Manager, Business Operations Strategy.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, Project Management, Finance, and technical teams to correct data issues and improve adoption.

User Support and Continuous Improvement

  • Provide practical support and training for reports, CRM workflows, dashboards, and related systems.
  • Gather user feedback and translate recurring problems into improvement requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual work and improve business visibility or control.
  • Support and guide data analytics interns or temporary resources on defined assignments.

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Three or more years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, business systems, CRM administration, or a comparable role.
  • Hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and data models.
  • Advanced proficiency with Excel and working knowledge of relational data concepts.
  • Experience administering or supporting CRM, LIMS, ERP, or related enterprise systems.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder-communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, LIMS, SQL Server, Power Query, DAX, SharePoint, Dataverse, and the broader Power Platform.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple enterprise systems.
  • Experience in medical device, life sciences, laboratory services, healthcare, or another regulated environment.
  • Experience with user acceptance testing, release management, workflow configuration, or access administration.
  • Experience guiding interns or junior analysts.
  • Experience using AI to support data model and report development

Key Attributes for Success:

  • Analytical and technically curious with strong attention to detail.
  • Able to understand both business processes and underlying data structures.
  • Able to create and comprehend data and reporting requirements.
  • Disciplined about documentation, testing, change control, and data integrity.
  • Service-oriented and able to explain technical concepts clearly to business users.
  • Proactive in identifying risks, inconsistencies, and opportunities for automation.
  • Comfortable balancing recurring administration with longer-term development work.

Measures of Success:

  • Reliable and actionable Power BI reports supporting MDS reviews and operational decisions.
  • Improved completeness, consistency, and accuracy f commercial and operational daa, mainly from CRM and eLIMSim
  • Reduced manual reporting, reconciliation, and duplicate data-maintenance effort. Increased efficiency around information transfer between systems.
  • Timely delivery and controlled implementation of approved CRM and reporting enhancements.
  • Clear system documentation, training, and user support.
  • Increased adoption of MDS data standard andgeneral system usage.

What We Offer:

  • Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
  • Life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid vacation and holidays

Eurofins USA BioPharma Services is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. Eurofins is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. The Group also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 55,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 50 countries. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2020, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 5.4 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer who owns technical direction, thrives in ambiguity, and uses AI as a natural part of how they build software. You won't just write code — you'll make decisions that shape systems for years, mentor engineers across teams, and drive the engineering bar higher across the organization.

This team designs and operates large-scale systems that ingest, process, and enrich diverse content like filings, transcripts, news, research, and more. In this role, you will build and own backend services and high-throughput data pipelines that turn raw content into structured, searchable intelligence.

As a Staff Engineer, you'll operate at the intersection of technical depth and organizational influence — turning ambiguous business problems into executable technical strategies, and shipping them end-to-end.

What You'll Do

  • Set technical direction for your area — make build-vs-buy decisions, define architecture, and own the technical roadmap alongside product leadership.
  • Take ambiguous problems and make them concrete — scope work, identify risks, break down large initiatives into deliverable increments, and drive alignment across teams.
  • Design and deliver production-grade systems — scalable pipelines, robust services, and high-performance solutions that serve real users at scale.
  • Leverage AI tools as part of your workflow — you use AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate your work and have formed opinions on when it helps and when it gets in the way.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI/ML capabilities into production systems when the problem calls for it — you don't need to be an ML researcher, but you're sharp enough to pick up LLMs, embeddings, or classification models and put them to work.
  • Drive cross-team technical initiatives — influence engineers and teams you don't manage. Lead RFCs, drive architectural reviews, and build consensus on hard technical decisions.
  • Own what you build — from requirements to release to production. You build it, you run it. You monitor SLOs/SLIs, troubleshoot production issues, and continuously improve reliability.
  • Raise the engineering bar — through code reviews, mentorship, technical documentation, and by modeling the standards you expect from others.

Must Have

  • Strong in Python (our primary backend language). Comfortable working across languages — you've shipped production code in at least two.
  • Designed and owned production systems serving real users at scale — not just contributed to them, but made consequential architectural decisions and lived with the outcomes.
  • Led cross-team technical initiatives without formal authority — driven migrations, platform changes, or architectural shifts that required aligning multiple teams.
  • Strong system design instincts — you think in terms of failure modes, data flow, scalability, and operational cost. You design for the system you'll maintain, not just the one you'll ship.
  • Deep DevOps and operational experience — Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), CI/CD, observability. You don't throw code over the wall.
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and raising team standards — through pairing, reviews, RFCs, and leading by example.

Good to Have

  • Experience leading large-scale migrations or platform rewrites
  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML in production — LLMs, BERT, NLP pipelines, or document understanding systems
  • Contributed to or driven engineering-wide standards, practices, or tooling
  • Experience with content processing, enrichment, or search systems at scale
  • Familiarity with Java (parts of our stack)
  • Experience with GitOps, ArgoCD, or Infrastructure as Code
  • Active practitioner of AI-assisted development (AIDLC) — uses AI tools daily in their engineering workflow

How We'll Evaluate You

Our technical interview includes a hands-on session in a real development environment — not a whiteboard. You'll work on a realistic, messy codebase with AI tools pre-configured and available. We're evaluating how you think, how you use tools, and how you approach problems — not whether you've memorized algorithms.

What we look for:

  • How you navigate and make sense of unfamiliar code
  • How you leverage AI tools — critically, not blindly
  • How you decompose problems and make incremental progress
  • How you communicate trade-offs and decisions as you work

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

Role Summary

We’re hiring a VP of Growth Marketing to lead the next evolution of HubSpot’s growth strategy as AI reshapes how people discover, research, evaluate, and buy software. This leader will be accountable for two outcomes:

  1. Make HubSpot the most visible and recommended agentic customer platform across search and AI.
  2. Grow high-quality, top-of-funnel demand across our SMB and upmarket businesses.

You'll own HubSpot's organic search and AI visibility strategy, performance marketing, emerging acquisition channels, and growth experimentation—deciding where to invest, what to test, and where our next meaningful source of growth will come from.

We're looking for a builder, not someone who wants to manage the growth engine from a distance. You'll get close to the work, challenge how we operate today, and turn shifts in technology and buyer behavior into growth opportunities before there's an established playbook.

You'll lead an exceptional global team and partner deeply across Marketing, Product, Sales, Data, Finance, and Operations. You'll have HubSpot's scale and resources behind you, as well as the mandate to build what comes next.

What You’ll Do

  • Own HubSpot's growth strategy and find what's next. Set the strategy for how HubSpot creates and captures demand across paid, organic, AI, and emerging channels. Choose where to invest, pull back, and experiment across our SMB and upmarket businesses. Constantly look for new opportunities, test them quickly, and scale the ones that work.
  • Reinvent search and AI discovery. Lead HubSpot's strategy across traditional search and emerging AI discovery experiences. Protect and grow our organic search position while building the capabilities, experiments, and playbook required to drive visibility, recommendations, and demand in AI.
  • Transform performance marketing. Reinvent how HubSpot uses paid advertising to create and capture demand across our SMB and upmarket businesses. Modernize measurement and harness data and AI to improve targeting, accelerate creative testing and personalization, and maximize short- and long-term returns, while finding and scaling new sources of profitable growth.
  • Turn growth insights into product opportunities. Partner with Product to turn new customer behaviors and unmet needs into new ways to acquire customers and, where the opportunity exists, entirely new products or features.
  • Build an exceptional growth organization. Attract, develop, and lead an exceptional team with a high bar for curiosity, accountability, and execution. Stay close enough to challenge assumptions and accelerate decisions while empowering leaders to own big problems. Use AI and automation to help the team experiment, learn, and execute faster. Build a culture where the standard isn't activity, it's impact.

What You’ll Bring

  • You've built growth at a meaningful scale. You've led acquisition, performance marketing, organic growth, or related functions and can point to material business outcomes you've created.
  • You've created growth where there wasn't an existing playbook. You've spotted emerging channels, technologies, or shifts in customer behavior early, formed a point of view, experimented quickly, and turned the strongest signals into meaningful growth.
  • You have deep search and acquisition instincts. You understand what it takes to win across search and paid acquisition, and have a strong point of view on how AI search, LLMs, agents, and new discovery experiences are changing how brands get found, recommended, and chosen.
  • You think like an investor. You understand the economics of growth and know how to allocate people and dollars across a portfolio of opportunities. You're fluent in incrementality, returns, CAC, attribution, and pipeline economics—and can balance near-term performance with longer-term bets without waiting for perfect information.
  • You're an exceptional leader. You've led leaders, built high-performing teams, attracted exceptional talent, and set a high bar. You know how to stay close to the work without becoming the bottleneck.
  • You can operate across different growth models. You understand both high-volume self-service and sales-assisted growth and can build strategies for different customer segments, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • You're an influential executive and cross-functional partner. You turn complex problems into clear decisions, communicate with conviction, and can influence senior leaders across Product, Sales, Finance, Data, and Marketing.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience turning growth or customer insights into new products, features, or business opportunities.
  • Experience with marketing engineering, automation, or using AI to fundamentally change how marketing work gets done.

In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

$306,300—$490,100 USD

We know theconfidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

If you need accommodations or assistance due to a disability, please reach out to us using this form.

Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Lead
jobs.excerpt: The QA Lead is accountable for the quality assurance practice across product delivery, ensuring that software is testable, test execution is timely and transparent, critical defects are surfaced early, and releases meet agreed quality standards.
jobs.description:
The QA Lead is accountable for the quality assurance practice across product delivery, ensuring that software is testable, test execution is timely and transparent, critical defects are surfaced early, and releases meet agreed quality standards. This role leads day-to-day QA planning and execution, strengthens automation and regression coverage, coaches QA team members, and works closely with Product Owners and Engineering to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final-stage activity.

The QA Lead is expected to create clear visibility into test readiness, progress, risk, and blockers. The role owns the operating discipline of QA: defining test approaches, ensuring execution begins when planned, maintaining useful quality metrics, driving defect triage, and escalating issues early when delivery or release quality is at risk.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Leadership & Accountability
  • Own the day-to-day QA practice and establish consistent expectations for test planning, execution, documentation, and release readiness.
  • Ensure QA work begins when planned and that delays, blockers, environment issues, data needs, or scope gaps are identified and communicated immediately.
  • Create transparency into what has been tested, what remains untested, current defects, quality risks, and confidence in release readiness.
  • Hold QA team members accountable for execution commitments, timely updates, accurate status reporting, and follow-through.
  • Coach QA team members on testing discipline, risk-based thinking, root-cause analysis, and stronger ownership of outcomes.
Test Strategy, Planning & Execution
  • Develop and maintain test strategies for new features, enhancements, integrations, defects, and platform changes.
  • Partner with Product Owners early in discovery and refinement to identify test scenarios, edge cases, data needs, dependencies, and acceptance criteria before development is complete.
  • Ensure test cases provide adequate functional, integration, regression, negative, end-to-end, and workflow coverage based on business and technical risk.
  • Coordinate test data, environments, integrations, and dependencies required for successful QA execution.
  • Confirm that critical workflows can be tested end-to-end before work is considered ready for business UAT.
  • Use risk-based testing to prioritize the highest-value scenarios when time or environment constraints require tradeoffs.
Defect Management & Release Readiness
  • Lead defect triage in partnership with Product and Engineering, ensuring severity, priority, business impact, and ownership are clear.
  • Track critical defects through resolution and retest and ensure unresolved quality risks are explicitly documented before release decisions.
  • Define and enforce practical QA exit criteria, including expectations for critical defect closure, regression completion, and stability.
  • Provide an objective quality recommendation for releases based on test evidence and known risk.
  • Identify recurring defect patterns and partner with Engineering and Product on preventive actions rather than relying only on downstream testing.
Automation & Continuous Improvement
  • Develop and maintain a pragmatic test automation strategy focused on high-value regression, repeatable workflows, integrations, and business-critical scenarios.
  • Partner with QA Automation Engineers and Engineering to increase reliable automated coverage without creating brittle or low-value automation.
  • Use modern AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to accelerate test-case creation, test-data design, automation development, and quality analysis while preserving human review and accountability.
  • Evaluate test tooling, frameworks, and processes and recommend improvements that increase efficiency, coverage, and maintainability.
  • Reduce manual regression effort over time by identifying the strongest candidates for automation and incorporating automated tests into delivery pipelines where feasible.
Cross-Functional Partnership
  • Work closely with Product Owners to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and aligned to expected business outcomes.
  • Partner with Engineering on defect prevention, unit/integration test expectations, environment stability, observability, and root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with Architecture and platform teams when quality issues involve integration, infrastructure, data movement, or systemic technical risk.
  • Support business UAT by ensuring the product is genuinely ready for validation and by helping distinguish blocking defects from non-blocking follow-up work.
  • Communicate quality risk in clear business terms so leadership can make informed release and prioritization decisions.
Metrics & Reporting
  • Maintain a small, actionable set of QA metrics that reflect product quality and execution health rather than activity alone.
  • Track measures such as test execution progress, escaped defects, defect severity, defect reopen rate, regression coverage, automation coverage, UAT rework, and recurring defect trends.
  • Use metrics to identify systemic improvement opportunities and to show whether changes to process, automation, or requirements quality are producing measurable results.
  • Provide concise status reporting that clearly states current quality, material risks, blockers, required decisions, and next actions.
Required Qualifications
  • Significant hands-on experience in software quality assurance, including functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  • Experience leading QA execution, mentoring testers, or functioning as a senior/lead resource responsible for quality outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery and the role of QA throughout discovery, development, testing, UAT, and release.
  • Demonstrated ability to create test strategies and translate complex business workflows into thorough, risk-based test coverage.
  • Experience managing defects and facilitating effective triage with Product and Engineering.
  • Working knowledge of test automation concepts, frameworks, and CI/CD practices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to surface concerns early and communicate quality risk clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership mindset, organization, follow-through, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with multiple concurrent priorities.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience testing complex enterprise applications, healthcare technology, claims, payments, utilization management, provider data, EDI, APIs, or other heavy integration workflows.
  • Experience with automated API, UI, regression, and integration testing.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development or testing tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, test-management tools, CI/CD pipelines, observability platforms, and cloud-based application environments.
  • Experience helping a QA organization mature from primarily manual testing toward a balanced automation and risk-based quality model.
Success Measures

Success in this role will be demonstrated through measurable improvement in the reliability, transparency, and efficiency of the QA function, including:
  • QA execution starts on time, with blockers surfaced immediately rather than discovered later.
  • Leaders and delivery teams have clear visibility into test progress and release risk.
  • Critical defects are identified earlier in the lifecycle, and fewer defects escape into UAT or production.
  • UAT rework and repeated defect patterns decline over time.
  • Regression coverage becomes increasingly reliable, repeatable, and automated.
  • QA team members demonstrate stronger ownership, consistency, technical capability, and accountability.
  • Release decisions are supported by objective test evidence and clearly documented risk.
Leadership Expectations

The QA Lead is expected to model transparency, ownership, and proactive communication. Problems do not need to be perfectly solved before they are raised. When quality, timing, environment stability, or test readiness is at risk, the expectation is to surface the issue early, explain the impact, and drive the appropriate next action with the delivery team.

Role Overview

As Commercial Director, Public Health (Vector Control), you will build and drive Flyttr’s commercial growth in US mosquito control, focusing on the invasive Aedes spp. mosquitoes now spreading across the United States and elevating local risks of dengue, Zika and chikungunya transmission.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Commercialization and Business Development, you will drive Flyttr’s US vector control strategy to yield pipeline and revenue growth, winning and growing contracts with mosquito control districts, state, county and local health departments, and federal departments and agencies. Based in Florida (or in the region with proven commercial leadership in Florida), the frontline state for invasive mosquitoes and at elevated risk of locally acquired arboviral diseases, your remit will include generating sales and partnerships and converting policy momentum into sustainable commercial programs with state, county and federal partners that set the template for future nationwide rollout.

Commercial Planning & Growth

  • Market Planning: Translate the US commercial strategy into market and account plans, prioritizing opportunities by disease risk, budget and readiness to adopt new tools.
  • Revenue & Pipeline: Own the pipeline from opportunity to signed contract, delivering against revenue targets with accurate forecasting.
  • Offer & Pricing: Shape pricing and commercial models, such as multi-year suppression programs, with Product and Finance.
  • Market Insight: Track competing approaches and customer needs, feeding insight into product and operational planning.
  • Business Strategy: Help shape Flyttr’s medium- and long-term US business strategy, from market and segment priorities to the commercial models that will sustain growth.
  • Product Pipeline: Help shape Flyttr’s vector control pipeline, bringing customer and market insights to the development of next-generation vector control tools for the US market.

Customers & Partners

  • Customer Relationships: Build senior relationships with mosquito control districts; state, county and local health departments; federal agencies and departments; and professional associations.
  • Federal Engagement: With Policy colleagues, align and coordinate any potential direct engagements with the US CDC, EPA and other federal agencies and departments.
  • Partnerships: Secure customer-focused delivery and technology partnerships with clear success measures and a pathway to multi-year contracts.
  • Representation: Represent Flyttr as needed at industry conferences, mosquito control district board meetings and other public fora.

  • Procurement & Bids: Lead proposals and contract negotiation across federal, state, county and local procurement routes, including cooperative agreements and special-district funding cycles.
  • Funding Sources: Identify supplemental funding for programs, including federal cooperative agreements, amended state appropriations and philanthropic capital.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Location: Based in Florida or in the region with professional experience in Florida and legally authorized to work in the United States; able to travel extensively across the US, as needed.

  • Sector Knowledge: Strong understanding of the US mosquito control and public health landscape, including how districts and health departments plan, budget and buy; knowledge of sterile insect techniques and other novel vector control tools highly desirable.

Overview

Location(s): Remote, USAWork Environment: Hybrid/RemoteCompensation: $115,000–$135,000 annually*

Dudek’s journey began in 1980 with a vision to serve Southern California’s water and wastewater agencies.

Today, we are a 100% employee-owned firm supporting clients nationwide and delivering projects that improve and protect the built and natural environments of communities throughout the United States. Our work has been recognized by leading industry organizations, and we’ve been honored with multiple national Top Workplace Awards.

Our employee-owners are unified by a singular commitment to supporting projects that address key societal issues, such as the transition to renewable energy, infrastructure hardening and repair, environmental protection, and community resilience.

Learn more about our award-winning culture, the benefits and perks of being a Dudekian, and the projects you will have the opportunity to shape.

Position Overview

Who You Are

As an employee-owner, you embrace accountability, working safely, and collaboration while thinking resourcefully and independently.

Like all Dudekians, you are curious and solution-oriented, with the ability to adapt quickly to changes and approach challenges with a spirit of innovation.

How You’ll Make an Impact

As a Security & Compliance Manager, you'll be responsible for overseeing Dudek's cybersecurity operations, managing security service providers, and ensuring the protection of company systems, technology, and sensitive data. You'll play a key role in identifying and mitigating security risks, strengthening security controls, and supporting compliance with applicable regulatory and contractual requirements.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for a cybersecurity professional who brings strong technical expertise and a practical, risk-based approach to information security. You'll collaborate with internal teams and external partners to maintain effective security operations while supporting Dudek's business objectives.

This role is part of our Information Technology (IT) department and reports directly to the Chief Information Officer (CIO).

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Partnering with the CIO and business leaders responsible for ensuring the security, compliance, and risk management of the company technology and data portfolio in concert with legal, regulatory, and contractual commitments.
  • Responsible for identifying and acting on opportunities for process improvement, process mapping and related documentation, communication of new processes to applicable stakeholders and identification of appropriate automation and process technology to support further improvements.
  • Managing the relationship and ongoing coordination of managed service security providers (MSSP’s).
  • Manage IT controls program to ensure the ongoing operational effectiveness, review, and auditing of a core set of internal controls.
  • Lead efforts to ensure IT compliance with industry (e.g., local, state, federal) and contractual regulations & requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and security service providers to integrate security measures into the development and maintenance of IT systems and applications.
  • Manage incident response, escalation, and resolution for security breaches or incidents, implementing corrective actions and preventive measures.
  • Proactively monitor and assess emerging threats, trends, and technologies in the cybersecurity landscape and recommend proactive measures to mitigate risks.
  • Conduct regular security assessments, audits, and ongoing vulnerability management operations to identify potential risks and weaknesses in systems and processes.
  • Interface with external auditors, regulatory bodies, and customers, as necessary, on security and compliance matters.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field; relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA) preferred.
  • Proven experience in internal controls, information security, risk management, and compliance roles.
  • Experience leading and conducting IT audits and remediation activities.
  • Strong knowledge of security frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF), security standards (e.g. 800-53, 800-171), and industry best practices.
  • Experience working with CMMC Level 2 compliant environments.
  • Proficiency in conducting security assessments, vulnerability management operations, and implementing security controls.
  • Experience with cloud security service providers, tools, and technologies.
  • Strong analytical and analysis capabilities and related communications.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CISA), as identified in the original qualifications.

Compensation: $115,000–$135,000 annually*

*Final agreed-upon compensation will be based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s related experience, education, certifications, skills, and work location. Successful candidates must pass a pre-employment drug test and background check prior to beginning employment.

Working Conditions

  • This job operates in a remote or office-based environment and this role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, etc.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. This job requires the following:

  • Working on a computer, sitting, or standing for long periods of time in an office or remote office setting.
  • Attending meetings, both in person and virtually, and speaking on the phone with peers, clients, etc.
  • Specific vision abilities, including close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

About Arden University:

We are an aspirational and multi-award-winning university, delivering rapid growth with ambitious plans to disrupt the HE sector through our passion for innovation and digital education. Our vision is to become the first-choice university for career-focused lifelong learners worldwide, ensuring that everyone, everywhere can access higher education.

There has never been a more exciting time to join Arden University, as we expand into new disciplines, forge worldwide partnerships, and expand our locations.

About our Department:

The Senior Business Data Analyst joins Arden University's Technology Department at an exciting time of growth and innovation. Technology is at the heart of our strategy, enabling us to deliver an outstanding experience for students and colleagues while supporting our ambitious global expansion.

Our Technology team of around 100 specialists spans Software Development, Business Systems, Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Data and IT Operations. Together, we deliver the solutions and services that keep the University running while driving continuous digital improvement.

We're also embarking on a significant AI transformation, embedding AI across the University to enhance the way we work, improve decision-making and deliver even better experiences for our students and staff. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to enterprise-wide initiatives, shape the future of our IT platforms, and play a key role in our evolving digital landscape.

We're committed to developing our people and are proud of our strong culture of learning, collaboration and internal career progression.

About the Opportunity:

As Senior Business Data Analyst (Learning Systems), you will play a key role in shaping how Arden University manages, maintains and uses data across its Learning Systems landscape. Sitting within the IT Department’s Learning Systems team, you will lead data management, analysis and reporting activities across platforms including Moodle and its plugins, Accipio, Zoom and PMA, ensuring data is accurate, reliable, accessible and fit for purpose.

You will lead the identification and delivery of data and process improvements, working closely with stakeholders to understand business needs, translate requirements into practical technical solutions and ensure data capabilities support both current operations and future projects. From improving data quality and readiness to strengthening system integrations, developing dashboards and enhancing reporting, you will help ensure decision-makers have access to meaningful, timely and trusted information.

This is a senior, hands-on role requiring you to take ownership of complex data challenges, provide expert advice and recommendations, and lead multiple activities and projects with minimal guidance. You will work closely with senior stakeholders, business analysts and technical teams to identify gaps in existing processes, develop effective solutions and oversee the successful implementation of improvements. You will also promote adherence to data standards, reporting requirements and relevant policies, ensuring data risks are identified and managed appropriately.

Alongside your technical and analytical expertise, you will help set the standard for business analysis across the team. This includes developing effective tools and approaches, improving consistency and efficiency, coordinating business analysis activities and fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

About You:

We are looking for an analytical, proactive and solutions-focused individual with strong data and business analysis skills. You will be confident managing complex challenges, influencing stakeholders and translating business needs into practical solutions, while championing collaboration and continuous improvement.

Essential requirements:

  • Extensive experience in data analysis, data management and data quality, including data mapping, identifying process improvements and resolving complex data issues.

  • Strong practical knowledge of Learning systems - ideally Moodle but open to alternatives.

  • Expert knowledge of business analysis methodologies and techniques, including requirements elicitation, stakeholder workshops, user stories, use cases and process mapping.

  • Experience leading complex data analysis activities, translating business needs into technical requirements, evaluating solutions and providing clear, evidence-based recommendations to support decision-making.

  • Experience with testing methodologies, including User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and supporting the successful delivery of system and process improvements.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to draw meaningful insights from incomplete or conflicting data.

  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and influencing skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and negotiate outcomes with senior stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced IT or data environment, work independently and lead activities with minimal guidance.

  • Ability to provide guidance and share expertise with colleagues, promote consistent business analysis standards and foster a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

  • Practical knowledge of data governance, relevant legal and regulatory requirements, and information security, including GDPR.

Desirable requirements:

  • Strong practical knowledge of Moodle, its plugins and associated learning systems, including assessment platforms and system integrations, ideally within a higher education environment.

  • ITIL Foundation, Business Analysis or Project Management qualifications (e.g. PRINCE2 or AgilePM).

  • Data-related qualifications or training in GDPR, information security or DLP.

  • Exposure to Azure, Fabric, AWS, TOGAF or change management frameworks.

  • Experience delivering data initiatives within Higher Education.

  • Experience working with IT architects to implement policies and standards.

  • Experience supporting strategic initiatives and engaging with senior stakeholders.

Why Arden:

At Arden, you will become a part of a passionate and dedicated team who are committed to removing unnecessary barriers to learning and making education more accessible. Our people work hard to ensure our students journeys are the best they can possibly be, as such we want to reward our people with fantastic benefits. Employees benefit from:

  • 30 days holiday + bank holidays on-top, and even a Christmas closure!

  • A generous Aviva pension plan, company contributions starting from 7%

  • BUPA Cash Plan

  • Private Medical Insurance coverage (applies to certain job roles)

  • Access to Perkbox benefits

  • Study any Arden course for free, with a discount for all family and friends

  • Plus, other excellent benefits

  • Our ‘Golden Ticket’ which allows you to gift anyone in your life a free Arden education

Our Values:

Stand out, Progressive, Accessible, Resourceful, Kindness, reflect who we are as an institution, a team and as individuals. If they also reflect you and you are excited by the chance to be the driving, creative force within a growing business, we want to hear from you.

There has never been a more exciting time to join Arden University, as we expand into new disciplines and locations.

Closing Date:8th November

We reserve the right to close this vacancy before the specified closing date should we receive sufficient applications or in order to respond to business needs. In order to avoid missing an opportunity to apply please submit your application as early as possible.

If you are a current Arden student or have an upcoming course with us, you are not eligible to apply for Student Experience roles due to a conflict of interest related to system access.

jobs.title: Level 3 Escalation Projects Engineer - Remote
jobs.excerpt: Since 2004, OSIbeyond has delivered managed technology and cybersecurity services on a founding principle: outstanding technical expertise, matched by an exceptional customer experience.
jobs.description:
Since 2004, OSIbeyond has delivered managed technology and cybersecurity services on a founding principle: outstanding technical expertise, matched by an exceptional customer experience. Today, that commitment is delivered through OSIbeyond ONE, our integrated technology platform that unifies IT operations, cybersecurity, Microsoft 365, cloud, automation, AI, and expert support into a single, continuously managed environment. The platform is built on a clear operating philosophy: Automation First. AI Enabled. People Powered.

Within that model, the overwhelming majority of routine service requests are resolved by automation, with the Level 2 (Human Support) team confirming AI-extracted parameters and initiating workflows. What remains is, by definition, the hard part: the intermittent fault that spans identity, network, and application layers; the migration that touches every user in an organization; the server, firewall, or hybrid cloud dependency that no runbook anticipated. The Level 3 Engineer is where that work lands, and where it gets solved.

This is the senior engineering seat in Technical Services. The Level 3 Engineer is the escalation authority for the Level 2 team, the engineer who scopes, leads, and delivers client infrastructure projects, the steward of OSIbeyond’s own internal infrastructure, and a working partner to the Automation Engineering team in deciding what gets automated next. Every escalation resolved here is also studied here: the engineer is expected to ask whether a class of problem should ever reach a human again, and to help design the workflow, detection, or self-healing logic that ensures it does not.

The position spans a range of seniority. Engineers at the earlier end of that range concentrate on resolving the most complex escalations and executing pre-scoped project work to a high standard. Engineers at the senior end own project scoping and delivery, direct the work of peers on complex migrations, design architecture, and carry a larger share of automation design and technical leadership. Compensation and scope of ownership grow with demonstrated expertise and impact within the position.

This position is suited to a technically accomplished engineer who has outgrown ticket volume and wants ownership of the difficult, consequential work: complex escalations, infrastructure and project delivery, and the engineering of automation that lifts an entire team. The successful candidate combines deep Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows Server, and network expertise with sound judgment under pressure, disciplined documentation, and the professionalism to represent OSIbeyond in front of client leadership during a high-stakes incident or a major project cutover.

About the Role:

The Level 3 Engineer resolves the complex, high-priority, and urgent escalations that exceed the scope of automation and the Level 2 team; scopes, leads, and delivers client technology projects; designs, deploys, and maintains client infrastructure across on-premises, Microsoft 365, and Azure environments; and completes the internal projects and maintenance that keep OSIbeyond’s own infrastructure and operations secure and current.

The engineer owns the escalation queue end to end. Each escalation is triaged for business impact, diagnosed to root cause rather than symptom, resolved within service level commitments, and documented so that the resolution becomes reusable knowledge, an updated procedure, or a specification for new automation. Where an automated workflow has failed or produced an unexpected result, the Level 3 Engineer is the engineer who determines why, corrects the environment, and works with Automation Engineering to harden the workflow.

On the project side, the Director of Engineering leads discovery and scoping, and the engineer takes the work from there through delivery: solution design, detailed implementation plans, cutover execution, post-project validation, and client-facing training on what was delivered. Projects range from server, network, and identity deployments to tenant and data migrations and cloud modernization. The engineer prepares the detailed directions that allow peers to execute project tasks reliably, and manages scope, schedule, and client communication throughout.

Across all of this work the engineer uses OSIbeyond-approved AI assistants to accelerate diagnostics, scripting, planning, and documentation, and holds every AI-assisted output to the same standard of verification as any other engineering work. The Level 3 Engineer also raises the technical ceiling of the team through mentorship, peer review, and the on-call rotation. Performance is measured against escalation quality and timeliness, SLA adherence, project delivery, client satisfaction, documentation standards, and the volume and value of automation the engineer helps bring into production.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Escalation Resolution & Advanced Troubleshooting (≈35%)

  • Own the escalation queue: accept complex, high-priority, and urgent tickets escalated from the Level 2 team or generated by automation exceptions, and resolve them within service level commitments
  • Perform structured root cause analysis across identity, endpoint, server, network, cloud, and application layers; correct the underlying condition rather than the presenting symptom
  • Diagnose and resolve failed or unexpected automation outcomes, restore the affected environment, and document the failure mode for Automation Engineering
  • Lead the technical response to client-impacting outages and coordinates with the Security Operations Center for security incidents, following documented incident response procedures
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with client stakeholders, including leadership, throughout high-impact incidents, setting expectations and providing accurate status until resolution
  • Recognize when an escalation requires vendor engagement, Automation Engineering, or the Director of Engineering, and escalate without delay
  • Participate in the support desk phone call queue when Level 1 and Level 2 engineers are in calls

Project Delivery & Infrastructure Engineering (≈30%)

  • Deliver client technology projects, managing schedule, risk, and stakeholder communication from kickoff through closeout
  • Design, deploy, and maintain physical and virtual servers, storage, and backup and continuity platforms across client environments
  • Configure and maintain firewalls, switching, wireless, VPN, and secure remote access in accordance with OSIbeyond security standards
  • Administer and architect Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Azure environments, including conditional access, single sign-on and identity federation, SharePoint and Teams governance, and hybrid identity
  • Plan and execute tenant, mail, file, and server migrations, including discovery, cutover planning, execution, and post-migration validation; prepare detailed, step-by-step directions that peers can execute reliably
  • Plan and deliver client-facing technology training and knowledge transfer related to completed projects
  • Complete internal projects and scheduled maintenance that support OSIbeyond’s own infrastructure and operations, applying firmware, patching, and configuration changes under appropriate change control
  • Contribute to system and network architecture designs, hardware and licensing recommendations, and client technology roadmaps

Automation & AI Enablement (≈20%)

  • Analyze escalation, ticket, and project patterns to identify work that should be automated, and author clear, testable specifications for new or expanded automation workflows
  • Convert resolved escalations and repeatable project tasks into automation-ready standard operating procedures, decision logic, and knowledge base content that AI and automation can act upon
  • Review automation exception logs, tune thresholds and guardrails, and recommend self-healing or preventive detection where recurring failures are observed
  • Develop and maintain PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, and KQL scripts and queries that extend the automation platform, standardize project execution, and accelerate investigation
  • Apply OSIbeyond-approved AI assistants to diagnostics, ticket history searches, scripting, project planning, and documentation, verifying all AI-assisted output before it is acted upon or delivered

Technical Leadership & Mentorship (≈15%)

  • Provide technical direction to peers assigned to project tasks, reviewing their work for quality and completeness
  • Mentor Level 2 engineers through escalation walk-throughs, shadowing, and structured feedback that builds their diagnostic depth and reduces future escalations
  • Perform peer review of complex changes, migration plans, and client-facing technical documentation prepared by the team
  • Maintain and improve the technical knowledge base, standard operating procedures, and client environment documentation so that they remain accurate, complete, and actionable
  • Participate in the escalation on-call rotation and serve as the senior technical point of contact during assigned periods
  • Contribute to technical training, engineering standards, and continuous improvement initiatives across Technical Services

General Responsibilities

  • Provide high-quality written and verbal customer service in every client interaction
  • Meet all key performance indicators and notify the Director of Engineering promptly when workload or circumstances place a KPI or project milestone at risk
  • Accurately track and document all work in the ticketing and project systems with detail sufficient for a peer to resume the work without additional context
  • Set up and support physical hardware through the use of local “smart hands” OSIbeyond engineers
  • Support peers and contribute to a collaborative, accountable team culture
  • Perform other duties as assigned

SUCCESS METRICS:

  • Escalation resolution time and KPI adherence across all assigned tickets
  • Root cause quality: escalations closed with documented cause and corrective action, measured by recurrence rate
  • Project delivery against agreed scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards, including client sign-off and post-project satisfaction
  • Quality and reliability of implementation plans and peer directions, measured by execution errors and rework on project tasks
  • Automation contribution: specifications submitted, workflows validated, and automation adopted into production, with the resulting reduction in human-handled tickets and manual project steps
  • Automation exception resolution time and accuracy of exception analysis
  • Health and currency of internal OSIbeyond infrastructure, including completion of scheduled maintenance
  • Client satisfaction with incident handling, project delivery, training, and technical communication
  • Mentorship impact: measurable improvement in Level 2 resolution rates for previously escalated issue types
  • Documentation quality and completeness of ticket notes, root cause analyses, project records, procedures, and client environment documentation
  • On-call responsiveness and resolution quality during assigned rotation periods

SECURITY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Complete training for and maintain awareness of cybersecurity risks, including insider threat, and the appropriate handling of CUI and other regulated data
  • Treat client data and OSIbeyond data as sensitive, and do not disclose, release, or otherwise transfer it outside of OSIbeyond or client environments without written permission
  • Follow cybersecurity requirements as described in the Employee Handbook and other OSIbeyond policies
  • Immediately follow incident response procedures when a security incident or concern is identified
  • Design and implement client and internal infrastructure in accordance with OSIbeyond security baselines and applicable client compliance requirements, including CMMC and NIST SP 800-171
  • Assist with the escorting or monitoring of visitors when working onsite

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • Four or more years of progressive experience in systems engineering, infrastructure administration, or escalation support, with the most senior engineers in the position typically bringing seven or more; managed service provider experience is strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-layer escalations and client-impacting incidents through to root cause and resolution
  • Hands-on delivery of infrastructure projects such as server deployments, firewall implementations, identity architecture, or tenant and data migrations; experience scoping and leading such projects end to end is expected at the senior end of the position

Infrastructure & Platform Skills

  • Expert administration of Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, conditional access, identity federation and single sign-on, and audit logging
  • Strong Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and NTFS and DFS permission design; working knowledge of hybrid identity synchronization
  • Virtualization and storage administration (Hyper-V or VMware), and backup and business continuity platforms
  • Firewall, switching, wireless, VPN, and routing configuration and troubleshooting; solid grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, and network security
  • Microsoft Azure and Intune administration, including virtual machines, networking, device management, and compliance policies
  • Email security and spam filter administration, and security incident response in coordination with a SOC

Project & Automation Skills

  • Ability to produce a project implementation plan and cutover schedule, manage risk and stakeholder communication, and close out with validation and training
  • Ability to write detailed, unambiguous technical directions that peers can execute without supervision
  • Proficiency in PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; working knowledge of KQL or comparable query languages
  • Ability to decompose a resolved escalation or repeatable project task into decision logic, parameters, and guardrails suitable for automation
  • Experience validating or troubleshooting the output of automation and orchestration platforms (Tines or comparable), RMM scripting, or infrastructure-as-code
  • Effective, verified use of AI assistants for diagnostics, scripting, planning, and documentation

Professional Skills

  • Composed, authoritative communication with client stakeholders and leadership during high-impact incidents and project cutovers
  • Disciplined documentation and ticket hygiene; ability to produce clear technical writing and deliver training for both engineers and non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, direct, and raise the capability of less experienced engineers
  • Self-management appropriate to a remote, escalation- and project-driven role with on-call responsibilities

Additional Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience supporting clients subject to CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, or similar regulatory frameworks
  • Prior contribution to automation development, detection engineering, or platform standardization in an MSP environment
  • Formal project management training or certification (CompTIA Project+, PMP, or equivalent)
  • Experience with Azure landing zones, infrastructure-as-code, or zero trust network architecture

KNOWLEDGE & CERTIFICATIONS

Tooling Environment: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Azure administration portals; Windows Server and hypervisor management; firewall and network management platforms; remote monitoring and management; backup and continuity platforms; Tines automation; Autotask professional services automation (ticketing and projects); IT documentation platform; Microsoft Teams for internal collaboration; OSIbeyond-approved AI assistants.

Required Certifications (or attainment within the first six months)

  • Microsoft MS-102: Microsoft 365 Administrator
  • Microsoft AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft SC-300: Identity and Access Administrator
  • Microsoft MD-102: Endpoint Administrator
  • CompTIA Security+ or CompTIA Network+
  • Vendor firewall certification (Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto PCNSA, or equivalent)
  • CompTIA Project+ or PMP

Position:
