ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

jobs.description:
Who we are

Properstar connects real estate buyers, renters, and agents, here and everywhere. Buyers and renters find their next home with us, locally or across borders. Agents reach them in countries they couldn't otherwise sell into, in languages they don't speak.

Our Product & Marketing department grows the brand and our footprint. Small team, no fluff. We acquire new users, nurture them, qualify them, and turn them into customers. We believe in a new way of working, where AI is fundamental: you direct, you don't execute.

About the job

You own B2B growth end to end. Our database holds some 140,000 real estate agency offices and 640,000 agents. You turn more of them into active, engaged and paying users. AI does the heavy lifting, you steer it.

Three targets: B2B revenue, monthly active users, and mobile adoption.

That means real segmentation, not the same email sent to everyone. A solo agent in Lisbon and a 40-office network in Madrid don't need the same message. You get agents onto the app, push self-serve purchases through the dashboard, design offers that convert, and use content and every relevant channel to move them along.

2027 is the year we build and test the engine. 2028 is the year we scale it.

You set the strategy and you run it. You own the budget, get hands-on when needed, and lead the people who help you execute. You report to the CPO.

What you'll do

  • Set the B2B growth strategy. Segments, markets, channels, offers, budget. Defend every euro with numbers.
  • Segment the base for real. Office size, market, plan, activity, behavior. Each segment gets its own path.
  • Own the agency lifecycle. Onboarding, activation, engagement, upgrade, retention, win-back. Find where agents drop and fix it.
  • Drive self-serve revenue. Push purchases through the dashboard. Upgrade flows, trials, pricing pages, checkout. Less sales touch, more conversion.
  • Design offers that convert. Plans, bundles, promotions, timing. Test them. Kill the losers.
  • Make the app the agent's daily tool. Installs, adoption, weekly use. Move agents from desktop to mobile and keep them there.
  • Grow monthly active users. Give agents reasons to come back. Leads, insights, alerts, content.
  • Use every relevant channel. Email, push, in-app, content, webinars, paid, partnerships. Pick by segment, not by habit.
  • Run experiments. Onboarding, messaging, offers, pricing. Fast cycles, clear reads.
  • Work with sales and customer success. Self-serve for the long tail, humans for the big accounts. Hand them the right accounts at the right time.
  • Work with product. Push for what moves activation and conversion. Bring evidence, not opinions.
  • Lead the people who execute. Set their goals, review the work, raise the bar.
  • Build the playbooks as Claude skills, so the team and the agents can run them.
  • Talk to agents. Read the data yourself.

What we're looking for

  • B2B growth track record. You've grown a B2B or SMB product with thousands of customers, largely self-serve. Real numbers, real graph. Show us. SaaS for small businesses, marketplace, or portal experience is a strong plus. Real estate is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • Lifecycle and segmentation. You think in cohorts, segments, and lifecycles, not campaigns. The cheapest customer is the one already in your database.
  • Self-serve monetization. You've moved users from free to paid through the product. You know your activation, conversion, expansion, and churn by segment.
  • Multichannel range. You've owned several channels and have strong opinions on the rest. Single-channel specialists won't fit.
  • Mobile adoption. You've driven app adoption with a professional audience. You know what makes a busy agent open an app twice.
  • Product sense. You know how product changes move conversion. You bring PMs and designers evidence, not opinions.
  • Strategist and operator. You build the plan and you run it. You've owned a budget and answered for the return. You set up the flow and pull the numbers yourself. No agency in between.
  • Deep AI fluency. Claude is your daily driver, in Cowork and Code. You've built skills and orchestrated agents. Tell us what you automated this month. "Open to AI" doesn't pass the bar.
  • Data and judgment. You measure what works and kill what doesn't. You also decide without waiting for the perfect test.
  • Ownership. Brief to result. No handoffs.
  • Leadership. You make people better and faster without micromanaging them.
  • Clarity. You explain things simply. You don't hide weak results behind charts.
  • Languages. Fluent English. French or Spanish is a plus.

What we don't care about

  • Where your degree is from. Bachelor preferred, not required. Track record beats papers.
  • How polished your LinkedIn is. We read what you've shipped.
  • Whether you've worked at a brand we recognize. The best operators we've met came from companies you haven't heard of.

Logistics

Remote. Anywhere within +/- 3h of CET.

Type: Full-time, permanent contractor.

Start: January 2027 at the latest.

What we offer

  • B2B growth to own end to end. No committees, no hand-holding.
  • 140,000 agency offices and 640,000 agents to activate.
  • A dashboard and an app to grow.
  • Budget to test now, and a bigger one to scale in 2028.
  • The AI stack you'd struggle to build elsewhere. Claude (Cowork and Code), Mixpanel, HubSpot. All paid for.
  • A title with weight. You report to the CPO in a flat hierarchy.
  • Competitive comp aligned with your market.

jobs.description:
Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results-driven individuals to join our dynamic team.

You’ll also help build the team’s workflows, including for your own role, and test new tools as they’re introduced.

  • Test new tools and R&D initiatives as they’re introduced, and share feedback on what works in practice.

Standards

  • Keep file activity accurately documented in the portal, following internal processes and regulatory guidelines.

Qualifications

Director, Enterprise Managed Services Sales

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Broadcast Management Group

Broadcast Management Group (BMG) designs, builds, and operates media infrastructure for organizations whose content cannot fail. Our model is one connected production ecosystem: Create it. Engineer it. Operate it.

We run cloud-based production through our Cloud Control Center™, REMI (remote integration) workflows, a 24/7 network operations center, embedded production staffing, system integration, and OTT channel services.

Our clients include Amazon, Meta, Verizon, Blue Origin, UBS, Charles Schwab Network, CNN, Netflix, and the U.S. Department of State.

The Opportunity

BMG is seeking a senior sales professional who has run enterprise media operations from the inside and can sell the model that replaces what organizations have traditionally built and managed in-house.

Enterprise media organizations represent a significant growth opportunity for BMG. Telecom, financial services, technology, and consumer brands now operate studios, internal networks, executive communications, and live events at broadcast scale—often with in-house teams stretched thin.

This role sells a better operating model. BMG consults, designs and builds the facility, staffs it, and operates it through our Network Operations Center (NOC) under a recurring managed services agreement.

We are looking for someone who has sat in the buyer’s chair, managed these teams and budgets, and understands where in-house media operations break down.

What You’ll Do

  • Build a new-logo pipeline of Fortune 1000 enterprises with in-house media, studio, or live event operations, prioritizing multi-year managed services agreements over one-off projects.

  • Package the full lifecycle of BMG services, including consulting, facility design and build, embedded staffing, Cloud Control Center™ and REMI production, and 24/7 NOC operations, in partnership with BMG engineering and operations teams.

jobs.excerpt: About SleekThrough proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
jobs.description:
About Sleek

Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a high-growth space.

We operate 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 500 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled companies to achieve a public listing in the Asia Pacific region.

Mission:

Own a portfolio that starts at around 300 UK small business clients and grows to around 500 through 2027, delivered through a team of accountants based mostly in India and the Philippines. You are responsible for every client in it: their work is filed on time and accurate, and they can rely on you to explain what their numbers mean. This role is remote in South Africa but reports into leadership seated in our UK office.

What you’ll do

  • Run your portfolio end to end: year end accounts, corporation tax returns, VAT returns and confirmation statements.
  • Review and sign off your team’s work, and coach them so it’s right the first time.
  • Prepare management accounts for clients who need them, and take calls with clients to explain their accounts and what they mean for their business.
  • When a client’s delay puts a deadline at risk, chase early, keep a record, and make sure the client understands the consequences in good time.
  • Keep client records and workflow data accurate, so anyone can see where each client stands.
  • Work with Product, Tech, Sales, Support and Onboarding to fix problems where they start.
  • Use the AI tools we are building into our products and workflows, and help shape them.

Key Outcomes

  1. No statutory deadline in your portfolio missed because of us.
  2. Client satisfaction at or above our 97% target.
  3. Fewer review rounds on your team’s work, measured from when you start.
  4. Your portfolio’s workflow data is accurate enough to run the business from

Requirements

  • Fully qualified member of ACCA, ICAEW (ACA) or ICAS (CA) is required
  • At least 5 years in UK accounting practice, including at least 2 running your own portfolio of 150 or more SME clients.
  • Expert knowledge of UK statutory accounts (FRS 102 and 105) for private limited companies.
  • Strong knowledge of corporation tax and VAT for private limited companies, including preparing and reviewing corporation tax and VAT returns.
  • Experience preparing management accounts and explaining them to business owners in plain terms.
  • Experience reviewing and managing a team’s work, including people working remotely or offshore.
  • Confident with Xero or a similar cloud accounting package.
  • Based in South Africa with legal working rights. This role reports into leadership seated in our UK office.

Must-have Attributes

  1. Ownership: your portfolio is yours, and you fix problems rather than pass them on.
  2. Knowledgeable: you give your team and clients a definite answer.
  3. Great communicator: clear in writing and in person, with clients and with a team in another country.
  4. One team: you help other teams succeed, not just your own portfolio.
  5. Influence: you can get other teams, particularly Product, Tech, Sales and Support, to change something without having authority over them.
  6. Process, data and compliance: you follow the process, keep records clean and never cut corners on compliance.
  7. Open to AI: growing to 500 clients is only workable because our tools take on more of the routine work.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

Screening Interview

A 30-minute screening call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your background, evaluate mutual fit for the role, address expectations, and answer your questions.

Technical round and live case study
A 45-minute virtual session with the Hiring Manager, running through the technical experience of your background. They will discuss your last 1–2 roles to explore your background in more detail.

Behavioral/ Soft Skills round

A 30 minute chat with a member of the leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Reference verification

Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work from home. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

Stermedia.ai is looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer with strong Databricks expertise to join a data platform team building a global analytics environment for a leading pharmaceutical organization.

The platform integrates data from more than 80 facilities worldwide, including laboratories, manufacturing systems, logistics platforms, and operational environments. Its goal is to transform distributed datasets into reliable, analytics-ready data that supports reporting, operational monitoring, and data-driven decision-making.

You’ll contribute to the full delivery lifecycle — from direct client discussions and business requirements analysis to solution design, implementation, and production deployment. Working alongside international data engineering, analytics, and machine learning teams, you’ll focus on building scalable data pipelines and transformation layers using Databricks, Apache Spark, Python, SQL, and Delta Lake.

About the project

The project focuses on building a scalable data platform for operational data from pharmaceutical laboratories, production systems, and global supply chains.

Data from multiple regions is consolidated into a centralized analytics environment. The role focuses on using Databricks and a lakehouse architecture to ingest, process, and organize this data into reliable datasets for downstream analytics.

Required skills

jobs.description:
L'équipe Science s'agrandit !

AssessFirst, en quelques mots 👇

Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale.
Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.
Aujourd’hui, nous sommes plus de 110 collaborateurs et accompagnons 3 500+ clients dans plus de 40 pays, pour recruter et faire évoluer leurs équipes de manière plus inclusive et plus efficace.
Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.

Ce que tu feras :

En tant que Machine Learning Engineer dans l'équipe Science, tu conçois et mets en production les systèmes d'IA au cœur de nos produits. Il s'agit par exemple d'agents qui prennent en charge une mission de recrutement, d'une IA vocale qui mène des entretiens, ou d'outils qui analysent les échanges entre recruteurs et candidats. Les problèmes sont variés : voix, texte, agents, modélisation probabiliste. Tu choisis l'approche selon le problème, pas l'inverse. Tu travailles au quotidien avec nos ingénieurs ML, psychométriciens, Product Managers et les équipes Tech. Tu reportes directement au Chief Product Officer, qui pilote le Produit et la Science, ainsi qu'à ton Team Lead.

Tes missions :

  • Développer des agents IA autonomes : conçois des systèmes agentiques capables de gérer un processus de recrutement complet, du sourcing à la qualification des candidats, jusqu'à la création d'une shortlist documentée.

  • Faire évoluer notre IA vocale : améliore la fluidité et le naturel des entretiens conversationnels en travaillant sur la latence, la gestion des tours de parole et la robustesse aux accents et aux environnements bruyants.

  • Construire des outils d'analyse intelligents : développe des solutions capables d'exploiter les échanges recruteur-candidat, de générer des comptes rendus et d'apporter une assistance en temps réel, en structurant les informations issues des CV, portfolios et transcriptions.

  • Concevoir et entraîner des modèles ML : développe des modèles de scoring, de classification et de modélisation probabiliste, en collaboration avec nos psychométriciens, pour combiner différents signaux et quantifier l'incertitude.

  • Garantir la qualité et la fiabilité de nos systèmes : sélectionne les approches adaptées à chaque problématique, construis des frameworks d'évaluation et mesure la performance, l'équité et la robustesse des modèles avant et après leur mise en production.

  • Industrialiser et faire évoluer nos solutions IA : déploie et monitore tes systèmes avec l'équipe MLOps, conçois des services réutilisables et partage tes découvertes sur les dernières avancées en IA vocale, agentique et multimodale.

Ta future équipe

Tu rejoins notre équipe Product & Science, composée de 10 personnes : psychométriciens, ML Engineers, ingénieurs MLOps, Data Engineers, Product Managers et Product Designers.

Ton manager est Emeric, notre CPO, qui pilote à la fois le Produit et la Science. Au quotidien, tu avances avec Matthias, notre ML Team Lead, sur la conception de nos systèmes et les choix techniques. Tu travailles aussi avec les équipes back-end, front-end et QA.

Expérience souhaitée

🎯 Tu as une expérience confirmée en ML Engineering, avec des modèles et systèmes d'IA que tu as personnellement contribué à déployer en production.

💻 Tu maîtrises Python (moderne, typé, asynchrone), les bonnes pratiques de software engineering et le développement de solutions ML de bout en bout, de la préparation des données à l'entraînement et à l'évaluation.

☁️ Tu es à l'aise avec l'écosystème AWS, notamment SageMaker, Lambda et Kubernetes, pour développer et industrialiser des systèmes ML.

🎙️ Tu as une expérience en IA vocale (ASR, TTS) ou dans le développement d'agents conversationnels temps réel, avec une attention particulière portée à la qualité des interactions.

🤖 Tu sais concevoir et évaluer des agents IA ou des systèmes complexes, et tu explores les possibilités offertes par les modèles de fondation et les architectures agentiques.

📊 Tu possèdes de solides bases en statistiques, notamment en modélisation probabiliste, calibration et évaluation rigoureuse des modèles. Une expérience en inférence causale, expérimentation ou fairness en ML est un vrai plus.

🤝 Tu sais expliquer et défendre tes choix techniques, y compris auprès d'interlocuteurs non techniques, et tu apprécies travailler avec des expertises complémentaires.

⚡ Tu es curieux, pragmatique et sensible à l'impact de l'IA sur les personnes. Tu sais arbitrer entre innovation, performance et fiabilité, notamment dans des environnements régulés.

🧠 Tu utilises les outils d'IA au quotidien (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini ou équivalents) pour accélérer ton développement, explorer des approches techniques et challenger tes solutions, tout en gardant un regard critique sur les résultats.

Qu'est ce que tu obtiendras ?

Fourchette salariale : 70 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel fixe.

Autonomie & flexibilité : tu t'organises librement selon les priorités et les projets du moment.

Full remote : travaille d'où tu veux en Europe ! 🌍

Tickets resto : carte Swile à 10 € par jour travaillé.

Mutuelle : couverture santé avec Alan.

Épargne & participation : dispositif d'épargne salariale et de participation.

Bien-être : participation à tes activités sportives, chèques cadeaux et plateforme d'avantages.

Coworking : accès à des espaces partagés jusqu'à 5 fois par mois avec Worklib.

Vie d'équipe : une culture forte et quatre séminaires par an pour se retrouver.

Notre processus de recrutement:

  1. Notre annonce te parle et te donne envie d’en savoir plus

  2. Tu remplis nos tests en ligne en postulant (tu recevras un lien par email).

  3. L'équipe Talent te contacte

  4. 3 entretiens maximum : avec Matthias (Lead Science) et Basile (ML Engineer), puis Emeric (CPO) et Anthony (Lead Back End), et enfin Quentin (CEO) et David notre fondateur !

  5. Bienvenue, tu fais désormais partie de l'équipe ! 👏

jobs.description:
Director of Revenue Operations

Sundae

Compensation: $100,000–$125,000 annually, plus eligibility for performance-based bonus compensation

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Sundae

Sundae operates in the real estate industry, supporting a network of local market operators through centralized technology, marketing, and operational infrastructure. Our systems connect lead generation, customer relationship management, communications, data analytics, and business operations to help our teams operate efficiently and effectively.

Position Summary

Sundae is seeking a technically proficient, hands-on Director of Revenue Operations to oversee and continuously improve the technology systems that support our sales, marketing, and member operations.

This position is responsible for the administration, integration, automation, and reliability of the company's revenue technology infrastructure, including Salesforce, Zapier, Rill, smrtPhone, Twilio, DocuSign, and other business-critical platforms.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical execution with operational problem-solving skills. This individual must be comfortable working across multiple interconnected systems, troubleshooting complex issues, developing automations, and managing the technology setup for new market operators.

This is a highly hands-on role suited for someone who enjoys building and improving systems, takes ownership of technical challenges, and can work independently in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Technology and Systems Management

  • Own the day-to-day administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Sundae's revenue technology ecosystem.
  • Manage Salesforce environments through LeftMain, including system configurations, integrations, deployments, and ongoing support.
  • Support the technical onboarding of new market operators, including Salesforce organization setup, standard package deployment, integration validation, and system testing.
  • Maintain and improve integrations between Salesforce, Rill, Zapier, smrtPhone, Twilio, and other connected platforms.
  • Troubleshoot system issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions.

Automation and AI-Assisted Development

  • Leverage Codex and other AI-assisted development tools to configure, deploy, audit, and maintain technology solutions.
  • Build and maintain automated workflows that support lead distribution, notifications, customer communications, and operational processes.
  • Manage Zapier workflows for inbound leads originating from website forms, Google Ads, text messages, and phone calls.
  • Ensure accurate lead routing based on geographic territories and business rules.
  • Modify existing automations and develop new workflows as business requirements evolve.
  • Maintain standardized configurations and deployment processes across multiple market environments.

CRM and Member Onboarding

  • Coordinate with LeftMain to establish new Salesforce organizations and obtain administrative access.
  • Configure and validate connections between Salesforce and Rill.
  • Deploy standardized Sundae configurations, update associated data models, and audit new environments for accuracy and consistency.
  • Test automated sales cadences, including SMS and email communications, to verify correct contact information, routing, and functionality.
  • Configure DocuSign templates using territory-specific agreements and standardized company branding.
  • Provide ongoing technical support and configuration changes for existing market operators.

Data Infrastructure and Analytics

  • Support the administration and maintenance of Rill's data infrastructure, including raw data sources, staging models, and marketing attribution models.
  • Maintain reliable data integrations involving Google Ads, Salesforce, smrtPhone, First American data, and historical marketing lists.
  • Identify and resolve data quality, integration, and reporting issues.
  • Support accurate marketing attribution and reliable access to operational data.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to improve data consistency, visibility, and usability.

Telecommunications and Lead Routing

  • Administer smrtPhone accounts and configurations across Sundae's network of market operators.
  • Configure inbound call routing, team member assignments, backup routing, and territory-specific call flows.
  • Maintain Twilio-based routing solutions for shared or split territories, including rotation logic and caller continuity.
  • Support corporate SMS initiatives and troubleshoot telecommunications issues.
  • Ensure inbound communications are accurately directed and operationally reliable.

Business Systems Administration

  • Administer Google Workspace, including user provisioning, account deactivation, data backup, email groups, routing rules, and authorized email recovery.
  • Support Slack administration and user access.
  • Manage credential access and authentication workflows through 1Password.
  • Provide technical administration and support for DocuSign, YourVoice AI, and Sundae's website as business needs require.
  • Maintain appropriate access controls, documentation, and system administration practices.

Process Improvement and Operational Support

  • Develop and maintain documentation for technical configurations, integrations, onboarding procedures, and recurring administrative processes.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work through automation and system improvements.
  • Coordinate with external technology vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve issues and implement changes.
  • Prioritize competing technical requests while maintaining the reliability of business-critical systems.
  • Recommend practical technology improvements that support scalability, efficiency, and business performance.

Qualifications

Required

  • Demonstrated experience administering and integrating multiple business technology platforms, preferably in a revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, or business systems environment.

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Buscamos uma pessoa Staff AI Engineer para liderar a estratégia de uso e adoção de Inteligência Artificial nos produtos de Marketing Services, conectando profundidade técnica em GenAI com oportunidades concretas de produto, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a BU.
jobs.description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Staff AI Engineer para liderar a estratégia de uso e adoção de Inteligência Artificial nos produtos de Marketing Services, conectando profundidade técnica em GenAI com oportunidades concretas de produto, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a BU.

É uma posição de contribuidor individual sênior: esperamos que você construa, decida e responda pelo que coloca em produção. Além disso, lidera funcionalmente outros AI Engineers — direciona tecnicamente, revisa arquitetura, estabelece padrões e desenvolve o time —, sem gestão hierárquica formal neste momento.

A posição é central na evolução de soluções baseadas em LLMs, RAG e agentes, e responde pela identificação de casos de uso, pela definição das abordagens técnicas e pela transformação de aprendizado experimental em direcionamento para Produto, Engenharia e Liderança.

Mais do que uma referência em experimentação, buscamos quem já aplicou IA para acelerar estratégias de produtos digitais, melhorar jornadas e sustentar decisões de negócio com impacto real e medido.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Conduzir experimentos comparativos com diferentes LLMs, agentes e arquiteturas de GenAI aplicados a casos reais de negócio;

  • Projetar, otimizar e evoluir pipelines de RAG, incluindo estratégias de chunking, embeddings, retrieval e avaliação contínua;

  • Estruturar frameworks de avaliação e benchmarking para aplicações GenAI, considerando qualidade, relevância, confiabilidade, custo, latência e aderência ao caso de uso;

  • Medir performance, custo e ROI de soluções baseadas em IA, sustentando decisões de priorização e escala;

  • Decidir quando utilizar Prompt Engineering, RAG, Fine-Tuning ou arquiteturas multiagentes, respondendo pelos trade-offs técnicos e de negócio da escolha;

  • Atuar em parceria com times de Produto, Engenharia, Dados e Liderança para identificar onde IA pode acelerar estratégias de produtos digitais e ampliar valor para a BU;

  • Traduzir resultados técnicos em recomendações claras para roadmap, arquitetura, governança e evolução de capacidades;

  • Estabelecer boas práticas, padrões técnicos e uso responsável de GenAI dentro da estrutura, com adoção real pelas squads;

  • Construir e conduzir a visão aplicada de IA para Marketing Services, conectando tendências tecnológicas a necessidades reais de clientes, parceiros e produtos;

  • Elevar o nível técnico do time em GenAI por meio de mentoria, revisões de arquitetura e documentação de decisões.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em engenharia de software, dados ou Machine Learning, com trajetória de responsabilidade técnica crescente;

  • Ter conduzido transformação tecnológica em escala de área, BU ou organização, sabendo descrever o estado anterior, o que mudou e o resultado medido. Exemplos: adoção de IA ou GenAI em produtos e times, migração de plataforma, programa de MLOps, mudança de arquitetura ou evolução do modelo de engenharia;

  • Ter estabelecido padrões, componentes ou práticas técnicas adotadas por times que não eram o seu, incluindo como a adoção foi conquistada;

  • Experiência comprovada levando soluções de GenAI a produção — RAG e/ou agentes com usuário real, sustentação e medição de qualidade e custo. Não contam provas de conceito, notebooks ou pilotos que não chegaram a usuário;

  • Experiência prática com GenAI e LLMs em contexto real de negócio;

  • Experiência no desenho, avaliação e evolução de soluções com RAG, embeddings, retrieval e/ou agentes;

  • Vivência em iniciativas que conectaram IA a produto digital, eficiência operacional, automação ou aceleração de jornadas;

  • Proficiência avançada em Python;

  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados;

  • Base consistente em estatística, análise de dados e experimentação;

  • Experiência com avaliação de modelos generativos, incluindo métricas tradicionais e abordagens LLM-based;

  • Familiaridade com frameworks e ecossistemas de LLMs, como OpenAI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI ou equivalentes;

  • Experiência construindo servidores MCP (Model Context Protocol) — desenho das tools, contratos de exposição e operação;

  • Capacidade de documentar trade-offs e transformar conclusões técnicas em recomendações acionáveis.

  • Ter desenvolvido engenheiros com evolução observável: mentoria, ramp-up de pessoas novas no tema, elevação de nível técnico do time;

  • Ter influenciado roadmap e decisões de arquitetura sem autoridade formal, em contextos com interesses divergentes;

  • Ter conduzido uma decisão técnica contestada até a adoção — e saber dizer o que foi necessário para convencer, ou o que fez mudar de posição.

Idiomas

  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório) — leitura, escrita e conversação para atuação em fóruns, comitês e iniciativas globais da companhia.

    Inglês fluente (diferencial).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em acelerar a adoção de IA dentro de uma Business Unit, conectando tecnologia a estratégia e execução;

  • Vivência com produtos digitais, personalização, automação, Martech ou jornadas orientadas a crescimento;

  • Experiência com Fine-Tuning, Transfer Learning, Hugging Face, PyTorch ou TensorFlow;

  • Familiaridade com AWS Bedrock Agents / AWS Agent Core;

  • Experiência com automação e orquestração de fluxos GenAI, usando n8n, Flowise, LangFlow ou equivalentes;

  • Vivência com Prompt Optimization, incluindo DSPy ou abordagens similares;

  • Experiência em coordenação de time ou gestão formal de pessoas — a estrutura deve crescer e a liderança do time é uma possibilidade de evolução;

  • Capacidade de navegar bem entre exploração técnica e priorização executiva.

Competências esperadas

  • Decide com evidência. Sustenta escolhas técnicas com dado, experimento e medição — não com preferência ou autoridade;

  • Transforma ambiguidade em direção. Recebe um problema mal definido e devolve um caminho com escopo, risco e critério de sucesso;

  • Comunica nos dois registros. Explica a mesma decisão para um engenheiro e para um executivo sem perder precisão nem encher de jargão;

  • Assume o resultado, não só a entrega. Acompanha o que construiu em produção — qualidade, custo, incidente — e corrige;

  • Separa hype de valor. Reconhece quando IA não é a resposta e diz isso, mesmo quando a expectativa é o contrário.

Escopo esperado

  • Influência relevante em decisões de arquitetura e estratégia de GenAI, atravessando múltiplas squads de Marketing Services;

  • Referência técnica para as squads da BU: padrões, revisões de arquitetura e elevação do nível técnico do time;

  • Liderança funcional de outros AI Engineers, com direcionamento técnico e desenvolvimento do time;

  • Papel ativo e mensurável na aceleração da curva de adoção de IA em Marketing Services;

  • Conexão entre excelência técnica e direcionamento de produto e negócio.

Como mediremos sucesso

  • Casos de uso de GenAI em produção, construídos dentro da estrutura;

  • Redução do lead time entre ideia e produção;

  • Custo de inferência conhecido, instrumentado e otimizado por caso de uso;

  • Componentes e padrões publicados e efetivamente adotados pelas squads;

  • Autonomia da BU em IA: menos dependência de filas externas para evoluir produto.

O que deve diferenciar esse perfil

Buscamos alguém que una excelência técnica em GenAI com visão aplicada de negócio, e que já tenha transformado capacidade técnica em mudança real de organização — não apenas em projeto entregue. A pessoa certa aqui lê o sistema, antecipa prioridades, lidera mudanças relevantes sem autoridade formal e move a estrutura por direção técnica e padrões escaláveis.

  • Structure videos to maximise retention, keeping viewers engaged throughout

Create Thumbnails

  • Design thumbnails for each video that match the style of The Cruise Globe's existing YouTube channel
  • Source all thumbnail imagery directly from the video footage
  • Ensure thumbnails are optimised for click-through and consistent with the channel's visual identity

Work to Brief and Iterate

  • Follow briefs clearly and deliver to agreed timelines, often with quick turnaround requirements
  • Proactively suggest creative improvements where you see an opportunity to strengthen the edit or the thumbnail
  • Incorporate feedback efficiently and maintain quality through revision cycles

Stay Current and Bring Ideas

  • Actively monitor what is performing well on YouTube within travel and cruise content
  • Flag trends, editing styles, or thumbnail approaches that could work well for the channel
  • Use AI tools to accelerate production or enhance workflows where appropriate


What We're Looking For


Essential

  • 3+ years of professional video editing experience with a strong focus on YouTube content
  • A strong portfolio of long-form YouTube edits. Please include this with your application, links to live YouTube videos you have edited are preferred
  • Deep understanding of YouTube as a platform, including pacing, retention, chapter structure, and what makes content perform
  • Experience creating YouTube thumbnails that are on-brand and built for click-through
  • Proficiency in DaVinci, Adobe Premiere Pro and/or Final Cut Pro
  • Strong audio editing skills, including voiceover cleanup and sound design
  • C1/C2 level written and spoken English. All communication with the team is in English and must be clear and professional
  • Highly organised, with disciplined file and asset management
  • Reliable, punctual, and comfortable managing your own workload independently
  • Comfortable working within UK timezone overlap hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience editing content for travel, lifestyle, or creator-led YouTube channels
  • Experience with Canva for thumbnail creation
  • Background working with or for individual YouTube creators

Technical Requirements

  • Access to a reliable, high-speed fibre internet connection with a backup option
  • Your own computer capable of running Adobe Creative Suite and editing HD footage without performance issues
  • Sufficient local storage to download and work with large video files. Individual project files can range from 2 to 3 GB, so adequate drive space and the ability to manage and clear files regularly is essential.

Benefits

What We Can Offer

  • A monthly fee of PHP 80,000, plus 13th month payment
  • 26 days of paid time off annually, inclusive of public holidays, sick leave, and annual leave. You choose which days you take
  • Set working hours of 09:00 to 18:00 UK time, Monday to Friday, with a 1-hour lunch break
  • Annual salary reviews. Consistently strong performance will be rewarded
  • Fully remote, home-based role
  • A close-knit international team with a track record of flexibility and strong employee retention
  • The opportunity to work directly alongside one of the world's leading cruise creators from day one

The Hiring Process

We assess candidates based on the quality of their work, not just their CV.

To apply, submit your application through the link below. Upon applying, you will receive an email with an initial editing task that we will use to assess your suitability for the role. This task must be completed and submitted within 72 hours of receipt to be considered.

The task will ask you to complete the following:

  • Introduction edit. You will be provided with a recorded voiceover and a folder of b-roll footage. Edit the voiceover, removing any mistakes or pauses. Place b-roll over the audio, matching clips to the spoken content. Select visually strong clips, avoid anything shaky, blurry, or fast-moving. Keep the pacing tight. The final edit will be approximately 30 to 40 seconds.
  • Thumbnail creation. Create one thumbnail for the video. The style should match The Cruise Globe's existing YouTube channel. Research the channel before you begin. All imagery must be taken from the video footage provided.

When applying, please also include the following:

  • Your portfolio. Share links to YouTube videos you have edited. We want to see long-form content specifically. If you have also edited short-form or paid social content, please include examples of that too.
  • A short answer. In a few sentences, tell us about a YouTube channel whose editing and thumbnails you think are done really well, and why.

Please create a Google Drive folder titled with your name and the role you are applying for. The folder should contain your completed task, portfolio links, and your short answer.

The Process:

  • Application and initial editing task
  • First-round interview
  • Final interview with the wider team

Applications submitted without a completed editing task will not be considered.

jobs.title: Senior Product Strategist
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWhale Song is a digital product studio backed by Golden Section, serving mid-market, enterprise, and government clients with custom software development, AI-enabled solutions, and product strategy services.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Whale Song is a digital product studio backed by Golden Section, serving mid-market, enterprise, and government clients with custom software development, AI-enabled solutions, and product strategy services. We build right the first time, which means strategy before execution, clarity before build, and measurable outcomes before feature output.

We're looking for a Senior Product Strategist who brings genuine senior-level product thinking and the presence to deploy it in a client-facing consulting environment. This is not a pure internal PM role. Depending on the engagement, you'll move fluidly between setting product strategy and owning hands-on product management execution — leading discovery, scoping, requirements strategy, delivery oversight, and stakeholder alignment across multiple client engagements simultaneously.

The right person has led products, not just managed them. You understand the difference between writing user stories and driving outcomes. You can walk into a room with a VP of Engineering or a CMO and credibly lead a strategy conversation. And you know how to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous, complex product problems, and then stay in the work long enough to see it through.

What You'll Do

Your work will span the full arc of our client engagements from initial discovery through active delivery:

Discovery & Strategy

  • Lead client discovery sessions to define business problems, goals, constraints, and success criteria before a line of code is scoped.
  • Translate complex, ambiguous client needs into clear product strategy, prioritization frameworks, and phased roadmaps.
  • Develop and present strategic recommendations to executive stakeholders with confidence and credibility.

Scoping & Requirements

  • Produce development-ready requirement documents, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications grounded in business outcomes.
  • Assess technical feasibility and integration requirements in collaboration with engineering leads.
  • Own scoping calls end-to-end: structure the conversation, identify risks, and produce the deliverable.

Product Management Execution

  • Step into hands-on Product Management ownership when engagements require it; managing backlogs, facilitating sprints, and driving delivery accountability.
  • Serve as the product authority during active delivery; guiding sprint execution, scope management, and release coordination.
  • Identify and escalate scope creep, delivery risks, and client expectation gaps before they become problems.

Client Relationship

  • Act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, building credibility through consistent delivery and strategic thinking.
  • Maintain proactive communication across multiple concurrent client engagements.
  • Represent Whale Song professionally in all client interactions — written, verbal, and in person.

Internal Contribution

  • Support pre-sales solutioning and proposal development for new engagements.
  • Contribute to methodology refinement as Whale Song's product practice continues to mature.
  • Mentor and support junior team members on requirements quality and product thinking.

What We're Looking For

Experience & Background

  • 7+ years in product management, product strategy, or business analysis — with meaningful time spent in a client-facing, consulting, or agency delivery environment.
  • Demonstrated track record leading product work across B2B SaaS, custom software, or enterprise application development.
  • Comfortable moving between strategic advisory work and hands-on PM execution depending on what the engagement requires.
  • Experience working with cross-functional remote teams including engineering, UX, and business stakeholders.
  • Prior exposure to multiple industries preferred — healthcare technology, fintech, real estate tech, or enterprise software are all relevant backgrounds.

Core Skills

  • Product Strategy and Roadmapping
  • Requirements and User Story Writing
  • Client-Facing Delivery
  • Agile/Hybrid-Agile Methodologies
  • Business Analysis
  • Software Scoping & Estimation
  • UX Collaboration
  • Stakeholder Management
  • SaaS & Custom Application Delivery
  • AI-Enabled Product Operations
  • Backlog Management
  • Product QA & Release Coordination

What Sets You Apart

  • You lead with strategy before jumping to solutions — you ask why before you ask how.
  • You can hold your own in a room full of executives or engineers, and you know which conversation you're in.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and skilled at bringing structure to it.
  • You write with precision. Your requirements documents don't leave room for misinterpretation.
  • You manage your own workload without being managed — you flag issues early, communicate proactively, and follow through.
  • You take quality personally. Rework is not an acceptable outcome.

Our Methodology & Culture

Whale Song operates on a set of principles that are non-negotiable, and we hire people who already believe in them:

  • Build Right the First Time: Every engagement starts with clarity, not code.
  • Clarity before build: Strategy before execution, always.
  • Financial and delivery discipline: Delivery must be feasible, margin must be healthy, and client expectations must be set honestly.
  • Client partnership, not vendor relationship: We are an extension of our clients' teams, and we show up like it.
  • AI-enabled operations: We actively adopt AI-enabled tools and workflows to improve delivery quality and team efficiency.

We're a remote team. That means high trust, high autonomy, and high accountability. You'll have the freedom to do your best work — and the expectation that you will.

Role Details

Location: Remote (must be based in the United States)

Type: Contract (10 to 40 hours per week, depending on active engagements)

Availability: Must be available during standard U.S. business hours for client calls and team collaboration

Travel: Occasional client visits or team offsites may be required

How to Apply

Apply via our online application portal. You'll be asked to upload your resume and a brief cover sheet (please include both).

In your cover sheet, tell us why this role is the right fit for you. Specifically, describe a product engagement where you drove measurable business outcomes, not just a list of features you shipped. We want to understand how you think, not just what you've done.

We review every application and respond to candidates who are a genuine match. No recruiters or agencies, please.

Aperçu du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d’une développeuse ou d’un développeur de logiciels pour se joindre à l’équipe de la plateforme Unified Storage Layer (USL). Vous contribuerez au développement de la solution de stockage infonuagique d’Intelerad pour ses applications infonuagiques. Dans ce rôle, vous concevrez et livrerez les services de stockage qui soutiennent la clientèle qui passe des déploiements traditionnels d’Intelerad à notre plateforme infonuagique. Vous travaillerez au sein d’une équipe agile multidisciplinaire et assumerez l’entière responsabilité du cycle de développement des fonctionnalités, tout en contribuant à une plateforme qui stocke et fournit de l’imagerie médicale à grande échelle.

Principales responsabilités

  • Concevoir, développer et maintenir des fonctionnalités de l’Unified Storage Layer, en assumant l’entière responsabilité du travail, de la délimitation de la portée jusqu’à la livraison. Veiller à ce que les solutions soient testées, documentées et conformes aux engagements de sprint.
  • Traduire des billets de soutien complexes et les exigences des parties prenantes en solutions techniques bien conçues. Repérer et résoudre de façon proactive les problèmes touchant la couche de stockage et son infrastructure infonuagique.
  • Contribuer à la qualité du code au moyen de revues approfondies des demandes de tirage (pull requests) et d’une documentation complète, en soutenant les normes communes à l’équipe et le partage des connaissances.
  • Bâtir et maintenir l’infrastructure infonuagique de l’USL, notamment la conception de grappes Kubernetes, l’approvisionnement automatisé avec Terraform, l’optimisation des composants AWS et la gestion des pipelines CI/CD.
  • Travailler avec diverses technologies, bases de code et services infonuagiques natifs, en cernant les possibilités d’amélioration et en prenant l’initiative de les mettre en œuvre dans un flux de travail agile/Scrum.

Qualifications et expérience

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle en développement de logiciels commerciaux, ou expérience équivalente appuyée par un historique démontré de livraison de logiciels prêts pour la production
  • Expérience pratique des services infonuagiques AWS (par exemple, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM) et de Kubernetes, y compris l’approvisionnement de l’infrastructure avec Terraform
  • Capacité avérée à travailler de façon autonome au sein d’une équipe répartie, à gérer les priorités et à produire des résultats avec un minimum de supervision
  • Solides compétences en débogage et en résolution de problèmes, et capacité à décomposer des objectifs complexes à long terme en incréments bien délimités et livrables
  • Aisance à travailler avec plusieurs langages, cadriciels et domaines fonctionnels, selon l’évolution des besoins de l’entreprise

  • Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine connexe
  • Expérience de développement en Kotlin ou dans un autre langage JVM semblable
  • Java, Spring Boot
  • Expertise en développement d’API REST et de bases de données PostgreSQL
  • Orchestration de conteneurs avec Docker, Kubernetes et Helm
  • Expérience du contrôle de version avec Git/GitHub et connaissance des pratiques exemplaires en matière de tests unitaires et d’intégration.
  • Expérience des environnements Linux/Unix, de l’écriture de scripts shell et des outils en ligne de commande
  • Expérience de la méthodologie agile/Scrum dans des environnements de développement au rythme rapide
  • Expérience en technologies de la santé : compréhension de DICOM, de HL7, de l’imagerie médicale ou des flux de travail en radiologie
  • Connaissance de la sécurité des TI et de l’authentification
