  • Gather intelligence on how customers are using products and determine features and services that are most valuable to their businesses
  • Act as an escalation point for all customers
  • Identify areas for improvement in customer experience in the product and processes

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5+ years Enterprise Customer Success, Sales, or Account Management experience with a proven track record of success
  • A customer-centric thinker with a track record of delivering scalable solutions in a high-growth environment
  • Demonstrated ability in learning new software programs and products while identifying opportunities to use them to their full potential
  • Ability to thrive in a high-growth, high-ambiguity environment; setting personal objectives and prioritizing impact-based activities.
  • Exceptional account management skills and project management skills with strict attention to detail
  • Problem solver with demonstrated ability to overcome challenges and ambiguity with creative solutions

Competencies:

  • Execution: Strategic Accounts Customer Success Managers (CSM) own a book of business averaging 5-8 clients or ~$ 5-8MM in ARR. CSMs conduct planned and time-gated outbound activities that enable client outcomes, communicate value, and identify new growth opportunities.
  • Domain Expertise: Strategic Accounts CSMs' execution is tailored to the cohort of clients within their book of business. Caring for a specific client type not only leverages their deep knowledge of CS and Motive but also requires them to become an expert in a particular niche.
  • User Focus: Strategic Accounts CSMs enable clients to extract value from Motive’s products and solutions through activities like training and adoption. Strategic ENT CSMs have a sharper focus on particular cohorts of the account base in which their activities/suggestions are more targeted. They use their expertise to expand usage and drive value far beyond the initial purchase reasons.
  • Collaboration: Strategic Accounts CSMs are the internal advocate for Motive’s customers. They escalate issues to key business partners, including escalating up leadership chains, in order to drive resolution. CSMs coordinate and lead EBRs that include AEs and other internal stakeholders. CSMs also participate routinely in identifying clients for BETA programs, references, and case studies.
  • Problem Solving: Strategic Accounts CSMs are capable of driving resolution cross-functionally, independent of leadership involvement. Their ability to proactively tackle problems and manage them to completion separates Motive from competitors.

Duties/Functions:

Specialized Book of Business: Strategic Accounts CSMs care for special cohorts within the ENT segment, which includes Partner (e.g, Insurance), New Client (Adoption), and Mature (fully penetrated) accounts.

  • Client Enablement: Strategic Accounts ensure clients are capable of extracting value from Motive’s products and services through adoption activities, new feature training, and providing suggestions on how to best leverage the platform.

  • Client Marketing: Strategic Accounts CSMs engage clients about thought leadership and new products framed around the value they create, which in turn leads to cross-sell opportunities for sales. CSMs also capture organic upsells through natural touchpoints.
  • Renewal Management: Strategic Accounts CSMs ensure clients have a great experience and extract value, turning the renewal into a predetermined event. Renewal Managers partner with CSMs to ensure the most value possible is extracted for Motive, while retaining the most units possible, driving profitability.
  • Escalation Management: Strategic Accounts CSMs proactively advocate for clients by escalating internally to prevent the need for the client to escalate. When clients do escalate, the CSM leads the engagement to drive swift resolution.
  • Account Stewardship: Strategic Accounts CSMs act as the main point of contact to guide clients through working with Motive as a company. Any non-selling activity becomes the CSM's responsibility to champion.
  • Technical Expert: Strategic Accounts CSMs act as a consultant and first line of triage. Their technical skill aids clients in maximizing value, becoming self-reliant, and reducing unnecessary tier 1 support needs.

jobs.excerpt: Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMH-NP)Department: Clinical Services | FLSA Status: Exempt | Reports To: Director of Clinical Operations Part-Time | Telehealth / RemotePosition SummaryWe are seeking a compassionate and highly skilled Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMH-NP) to join our growing tele-health behavioral health team.
jobs.description:
Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMH-NP)

Department: Clinical Services | FLSA Status: Exempt | Reports To: Director of Clinical Operations

Part-Time | Telehealth / Remote

Position Summary

We are seeking a compassionate and highly skilled Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMH-NP) to join our growing tele-health behavioral health team. In this fully remote role, the PMH-NP will provide comprehensive psychiatric evaluation, diagnosis, medication management, and ongoing care to individuals experiencing a range of mental health conditions. The ideal candidate is clinically excellent, patient-centered, and comfortable delivering high-quality psychiatric care through a telehealth platform.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Care

  • Conduct thorough psychiatric evaluations and diagnostic assessments for new and established patients via telehealth.
  • Develop and implement individualized treatment plans including psychopharmacological interventions and therapeutic recommendations.
  • Manage a panel of patients with conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, bipolar disorder, PTSD, and other psychiatric diagnoses.
  • Monitor patient progress, adjust medications as clinically appropriate, and document outcomes in accordance with evidence-based practice.
  • Provide crisis assessment and intervention as needed, with appropriate referrals to higher levels of care.
  • Collaborate with therapists, care coordinators, and other members of the multidisciplinary team to ensure integrated, whole-person care.

Telehealth Service Delivery

  • Deliver all clinical services via a HIPAA-compliant tele-health platform, ensuring a professional, private, and secure environment.
  • Maintain punctual scheduling and efficient patient flow to meet productivity expectations while upholding quality of care.
  • Assist patients in navigating the telehealth experience, including troubleshooting basic platform issues and ensuring informed consent.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Complete timely and accurate clinical documentation in the electronic health record (EHR) in accordance with organizational and regulatory standards.
  • Adhere to all applicable state and federal regulations governing prescribing authority, controlled substances (DEA), and telehealth practice.
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA, licensing requirements, and organizational policies and procedures.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, peer review processes, and ongoing clinical audits.

Patient Engagement & Education

  • Provide patient education on diagnoses, medications, side effects, and self-management strategies in a clear and empathetic manner.
  • Engage patients and, where appropriate, their families or support persons in shared decision-making and care planning.
  • Promote medication adherence and support patients in overcoming barriers to treatment.

Qualifications

Licensure & Certification

  • Current, unrestricted Nurse Practitioner license in the state(s) of practice; multi-state licensure or compact eligibility strongly preferred.
  • Board certification as a Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMH-NP-BC) through ANCC required.
  • Active DEA registration with prescriptive authority, including Schedule II–V controlled substances.

Education & Experience

  • Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) or Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) with a specialization in Psychiatric Mental Health required.
  • Minimum of 2 years of clinical experience as a PMH-NP, preferably in an outpatient or tele-health behavioral health setting.
  • Experience treating adult and/or adolescent populations with a broad range of psychiatric conditions.
  • Prior tele-health experience strongly preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Proficiency with EHR systems; experience with behavioral health platforms.
  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic reasoning, and psychopharmacology skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build rapport in a virtual environment.
  • Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and thrive in a remote work setting.
  • Commitment to culturally responsive, trauma-informed, and patient-centered care.

Why Join Us

Our mission is to make high-quality psychiatric care accessible to all — regardless of geography or circumstance. As a member of our telehealth team, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of patients who may otherwise face significant barriers to mental health treatment. We offer a flexible, fully remote work environment, a collaborative clinical culture, and the support you need to practice at the top of your license.

Salary: $70 per hour

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Key Accounts
jobs.excerpt: Sprout Social is looking to hire a Customer Success Manager, Key Accounts for the Sales & Customer Experience team.
jobs.description:
Sprout Social is looking to hire a Customer Success Manager, Key Accounts for the Sales & Customer Experience team.

Why join Sprout’s Sales & Customer Experience team?

The Sales and Customer Experience team shapes how Sprout powers the future of customer connection for today’s most innovative brands. We sell and support the leading social media management platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.

You’ll join a high-performing, collaborative team made up of some of the brightest minds in the industry, working with iconic brands like Campbell's, Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, Sprout is a place where your growth matters. You’ll have the freedom to shape your career, explore new paths, and build toward what’s next, with a team that’s invested in helping you get there.

What you’ll do

Own a book of ~60 Enterprise accounts — building relationships, driving adoption, and growing revenue within some of our largest, most strategic customers. The Customer Success Manager, Key Accounts plays a critical role in driving value through Sprout’s Social Intelligence platform.

  • Grow the relationship. Build strong, lasting relationships with key stakeholders — C-level executives, marketing directors, social media managers, and agency partners.

  • Bring a commercial mindset. Uncover new opportunities, qualify upsell and cross-sell leads, and confidently work through objections to expand accounts and defend revenue at renewal.

  • Run the cadence. Lead Mutual Success Plan reviews, monthly syncs, Executive Business Reviews, and adoption sessions to track usage, surface risks, and align on strategic goals.

  • Drive adoption. Partner with Onboarding and Professional Services to ramp new customers, and deliver ongoing training that keeps value visible throughout the client lifecycle.

  • Manage risk and retention. Spot churn risks early, resolve them proactively, and keep satisfaction high across your book. Collaborate effectively with Renewal Managers.

  • Tell the story with data. Track account health and key metrics, and turn them into a clear, compelling ROI narrative for customers and internally.

  • Work smart. Use generative AI tools like Claude and Gemini to speed up daily work — call prep, troubleshooting, drafting client messaging — so you can focus your time on the strategic parts of the job only you can own.

  • Hit your numbers. Consistently meet and exceed quota, managing your book against KPIs and your comp plan.

What you'll bring

Minimum qualifications:

  • 4-6 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales in B2B SaaS, including 2+ years managing an Enterprise book of business.

  • Strong preference for candidates with prior account management or sales experience — comfortable qualifying leads, uncovering opportunity, and navigating objections in commercial conversations.

  • Demonstrated success retaining, renewing, and expanding Enterprise accounts through strategic relationship management.

  • Experience building relationships with, presenting to, and influencing senior decision-makers.

  • Familiarity with generative AI platforms (e.g., Claude, Gemini) and comfort integrating them into daily operations — call prep, troubleshooting, messaging — to work more efficiently, while retaining full ownership and leadership of strategic client engagements.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience advising on social media strategy or tools.

  • Experience working with or managing agency partners is a plus.

  • Familiarity with G-Suite, Salesforce, Gainsight and Tableau.

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.

  • Partner with the Manager of Customer Success to define key success metrics for your role and how you will measure against them.

  • Begin developing familiarity with our business, platform, and applications, as well as our company’s key metrics.

  • Acclimate yourself with the day to day responsibilities of Sprout’s Success Team by shadowing team members, listening to recorded customer calls and working closely with our dedicated Enablement Manager.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Receive your dedicated book of business and begin familiarizing yourself with your customer base.

  • Establish relationships with customer-facing departments across the organization.

  • Direct customers to Sprout resources such as product guides, webinars, and customer support to encourage product adoption.

  • Respond to high-impact customer issues in a fashion that inspires continued customer loyalty.

  • Actively handle inbound requests and account related questions.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Maintain product expertise across our platform to serve as the ultimate trusted advisor.

  • Partner with colleagues across departments to address customer feedback and communicate accordingly.

  • Review to-date performance with your manager, identify areas of improvement and establish a plan for career development.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Propose and execute independent projects benefiting the whole of Customer Success or Sprout as an organization.

  • Identify individual strengths and how to apply them effectively for continued success.

  • Master the Strategic Business Review and begin visiting customers in person to provide additional value.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.

  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.

  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).

  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.

  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.

  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.

  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.

  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.

  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Whenever possible, Sprout wants to provide our team with the flexibility to work in the location that makes the most sense for them. Sprout maintains a remote workforce in many places in the United States. However, we are not set up in all states, so please look at the drop-down box in our application to see whether your state is listed. Few roles require an office setting. If your position requires a physical presence in a Sprout office, it will be evident in the job listing and your offer letter.

Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills.

Our current hiring range for this role: $92,000 - $115,000 OTE annually. OTE is governed by an incentive plan. It is the sum of a fixed base salary plus incentives at target performance. Incentive compensation will vary based on performance. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth potential available as you progress in your role.

We have two geographic pay zones in the United States:

Zone 1 (New York, California, Washington): $101,200 - $152,800

Zone 2 (All other US states): $92,000 - $138,000

These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges. We also evaluate compensation bi-annually, identify any changes in the market and make adjustments to our ranges and existing employee compensation as needed.

Job Description:

Position Description


We are seeking a hands on, highly engaged Forward Deployed Engineer specializing in Kubernetes, platform modernization, large scale stateful workload migration, and enterprise AI infrastructure. In this role, you will be embedded directly alongside enterprise client teams throughout the entire end to end lifecycle of an engagement. From initial architecture, bare metal/legacy re platforming, and AI cluster setup to live in the field troubleshooting and production rollout.


Because you are part of the core Engineering organization, you won't just file bug reports; you will write production code in the field, build prototype integrations, and channel those contributions directly back to our engineering teams across the Infrastructure Software Division (ISG) to help shape, prioritize, and accelerate high impact platform capabilities. This role sits directly within the Engineering Business Unit (BU), working side by side with product and core software teams. Unlike traditional professional services or post sales support roles, our Forward Deployed Engineering team operates as an extension of core engineering in the field.


Our Core Mission: Reduce customer adoption friction, dramatically shorten software iteration cycles, and establish a high bandwidth, direct feedback loop between real world enterprise deployments and product development.


Key Responsibilities


  • Direct Engineering to Field Collaboration: Act as an embedded engineering liaison across the Infrastructure Software Division, working directly with core software architects, product managers, and enterprise client developers to eliminate deployment friction.
  • Rapid Iteration & Friction Reduction: Identify recurring migration blockers and platform usability gaps in real world customer environments, rapidly building and testing field fixes to shorten feature iteration cycles from months to days.
  • End to End Engagement Ownership: Stay actively embedded with customer technical teams from pre migration discovery through go live and operational stabilization, ensuring successful platform adoption and high customer trust.
  • Hands on Field Implementation & Troubleshooting: Work shoulder to shoulder with client engineers in production environments to write code, build manifests, debug live networking/storage/GPU failures, and optimize VKS performance.
  • Engineering Feedback Loop & Feature Prioritization: Synthesize field tested code, architectural patterns, and customer pain points directly into core engineering requirements. Partner with product managers and core engineers to translate customer contributions into prioritized platform features.
  • VKS & AI Infrastructure Architecture: Architect, deploy, and maintain production grade vSphere Kubernetes Service (VKS) clusters across VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) and hybrid cloud infrastructure, optimized for both general purpose compute and accelerated GPU/NPU workloads.
  • Bare Metal & Legacy Platform Migration: Lead technical migration strategies transitioning enterprise platforms, massive bare metal environments, and legacy data stacks over to VKS or cloud native Kubernetes targets.
  • Enterprise AI & Inferencing Modernization: Deploy, tune, and scale production AI inferencing workloads, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures, vector search, and model serving frameworks on Kubernetes using virtualized GPU resources (NVIDIA vGPU, MIG).
  • Data Services & Messaging Re Platforming: Containerize, refactor, and migrate heavy stateful engines, message brokers (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ), distributed caches (Redis, Oracle Coherence, Hazelcast), and risk calculation/analytics platforms onto Kubernetes.
  • Modern Data & AI Stack Modernization: Architect operator driven, cloud native deployments for data processing, orchestration, and distributed AI frameworks (Ray, vLLM, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Trino/Presto, Flink, Dask, Cassandra/ScyllaDB, Milvus/Qdrant).
  • Multi Kubernetes Integration: Guide clients evaluating or operating VKS alongside competing distributions (Red Hat OpenShift, Amazon EKS, Google GKE, Azure AKS, Rancher RKE/RKS).

Key Qualifications


  • Engineering Mindset & Organizational Fit: Deep alignment with product engineering workflows; experience functioning within or closely alongside core software/R&D divisions rather than pure IT or professional services.
  • Full Lifecycle Engagement Experience: Proven track record of staying deeply engaged with customer technical leadership and developers across long term, complex engineering projects.
  • Product Minded Engineering: Demonstrated ability to translate raw technical customer requirements and field workarounds into clean product specifications and feature requests for core development teams.
  • AI & Accelerated Compute Infrastructure: Hands on experience operating GPU accelerated Kubernetes nodes, model serving runtimes (vLLM, TGI, Triton Inference Server), vector databases (Milvus, Qdrant, Pgvector), and distributed AI orchestration (Ray, KubeRay).
  • Distributed Systems & Stateful Workloads: Hands on experience containerizing and operating high throughput/low latency platforms:Distributed Caching & In Memory Grids: Redis, Oracle Coherence, Hazelcast
  • Compute & Analytics Engines: Risk calculation platforms, Hadoop (HDFS/YARN)
  • Messaging & Streaming: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pulsar
  • Cloud Native Data & AI Stack Depth: Deep technical knowledge of deploying, tuning, and scaling containerized data services, AI engines, and orchestrators:
  • Batch, Real Time & AI Processing: Ray, vLLM, Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Dask
  • Orchestration & Workflow: Apache Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Argo Workflows
  • Query, NoSQL & Vector Engines: Trino/Presto, Apache Cassandra / ScyllaDB, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch, Milvus, Qdrant
  • Multi Kubernetes Proficiency: Technical depth across competing enterprise distributions (OpenShift, EKS, GKE, AKS, or Rancher RKE/RKS).
  • Infrastructure as Code & GitOps: Advanced skills in Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes Operators (KPO), Cluster API (CAPI), and GitOps (ArgoCD, Flux).

Experience/Education:

Bachelor's degree preferred. Relevant year's experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.

12+ years related experience required


Compensation and Benefits


The annual base salary range for this position is USD 110,800.00 To USD 177,300.00

You live at the intersection of culture, platform, and execution, and you know how to turn good creative into scalable content through iteration, optimization, and testing.

THE RESPONSIBILITIES / THE TASK AT HAND

  • Create content that makes impactful connections with consumers, measured by high attention metrics (views, likes, comments, shares, retention).
  • Serve as an algorithm-fluent editor with deep expertise in hooks, pacing, structure, and retention across social platforms — owning the DJ-ing, remixing, and optimization of content to drive scalable performance.
  • Take principal accountability for performance tuning and platform success, continuously optimizing creative to unlock stronger results.
  • Edit and assemble raw footage into polished final videos, ensuring assets are natively optimized for platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube — with a performance-creative mindset, not post-production only.
  • Stay up to date with platform algorithms, emerging formats, creator trends, and editing techniques to keep content fresh, relevant, and competitive in-feed.
  • Bring ideas to the table and actively participate in ideation, while recognizing that the core value of the role is making the work work through execution and iteration.
  • Collaborate effectively with teammates and cross-functional departments on rapid-fire requests and tight timelines.
  • Attend creative brainstorms, kickoffs, and team meetings, contributing meaningful ideas and helping shape performance-driven strategy.
  • Mentor Creators and, in some cases, Art Directors and Copywriters across the agency — following the leadership of your A/CD to guide best practices in ideation, execution, and performance optimization.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • 3–5 years of professional creative experience, with a demonstrable passion for making content (beauty content) across platforms — social, streaming, AR, music, film, interactive, etc.
  • Proven experience as a video editor, preferably within advertising, digital media, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Photoshop.
  • Extraordinary content creation skills with the ability to execute from start to finish, including video and motion design.
  • Strong understanding of social platform best practices and performance metrics.
  • Responsible, accountable, and a self-starter who demonstrates initiative.
  • Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and foster positive team dynamics.

What you should know about VaynerMedia

Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!

Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us. We can’t wait to meet you.

Navan’s Global Operations and Service (GO&S) organization is looking for a Senior Manager of Client Experience (Pre-Sales Solutions & Scoping) to architect the operational experiences our customers expect of Navan during the earliest stages of the commercial lifecycle. This role transforms the pre-sales operational footprint from a defensive gatekeeper into a proactive commercial driver, injecting elite service presence into active sales deals to win enterprise clients. This individual is a strategic thinker who is comfortable in selling both success and failure, enjoys developing relationships with cross-functional partners, and thrives on aligning internal and external stakeholders on innovative ways of working to deliver successful commercial outcomes and sustainable operational partnerships.

The primary duty of this position is to lead our pre-sales scoping engine, ensuring our stratified service delivery model (Core through Premier) matches our operational capabilities, accurately aligns with regional pricing models, and positions our AI-first capabilities as a core differentiator. This will require working closely with Global Operations, Product, Pricing, and Sales teams to ensure we ruthlessly simplify legacy service offerings into unified packages. Setting realistic expectations with commercial teams and enterprise prospects is critical in this role to eliminate onboarding drag. This role will also directly lead our new GOS "Sales Squad," personally interfacing with prospective customers during complex, late-stage sales cycles to showcase our redefined Five-Star Care and bring them along on the Travel Experience Journey.

In this role, you will work directly with Navan prospects and cross-functional executives to address complex scoping requirements and unique service asks. You will work both pre-emptively and proactively to identify and mitigate potential operational risks before contracts are signed, using a data-backed approach to find innovative operational solutions that protect margins without stalling deals.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead GOS Sales Squad Execution: Personally lead and deploy the GOS "Sales Squad" initiative, embedding operational experts directly into late-stage enterprise sales pitches and RFP responses to leverage our five-star care as a core competitive advantage.
  • Drive Service Tier Unification: Partner with commercial pricing and strategy teams to conduct competitive service analyses, ruthlessly identifying and simplifying fractured, legacy service offerings into unified, high-value packages.
  • Redefine the Service Bar: Partner with Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to translate our streamlined service configurations into value-driven commercial narratives that resonate with C-suite champions and executive assistants.
  • Conduct Strategic Commercial Consultations: Align operational delivery packages with regional pricing structures, ensuring Sales accurately represents our automated AVA capabilities alongside premium human support options.
  • Execute Collaborative Guardrail Enforcement: Maintain a rigorous, data-backed approach to custom scoping requests, working collaboratively with Sales leadership to co-author creative operational solutions that protect margins and scale effectively.

  • Enforce Scoping Integrity: Create process and operational checkpoints within the pre-sales pipeline to eliminate scoping errors, misaligned verbal promises, and premature tier commitments.
  • Standardize Operational Collateral: Partner with Enablement to maintain and publish clean pre-sales operational collateral, capability matrices, and standard SLA decks used during high-visibility customer presentations.
  • Govern Pre-Sales Metrics: Track and report on key operational health indicators for pre-sales deal quality, scoping compliance, and pipeline velocity, utilizing metrics to drive data-backed commercial decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven Operational Background: 5–7+ years of progressive experience in Pre-Sales Solutions, Customer Experience Operations, Commercial Scoping, or Technical Account Management, preferably within SaaS or corporate travel ecosystems.

Facilities Management eXpress is looking for an Engineer Manager to join our team!

At FMX, our Engineering Managers have a direct impact on our product, our people, and our culture. As manager of a Core Team, you’ll coach and mentor a talented group of software engineers, give them clarity on priorities and expectations, and help them grow technically and professionally while delivering high-quality software for our customers. You’ll partner closely with product, design, QA, and other engineering leaders to align your team’s work with business goals and build a healthy, high-performing, inclusive engineering culture.

This is a player-coach role. We want a manager who still loves to build: someone who stays close to the code, picks up bugs and non-mission-critical work alongside the team, and leads by example. You’ll also help shape how FMX builds software in an AI-first world, setting the practices, tools, and standards that help our engineers ship faster without lowering the bar on quality.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and grow your team: Give every engineer clarity on their role, responsibilities, goals, and the team’s processes, and clearly communicate changes to practices, priorities, and expectations. Provide regular coaching, feedback, and career guidance, and advocate for each person’s professional and technical growth.
  • Build a strong culture: Foster trust, accountability, and continuous improvement, where engineers feel valued, heard, and connected to FMX’s mission. Keep the team engaged with challenging, meaningful problems and help them see the customer impact of their work.
  • Clear the path: Actively remove blockers so the team works efficiently with minimal friction.
  • Stay technical: Keep a strong understanding of your team’s systems so you can guide architecture decisions and unblock engineers directly. Champion operational excellence, including observability, CI/CD health, and production readiness.
  • Drive AI-first development: Evaluate, adopt, and set standards for AI-assisted coding, code review, and testing tools.
  • Shape the bigger picture: Contribute to engineering leadership discussions, decisions, and process evolution; partner with product and design leads on priorities and long-term vision; and help hiring teams identify, recruit, and onboard top engineering talent.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

  • 2-4 years of engineering management or technical leadership experience, and prior experience as a software engineer, ideally in SaaS.
  • A builder’s mindset: you still enjoy writing code and will regularly contribute fixes, features, and triage work that isn’t mission-critical.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-first development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, agentic workflows) and a point of view on best practices you can teach others.
  • This role requires working Eastern Time hours to join daily team meetings, so candidates should be based in or able to work on Eastern Time.
  • A proven ability to coach and grow engineers at every career stage, with strong, empathetic, and clear communication.
  • Experience improving engineering processes and development workflows, plus familiarity with agile practices and cross-functional collaboration.
  • The ability to think strategically while attending to the details of day-to-day execution.
  • A passion for building inclusive, psychologically safe teams that value continuous learning and an excellent developer experience.
  • Enthusiasm for FMX’s mission and alignment with our core pillars: Teamwork, Excellence, and Integrity.

Nice to Have:

  • Native mobile experience (Swift or Kotlin)
  • Cloud infrastructure experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform
  • Containerization with Docker
  • CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance
  • Observability (logging, metrics, traces, and alerting) or SIEM experience

Our Tech Stack:

  • .NET / C#
  • React and TypeScript
  • React Native
  • Azure

The Hiring Process:

  • 1. Apply! Submit your resume and brief application questions directly through our Workable portal to get started.
  • 2. PeopleOps Phone Screen (30 min) A introductory conversation to dive into your background, introduce you to FMX culture, and clarify core role expectations. This is also your chance to ask about compensation, benefits, and life at FMX.
  • 3. Hiring Manager Conversation (60 min) An in-depth chat with our Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Come ready to discuss your experience, career goals, and ideal next steps, as well as to ask detailed questions about team dynamics and role expectations.
  • 4. Final Interview (60 min) A panel and peer interview designed to introduce you to key team members and explore technical alignment and collaborative fit.
  • 5. Offer & Onboarding Once an offer is extended, we’ll initiate a standard background check to complete your onboarding process.

Benefits

FMX Benefits & Life at FMX:

  • Make a big impact: You’ll have significant influence over the direction and future of our engineering teams, flagship product and company. We are scaling rapidly and there is a lot of room for advancement.
  • Enjoy a collaborative culture and a close-knit team: We're a team of hard-working, high-fiving, friendly folks. We take collaboration, transparency, continuous improvement, and work/life balance seriously.
  • Get to hire and work with the best: We believe in building high-quality, well-designed products and that requires the best talent. You’ll have the opportunity to work with and grow a highly-talented team.
  • Learn and grow in your role and outside it: At FMX, we’re committed to improving our professional and personal selves. We bring in industry-experts as our advisors, provide leadership training, invest in team-building activities, and have a training budget and incentive program. Our Engineering team also dedicates 10% of their time to learning or working on projects that interest them.
  • Enjoy flexible working hours: Have a dentist appointment at 8:30 AM? Need to tack on an extra 15 minutes at lunch to squeeze in that workout? As long as you're getting your work done then our working hours are flexible.
  • Work from home: At FMX we are remote first, but you’re welcome to use our office as you need. We have two all-company events a year to ensure that you can put a face to that name and establish high-trust relationships with your teammates and co-workers. When you’re in the office, you can take advantage of our free snacks, beverages, and office kegerator.

Company:

While FMX is formally founded and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, on the day-to-day, we like to think of ourselves as headquartered “in the cloud”. We develop a cloud-based, software-as-a-service facility maintenance and management product. FMX serves education, property management, manufacturing, and other markets and is one of the fastest-growing companies in its space. Check us out at:

Sie überzeugen durch Einflussnahme, indem Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams mobilisieren, globale Abstimmung schaffen und Entscheidungen auf Basis von Daten und Kunden-Insights vorantreiben. Dies ist eine hochsichtbare, wirkungsvolle Rolle im Zentrum der strategischen Agenda von TE Industrial.

Stellenanforderungen

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer umfassenden globalen Portfoliostrategie zur nachhaltigen Umsatz- und Margensteigerung in Schlüsselmärkten
  • Identifizierung von Durchbruchmöglichkeiten (neue Anwendungen, Plattformen, Technologien, Geschäftsmodelle und gezielte M&A-Chancen), die die Wettbewerbsposition von TE stärken

  • Leitung von VOC- und Anwendungs-Insight-Programmen zur Entwicklung differenzierter Produktvorschläge und zur Steuerung von Investitionsentscheidungen

  • Übernahme der vollständigen P&L-Verantwortung für globale Produktlinien, Erzielung von überdurchschnittlichem Wachstum durch NPI-Adoption, Kundendesign-Gewinne und Marktanteilssteigerungen in Zielsegmenten
  • Überwachung der Performance im Vergleich zum Jahres- und Langfristplan, Risikomanagement und Schaffung von Wettbewerbsvorteilen durch Produktdifferenzierung, operative Effizienz und strategisches Kostenmanagement

Was Sie mitbringen sollten:

  • 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in Produktmanagement, Strategie, Business Development oder vergleichbaren Bereichen innerhalb der industriellen Technologie oder angrenzender Märkte
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in Portfoliostrategie, Lifecycle-Management, Roadmap-Erstellung und Identifizierung von Produktlücken
  • Erfolgsbilanz bei Umsatzwachstum, Kostenoptimierung und Margenverbesserung
  • Erfahrung in industriellen Märkten bevorzugt (Geräte, Steckverbinder, elektromechanische Komponenten, industrielle Automatisierung etc.)
  • Ausgeprägte finanzielle und quantitative Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Insights abzuleiten und disziplinierte Entscheidungen zu treffen

Kompetenzen

In einer Welt, die sich rasant weiterentwickelt, bleibt TE seinem Leitsatz treu: EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Erfahren Sie mehr auf und auf LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram und X (ehemals Twitter).

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Data Quality / Governance Analyst to support Task 3 data governance, accuracy, and cross-system alignment for a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment.

This role validates data sources, maintains metadata rules and data dictionaries, supports tagging standards, and performs continuous quality checks to ensure accurate reporting, dashboards, and analytics.

The Data Quality / Governance Analyst collaborates closely with Task 2 and Task 3 reporting teams, dashboard developers, data owners, and PMO leadership to maintain consistent, reliable, and governable enterprise data.

This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Validate Task 3 data sources and assess accuracy, completeness, and reliability.
  • Maintain data dictionaries, metadata rules, tagging standards, and classification definitions.
  • Ensure consistency of KPIs, metrics, and datasets across Tasks 2 and 3.
  • Perform data reconciliation, profiling, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Support cross-task data harmonization and integration workflows.
  • Identify data anomalies, gaps, or inconsistencies and recommend remediation steps.
  • Collaborate with dashboard teams, analysts, and system owners to align data definitions.
  • Maintain documentation for data governance processes, metadata rules, and data lineage.
  • Track source system changes, schema updates, and data dependency impacts.
  • Support adherence to federal data governance standards and reporting requirements.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of dashboard specifications, metric definitions, and reporting standardization under Data COE-owned standards.

Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in data governance, data quality, metadata management, or a directly related data management discipline.
  • Experience maintaining data dictionaries, metadata rules, and standardized data fields.
  • Experience performing data validation, profiling, or cleansing.
  • Demonstrated experience reconciling conflicting metrics across independent source systems, including diagnosing differences in definition, population/filter logic, refresh timing, and transformation logic.
  • Experience supporting cross-team or cross-system data harmonization efforts.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Analytical and problem-solving ability, particularly in diagnosing the root cause of data discrepancies.
  • Clear written communication, including the ability to produce standards documentation, data dictionary entries, and remediation write-ups that non-technical stakeholders can act on.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Understanding of data governance frameworks, data quality principles, and metadata standards.
  • Proficiency with Excel, SQL, or similar tools for data validation and analysis.
  • Familiarity with KPI frameworks and structured metric definitions.
  • Working knowledge of PII handling and Privacy Act requirements as applied to reporting, including aggregation practices and small-cell suppression thresholds for sensitive population data.

Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Experience with Power BI, including Power Query/M and DAX; Tableau, Grafana, or similar BI tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms or ETL/ELT tools.
  • Familiarity with data catalog or governance tooling.
  • Familiarity with the DoD Data Strategy (VAULTIS).

Certifications (preferred)

  • ITIL v4 Foundation
  • Data governance or data management certifications

  • Familiarity with lead qualification and pipeline management.

jobs.title: Director, General Liability Pricing Analytics - REMOTE
jobs.excerpt: As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless!
jobs.description:
As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Director, General Liability Pricing Analytics

The Role

In this position, you will work at the intersection of predictive analytics, actuarial thinking, and pricing strategy. You will partner closely with teammates and business partners to build, enhance, and refine models that support general liability insurance pricing. You will also have the opportunity to work across a variety of projects, expand your technical toolkit, and deepen your understanding of how modeling drives real business outcomes.

As Director, General Liability Pricing Analytics, you will serve as the senior technical leader for General Liability pricing data science and price modeling. You will lead the development, enhancement and implementation of pricing models and data science solutions that support profitable growth, competitive market position and sound underwriting decisions.

This is a hands-on people leadership role with direct reports. You will combine deep expertise in actuarial, statistical and predictive modeling with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for Actuaries, Underwriting, Product, Claims, Finance and senior business leaders. You will guide and develop analytical professionals, including direct reports, lead complex work across functions and help establish consistent standards for model quality, documentation, validation and use.

Key Responsibilities

Technical and Model Leadership

  • Set technical direction for General Liability pricing strategy, segmentation, rating analysis, portfolio insights and model delivery.

  • Lead the research, development, implementation and monitoring of advanced statistical, actuarial, predictive and risk models.

  • Explore and pilot emerging AI tools and advanced statistical methods to improve General Liability price modeling and analytical workflows, while maintaining appropriate standards for governance, validation, explainability and production readiness.

  • Evaluate data, assumptions, methodologies and model outputs; identify limitations or unreasonable results and recommend corrective actions.

  • Own model governance standards covering validation, documentation, reproducibility, implementation readiness and business continuity.

Business Partnership and Decision Support

  • Translate underwriting and business needs into clear analytical questions, recommendations and delivery plans.

  • Partner with Actuaries, Underwriting, Product, Claims, Finance, Data, Analytics, and Technology teams to ensure analytical solutions are understood and applied effectively.

  • Convert complex findings into concise recommendations and decision materials for technical, non-technical and senior leadership audiences.

  • Advise on products, data needs, rating approaches, implementation implications and opportunities to improve profitability and underwriting decisions.

Delivery and Continuous Improvement

  • Lead complex projects, cross-functional reviews and working sessions that align stakeholders around priorities, tradeoffs and actions.

  • Manage scope, timelines, resources and delivery quality across assigned work.

  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, analytical processes, technology enablement and model delivery practices.

  • Represent Nationwide in governance forums and with auditors, regulators, vendors or industry groups, as appropriate.

Talent and Team Leadership

  • Coach and develop analytical talent through technical guidance, peer review, training, career development and feedback.

  • Lead the day-to-day people management of direct reports, including hiring, performance management, talent planning, resource alignment and career development.

  • Perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Typically, seven or more years of experience in actuarial, statistical, predictive modeling, risk analytics, pricing analytics or a related quantitative discipline.

  • Experience leading complex projects, setting analytical direction and delivering results across business functions.

  • Graduate or PhD degree in actuarial science, statistics, mathematics, data science, economics, finance, engineering or a related quantitative field; graduate study preferred.

Technical Expertise

  • Experience developing, validating, implementing or monitoring complex models used to support business decisions.

  • Strong understanding of statistical inference, predictive modeling, model diagnostics, data quality, assumptions and model limitations.

  • Working knowledge of commercial property and casualty insurance; General Liability pricing, underwriting or portfolio experience strongly preferred.

  • Proficiency in Python and GitHub-based version control, along with experience using cloud-based analytics, model development, or deployment platforms such as Databricks, SageMaker, or comparable tools.

  • Demonstrated experience taking a model from development through production deployment, testing, documentation, monitoring, and post-deployment validation.

Leadership and Professional Effectiveness

  • Sound judgment in ambiguous business situations, with the ability to develop practical, well-supported recommendations.

  • Ability to communicate sophisticated technical concepts in clear business language and influence technical and non-technical partners.

  • Demonstrated commitment to Nationwide Values and Guiding Behaviors.

Preferred Qualifications

Insurance and Actuarial Depth

  • Associate or Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society, or meaningful progress toward an actuarial designation.

  • Experience with commercial insurance pricing, loss-cost analysis, frequency and severity modeling, segmentation, indication analysis, rate implementation or portfolio monitoring.

Advanced Modeling and Governance

  • Experience applying machine learning, generalized linear models, credibility methods, stochastic techniques or other advanced quantitative methods to insurance problems.

  • Experience with model governance, peer review, independent validation, regulatory support or audit response.

Business Impact and People Leadership

  • Experience translating model output into underwriting actions, pricing recommendations and measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience directly managing and developing actuaries, data scientists, analytic scientists or pricing professionals.

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will be a technically credible, business-oriented leader who:

  • Brings curiosity, rigor and sound judgment to complex pricing and risk questions.

  • Connects analytical work to underwriting decisions, customer outcomes, profitability and enterprise strategy.

  • Creates clarity when objectives, data or stakeholder perspectives are competing or incomplete.

  • Raises the quality of analytical work through thoughtful challenge, peer review and disciplined documentation.

  • Develops people while maintaining high standards for accountability, collaboration and delivery.

  • Builds durable partnerships and communicates with confidence at all levels of the organization.

Job Conditions

This role can be staffed fully remote.

Job Description Summary

Do you have the desire to play a critical role in driving data-based business outcomes? At Nationwide, our Analytic Scientists are responsible for modeling complex problems, discovering insights and identifying business opportunities using scientific research methods, statistics, machine learning, and data visualization techniques. They participate in all phases of the analytic lifecycle, from research design, data collection and data processing to model building, deployment, and presentation of results. We value a dedication to lifelong learning and strong quantitative judgment. If you are a methodological generalist who is adept at applying your technical skill set to a wide range of business applications, we want to know more about you!

As a Director, you’ll lead a team of Analytic Scientists and work directly with business partners to define project scope and build solutions. We’ll count on you to structure and lead large, complex analyses across one or more business areas and effectively synthesize analytic results to improve business outcomes. You’ll build lasting business relationships across and help business leaders navigate complex, competing objectives. You’ll be a subject matter authority, in both analytical and business applications, and will communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences. Your proficiency with advanced statistical and machine learning techniques will help you direct the application of these techniques to solve complex problems.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Leads a team that works on a wide array of statistical and machine learning projects across the enterprise.

  • Collaborates with business partners to build consensus around problems of broad scope and business impact. Guides the research, analysis, implementation and monitoring of modeling methodology to solve those problems.

  • Upholds a high standard for methodological rigor, sound statistical inference and robust model validation.

  • Plans and manages the execution of analytic work including defining project scope, schedule, resource requirements and delivery timelines.

  • Collaborates with multiple departments or business functions to accomplish management goals, objectives and tasks.

  • Communicates technical work to leadership.

  • Demonstrates knowledge of a wide array of business practices and business knowledge. Applies knowledge to direct projects that provide creative solutions to complex business problems.

  • Directs associate management, including performance management, salary planning and administration, training and development, workflow and organizational planning, hiring and placement, and disciplinary actions.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Associate Vice President, Vice President. Manages a team of 4 or more associates responsible for creating a high-performance, business-focused team. Ensures that team members at all levels are supported with career development, succession planning, performance management, etc.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Preferred undergraduate or graduate studies in statistics, engineering, math, quantitative social science fields, or related areas. Experience building and deploying machine learning and/or statistical models or executing quantitative research studies may be considered in lieu of formal education.

Experience: Typically, 10 or more years of related work experience in a relevant field.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills:
Quantitative judgment: Demonstrated knowledge of building and deploying machine learning and/or statistical models.

Research methods: Knowledge of multiple quantitative research and analysis approaches and their tradeoffs.

Strong project management skills and the ability to handle multiple large projects simultaneously.

Advanced written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate technical concepts to all levels of leaders and associates.

Seeks and objectively considers input from appropriate sources. Considers implications of actions on other areas, people, and processes when making decisions.

Drives decisions, projects, and processes without formal authority. Works directly with a variety of people to create broad acceptance for proposed innovations and changes.

Implements changes which improve business processes. Anticipates and responds to changing situations, needs and expectations.

Able to handle large and complex engagements focused on broader business activities.

Ability to lead key relationships and act independently.

Programming ability: Python, R, SQL, or any other transferrable language (MATLAB, Java, etc.).

Passion, inquisitiveness, creativity, self-starters and team builders.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the Vice President and HR Vice President.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Exempt (Not Eligible)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment

Job Title: Senior Full Stack Engineer

Location: Remote

Reports to: Program Manager

FLSA Status: Exempt

A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens or legal permanent residents. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident to qualify.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a capable and mission-focused Senior Full Stack Engineer to support the deployment, configuration, integration, and ongoing operation of HUD’s data infrastructure, including Databricks, within HUD’s enterprise environment. This hands-on engineering role will work alongside cloud, data, security, and DevSecOps teams to establish secure and repeatable data, analytics, and AI/ML infrastructure to enable modern data engineering and governance. The ideal candidate combines practical Databricks deployment and operations experience with cloud engineering, automation, and troubleshooting skills and is comfortable learning and working across multiple technologies in a dynamic federal environment. As a senior member of the team, this individual will also work directly with HUD stakeholders, help guide technical approaches, and provide technical leadership to other engineers.

Compensation & Benefits:

Starting Salary Range for Senior Full Stack Engineer: $140,000 – $160,000

Benefits That Set Us Apart

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights include:

  • Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security
  • Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage
  • Basic life and AD&D insurance, with supplemental life options
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage

•Paid holidays

•Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
  • Professional development, training, and certification support
  • Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.

Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities:

Includes the following:

  • Deploy, configure, and support enterprise data platform workspaces and associated cloud infrastructure.
  • Configure compute, storage, identity, access controls, Unity Catalog, and related platform services.
  • Automate deployments and configuration using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), scripting, APIs, and CI/CD tools.
  • Integrate data platform with enterprise data sources, cloud services, security capabilities, and development tools.
  • Support data engineering workloads, ingestion pipelines, and Databricks-based applications.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve platform, integration, performance, and access issues.
  • Collaborate with data, cloud, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, and application teams to implement secure and reliable solutions.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, and operational guidance.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

No supervisory/management authority

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 10+ years of relevant cloud, data engineering, platform engineering, or DevOps experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks deployments and operations.
  • Experience working with AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD tools and practices.
  • Working knowledge of Python, SQL, and/or scripting languages.
  • Understanding of cloud networking, identity and access management, security, and data integration concepts.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaborative problem-solving skills.

•Must be a US Citizen.

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; may occasionally require standing or moving about the office for extended periods.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Remote but desire someone in the Greater Washington DC Metro area or Huntsville, AL to support on-site meetings with the client as needed.
  • Databricks or relevant cloud certification.
  • Experience with Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, and Databricks automation tools.
  • Experience with enterprise data pipelines, data governance, or modern lakehouse architectures.
  • Familiarity with federal cybersecurity requirements, including NIST, FedRAMP, or RMF.
  • Experience supporting federal government technology environments.

Work Environment:

Work is performed primarily in a climate-controlled environment.

Company Information:

Behind every government mission stands skilled, mission-driven talent: people whose expertise and dedication turn complex challenges into successful outcomes. Cherokee Nation Businesses Corp - CFED, part of Cherokee Federal, the federal contracting division of Cherokee Nation Businesses, is that team. We modernize aging systems, deliver care where it’s needed most, and keep missions supplied, staffed, and moving across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies. For more than 60 federal clients, we take on the work others won’t, and deliver where it counts. If that’s the kind of work you’re looking for, you’ve found your team. Learn more at cherokee-federal.com.

#CherokeeFederal

Cherokee Federal is a military friendly employer. Veterans and active military transitioning to civilian status are encouraged to apply.

Legal Disclaimer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected veteran status, disability or any other status protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

Many of our job openings require access to government buildings or military installations. Candidates must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

For applicants located in Colorado, New York, California, Washington, Illinois, Hawaii, Massachusetts, or other states with pay transparency requirements: the estimated annual salary range for this position is $140,000 – $160,000. Actual compensation varies based on qualifications, experience, and location.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD101582

Position Overview 

Autodesk is strengthening its M&A HR capability to support disciplined growth, speed to integrate, and positive employee experience through change. The M&A Total Rewards Partner plays a critical role in supporting Total Rewards activities across the deal lifecycle, from diligence through close and post-close integration, by helping evaluate, advise on, and execute compensation and rewards decisions.

This trusted M&A TR advisor partners closely with Corporate Development, Finance, Legal, People Business Partners (PBPs), and People & Places leadership to assess workforce impacts, identify people related risks, and support informed, market aligned rewards decisions. You translate fast-moving and ambiguous deal inputs into clear, pragmatic recommendations that balance internal equity, external market competitiveness, cost, and employee experience.

Responsibilities

Deal Lifecycle Support

· Support end-to-end Total Rewards activities across M&A transactions, including due diligence, integration planning, deal modeling, close execution, and post-close integration

· Evaluate target company compensation structures, incentive plans, equity programs, and benefits positioning to identify risks, gaps, and integration considerations

· Partner with Finance and Corporate Development to support cost modeling, synergy assumptions, and people related deal risks

· Support communications and enablement related to compensation, benefits, retention programs, and other Total Rewards changes throughout the transaction lifecycle

Total Rewards & Market Analysis

· Conduct job and level mapping using Autodesk job architecture and market data

· Analyze internal and external market positioning to inform pay alignment, equity conversion, and retention recommendations

· Develop compensation, equity, and retention recommendations for executives and key talent populations where retention or leadership continuity is critical

· Assess target company benefits, identify gaps vs. company programs, and execute compliant, cost-effective transition and harmonization plans

· Support the design of transition, retention, and harmonization approaches consistent with Autodesk Total Rewards principles

Advisory & Stakeholder Partnership

· Partner with PBPs, Legal, and business leaders to surface implications, tradeoffs, and recommended paths forward

· Prepare clear, decision-ready materials that summarize options, risks, and financial impact for leadership review

· Apply established governance and approval frameworks consistently across transactions

Execution & Integration

· Support or lead execution of approved Total Rewards actions in Workday and downstream systems

· Support cross-functional planning and coordination to ensure Total Rewards deliverables, dependencies, and milestones remain on track throughout the transaction lifecycle

· Coordinate closely with HR Operations, Payroll, and related teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation

· Contribute to continuous improvement of M&A Total Rewards playbooks, tools, and templates based on deal learnings

· Provide project management support for Total Rewards activities across the M&A lifecycle, ensuring seamless execution and issue resolution

Broader Compensation Support

During periods of low M&A activity, this role is expected to flex across other Compensation functions, including:

  • Support Executive Compensation activities, including equity modeling and forecasting, peer group proxy data analysis, and preparation of Compensation Committee materials
  • Contribute to broad-based compensation activities, including benchmarking and retention analysis, and support annual compensation planning cycles

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, and/or M&A related HR work
  • 5+ years of experience supporting M&A transactions, integration, compensation, or workforce-related initiatives
  • Strong analytical capability, including compensation modeling and market data interpretation
  • Working knowledge of job architecture, leveling, and market pricing principles
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with discretion and handle highly confidential information
  • Comfort working in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments with shifting priorities and tight timelines
  • Strong cross-functional communication / presentation skills with business leaders

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Exposure to global compensation practices or multi-country integrations
  • Expertise in total rewards programs including employee benefits, with demonstrated experience in M&A integration, gap analysis, and program harmonization
  • Experience partnering with Corporate Development, Finance, or Legal teams

jobs.description:
About Inchcape Shipping Services

At Inchcape, our vision is to have a connected world, in which our customers trade successfully and make better decisions in every port, everywhere. We use technology and our global network to help our partners connect to a smoother, smarter ocean.

Inchcape combines its worldwide infrastructure with local expertise through our global network of over 250 proprietary offices, across 70 countries and a team of more than 3,000 committed professionals. Our diverse global customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors as well as naval, government and intergovernmental organizations.

We have an ambitious growth model and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry.

Note: This role is on a contract basis & the duration of contract will be 3-4 months .It can be extendable as per the business need.

Main Purpose of Job

The Senior Data Engineer designs, builds and maintains the data ingestion and transformation pipelines that populate Inchcape’s central data platforms. This role ingests raw data from diverse systems, curates the bronze and silver layers of the medallion architecture, ensures data quality and performance, and delivers reliable, reusable datasets for modelling, analysis, reporting and BI.

Key Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from ERP, CRM, operational, financial, and third‑party sources into the Microsoft Fabric Platform - Lakehouse (OneLake) using Delta Lake/Parquet.
  • Implement data quality standards and controls, incremental loading, CDC and error handling to ensure reliability and correctness.
  • Create bronze tables, curated Silver and gold tables by transforming, cleansing and conforming raw data, document lineage and transformations.
  • Optimise performance through partitioning, clustering and tuning of MS Fabric, SQL and Spark workloads, monitor pipeline health and costs.
  • Collaborate with Data Architects, Modellers and Data BAs to design schemas, naming conventions and integration patterns to ensure business self-service enablement through Gold data.
  • Build reusable components, templates and automation scripts using Fabric Dataflows Gen2, Spark notebooks or equivalent tools.
  • Maintain metadata and sensitivity labels via Purview, ensure proper access controls and compliance.
  • Research and evaluate new features and patterns in Microsoft Fabric and make recommendations for adoption, enabling an AI-driven data strategy.
  • Introduce the most economic, optimised technique in the data integration space to reduce total operational cost.
  • Ensure NFR requirements like resilience, availability and security standards are applied as per agreed NFR metrics.

Key Deliverables

  • Automated, documented ingestion pipelines with monitoring and alerting.
  • High‑quality conforming bronze, silver and gold data assets that are ready for self-service.
  • Performance benchmarks and tuning reports demonstrating efficient resource usage.
  • Contribution to ingestion templates, best practice guides and knowledge sharing.
  • Low-Level Designs for data pipelines and other data integration-related assets.

Essential

  • 8+ years in data engineering or data integration roles, working with SQL, Python and or Scala.
  • Experience of ETL/ELT patterns, CDC, incremental loading and data warehousing principles using Microsoft Fabric.
  • Practical experience with Delta Lake, Lakehouse/Medallion architecture and cloud data platforms (Azure and AWS).
  • Proficient in building pipelines with tools like MS Fabric Dataflows Gen2, Spark/SQL notebooks or equivalent.
  • Experienced in data quality frameworks and monitoring/observability tools.
  • Ability to collaborate across teams and communicate technical concepts to non‑engineers.

Desirable

  • Experience with streaming data (Kafka, Event Hubs) or real‑time ingestion.
  • Knowledge of master data management and data governance practices.
  • Familiarity with version control and CI/CD for data pipelines.
  • Experience in, and assisted in, the implementation of governance, controls, and standards.
  • Any Shipping or Maritime experience
  • Big Data Ecosystem prior experience is a plus.

Educational & Professional Qualification:

Essential

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline.
  • Certification in Azure Data Engineering is a MUST.

Desirable

  • Certifications in AWS cloud data platform or other data platform.

Plus much more!

Why Inchcape Shipping Services?

We believe in building a diverse and high-performing workforce that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards, we depend on our people, their welfare, training, and expertise. We realize the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills, and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry.

Our values are at the centre of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these:

Global Perspective - We connect the world and see the bigger picture.
The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships.
Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry.

Inchcape is an Equal Opportunities Employer - equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of everything we do. Working in a diverse society, we recognise that our customers, colleagues, and contractors are central to our success.

Additional Information:

Appointment to this role will be subject to satisfactory references and possession of a valid Right to Work documentation, depending upon your geographical location.

To protect the interests of all parties, Inchcape will not accept unsolicited or speculative resumes from recruitment agencies and will not be responsible for any fees associated with them.
