Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About usMoneyhub empowers leading financial services organisations to understand their clients’ needs better.
jobs.description:
About us

Moneyhub empowers leading financial services organisations to understand their clients’ needs better. We provide the data services and embedded technologies required to deliver highly personalised, lifelong financial relationships.

We are a data and payments company building ISO 27001-certified software for Open Banking, Open Finance, and Open Data. Our FCA-regulated platform lets organisations turn financial data into personalised digital experiences and initiate payments and hundreds of organisations across finance, media and retail rely on it.

The role

We are seeking an experienced engineer who has built things people actually use and still wants to write the code.

You will have taken products from nothing to real users, more than once and seen what happens to them afterwards. We will ask what you shipped, who used it and what you did yourself. We mean end users, not just other engineers.

Scale and performance matter here - clients notice when things are slow. You know how to find the bottleneck rather than guess at it. You are comfortable reading a flame chart and you will follow a problem down as far as it goes, whether that is a React component re-rendering because of a misused useEffect or cache locality in the hot path of an algorithm.

You will have seen approaches fail in different companies and codebases and you know why. People will want your view before they start something and you will have influenced what a team builds without being their manager.

You also need to be using agentic engineering already and treating it as a multiplier. One good engineer can now take on work that used to need a team. We want to hear your opinions and your approach.

What you would work on

In your first 6–12 months, you might:

  • Ship a committed piece of work to production in your first three months, and come out of it with two or three platform improvements you think we should take on next.
  • Take a project of your own from prototype to production, such as redesigning part of an event processing or data pipeline so it handles more load, more reliably.
  • Set the standard for agentic engineering: show the team the workflows that work for you, and turn them into patterns other teams adopt.

Success in this role looks like a steady record of shipped work, with at least two of your architectural patterns or AI standards in use across engineering.

How you would work

You would join our experienced engineering team - we are about 40 software/platform/data engineers and data scientists. We use Shape Up, and you would work within it: shaping bets, delivering committed work, and getting things over the line with the teams.

Our culture is based on trust, and we empower people to deliver in the way that suits them best. For this role, that means real say over how you solve problems and some latitude over what you pick up, alongside the expectation that your work is visible, shared with your colleagues and pointed at what the business needs. In practice, you might have a committed bet, something you are improving because it needs it, and something you are exploring for a future cycle. Judging which deserves your time, and being open about it, is a big part of the job.

This is an individual contributor role. No line management, and no moving away from the code.

Our stack

Most of our platform is TypeScript on Node. Python is used across data science and machine learning. We use Kafka for events, Postgres for most of our data, and Kubernetes on AWS to run it all.

We want someone comfortable across data science, Python, Node, React and Rust. You do not need to be an expert in each, but none of them should put you off. If you have not used a language before, we expect you to pick it up.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • Experience at several startups and on systems at real scale, shipping software that people actually used
  • A track record of building and running software in production across different companies and codebases, including the unglamorous years after launch
  • The person others turn to when something is hard or has gone wrong, with experience setting technical direction without authority over the people doing the work
  • A habit of finding where a system slows down under real load, working out why and fixing it, using profilers and flame charts rather than guesswork. Equally at home with a front-end rendering problem or the memory behaviour of a tight loop
  • Comfort across Python, Node, React, Rust and data science. Not an expert in each, but none of them a worry
  • The ability to work properly with data scientists. No need to be one, but an understanding of how to judge a model (precision, recall and F1 score) and what the numbers mean for the product and for clients
  • Still hands-on, with every intention of staying that way
  • Already using agentic tools day to day and getting more done because of them
  • An eye for work worth doing and the drive to make the case for it rather than wait for a brief
  • Sound judgement on security, privacy and client trust. This is regulated financial software
  • Clear communication, whether with engineers, senior stakeholders or clients

Nice to have: experience with open banking, connections or identity systems.

Probably not a fit if

  • You cannot point to software that end users used, or to technical decisions of yours that people followed.
  • You want to stay in one language, or only the front end or the back end.
  • You are unsure about agentic engineering, or see it as a shortcut.
  • You only want a defined set of tickets.
  • You would rather work outside a team process than within one.
  • You want a management role, or architecture at a distance from the codebase.

How to apply

Apply via the link below.

Questions about the role? Please contact Dilshan Rukunayake, Principal TA Partner,

Right to work and screening

You must have the right to work in the UK. As an FCA-regulated firm, offers are subject to pre-employment screening, including reference, credit and criminal record checks.

Benefits

  • 5% employer pension contribution from your first day, with a 3% employee contribution
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, rising to 30 days after two years
  • Option to take UK bank holidays at other times, on days of significance to you

jobs.title: Senior Responsable de projets transverses Platform Engineering
jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilitésLa division Platform Engineering met à disposition des équipes de développement des plateformes, produits et services mutualisés afin d'accélérer la livraison des applications, tout en garantissant la sécurité, la standardisation et l'efficacité opérationnelle.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

La division Platform Engineering met à disposition des équipes de développement des plateformes, produits et services mutualisés afin d'accélérer la livraison des applications, tout en garantissant la sécurité, la standardisation et l'efficacité opérationnelle.

Le périmètre couvre notamment le Community Cloud et le Public Cloud, le CI/CD et la Software Factory, les bases de données et le DBaaS, les technologies middleware comme l'API Gateway, le messaging, le load balancing, le routing et le WAF, ainsi qu'une plateforme d'observability et des outils destinés aux développeurs.

Dans ce rôle, vous prenez en charge des projets et programmes stratégiques impliquant plusieurs équipes de Platform Engineering. Vous coordonnez les équipes techniques, les responsables de service, les architectes et le management afin d'assurer la cohérence des initiatives, leur alignement avec les priorités de la division et une visibilité claire sur leur avancement.

  • Piloter des projets transversaux complexes impliquant plusieurs équipes
  • Coordonner les dépendances et les contributions des différentes parties prenantes
  • Assurer le suivi des plannings, des risques, des actions et des décisions
  • Préparer les reportings à destination du management
  • Contribuer à la définition et au suivi des feuilles de route
  • Faciliter la communication entre les équipes et avec les clients internes
  • Veiller à l'alignement des initiatives avec la stratégie de la division

Projets prioritaires

Sécurité des plateformes

Vous pilotez une feuille de route sécurité commune à l'ensemble des plateformes de la division, de la définition à l'exécution, afin d'harmoniser les pratiques et d'accélérer l'adoption des standards.

Les thèmes principaux incluent la gestion des secrets avec Vault, la gestion des identités, des accès et des privilèges, le chiffrement des données et des communications, la gestion des certificats, l'auditabilité, les bonnes pratiques de sécurité, ainsi que les frameworks de sécurité tels que CyFun, ISO 27001, NIST CSF et CIS Controls, avec réalisation de gap-analyses.

Adoption du Public Cloud

Vous accompagnez la transition vers le Public Cloud en coordonnant les initiatives interéquipes.

  • Suivre l'onboarding des équipes
  • Assurer la cohérence des choix techniques et d'architecture cloud
  • Identifier les besoins d'accompagnement et de formation
  • Consolider les impacts organisationnels, techniques et opérationnels

Programme CI/CD

Vous pilotez le programme CI/CD avec les responsables techniques et les architectes, suivez son avancement et favorisez l'adoption de pratiques de développement modernes, y compris l'automatisation de build et de déploiement avec des outils tels que Jenkins.

Renforcer l'autonomie des Business Units

Vous coordonnez et priorisez les évolutions qui renforcent l'autonomie des équipes de développement, tout en garantissant la visibilité de l'avancement et le respect des standards, de la gouvernance et des plateformes partagées.

Gestion du portefeuille de services de plateforme

Vous contribuez à structurer et à piloter le portefeuille de services de plateforme de la division.

  • Suivi des roadmaps
  • Coordination des dépendances
  • Visibilité consolidée des initiatives
  • Amélioration de la communication vers les clients internes
  • Alignement des projets avec la stratégie de la division
  • Suivi des SLA lorsque cela s'applique

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée en gestion de projets complexes ou de programmes transversaux dans un environnement IT.

  • Capacité à travailler avec des équipes techniques multidisciplinaires
  • Excellentes compétences en coordination, en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes
  • Bonne compréhension des environnements cloud, des plateformes, du DevOps, des infrastructures, des bases de données et des technologies middleware
  • Capacité à structurer, prioriser et faire progresser plusieurs initiatives en parallèle
  • Autonomie, esprit d'initiative et orientation résultats
  • Maîtrise de Jira et Confluence
  • Bonne connaissance d'Agile, d'ITIL et de PRINCE2
  • Expérience avec l'API Gateway, le CI/CD, les outils de build automation comme Jenkins, ainsi que les environnements cloud et conteneurisés tels que Kubernetes, OpenShift, AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud
  • Compréhension des enjeux liés à la gestion des identités, des secrets et des certificats, au Privileged Access Management, au Vault Secret Store et aux bonnes pratiques de sécurité
  • Connaissance du pilotage de portefeuille et du project management appliqués à des services de plateforme
  • Français ou néerlandais avec une connaissance active de l'autre langue nationale, ainsi qu'une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais

Candidature

Le CV doit inclure une synthèse concise des principes et bonnes pratiques appliqués à la réussite du pilotage de projets techniques.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

jobs.title: FinOps Specialist – Databricks and Cloud
jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryScicom Infrastructure Services is seeking aFinOps Specialistto manage cost visibility, forecasting, financial governance, and optimization for a large-scale Databricks and cloud data platform.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Scicom Infrastructure Services is seeking aFinOps Specialistto manage cost visibility, forecasting, financial governance, and optimization for a large-scale Databricks and cloud data platform.

This role will partner with engineering, operations, finance, procurement, and program leadership to monitor cloud consumption, identify savings opportunities, improve cost allocation, and ensure platform spending remains aligned with project and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyze Databricks and cloud spending across workspaces, projects, teams, environments, and workloads.
  • Track Databricks compute usage, SQL warehouses, jobs, storage, networking, and related cloud services.
  • Identify idle, oversized, underutilized, or inefficient resources.
  • Recommend improvements involving cluster sizing, autoscaling, job scheduling, serverless compute, storage, and workload design.
  • Develop monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets and forecasts.
  • Compare actual costs against budgets and investigate significant variances.
  • Create cost-allocation models by client, project, contract, cost center, team, or data product.
  • Support showback, chargeback, tagging, and resource-ownership standards.
  • Build dashboards and reports covering spend, trends, forecasts, anomalies, savings, and commitment utilization.
  • Configure budgets, thresholds, alerts, and financial guardrails.
  • Review Databricks and cloud invoices for accuracy and reconcile charges against usage and contract terms.
  • Evaluate reserved capacity, savings plans, committed-use discounts, and enterprise agreements.
  • Maintain a register of optimization opportunities and track realized savings.
  • Provide financial estimates for new workloads, migrations, proposals, and architectural changes.
  • Help technical teams understand the financial impact of platform and engineering decisions.
  • Support development of FinOps policies, procedures, and cost-aware engineering practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, information technology, data analytics, or a related field.
  • At least five years of experience in FinOps, cloud financial management, technology finance, or cloud cost optimization.
  • Experience analyzing Databricks or other cloud data-platform costs.
  • Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud pricing, billing, and cost-management tools.
  • Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, cost allocation, and optimization.
  • Experience with showback, chargeback, tagging, invoice reconciliation, and commitment management.
  • Strong Excel or financial-modeling skills.
  • Ability to translate technical usage data into clear financial recommendations.
  • Strong analytical, communication, reporting, and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Professional.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks billing data, system tables, cluster policies, SQL warehouses, and serverless compute.
  • Experience with Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, Google Cloud Billing, Cloudability, CloudHealth, Flexera, Finout, or similar tools.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, or Databricks SQL.
  • Familiarity with data engineering, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Terraform, and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience supporting large enterprise, consulting, government, or regulated programs.
  • Cloud or Databricks certification.

jobs.excerpt: We Move Fast, Think on Our Feet, and Have Fun Doing It!
jobs.description:
We Move Fast, Think on Our Feet, and Have Fun Doing It!

At Eleven, we thrive on solving complex challenges and pushing boundaries. We work at a rapid pace, embracing change, and staying laser-focused on delivering exceptional value to our customers.

We’re looking for visionary problem-solvers who excel in dynamic environments, embrace AI tools in streamlining work processes, adapt quickly, and drive innovation. If you love thinking outside the box, collaborating with top-tier talent, and having fun while making an impact—let’s talk!

Position Overview:

This role is a dual-focus technical leadership position within our Engineering organization: leading company-wide AI productivity initiatives and contributing as a senior software engineer to our core product. You will design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and tools that accelerate delivery and raise quality across engineering and other departments. You will develop and execute training strategies that bring all employees along in adopting AI effectively and securely. This role contributes to a globally distributed SaaS platform used around the world to effortlessly and securely connect guests and residents (and all their devices) to the internet with an at-home Wi-Fi experience. Our platform serves a variety of markets. From hotels and multi-family residences to campgrounds and college campuses, every day, tens of millions of people benefit from the services we provide.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will stay at the cutting edge of AI technology, evaluate and introduce new tools and patterns to the organization, champion security-first practices in a rapidly evolving AI landscape, and continue to contribute hands-on to the development of our cloud-native platform.

Reporting Relationships:

This role reports to a Senior Engineering Manager and has no direct reports. Provides AI and technical leadership across all engineering teams and partners with other departments on AI adoption initiatives.

Essential Job Functions & Core Responsibilities:

AI Leadership & Productivity

  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows, tools, and automation that improve productivity, code quality, and operational efficiency across engineering and other departments
  • Evaluate, prototype, and introduce cutting-edge AI technologies, frameworks, and patterns (including agentic AI, LLM orchestration, and multi-step reasoning) into company workflows
  • Develop and execute AI training strategies and enablement programs for employees across the organization, ensuring teams can effectively and responsibly adopt AI tools
  • Establish and maintain security guardrails, governance policies, and best practices for AI usage company-wide, accounting for the rapidly evolving threat and compliance landscape
  • Stay continuously informed on advancements in AI/ML tooling, foundation models, and development practices—serving as the organization's subject matter expert and go-to resource
  • Manage AI-related vendor and tech partner relationships, evaluating tools and platforms for fit, security, and cost-effectiveness

Core Product Engineering

  • Architect, design, and implement scalable, secure cloud-native solutions on AWS that handle high transaction volumes across multi-tenant environments
  • Work closely with the lead architect and other principal and senior engineers to lead technical strategy and provide architectural guidance across multiple engineering teams and projects
  • Champion security-first development practices, ensuring sensitive data handling meets compliance and industry standards across all services
  • Drive end-to-end solution ownership—from requirements and architecture through implementation, deployment, and operational excellence
  • Mentor and develop engineers at all levels, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and innovation
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives and projects, collaborating with product management, UX, and engineering leadership to deliver business outcomes
  • Design and maintain event-driven, serverless architectures using AWS services (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge, API Gateway, Step Functions, etc.)
  • Establish and evolve engineering standards, patterns, and best practices that scale with the organization
  • Identify and incorporate security requirements throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Lead software and infrastructure optimization efforts that translate directly into reduced cloud spend and operational costs
  • Work within Agile methodology with two-week sprints
  • Participate in on-call rotation
  • Other duties as assigned

Working Conditions:

This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and printers. This job operates remotely, in a home office environment, with occasional travel for team meetings or company offsites.

Physical Demands:

Remains in a stationary position for extended periods of time. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, cell phones, computer mouse and computer monitor. For remote office setup; places, moves, installs, replaces and hooks up technology equipment that may weigh up to 20 pounds. Communicates complex information effectively to clients and co-workers via telephone, video, or email.

Candidate Requirements

Must Have:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • 3+ with demonstrated leadership in AI adoption and tooling
  • Proven hands-on experience building AI-powered workflows, developer tools, or automation systems that delivered measurable productivity gains across teams or organizations
  • Deep understanding of the current AI/ML landscape—foundation models, agentic AI patterns, LLM orchestration, tool use, and multi-step reasoning—with the ability to translate rapidly evolving capabilities into practical, secure solutions
  • Experience developing and delivering AI/technical training programs, workshops, or enablement initiatives for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong security awareness in the context of AI—understanding risks around data leakage, prompt injection, model misuse, and compliance implications of AI tool adoption
  • Deep expertise in AWS cloud services with hands-on experience designing and operating complex serverless and event-driven architectures
  • Strong proficiency in two or more object-oriented programming languages
  • Experience with both relational and NoSQL databases, such as MS SQL Server, DynamoDB, and OpenSearch
  • Proven experience building and operating high-transaction, low-latency backend systems at scale
  • Demonstrated experience handling sensitive data in multi-tenant SaaS environments with a security-first mindset (encryption, access control, data isolation, compliance)
  • Track record of end-to-end ownership of large-scale solutions—not just contributing to a piece, but driving the full architecture from design through production
  • Experience with RESTful API design and event-driven integration patterns
  • Proven experience shipping product as part of an Agile team
  • Strong desire to help a successful company scale existing cloud-based services while also being a significant contributor to the development of new products
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for diverse audiences
  • A collaborative, energetic team player with a genuine willingness to help others, a proactive attitude, and a natural curiosity for learning and adopting new technologies

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience with data lake architectures and BI tooling (e.g., AWS Athena, QuickSight, Redshift, Glue)
  • Experience with storage architectures
  • Hands-on experience implementing CI/CD pipelines—not just using them, but designing and building deployment infrastructure using tools such as Kraken, CloudFormation, CDK, or similar IaC frameworks
  • Database administration experience or backup DBA capacity across various database engines (relational, NoSQL, in-memory)
  • AWS certification(s) (Solutions Architect, Developer, Security Specialty, or Machine Learning Specialty preferred)
  • Bachelor's degree in related field

Candidates for this role, must be based in the United States and legally eligible to work for any US employer. Eleven is not able to sponsor candidates at this time.

Eleven is a remote work employer and offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package; our benefits package includes medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) plan, and an attractive paid time off policy. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the United States is $160,000- $185,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills, and geography.

jobs.title: Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) - Parker, CO
jobs.excerpt: Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62K-80K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year

Job Description Summary:

About Rocket Software:

Rocket Software empowers organizations around the world to solve their most complex IT challenges. Our Legal team serves as a trusted business partner, enabling growth while managing risk across our global organization. We are seeking a business-minded Senior Legal Counsel to support our Americas sales organization, lead significant commercial matters, and provide practical, strategic legal guidance to internal stakeholders, customers, partners, and vendors.

This role directly supports revenue-generating activities for the Americas sales organization and will independently manage significant customer transactions from initial structuring through negotiation, escalation, and execution.

This role is ideal for an attorney who thrives in a fast-paced technology environment, enjoys partnering closely with go-to-market teams, and can balance commercial objectives with sound legal judgment.

Position Summary:

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will independently support revenue-generating activities for Rocket Software's Americas business by providing proactive, business-focused legal guidance throughout the customer lifecycle. You will work closely with Sales, Channel Partners, Product, Finance, Procurement, Information Security, Privacy, and executive stakeholders to structure, negotiate, and close complex commercial transactions, exercising sound judgment on when to resolve matters independently and when to escalate material risks.

In this role, you will serve as the primary legal partner on assigned business matters, independently advise on deals and issues arising in existing commercial relationships, and provide clear, risk-based recommendations to management and business teams. You will also advise on applicable laws and regulations and lead or materially contribute to new business processes within the business and risk areas.

The successful candidate will operate with a high degree of independence, take ownership of matters through completion, serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders, and help drive scalable legal processes that support Rocket's continued growth. The role requires the ability to work effectively from established templates and playbooks, identify when tailored language is appropriate, and create new templates, clauses, and guidance for emerging or recurring business needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Independently draft, review, negotiate, and manage a broad range of complex commercial agreements, including software licensing, SaaS, cloud services, reseller and partner agreements, professional services agreements, NDAs, procurement contracts, statements of work, and strategic enterprise transactions.
  • Serve as the lead legal advisor on assigned customer, partner, and vendor negotiations, providing practical, risk-based guidance, resolving issues independently within established parameters, and escalating material or novel risks with a recommended course of action.
  • Partner closely with Sales and go-to-market leaders on deal strategy, contract escalations, and complex commercial matters, including leading negotiations and coordinating cross-functional input through execution.
  • Advise internal stakeholders on legal, regulatory, and contractual issues related to technology transactions.
  • Structure creative commercial solutions that accelerate business outcomes while maintaining compliance with company policies and applicable laws.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of Rocket Software's products, business strategy, and customer environment to provide effective legal support.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Security, Privacy, Product Management, Procurement, and Compliance teams.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations, including data protection, anti-corruption, export controls, and software licensing requirements.
  • Monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting Rocket's business and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Use established contract templates, clauses, negotiation playbooks, and approval frameworks effectively; adapt them to the facts and risk profile of a transaction; and develop new templates, fallback language, legal guidance, and scalable contracting processes where business or legal needs are not adequately addressed by existing materials.
  • Support corporate governance initiatives and other strategic projects as needed.
  • Leverage technology and AI-enabled tools to improve legal operations, efficiency, and service delivery.

Qualifications:


Required:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Licensed and in good standing to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant legal experience, including substantial in-house experience focused on complex commercial transactions and software licensing.
  • Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex technology-related agreements.
  • Experience supporting software, SaaS, cloud computing, or other technology businesses.
  • Knowledge of software licensing, data privacy, export controls, and anti-corruption laws.
  • Strong business and legal judgment, with demonstrated ability to independently assess risk, make decisions within established authority, and clearly articulate practical recommendations to business and executive stakeholders.
  • Excellent written, verbal, negotiation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage a substantial workload, prioritize competing demands, and drive matters to timely completion in a fast-paced environment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with business stakeholders and customers.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, AI, cybersecurity, or data-driven technology companies.
  • Experience negotiating reseller, distributor, channel partner, and strategic alliance agreements.
  • Experience providing real-time support to U.S. and Canadian sales teams, international transactions and global commercial contracting.
  • Familiarity with privacy, information security, AI-related contracting, and enterprise procurement requirements.
  • Experience working from established legal templates and playbooks and independently creating or materially improving templates, clauses, guidance, and legal operations processes.

What Makes You Successful:

  • Business-minded attorney who focuses on enabling growth while appropriately managing risk.
  • Strong collaborator who builds trust and credibility across legal and business teams.
  • Skilled negotiator who can navigate complex transactions and competing priorities.
  • Self-starter who thrives with autonomy and takes ownership of outcomes.
  • Practical problem solver who translates complex legal concepts into actionable business guidance.
  • High integrity, sound judgment, and commitment to client service.

Why Join Rocket Software:

At Rocket Software, you'll have the opportunity to partner directly with business leaders, influence strategic transactions, and help shape the legal support model for a global technology company. You'll join a collaborative legal team that values innovation, integrity, and practical problem-solving while supporting some of the world's most recognized enterprises on their modernization journeys.

Our Values

Putting people first from day one.

We deeply value the people we work with. As a values-driven company, we are guided by empathy, humanity, trust, and love. We proudly show our care through benefits designed to help you thrive.


Benefits:

  • Generous paid time off, including holidays, sick leave, and vacation days.

  • Retirement savings plan with matching contributions from Rocket Software.
  • Life and disability insurance.
  • Tuition reimbursement and certificate reimbursement program opportunities.

Rocket Software’s Values


Empathy, Humanity, Trust, and Love

JOB SUMMARY

This opportunity is for Military personnel participating in the Department of Defense SkillBridge Program. Ideally, the SkillBridge will be a minimum of 90 days in length. DLB is able to accommodate up to the full 180-day program and we will consider durations less than 90 days. For more information and to speak with our SkillBridge Specialist, please submit your application and we will be in touch with you within 24 hours to schedule time to connect on the opportunities we have available, the geographic area that you are looking for and your time frame.

The SkillBridge - Commissioning Field Technician is an entry-level role that builds upon foundational commissioning knowledge while introducing more independent troubleshooting, testing, and reporting responsibilities. This role provides technical support in the inspection, validation, and functional testing of electrical, mechanical, and control systems.

The SkillBridge - Commissioning Field Technician will develop a deeper understanding of commissioning procedures, engage with vendors and project teams, will rely on instructions and take ownership of specific testing tasks under immediate supervision. They are expected to demonstrate increasing autonomy, problem-solving skills, and initiative in executing commissioning tasks.

The SkillBridge - Commissioning Field Technician will rely on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job. Works under immediate supervision.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Perform On-site Inspection, Validation, Testing and Verification of Electrical and Mechanical Equipment (50%)

  • Participate in factory witness testing
  • Observe startup activities
  • Use technical equipment to perform testing
  • Perform functional testing of equipment and electrical, mechanical and controls systems
  • Troubleshoot system components

Develop Testing Plans and Procedures (20%)

  • Assist in the development of commissioning plans
  • Prepare pre-functional checklists
  • Prepare functional performance test scripts

Review Construction Related Design Documents, Drawings and Specifications (15%)

  • Review shop drawings and submittals
  • Review sequence of operations
  • Assist in commissioning focused design reviews

Reporting (10%)

  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Assist in preparation and contributes to final commissioning report
  • Manage personal hours using company tools

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency (5%)

  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (BEGINNER LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED)

  • Must be a current participant of the Department of Defense SkillBridge Program
  • Knowledge of electrical, mechanical and controls system principles
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with supervision
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to achieve certification for NFPA70E and / or OSHA training as / if required
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces
  • Frequently descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment
  • On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 75%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and ability to rent vehicles.
  • Must be located near a major airport.
  • Effective May 7, 2025, and in accordance with U.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) is required for travel associated with this position.
  • Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business need.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.
  • Potential for international assignments.
  • Potential relocation opportunities may exist per project needs.

CERTIFICATIONS REQUIRED

  • Must be able to obtain NFPA 70E / OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certifications as required.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction or related discipline.

OR

  • A minimum of two years’ experience with installation, hands-on testing, validation and troubleshooting of mechanical, controls and / or electrical infrastructure.

Growth Pathway from Technician II

This role provides a structured learning path to progress into:
Technician III (Level 3, Step 1-4) – increased level of independent work and technical problem-solving.

WHAT YOU WILL GAIN IN THIS DOD SKILLBRIDGE PROGRAM WITH DLB:

  • Learn how your military experience translates into a rewarding civilian career.
  • Explore a career or industry you might want to pursue upon separation from active duty.
  • Earn real-world industry qualifications and certifications.
  • Build experience and competency in your trade/ profession with our team.
  • Expand your professional network of contacts.
  • Gain familiarity with corporate culture.

BENEFITS

  • This is a military transitional program that does not provide compensation through DLB. If selected for full-time employment with DLB upon completion of SkillBridge you will be eligible for a very competitive benefits package; highlights include:
  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26

Marketing Operations & Communications Manager

About sMedia

sMedia is a digital advertising and SEO provider specializing in helping automotive dealerships boost their sales, maximize marketing efficiencies, and grow their market share. We ground our partnerships in data, real results, and our core values: Growth, Reliability, Transparency, and Curiosity. We are looking for an accountable, strategic team member who is passionate about digital advertising and automotive retail, and who thrives on building trusting, long-term industry relationships that drive growth for everyone.

Role Overview

The Marketing Operations & Communication Manager serves as the architect and builder for sMedia’s B2B marketing engine. This role is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of relationship-driven content and growth-enablement assets, ensuring that every touchpoint in the prospect and partner journey reinforces sMedia’s position as a definitive thought leader in automotive digital marketing.

This position bridges strategic planning with hands-on technical execution. Working closely with executive leadership, you will translate the corporate roadmap into highly accurate product collateral, email marketing campaigns, educational webinars, and web content. A critical demand of this role is absolute precision: ensuring all messaging adheres strictly to sMedia's brand voice guidelines and that all product descriptions reflect our exact technical mechanics. By leveraging comprehensive CRM analytics and website performance data, you will continuously optimize campaign performance to fuel our sales engine without requiring extensive managerial oversight.

  • Reporting to: Head of Growth

Your Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

1. Campaign Implementation & Execution (40% Focus)

About Generate Canada

Generate Canada is a not-for-profit organization that for 30 years has been bringing together leaders from government, business, academia and civil society to drive change aimed at strengthening Canada’s economy, and the natural and social systems on which it depends.

We have built a national platform of pre-competitive innovation labs that we call ‘Solution Spaces’. They help develop and scale solutions—be it partnerships, investments, policies, standards, and/or new technologies— that are deemed most critical for a clean economy and a resilient future.

Our portfolio of Solution Spaces is ever-evolving to respond to complex and persistent challenges, and to fill gaps not already being addressed by other organizations. We are currently focused on advancing regenerative agriculture, the circular economy across construction and plastics supply-chains, and blended sustainable finance for nature-based solutions.

Join the work to advance a more resilient food system
Founded in 2023 as a Solution Space of Generate Canada, the Canadian Alliance for Net-Zero Agri-food (CANZA) grew out of a small group of passionate industry leaders willing to test ideas and work together in a pre-collaborative space to find real solutions. We collaborate with farmers, organizations, food and beverage processors and retailers, and researchers to develop and scale practical solutions that reduce emissions, improve environmental outcomes, and create new value across the agri-food system.

What You’ll Do

As the Marketplace Implementation Coordinator, you will play a central role in driving day-to-day operations and execution across the CANZA Marketplace and associated work related to CANZA’s Measurement, Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MMRV) initiatives. This role combines dedicated leadership over specific streams of work with active collaborative support across the broader Marketplace team to ensure seamless delivery of our organizational goals.

This position will bring knowledge of sustainable and regenerative agriculture practices to champion key workstreams. As part of this role, you will have ownership of enhancements to the Marketplace searchable directory to improve user experience and deepen partner relationships across Canada, while consulting with the Director on strategic direction. At the same time, you will work closely with the full Marketplace team to support, coordinate, and execute activities led by other team members - helping maintain detailed workplans, conducting research, and supporting testing of new functionality in the Marketplace and other associated technology platforms.

Working under the guidance of the Director, Data & Marketplace Strategy, you will bridge structured project management with hands-on coordination. You will ensure milestones are met, practical and high-quality research is conducted, progress reports and documentation are delivered accurately, and our collective efforts effectively advance CANZA’s mission across Canada's agrifood sector.

As Marketplace Implementation Coordinator, your key responsibilities will include:

Research and Tool Development

  • Provide subject matter expertise to support the development and evolution of Marketplace and Measurement, Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification tools, programs and resources, ensuring content and functionality are representative of emerging trends in agriculture and sustainability.
  • Participate directly in testing and quality assurance for new Marketplace tool features and digital functionalities prior to wider rollout.
  • Lead research on regenerative agriculture, sustainability, MMRV and environmental markets, serving as an internal resource and translate findings into actionable program recommendations.
  • Serve as the lead and champion for designated Marketplace workstreams, such as the searchable directory.

Documentation, Reporting and Proposal Support

  • Keep project documentation and reporting templates structured, up to date, and organized across workstreams.
  • Support the team by contributing technical subject matter input, as well as preparing, formatting and synthesizing materials for pitch decks, proposals and concept notes.

Stakeholder Engagement and Operations Support

  • Organize, document, and follow up on team and partner meetings to support seamless communication and stakeholder engagement across the Marketplace portfolio.
  • Assist in tracking project timelines, action items and dependencies to keep cross-functional team efforts aligned and moving forward smoothly.
  • Perform other related project coordination and operational duties as assigned to support the evolving needs of the Marketplace team and organizational priorities.
  • Collaborate closely with the Senior Program Lead and Sr. Project Manager to support the planning, tracking, and execution of broader Marketplace and MMRV initiatives and team-led activities.
  • Assist in maintaining proactive, professional correspondence with external system actors, serving as an approachable operational point of contact for meeting logistics, routine inquiries, and information sharing.

Who You Are

You’re a purpose-driven professional who thrives in dynamic, collaborative environments.

  • Facilitator: Clear communicator and collaborator who can work with both technical developers and stakeholders.
  • Ethical: Strong orientation and commitment to transparency, privacy, and data stewardship.
  • Disciplined: Strategic and systems-oriented thinker with excellent project execution skills.
  • Team Player: Skilled at building interpersonal connections and fostering a supportive, communicative, and collaborative environment.
  • Independent and Innovative: Motivated to take initiative and solve complex challenges.
  • Resilient and Adaptable: Comfortable navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities.
  • Aligned with Agri-Food Systems: Excited about the intersection of agriculture, food, and sustainability.

Essential Qualifications

  • Strong subject matter knowledge in agrifood sustainability, agricultural production systems, and sustainability initiatives across supply chains.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply technical data, specifically relating to agriculture, sustainability, and MMRV.
  • Ability to independently research, analyze data, and synthesize findings into concise summaries, presentations, executive briefings, and actionable recommendations on sustainable agriculture and sustainability practices.
  • One to three (1-3) years’ of experience in project coordination, implementation, or project management, ideally within agriculture, food systems, sustainability, or environmental markets.
  • Excellent organizational skills with proven experience tracking project timelines, managing action items, and managing competing priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail to assist with testing user functionality, and managing web-based platforms or directories.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of coordinating with external system actors, and creating clear documentation, pitch decks, progress reports, and meeting summaries.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills to work effectively alongside team members, technical experts, program administrators, and external partners.
  • Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Environmental Science, Sustainability, Agronomy, Agricultural Economics, Food Systems, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a willingness to adapt as priorities change, and a solutions-orientated mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with MMRV concepts, carbon accounting, Scope 3 emissions, sustainability reporting, environmental data management, or related frameworks.
  • Experience working with agricultural sustainability programs, carbon markets, regenerative agriculture, or ecosystem service initiatives.
  • Knowledge of environmental data standards, traceability systems, or digital agriculture platforms.
  • Experience working with producers, commodity organizations, or agricultural value chain partners.

How To Apply

Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $62K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.excerpt: job brief Interessierst du dich für spannende innovative Themen im Bereich der Marketing-KI?
jobs.description:
job brief

Interessierst du dich für spannende innovative Themen im Bereich der Marketing-KI? Hast du Lust, unsere Technologie-SaaS-Plattform gemeinsam mit uns auf das nächste Level zu heben? Steckst du voller Ideen, um die Zukunft von Brainsuite.ai mitzugestalten? Dann würden wir uns freuen, dich als Backend & DevOps Developer (m/w/d) in unserem motivierten Team begrüßen zu dürfen.


Als Backend & DevOps Developer (m/w/d) bei Brainsuite.ai verbindest du Softwareentwicklung und Betrieb zu gleichen Teilen: Rund die Hälfte deiner Zeit entwickelst du Python-basierte Web-Applikationen, APIs und Integrationen für unsere SaaS-Plattform, die andere Hälfte baust und betreibst du unsere Infrastruktur auf AWS. Dein Ziel ist, dass unsere Anwendungen nicht nur gebaut, sondern auch zuverlässig, sicher und nachvollziehbar betrieben werden. Dabei leitet dich ein Prinzip: Transparenz. Systemzustand, Änderungen und Entscheidungen sind für Team und Stakeholder jederzeit sichtbar und nachvollziehbar.

deine aufgaben beinhalten:

  • Entwicklung, Test und Pflege von Web-Applikationen, APIs und Integrationen mit Python
  • Aufbau, Betrieb und Skalierung unserer AWS-Umgebungen
  • Infrastruktur als Code mit AWS CDK sowie automatisierte Builds, Tests und Deployments in unseren CI/CD-Pipelines
  • Zustand, Fehler und Performance unserer Systeme sichtbar machen und Änderungen sowie Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar dokumentieren
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Produkt-, AI- und Data-Science-Teams, damit Teams direkten Zugang zur Infrastruktur haben und Änderungen schneller umsetzen können

über dich:

  • 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Python, idealerweise mit FastAPI, REST-APIs, SQL und pytest
  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von AWS-Umgebungen (z. B. ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, DynamoDB)
  • Praxiserfahrung mit Infrastruktur als Code (idealerweise AWS CDK) und CI/CD-Pipelines (z. B. Git, Bitbucket)
  • Freude an beiden Seiten der Rolle: Du entwickelst gerne und übernimmst gleichzeitig Verantwortung für einen stabilen, sicheren Betrieb
  • Eine transparente Arbeitsweise: Du machst Systemzustand, Änderungen und Entscheidungen für andere sichtbar und nachvollziehbar
  • Effektive Zusammenarbeit in einem funktionsübergreifenden, agilen Team
  • Eigeninitiative mit einem sehr kreativen und lösungsorientierten Problemlösungsansatz sowie einem Growth Mindset 
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1) in Wort und Schrift
  • Du verfügst über eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland

was wir als plus betrachten:

  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring und Observability, z. B. CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus oder OpenTelemetry
  • Erfahrung im Betrieb von Containern, z. B. mit Docker oder Kubernetes
  • Vorherige Erfahrung in einem B2B SaaS Unternehmen

was ist für dich drin?

  • Ein internationales Team, das gemeinsam Großes erreichen kann: Bei uns triffst du auf Menschen aus aller Welt, die Vielfalt leben und schätzen. Flache Hierarchien und eine offene, unterstützende Arbeitskultur schaffen Raum für die Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitigen Respekt.
  • Gestalte die Zukunft aktiv mit: Ob Künstliche Intelligenz, kreative Effektivität, Verhaltenswissenschaft oder Marketing-Transformation – bei uns arbeitest du an zukunftsweisenden Themen, die die Branche bewegen.
  • Dein Arbeitsplatz? Überall in Deutschland: Wir setzen auf 100% Remote Work und geben dir die Freiheit, deinen Arbeitsort flexibel zu wählen. Persönlicher Austausch kommt dabei nicht zu kurz – bei Teamtreffen und unseren Sommer- und Winterfeiern sehen wir uns auch persönlich.
  • Wachse mit uns: Für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung stellen wir dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget zur Verfügung, das du flexibel für Trainings, Kurse oder Konferenzen nutzen kannst.
  • Mehr Zeit für dich: Genieße 30 Urlaubstage im Jahr plus zwei zusätzliche freie Tage an Heiligabend und Silvester.
  • Workation: Du brauchst einen Tapetenwechsel? Kein Problem! Bei uns kannst du bis zu 28 Tage im Jahr im EU-Ausland arbeiten.
  • Jobticket: Wir bezuschussen dein JobTicket, damit du günstiger und nachhaltiger mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln unterwegs bist.
  • Exklusive Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten auf eine Vielzahl an Produkten und Dienstleistungen – dank unserer Partnerschaften mit corporate benefits und FutureBens.

so läuft der einstellungsprozess ab:

  • Erstes Gespräch mit Roberto Drummond (Software Architect) und Monika Vasatkova (People & Culture Manager) - 45 Min
  • Hausarbeit / Case Study Präsentation, Q&A - 60 Min (1 Woche Vorbereitungszeit)
  • Kompetenzgespräch Dr. Christian Scheier (Co-Founder & CAIO) - 30 Min

du erfüllst nicht alle anforderungen?

Bei Brainsuite.ai setzen wir uns für ein vielfältiges, gleichberechtigtes und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ein. Uns ist bewusst, dass verschiedene Faktoren die Entscheidung sich auf eine Stelle zu bewerben, beeinflussen können. Daher ermutigen wir alle Menschen mit jeglichem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben, unabhängig davon, ob sie alle Qualifikationen erfüllen.

Wir sind überzeugt: Vielfalt bereichert unser Team und stärkt unsere Innovationskraft. Wenn auch du unsere Werte teilst, freuen wir uns über deine Bewerbung.

Wir setzen uns dafür ein, ein für alle zugängliches Umfeld zu schaffen, auch für Menschen mit Behinderung. Wenn du bestimmte Bedürfnisse hast, teile uns bitte mit, wie wir dich während des Bewerbungsverfahrens oder im Arbeitsalltag unterstützen können.
