jobs.description:
If you're obsessed with the phone, the chase, and closing for the meeting — and you want AI in your corner, not in your way — this is your playground. 🚀

Most outbound sales jobs hand you a dialer and a quota. This one hands you a craft: you'll get the owners of Managed Service Providers on the phone, find the real problem, and book meetings sales is glad to take. We reward meetings that stick, not dials that don't.

🏢 About MSPbots

MSPbots is a US-based AI company that builds intelligent automation tools for Managed Service Providers worldwide—helping IT businesses work smarter by automating workflows, surfacing real-time data, and eliminating manual work. You'll join a lean, high-performing sales team, work directly with US-based leadership, and have real visibility into the pipeline you help build.

🛠️ The Role

You're at the very start of the sales process. You find the right Managed Service Providers, get them on the phone, and book quality meetings for our sales team—the kind they're genuinely glad to take.

Volume matters, but quality wins here. You're measured on the meetings that turn into real opportunities, not the number you dial or book. The habits that get you there: reaching the right accounts, following up without fail, and keeping your notes and records clean.

🌐 Work Setup: Remote (Philippine-based only)

🌙 Work Schedule: 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine Time

🎯 Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead Vetting & Qualification — Confirm a company is a genuine Managed Service Provider and a good fit for our ideal customer profile before outreach; respect account-ownership rules; capture details like their service-desk software, technician count, dispatch method, and pain points where possible.
  • Multi-Channel Outbound — Run the correct sequences per persona across calls and email; keep every cadence active, with nothing paused or stalled. Balance sequence-driven volume with personalized one-off outreach to the accounts that matter most.
  • Prospect Conversations & Discovery — Execute the call process: intro and rapport, gatekeeper navigation, an elevator pitch with storytelling and social proof, probing for pain, pivoting to business intelligence and automation, and handling objections with a structured approach.
  • Booking Meetings (Trial Close & Demo) — Close for a demo once pain or interest is identified; schedule specific next steps.
  • Follow-up & Nurture Discipline — Zero missed follow-ups; respond to high-intent signals the same day; keep your callbacks organized and consistently labeled; enroll prospects in nurture where appropriate; re-work leads the sales team did not accept.
  • HubSpot Hygiene & Data Accuracy — Accurate rep attribution, a disposition on every logged call, detailed notes, correct personas/titles/time zones, and meeting logging.
  • Handoff to Sales — Hand off booked meetings to the sales team with full context, following our handoff process.
  • Pipeline Prioritization — Protect warm and active opportunities before cold outreach; work tradeshow and inbound leads fast.
  • Continuous Improvement — Participate in scorecard reviews, team huddles, and coaching; progress section by section toward call mastery.
  • Tool & Compliance Adherence — Use the approved stack (HubSpot, ZoomInfo, Apollo/Lusha) and our AI-assisted research assistant. LinkedIn is manual review only—no scraping or automation.

🔍 Qualifications & What We Look For

Required

  • Strong US business-to-business phone sales background—proven success in high-volume outbound calling, cold prospecting, and booking meetings over the phone. Top hiring priority.
  • Real phone-selling experience with business owners or service leaders — not appointment-setting or script-reading; can handle nuanced conversations and objections and earn the meeting.
  • Confident, resilient phone presence: comfortable with gatekeepers, objections, and cold opens.
  • Able to write a short, specific, personalized email—30 a day, referencing something real about that account.
  • Disciplined follow-up and record-keeping habits (accurate notes, dispositions, task management).
  • Coachable—willing to be scored on in the prospecting call process and improve section by section.

Preferred (not required)

  • Software-as-a-service sales experience—a plus, not a requirement.
  • Exposure to the Managed Service Provider or IT services space, or technical business-to-business buyers.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, sequences, and prospecting tools (ZoomInfo, Apollo/Lusha).

Fit signals

  • Prioritizes quality conversations over vanity activity.
  • Self-directed on warm follow-through; protects active pipeline over busywork.

🎉 Compensation & Benefits

How you're paid: $8/hour base plus commission. Commission is your main upside — you earn on every deal you help close, along with a bonus for each qualified meeting the sales team accepts. (Meetings you book that aren't accepted count toward your performance but aren't paid.) We'll walk through the full numbers in the interview.

Perks:

  • 💊 Health Insurance (HMO) Reimbursement — $100/month
  • 🛡️ Life Insurance Allowance — $20/month

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on, highly technical role responsible for securing JLL’s global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings a security-first mindset, a bias towards action, and deep expertise in Palo Alto Networks technologies alongside broad command of API security, WAF/CDN platforms, and complex troubleshooting across network and application layers. You’ll work collaboratively with global engineering, application, and security teams to ensure security controls are intelligence-driven, optimized, and aligned to industry best practices.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for Palo Alto Networks technologies (NGFWs, Cloud NGFW, Panorama), Web Application Firewall, Content Delivery Network, API Security, IDS/IPS, and DDoS prevention
  • Own onboarding, policy tuning, and lifecycle management for WAF and CDN platforms; lead firewall ruleset optimization, IDS/IPS tuning, and DDoS protection configuration
  • Partner with internal teams to drive the global rollout, tuning, and operational management of URL filtering and TLS decryption across the network estate
  • Lead API security efforts — ensuring API traffic routes through security tooling, identifying vulnerabilities, and working with application teams on fixes
  • Lead troubleshooting of complex, multi-layer global network and application issues — from packet captures on inter-continental BGP topologies to WAF false-positive triage
  • Partner with business and application teams to produce clear, actionable security documentation, change proposals, and executive-ready findings
  • Analyze existing network security architectures, processes, and procedures to identify gaps and drive meaningful improvements
  • Configure and report on defensive measures against advanced threat actor tactics; maintain current awareness of the evolving threat landscape and the effectiveness of our defenses against them
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both global engineering teams and C-suite stakeholders
  • Champion the broader Security team’s initiatives, not just Network Security Engineering
  • Participate in the maintenance and tuning of all network security technologies including WAFs, CDNs, VPNs, and application-aware firewalls
  • Leverage and contribute to automation pipelines for global firewall rule deployment and policy management across the network estate
  • Utilize security tooling telemetry and data collection automations to produce actionable reporting and metrics for internal teams and executive stakeholders

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of hands-on network security engineering experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale security solutions
  • Expert-level proficiency in Palo AltoNetworks — NGFWs, Panorama policy management, and PAN-OS; PCNSE or PCNSC certification strongly preferred
  • Expert troubleshooting skills across network and application layers, including packet capture analysis on complex, dynamically routed architectures
  • Deep understanding of layer 7 web application technologies and WAF/CDN platforms (e.g. Akamai, Cloudflare, Imperva, F5) — onboarding, policy tuning, break/fix troubleshooting, and operational management
  • Solid grounding in API security — ensuring API traffic routes through security tooling, evaluating identified vulnerabilities, and partnering with application teams to drive remediation
  • Strong HTTP/application security knowledge: TLS interception, SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, command injection, LFI/RFI, rate limiting, bot detection, geo-blocking, and sinkholing
  • Intermediate to advanced network routing and switching knowledge with focus on DNS, TCP/IP, IPsec, TLS, GRE, OSPF, and BGP
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python preferred) and familiarity with Linux/CLI tooling
  • Working knowledge of public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Experience with at least one SIEM platform for log analysis, behavioral analytics, and rule tuning
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proven track record of taking ownership in unstructured environments — cutting through ambiguity, making sound decisions with incomplete information, building stakeholder consensus, and delivering security improvements without waiting for top-down direction

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Industry certifications: PCNSE, PCNSC, CCNP/CCIE Security, GIAC (GWAPT, GPEN, or similar)
  • Experience building metrics pipelines and KPI reporting for security operations

Role Summary

MarketMan builds restaurant management software for SMB and mid-market restaurant operators. Our sales team sells it directly to the people who run those businesses, and we win by understanding the operational and financial pain behind each one.

We're hiring a full-cycle Account Executive whose primary motion is outbound. You'll own every revenue opportunity across inbound, outbound, and partner channels, but the job is built on pipeline you create yourself: you self-source the majority of it. Inbound is a supplement, not the job.

The bar is a minimum of 100 outbound activities per day across calls, emails, social touches, and sequences. We publish that number because it's the prospecting discipline that fills your pipeline and feeds your quota, and we inspect outbound production every week. You carry two measured expectations: a new-business quota and a self-sourced pipeline target.

Please note: you must reside in one of the following states to qualify for this role - AZ, CT, FL, GA, ID, IN, KS, MI, MO, NC, NH, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA

Read This Before You Apply

This is a high-volume outbound seat. If you need warm inbound leads handed to you, or a defined book of business to work, you'll be miserable here, and it's better for both of us that you know that before applying. If you've built pipeline from cold, hit quota doing it, and can show the numbers, keep reading.

What You Will Own

  • The majority of your own pipeline, generated through 100+ daily outbound activities across calls, email, and LinkedIn.
  • A new-business quota with a 100% attainment expectation. You'll close restaurant operators in the 1–3 location range and progress at least 3 opportunities per day.
  • The full sales cycle: value-based discovery that surfaces operational and financial pain, tailored demos (an average of 2 per day, inbound plus outbound combined), objection handling, and negotiation through to signature.
  • A clean Salesforce pipeline. Next steps and close dates updated in real time, every deal on a scheduled next step within 72 hours, forecast accuracy within 10%.
  • Pipeline coverage of 3.0–3.5x entering each month, and a clear view of where the gaps are.
  • Working relationships with Marketing, Partner Managers, and the SDR/BDR team that move deals forward, while your number never depends on them.

What You Will Bring

Must-haves:

  • Proven outbound production, with numbers: activity volume, self-sourced pipeline created, and quota attainment you can walk us through.
  • Full-cycle closing skills, from first discovery call through negotiation and signature.
  • Salesforce (or similar CRM) fluency and the hygiene habits to keep it accurate in real time.
  • A track record in an outbound-heavy sales model.
  • High accountability. You own your metrics, your recaps, and your results without being chased.

Nice-to-haves:

  • SaaS sales experience in SMB or hospitality tech.
  • Familiarity with restaurant technology such as POS, accounting, or restaurant management software.
  • Time in a hybrid outbound/inbound or BDR-to-AE model.

How We Operate

You'll sell out of Salesforce, follow MarketMan's standardized sales process, and uphold our discounting rules. Each day ends with a short recap covering wins, losses, pipeline movement, and next steps, and you'll bring pipeline insights to team syncs. Success looks like consistent monthly quota attainment, pipeline created from both channels, and win rates that improve because your discovery does.

Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission tied to quota.

jobs.description:
Reports to: Head of Finance

Location: United Kingdom

Direct reports: None

Entities covered: All legal entities across all portfolios of the group

Frameworks: Local GAAP per jurisdiction, IFRS for group purposes

External parties: Statutory and group auditors, local accounting and filing providers, company secretarial providers

Role overview

The Statutory Reporting & Compliance Manager owns timely, accurate and audit-ready statutory reporting for every legal entity in the group, across all portfolios.

The role separates statutory compliance from the portfolio finance teams. They can focus on business performance, cash and portfolio priorities, while statutory deadlines and accounting judgements have a dedicated owner.

The role holder is the single point of accountability for statutory accounts, statutory audits, local GAAP to IFRS conversion and the group's compliance calendar.

Reporting line

The role reports directly to the Head of Finance and sits outside the portfolio reporting lines. This protects statutory deadlines and accounting judgements from competing business priorities.

Key responsibilities

Statutory accounts

• Prepare, or oversee preparation of, statutory financial statements for all legal entities under local GAAP.

• Own the group statutory and filing calendar, and make sure every filing deadline is met.

• Manage local accounting and filing providers where entities are serviced externally.

Statutory and group audits

• Plan and lead statutory audits end to end: timetable, PBC lists, audit files and closing meetings.

• Act as primary contact for statutory auditors, and coordinate support to the group auditor.

• Resolve audit findings and track management letter points to closure.

IFRS and technical accounting

• Deliver local GAAP to IFRS conversions and respond to IFRS reporting requests.

• Set group accounting policies and position papers, for example IFRS 15 revenue recognition, IFRS 16 leases, capitalised development costs and intercompany in close cooperation with the headquarter

• Support acquisition accounting for new deals, including opening balance sheets, purchase price allocation and alignment of acquired entities to group policies.

Compliance and controls

• Maintain the legal entity register from a finance perspective: filing status, auditors, year-ends and local requirements.

• Define minimum statutory standards that the portfolio teams' month-end must meet, for example balance sheet reconciliations and documentation.

• Coordinate responses to internal audit findings that relate to statutory reporting.

• Support entity rationalization, such as mergers and liquidations of dormant entities.

Tax interface

• Work with the Tax Manager on tax provisions, deferred tax and tax notes in the statutory accounts.

• Provide the financial data needed for transfer pricing documentation and local tax filings.

Interfaces and decision rights

The portfolio teams keep running the books. This role owns what turns those books into compliant statutory output.

  • Portfolio Finance Directors: They own portfolio results, priorities and staffing of entity teams. This role owns the statutory calendar, deliverable requirements and sign-off of statutory accounts.
  • Entity teams: They own the monthly close, ledgers, reconciliations and audit support data. This role owns statutory adjustments, audit files and auditor communication.
  • Finance business partners: They own management reporting, forecasts and KPIs. There is no overlap; this role informs them of audit adjustments affecting reported numbers.
  • Tax Manager: They own tax computations, filings and transfer pricing policy. This role owns tax notes and balances in the statutory accounts.
  • Treasury: They own cash, banking and financing. This role owns disclosures on cash, debt and covenants (if applicable).
  • External auditors: They own the audit opinion. This role owns audit-ready files, the timetable and resolution of findings.

Qualifications and experience

Required

• Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA or equivalent).

• 7+ years in statutory reporting, including 3+ years in audit at a Big Four or mid-tier firm.

• Strong IFRS knowledge, especially IFRS 15 and IFRS 16

• Experience with statutory accounts and audits across several jurisdictions, including the US, Europe and APAC.

• Track record of running multiple statutory audits in parallel against fixed deadlines.

Preferred

• Experience in a multi-entity software, SaaS or buy-and-build group.

• Acquisition accounting and post-deal integration of acquired entities.

• NetSuite or a comparable multi-entity ERP.

• Experience managing outsourced accounting and filing providers.

Skills and personal attributes

• Calendar discipline: plans months ahead and treats filing deadlines as fixed.

• Independence: holds a technical position under business pressure and escalates early.

• Influence without authority: gets entity teams in other reporting lines to deliver on time.

• Hands-on: prepares accounts and audit files personally where needed; this is not a pure oversight role.

• Clear communicator: explains technical accounting to non-accountants, including investment partners and other senior management.

• Builder: creates templates, checklists and standards that make the next year's cycle faster. Leverages tools to automate tasks

• Languages: fluent English; additional European languages are a plus.

Success measures

  • First 3 months: Complete statutory and filing calendar for all entities, with owners and current status.
  • First 3 months: Overdue filings and open audits identified, with 50% resolved.
  • First 6 months: All statutory filings submitted on time, with no late-filing penalties.
  • First 12 months: Statutory audits closed within agreed timetables; prior-year management letter points resolved.
  • First 12 months: Portfolio finance teams’ time spent on statutory work cut by at least 50%.
  • First 14 months: Automate at least 40% of the recurring preparation work for statutory audits.
  • Ongoing: Newly acquired entities aligned to group policies and the calendar within 6 months of closing.

We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

jobs.description:
Senior Embedded / Firmware Engineer

(RTOS, komunikacja, systemy krytyczne, secure embedded systems)

Zakres obowiązków

To nie jest typowa rola embedded. To projektowanie systemów, deterministyczna komunikacja, real-time oraz odpowiedzialność za kluczowe elementy produktu.

Będziesz pracować od niskopoziomowego firmware po komunikację z backendem.

W praktyce oznacza to:

  • Rozwój firmware dla komponentów bezpieczeństwa oraz modułów komunikacyjnych

  • Projektowanie i usprawnianie komunikacji między dwoma MCU

  • Praca z logiką czasu rzeczywistego, maszynami stanów i obsługą błędów

  • Tworzenie i utrzymanie sterowników sprzętowych (UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO)

  • Projektowanie i rozwój systemów komunikacji bezprzewodowej (BLE onboarding, provisioning, data exchange)

  • Zapewnienie stabilnej komunikacji z backendem poprzez OCPP over WebSocket (lub podobne protokoły device-cloud)

  • Praca nad OTA i odpornością systemu w środowisku produkcyjnym (rollback, recovery, bezpieczeństwo aktualizacji)

  • Niskopoziomowe debugowanie z użyciem profesjonalnych narzędzi (JTAG, SWD, analizatory logiczne itp.)

  • Projektowanie API i warstw komunikacyjnych pomiędzy modułami systemu

Technologia i architektura

System składa się z dwóch głównych jednostek:

  • Kontroler bezpieczeństwa / mocy: nRF5340 lub podobny MCU klasy low-power (RTOS / embedded firmware)

  • Kontroler komunikacji / aplikacji: i.MX RT1061 lub podobny MCU klasy application-grade (RTOS / embedded Linux optional)

MCU komunikują się poprzez autorski protokół zaprojektowany pod kątem deterministyczności i spójności.

Komunikacja z backendem realizowana jest w oparciu o protokół typu OCPP over WebSocket lub równoważny protokół device-cloud.

Wymagania

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość C/C++ w systemach embedded

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z MCU (np. STM32, nRF, ESP32 lub podobne)

  • Znajomość protokołów komunikacyjnych: UART, SPI, I2C oraz BLE (lub inne wireless)

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu systemów embedded (architektura, nie tylko implementacja)

  • Umiejętność debugowania systemów HW/SW (JTAG, SWD, logi systemowe)

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu interfejsów i API pomiędzy komponentami systemu

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie w secure embedded systems (device identity, secure update concepts, integrity, tamper resistance)

  • Doświadczenie z OTA / bootloaderami (rollback, recovery, update safety)

  • Znajomość systemów RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr lub inne)

  • Doświadczenie z komunikacją device ↔ backend (WebSocket, MQTT, REST)

  • Automotive / industrial embedded background

  • Znajomość systemów provisioning / fleet management / BLE onboarding

Nice-to-have (ale nie wymagane)

  • Doświadczenie z OCPP

  • Zephyr RTOS

  • Embedded Linux (Buildroot / Yocto)

Warunki pracy

  • 100% praca zdalna - możesz pracować z dowolnego miejsca

  • B2B: do 8 000 EUR netto miesięcznie

  • Elastyczne godziny pracy

  • Współpraca z doświadczonym zespołem system/firmware

  • Realny wpływ na architekturę i kierunek rozwoju produktu

OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Texas is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and/or Colorado preferred.

jobs.description:
Product Engineer

Position Overview

The Product Engineer is part of MTC Solutions’ Product Application Engineering team, the group responsible for transforming product data and research findings into design tools that enable engineers and designers to specify and apply our hardware confidently. In this role, you’ll translate engineering test data and research outcomes into clear, practical, and user-friendly documentation, including design guides, white papers, catalogs, spreadsheets, and digital tools. You’ll work at the intersection of technical precision and communication clarity, helping engineers across North America design better timber connections with MTC hardware. This position is intended for an experienced engineer who can independently manage technical documentation initiatives, coordinate cross-functional projects, and help drive the development of industry-leading design resources. The role combines engineering analysis, technical communication, project leadership, and product application engineering within the growing mass timber sector.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Technical Documentation: Create, maintain, and update design guides, white papers, and engineering resources.
  • Data Analysis: Interpret test results and research findings to produce design parameters and engineering tables.
  • Codes and Standards: Apply relevant design standards (CSA O86, NDS,
    Eurocode 5, AS/NZS) and document appropriate assumptions and limits.
  • Team Collaboration: Work with the R&D team to incorporate data, the Marketing team to refine visual layout and UX/UI, and the Technical Service team to address recurring industry questions.
  • Design Tools: Develop and maintain calculation spreadsheets and digital engineering tools (e.g., Cadwork plugins or software tools).
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify gaps or ambiguities in existing resources and propose updates that simplify the designer experience.
  • Project Leadership and Coordination: Lead technical documentation and engineering resource projects from planning through publication, coordinating priorities, schedules, and stakeholder input across Engineering, Marketing, Technical Service, and Business Development teams.
  • Mentorship and Technical Guidance: Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering standards, processes, and documentation practices.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Structural, or Timber Engineering (or equivalent background)
  • 5–10 years of engineering experience
  • Professional Engineer (P.Eng. or PE) designation, or eligibility for registration
  • Demonstrated experience managing technical projects involving multiple stakeholders
  • Experience developing engineering resources, design guides, specifications, calculation tools, or technical publications is considered an asset
  • Experience in timber engineering, structural connections, mass timber, or building products is considered an asset.
  • Strong understanding of design standards such as CSA O86, NDS, Eurocode 5, or similar
  • Excellent project management, communication, and organizational skills
  • Strong technical writing and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently and drive projects to completion
  • Proficiency in English required

Location: Greater Vancouver, Ontario and Quebec.

Salary Range: $80,000.00 to $120,000.00 (dependent on experience).

Who You Are

You are a technically curious and detail-oriented engineer who enjoys bridging the gap
between complex data and practical design solutions. You take pride in clarity, turning
dense calculations into information that others can trust and easily apply. You’re
motivated by collaboration, open to feedback, and thrive in an environment where
engineering, creativity, and communication meet. You are comfortable taking ownership of projects, coordinating stakeholders, and driving technical initiatives from concept through implementation.

About MTC Solutions

MTC Solutions is a North American leader in mass timber connection technology. We
design, test, and supply structural hardware that helps engineers and builders realize
safe, efficient, and beautiful timber structures. Our competitive edge comes from our
technical credibility and our ability to translate complex research into usable design

solutions.

Why Join MTC Solutions

At MTC Solutions, you’ll be part of a passionate, close-knit engineering team that is
shaping the future of mass timber construction across North America. We are small,
agile, and driven by quality. Here, your work has a direct impact: the documents and
tools you create will be used by engineers and designers on real mass timber projects

every day.

Company & Role

The Engineering Department

The Engineering Department is the technical core of MTC Solutions. Its mission is to
generate, validate, and distribute the data and tools that enable our customers to design
with confidence. The department includes two collaborative sub-teams:

1. Research and Development (R&D):

The R&D team drives innovation by developing new products and generating technical
data through research and testing. It supports evaluation reports (ICC-ESR, CCMC),
industry standards, and collaborative research projects with universities and labs. Their
focus is to turn market needs into validated engineering solutions, the scientific
foundation for all MTC products.

2. Product Application Engineering (PAE):
The Product Application Engineering team takes the data created by R&D and turns it
into the design resources used by the building community. This team creates the
documents and tools that define how our products are applied in practice, from design
guides and catalogs to calculation spreadsheets and software integrations. Their goal is
simple but ambitious: make it as easy as possible to specify MTC hardware in mass
timber projects.
Together, these two teams form a continuous loop:
Research creates knowledge → Application turns it into tools → Field feedback drives

new research.

The Product Engineer’s Place in the Team

As a Product Engineer, you'll be a key contributor within the Product Application Engineering team. You'll work closely with the Engineering Team Lead, Product Development Liaison, and other engineering stakeholders to develop technical resources, coordinate projects, and help shape the future of MTC's engineering tools and documentation.

You will:

  • Interpret data from the R&D team and implement it in design documentation.
  • Collaborate with the Marketing and Communication department to ensure the
    materials are clear and accessible.
  • Coordinate with Technical Service to understand where designers need more
    guidance.
  • Maintain and improve MTC’s library of design documents so that our hardware
    remains the easiest to specify and use in the industry.
  • Lead technical projects involving multiple internal stakeholders, ensuring priorities, timelines, and deliverables remain aligned.

The Product Engineer will collaborate with:

  • R&D Team: to receive and interpret testing data and technical reports.
  • Technical Service: to identify recurring customer questions and close information gaps
  • Marketing Communication: to ensure that technical documents are visually
    clear and brand-consistent.
  • Business Development: to align on industry needs and emerging specifications
    trends
  • External Research Partners: to support collaborative research initiatives and technology transfer into practical engineering resources.

Work Environment

You’ll join a team that is collaborative and highly engaged in continuous learning. The
Engineering Department is known for its attention to detail and its commitment to
publishing only the highest-quality technical resources. You’ll be supported by mentors
and peers who share a common goal: to elevate engineering practice within the mass

timber industry.

Why This Role Matters

Every MTC document and tool represents a promise to the design community: that our
data is accurate, our recommendations are trustworthy, and our products are ready to
perform. As a Product Engineer, you help uphold that promise. Your contribution will

shape how designers interact with mass timber hardware and how our brand continues

to lead in clarity and credibility.

At Municipal Credit Union, we believe that an incredible culture helps create a happy and motivated team that works hard to achieve the best results for themselves and their members. To help hard-working New Yorkers build better tomorrows

Our Vision:

Be New York's most loved financial institution by helping our members build their best financial futures

Overview:The Software Developer QA/QC independently evaluates development work completed by Software Developers and Senior Software Developers to ensure solutions meet approved requirements and MCU standards for functionality, security, performance, reliability, maintainability, documentation, and production readiness. The role reviews code and technical designs, coordinates and performs testing, validates defect remediation, and serves as a quality gate throughout the software development lifecycle while working collaboratively with developers, business analysts, stakeholders, and end users.

Responsibilities:

Specific duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Review business requirements, acceptance criteria, technical designs, and development deliverables for completeness, traceability, accuracy, and testability.
  • Perform independent peer reviews of source code, APIs, integrations, microservices, widgets, automation, database objects, reports, and application workflows developed by Software Developers and Senior Software Developers.
  • Validate adherence to MCU development standards, software architecture, coding conventions, source control practices, security requirements, and documentation standards.
  • Develop, execute, and maintain risk-based test strategies, test plans, test cases, test scripts, test data, and regression test suites.
  • Create and execute manual and automated test cases; identify, document, and track defects using defect‑tracking tools
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to identify, document, and resolve defects early in the development lifecycle
  • Perform functional, integration, system, regression, negative, security, performance, and production-readiness testing, as appropriate to the change.
  • Confirm that approved requirements and acceptance criteria have been implemented and that test evidence supports the results.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects; communicate findings clearly; and verify remediation through retesting before release.
  • Validate data integrity, SQL logic, interfaces, error handling, logging, exception management, monitoring, and auditability.
  • Review authentication, authorization, encryption, sensitive-data handling, input validation, dependency risks, and other secure coding controls.
  • Assess application performance, scalability, reliability, supportability, and maintainability and escalate material risks or unresolved quality concerns.
  • Validate deployment packages, configuration changes, release notes, implementation plans, rollback procedures, and production-readiness checklists.
  • Review automated test coverage and collaborate with developers to improve unit, integration and regression testing.
  • Maintain objective evidence of reviews, test execution, defects, approvals, exceptions, and release decisions in approved systems of record.
  • Apply appropriate QA approaches across Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall development methodologies
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts, developers, stakeholders, and end users to clarify requirements, expected results, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing while maintaining clear separation between technical quality validation and business acceptance.
  • Produce and communicate quality metrics, including defect trends, escaped defects, rework, test coverage, and release-readiness status.
  • Recommend improvements to coding, review, testing, documentation, and release processes to reduce defects and improve delivery quality.
  • Follow standardized methods and procedures used for efficient and prompt handling of all development requests.
  • Adhere to all regulatory compliance training inclusive of BSA/AML/OFAC and overall BSA/AML/OFAC compliance.
  • Lead efforts to continuously refine QA processes, incorporating feedback from retrospectives and post-release reviews
  • Perform other related duties as requested and special projects as assigned.
  • Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, objectivity, and the ability to provide constructive technical feedback.
  • Maintain the highest ethical standards.

Requirements:

  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, quality assurance, quality control, risk-based testing, defect management, and release validation.
  • Proficiency reviewing .NET applications and object-oriented code using C# or VB.NET; familiarity with ASP.NET, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, or jQuery.
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, SOAP or web services, integrations, microservices, and distributed application workflows.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and Microsoft SQL Server, including validation of queries, stored procedures, database objects, data integrity, and SSIS packages.
  • Experience with source control, pull requests, branching practices, code review tools, integrated development environments, and Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with tools such as Postman, Selenium and Playwright
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, application deployment, configuration management, rollback validation, and production-readiness controls.

  • Ability to create clear test documentation, reproduce technical issues, evaluate remediation, and communicate risk to technical and business stakeholders.

  • Experience with financial services applications, regulatory environments, performance testing, application monitoring, and AI-assisted development controls is desirable.

jobs.title: Professional Services - Canada
jobs.excerpt: Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data.
jobs.description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

About the Role

Our customers with the most demanding deployments subscribe to Advanced Services. These are the enterprises where Solace is carrying something the business cannot do without, and where an outage is a business event rather than a support ticket. They pay for a higher standard of service, and the Service Owner is accountable.

You carry a portfolio of these customers and you own their experience of Solace: how well we understand their environment, how quickly problems get found, how clearly we explain what we are doing about them, and whether the platform keeps up with where their business is heading. This is a continuous relationship rather than a project, and it does not get handed off at the end of a phase. It is yours.

What You’ll Do

Own the customer relationship

  • Be the named technical contact for a portfolio of Advanced Services customers, and the person inside Solace who understands their environment best
  • Build the kind of relationship where their architects call you before they make a decision rather than after
  • Report on service quality and the health of their estate in a way both their engineers and their leadership can act on
  • Advise them on where the Solace platform is going and which parts of it are worth their attention
  • Maintain ownership of all open support tickets for your accounts, ensuring they are progressed, accurately documented, and closed promptly
  • Produce and deliver service status reports for every customer with different levels of detail and frequencies

Own the quality of the service

  • Keep your customers' environments under active watch so that problems are found by us and not reported by them
  • Take issues end to end: triage, resolution, documentation and follow-up, including the ones nobody else wants to pick up
  • Pull in Support, Engineering and the account team when an issue needs them, and stay accountable for the outcome until it is closed
  • Hold the line on the standard. If the service is falling short for one of your customers, you should be the first to know it and the first to say so

Get new customers to steady state

  • Lead onboarding for new Advanced Services customers and bring them to a stable, well-understood steady state
  • Keep onboarding on schedule and raise blockers early instead of letting a date slide quietly
  • Keep adjusting after go-live until the service fits how the customer actually operates

Keep customers ahead of their own growth

  • Watch capacity and growth trends and flag what is needed well before it becomes urgent
  • Keep deployments on supported, current versions and coordinate upgrades with as little disruption as possible
  • Track advisories and known issues, and tell each customer what, if anything, it means for them

Make the practice better

  • Improve the playbooks you work from, so the next customer and the next Service Owner both benefit
  • Feed product gaps, architecture problems and customer education needs back to Product, Account and Customer Success
  • teams
  • Give the account team the technical credibility they need at renewal, and speak up where a customer would genuinely benefit from more Solace. Growth here comes from running the service well and being straight about what you see, not from a pitch
  • Use and contribute to the team's operational tooling (Example, Python-based CLIs for monitoring management) to streamline day-to-day service delivery tasks

Location and travel

  • This role can be based anywhere in Canada, the United States or Mexico, and the work is mostly remote
  • Travel is light but not zero. Expect a handful of customer visits a year for onboarding, service reviews, and the situations where being in the room is worth more than being on the call

About You

  • You take ownership. You treat the customer's environment as yours to look after, and you follow up on things without being chased
  • You want to know why. Restarting the broker is not a root cause, and you are not satisfied until you can explain what actually happened
  • You can write and you can present. A report a director will read, and a troubleshooting call with their engineers, are both well within range
  • You work well without scaffolding. Several customer relationships at once, no two days the same, and nobody planning your week for you

What You’ll Bring to the Role

Required

  • 5+ years in professional services, technical consulting, managed services or enterprise infrastructure operations, in a customer facing role
  • Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture, messaging middleware or distributed systems (Solace, Kafka, IBM MQ,TIBCO, RabbitMQ or similar)
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts across the application, middleware, network and cloud layers, plus the discipline to write down what you found
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling
  • Scripting and automation ability, Python preferred
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes, containerized deployments and at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and business audiences
  • Highly organized and self-directed, comfortable running several customer relationships at the same time

Preferred

  • Direct Solace Platform experience in any form factor: Solace Cloud, software broker or appliance
  • Familiarity with MQTT, AMQP, JMS, REST and SMF
  • Background in managed services, SRE or a NOC, somewhere you were close to the customer rather than behind a queue
  • ITIL or a similar service management framework
  • Data center and hardware appliance experience
  • Hands-on experience with Datadog or an equivalent enterprise observability platform (dashboards, alerting, monitors, notebooks), Datadog specifically is a strong advantage
  • Spanish or French, which comes in handy across our Americas customer base

What Success Looks Like

In 3 Months

  • You know your customers' environments, teams and priorities in detail
  • They treat you as their contact at Solace, and reach out to you first
  • Your reporting goes out reliably and says something worth reading

In 6 Months

  • Problems are getting found and addressed before your customers notice them
  • You run onboarding for new customers and land it on schedule
  • Support, Customer Success and Sales treat you as the authority on your accounts

In 12 Months

  • Service quality across your portfolio is consistent, and does not depend on heroics
  • Capacity and upgrade planning happens well ahead of need rather than in reaction to it
  • Your customers renew and expand because they can point at what the service did for them

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

  • Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.
  • Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.
  • Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.
  • Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.
  • Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.
  • Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).
  • Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.
  • Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

You will bridge the gap between technical engineering teams and executive leadership, translating complex security threats into actionable business risk assessments. This role is pivotal in maintaining our competitive edge by ensuring that security is a core component of our brand and customer trust.

Key Areas of Responsibility:

  • Security Program Leadership: Design and manage the enterprise-wide information security strategy, aligning security initiatives with software development lifecycles (SDLC) and business goals.
  • Risk Management & Governance: Lead comprehensive risk assessments and vendor security reviews to identify and mitigate vulnerabilities across third-party integrations and internal systems.
  • DevSecOps Integration: Collaborate with engineering leads to integrate security automation (SAST/DAST) into CI/CD pipelines, promoting a "shift-left" security culture.
  • Incident Response Management: Oversee the security incident response program, acting as the primary point of escalation and lead investigator during high-priority security events.
  • Regulatory & Compliance Oversight: Ensure continuous compliance with industry-standard frameworks such as SOC2, ISO 27001, and GDPR, managing external audits and certification processes.
  • Security Awareness & Culture: Develop and lead security training programs for non-technical staff and specialized secure-coding workshops for developers.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Present regular security posture reports to senior management and board members, providing data-driven recommendations for security investments.

Objectives:

  • Maintain the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of our SaaS platforms and customer data environments.
  • Minimize organizational risk by implementing robust security controls across the software development and deployment processes.
  • Achieve and maintain industry-leading security certifications (e.g., SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001, NIST) along with compliance with our parent company’s policies
  • Foster a proactive security-first mindset across all departments through education and transparent reporting.

Skills:

  • Strategic Leadership: Ability to lead technical teams and influence organizational change without direct authority.
  • Complex Problem-Solving: Expert at analyzing evolving cyber threats and designing creative, scalable mitigation strategies.
  • Effective Communication: Translating deeply technical security vulnerabilities into business-impact terms for executive stakeholders.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of software-relevant compliance standards (NIST, SOC2, ISO).
  • Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with cloud security (AWS/Azure/GCP), containerization, and automated security testing tools.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Management Information Systems, or a related field.

Additional Attributes:

  • Innovative and creative thinking: Ability to anticipate future security trends and prepare the organization accordingly.
  • Composure: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and remain calm during active security incidents.
  • Strong attention to detail: Ensuring precision in security policy and implementation.
  • Empathy: Balances the need for strict security controls with developers' operational needs to remain productive.

Travel:

jobs.excerpt: Senior Security EngineerReports To: Director of EngineeringSummaryAxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote Senior Security Engineer to own security and compliance across our SaaS platform, the market-leading product powering the home care industry.
jobs.description:
Senior Security Engineer

Reports To: Director of Engineering

Summary

AxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote Senior Security Engineer to own security and compliance across our SaaS platform, the market-leading product powering the home care industry.

This is not a job where you'll write policies that nobody reads. You'll work directly with product engineering teams, embedded in how we build software, shaping our security posture. You'll own engineering's side of our SOC 2 Type II compliance program, lead us toward HITRUST certification, and keep our AWS infrastructure, Docker pipelines, and PHP/React codebase hardened as we move fast.

We're also building AI-powered products on top of Amazon Bedrock and our own machine learning models, and we use AI heavily in how we develop software. That creates new kinds of risk that most security playbooks don't cover yet. We need someone who's thinking about this already and building the guardrails that agents need to write secure software.

Home care agencies trust us to run their business every day. Their data includes protected health information. We need someone who takes that personally.

What You'll Do

Own AxisCare Engineering's security program as an individual contributor. Continually improve our security standards as threats evolve, strengthen the systems that enforce them, and work directly with engineers to close gaps.

Own engineering's share of SOC 2 Type II compliance: control design, evidence collection, audit prep, and gap remediation. Chart the path toward HITRUST certification, mapping what we already have and building what we don't.

Threat-model our application and infrastructure. We run a PHP/React modular monolith on AWS, managed with Terraform, deployed in Docker containers, backed by MySQL in RDS. Raise the bar on this stack's security (IAM policies, VPC design, secrets management, container security, database access controls) and keep raising it as the architecture evolves.

Own and improve our security scanning program. Tune findings, cut false positives, and make sure scan results turn into developer action.

Assess and mitigate the security risks inherent in our AI products: prompt injection, data leakage, model output filtering, abuse scenarios. Set guardrails for AI-assisted development workflows so the team ships faster without opening new attack surface.

Strengthen our detection and response capabilities: logging, alerting, incident response playbooks. Coordinate penetration tests, track findings, and drive remediation.

Keep our security policies clear, current, and short. Train developers on secure practices without burying them in process.

What We're Looking For

A builder, not just an auditor. You've built or run a security program inside a product company, not just assessed one from the outside. You can point to systems, controls, and habits you put in place that made a real difference.

A technical peer to engineers. You read code, read Terraform, and talk to developers in their language. When you flag a vulnerability, you can explain the fix, not just the finding.

A pragmatist. You understand that we need to ship. You weigh tradeoffs, probability, and impact, not by saying no to everything.

A strong writer. Remote work demands it, and clear writing is clear thinking. You'll write policies, incident reports, audit narratives, and messages to engineers explaining why something matters. Clarity counts.

An AI-aware security thinker. You're already wrestling with what AI means for security: new attack surfaces, new tooling, new ways that development workflows create risk.

Experience required:

  • 5+ years in application security, infrastructure security, or security engineering at a SaaS company
  • Hands-on experience with AWS security (IAM, VPC, Security Groups, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty)
  • Experience owning or heavily contributing to the engineering side of SOC 2 Type II compliance
  • Familiarity with container security (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)
  • Solid grasp of web application security fundamentals (OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC)
  • Experience securing AI/ML systems or LLM-powered products
  • Concrete examples of how you've used AI to improve your own security work: automating compliance tasks, speeding up threat analysis, building detection rules faster, or something we haven't thought of
  • Able to work remotely from the Eastern, Central, or Mountain time zones
  • Qualified to work in the United States or Canada

What We'd Be Excited to Find

  • Experience building or maintaining HIPAA-compliant or HITRUST-certified environments
  • CISSP, OSCP, or AWS Security Specialty certification
  • Background in penetration testing or red team work

Working Conditions

  • Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals.

Compensation and Equipment

  • Salary (TBD based on job experience and skill level)
  • Medical insurance is covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
  • Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment

How to Apply

Apply with a brief resume and either a written or video cover letter.

We review the cover letter before anything else in your application, so this really matters. This is your single biggest opportunity to improve your chances, and video submissions go right to the front of the line.

Prompt: How has AI changed the security landscape you work in: what's gotten easier, what's gotten harder, and how have you adapted? Tell us about a security program, control, or hard problem you're proud of owning. Tell us why this position is the one you've been hoping to find.

Written: No more than 600 words. We're looking for clarity of thought and strong communication. Use AI if you want, but don't send slop.

Video: 1–2 minutes, linked in the "Website, Blog, or Portfolio" section of your application. Doesn't need to be highly produced. We care about how you think and communicate.

We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds and every walk of life to apply. Every person on our team brings their own unique perspective, and it's what makes our products better and our work more rewarding. We're eager to support you so that you can ship work you're proud of.

Candidates only. No recruiters, please.

About AxisCare

According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non-medical (also referred to as non-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.

AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more user-friendly and mobile-compatible solution. Our product is a web-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 6 other countries. We are a fast-growing company seeking high-performing individuals looking for a fast-paced, autonomous working environment.

Build the platform that makes AI customer conversations accountable

Are you a Staff or Principal-level engineer who thrives on building complex systems from the ground up?

We're looking for a Founding Platform Engineer to help architect and build the core platform of an early-stage AI startup tackling one of the biggest emerging challenges in enterprise technology: ensuring AI-powered customer interactions are safe, compliant, reliable, and accountable.

As the first senior engineer, you'll work directly with the CTO, take ownership of the platform's architecture, and write production code while establishing the engineering foundations for future growth.

This is an opportunity to shape both the technology and the engineering culture of a company from its earliest stages.

The opportunity

Enterprises are deploying AI agents to handle customer conversations across voice, chat, email, and SMS. But as these systems take on increasingly sensitive interactions, businesses need more than capable AI — they need independent oversight, measurable quality and reliable evidence that their AI systems meet the standards required of them.

The company is building an AI monitoring and assurance platform that evaluates customer interactions against applicable regulations and business requirements, helping enterprises identify issues early, reduce risk, and demonstrate accountability.

You'll help build the infrastructure that makes this possible, from high-volume conversation processing to enterprise-grade auditability and security.

What you'll own

Core platform architecture

  • Design and build the backend systems that power a scalable, multi-tenant SaaS platform.
  • Establish robust APIs, data models, and distributed processing architecture.
  • Make key technical decisions that will shape the platform as the company grows.

Conversation pipelines and integrations

  • Build pipelines that transform raw conversations into structured, enriched, and scorable data.
  • Develop integrations with contact-centre platforms, ticketing systems and direct-upload workflows.
  • Help evolve the voice-processing architecture, including transcription and audio ingestion.

Auditability and data provenance

  • Implement immutable versioning for scoring rubrics and configurations.
  • Build tamper-evident audit trails and preserve evidence throughout the conversation lifecycle.
  • Ensure historical results can be reproduced and explained, including why a particular interaction received its original score.

Infrastructure and engineering excellence

  • Own infrastructure as code, CI/CD, environment management and deployment workflows.
  • Establish observability, logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, secrets management and disaster recovery.
  • Take responsibility for production reliability, incident response and operational readiness.

Scale, performance and reliability

  • Build reliable data storage, retention and queueing systems.
  • Implement idempotent processing and reprocessing to prevent duplicate work and unnecessary AI inference costs.
  • Define service-level objectives and help scale the platform from early pilots to millions of interactions per month.

Security and enterprise readiness

  • Build tenant isolation, permissions, customer-specific configuration, and entitlements into the platform.
  • Implement sensitive-data handling and redaction before conversations reach AI models.
  • Support evidence exports, SOC 2 readiness, and enterprise security reviews.

What we're looking for

jobs.description:
The React (Next.js) Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, high-performance web applications using React.js and Next.js. This role involves building production-ready features, integrating with backend/BFF APIs, ensuring high code quality, and implementing best practices in performance, accessibility, and security.

The developer will work closely with the React Lead, UX/UI designers, QA, DevOps, and backend teams to deliver modern web applications aligned with enterprise architecture and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Frontend Development

  • Develop responsive, interactive, and accessible web pages using React.js and Next.js.
  • Implement server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and incremental static regeneration (ISR) as required.
  • Build reusable components, custom hooks, and libraries.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.

2. Next.js Framework Implementation

  • Utilize Next.js features effectively:
    • getServerSideProps, getStaticProps, getStaticPaths
    • API routes and middleware
    • Dynamic routing, layouts, and nested routes
  • Optimize hydration, lazy-loading, and client/server data fetching.
  • Implement efficient caching and prefetching strategies for faster UX.

3. State Management & Data Handling

  • Manage application state using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil, or Context API + Hooks.
  • Integrate with REST or GraphQL APIs from BFF/backend layers.
  • Handle errors, loading states, and fallback UI for smoother user experiences.

4. UI/UX & Design System Integration

  • Work with designers to implement pixel-perfect UIs aligned with the enterprise design system.
  • Integrate components from Storybook or other design libraries.
  • Implement accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and responsive design best practices.

5. Performance Optimization

  • Monitor and optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS).
  • Reduce bundle size using code splitting, lazy loading, and tree shaking.
  • Optimize rendering performance and memory usage.

6. Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Write unit and integration tests using:
    • Jest
    • React Testing Library
  • Support end-to-end testing with Cypress or Playwright.
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain high-quality, maintainable code.

7. Security & Best Practices

  • Implement secure coding practices (input validation, XSS prevention, secure storage of tokens).
  • Follow best practices for API integration, routing, and data handling.
  • Collaborate with security teams to comply with enterprise security policies.

8. Collaboration & Agile Practices

  • Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate closely with React Lead, QA, DevOps, backend/BFF developers, and product teams.
  • Communicate technical challenges and propose solutions clearly.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years experience in frontend development.
  • Strong expertise in:
    • React.js (Hooks, Context, Custom Hooks)
    • Next.js (SSR, SSG, ISR, Routing, API routes)
    • TypeScript
    • HTML5, CSS3, Sass, Styled Components, Tailwind CSS
  • Experience with:
    • State management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Recoil)
    • RESTful APIs / GraphQL
    • Performance optimization and debugging
    • Unit & integration testing frameworks (Jest, RTL)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern build tools (Webpack, Vite).

Soft Skills

  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to debug complex issues.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Detail-oriented with focus on high-quality, maintainable code.

Education & Background

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Portfolio of web applications using React and Next.js preferred.

  • You have related production experience with any programming language

  • You're happy working on your own as well as collaborating within a team, understanding that we ultimately operate as a unit, not as individuals

  • Someone comfortable working in an ambiguous environment; we’re early-stage

🔑 What the job involves

  • Collaborating: We’re remote but highly collaborative in nature

  • Shipping value: We’re in the early stages of building the product, so we need to get features out there, get feedback, and iterate

  • Improving our internal developer experience: In order to allow us all to be efficient

  • Not just writing code: We write proposals to gather feedback on upcoming work and document our decisions

jobs.excerpt: About Greenlight RentGreenlight Rent, formerly Rhino + Jetty, is making housing more affordable and accessible for millions of renters each year.
jobs.description:
About Greenlight Rent

Greenlight Rent, formerly Rhino + Jetty, is making housing more affordable and accessible for millions of renters each year. We're the market-leading rental housing platform building simpler, more accessible ways for people to move into homes — and for property managers to lease with confidence.

Our technology removes friction from the move-in process, lowers upfront costs for renters, and helps property managers make faster, more accurate decisions. We support a network of 3 million rental units nationwide and work with 47 of the NMHC Top 100 property owners, including Greystar, Brookfield, Asset Living, UDR, and more.

We pioneered security deposit insurance and continue to push the industry forward with a growing suite of products — from deposit management to lease guarantees and loss-of-employment protection. We're growing quickly, tackling real problems at scale, and building technology that's changing how renting works.

The role

As a Staff Engineer on our data team, you'll be a senior software engineer who builds the systems that produce, move and serve our data, not just the pipelines and queries on top of them. You'll set technical direction for how data flows through Greenlight Rent, from the application services and APIs that generate it to the warehouse, models and tools the business runs on. You'll partner with product, finance and operations to turn rental-housing problems into reliable software and trustworthy data.

Our teams are small, about three engineers each, and AI tools let every one of them cover a lot of ground. Staff Engineers here stay hands-on: most of the week goes to building, and the rest to leading the team and growing the people on it.

What you'll do

  • Design and build the data foundations of Greenlight Rent: event and data models, ingestion from our application databases and partner integrations (property management systems, payment providers), and the warehouse and transformation layer
  • Write production application code too: the services, APIs and jobs that generate and use data, not only what happens downstream of them
  • Own measurable outcomes with your product and business partners, and make the scope and sequencing calls that get you there
  • Own the reliability and correctness of the data the business depends on, including monthly close, reporting and partner data
  • Write high-quality code and set standards for testing, code review, observability and data quality, including when AI-generated code needs a closer look
  • Make pragmatic build-vs-buy and tradeoff decisions, and document them clearly
  • Mentor engineers through pairing, design reviews and feedback, and lead a few direct reports
  • Keep sensitive financial and personal data secure and compliant

What you bring

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering, including technical leadership at the senior or staff level
  • A software engineer first: deep expertise in at least one modern backend language (e.g., Python, Ruby, Go, TypeScript or Java), and a record of building and shipping application systems, not only data pipelines
  • Strong data engineering: SQL, data modeling, warehouses (e.g., Snowflake or BigQuery), transformation (e.g., dbt) and orchestration (e.g., Prefect or Airflow)
  • Experience designing and scaling APIs, distributed systems and relational databases
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP) and CI/CD
  • Product sense: you care about why something gets built and whether it worked, not just how it's built
  • Fluency with AI coding tools, and the judgment to know when their output isn't good enough
  • A track record of leading ambiguous, high-impact projects to completion
  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical partners

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, insurtech, payments or proptech
  • Familiarity with regulated environments (e.g., SOC 2, PCI, consumer-finance rules)
  • Experience building 0-to-1 products or data platforms at a startup or growth-stage company
  • Experience managing engineers, or a wish to grow into it

Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary Range: $195,000 - $235,000

Greenlight Rent has partnered with a number of compensation benchmarking tools to determine competitive and fair market pay bands for our size and stage. Our goal is to ensure each employee is paid equitably and competitively while also maintaining a consistent and standardized methodology.

Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors including qualifications for the role, experience level and balancing internal equity relative to other teammates.

Base salary is just one part of our Total Rewards Package here at Greenlight Rent. In connection with this position, we also offer:

  • Competitive cash compensation package including base salary, milestone based bonus, and other financial perks
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage (up to 90% employer contribution) - eligible from your start date
  • 401(k), HSA, Life & Disability Insurance Coverage ($0 employee contribution for additional insurances)
  • Unlimited PTO Policy
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave
  • Stock option plan to give our employees a direct stake in Greenlight’s success
  • Remote-first work culture with opportunities to collaborate as a team in person
  • Monthly lifestyle stipend to fit your needs (meals, wellness, co-working)
Salary: $195,000 - $235,000
